missing = function(arg, arg2, arg3)

hubUrl = function(arg)
	return GITHUB_PROXY_BASE .. "hub/" .. tostring(arg or ""):gsub("^/+", "")

getProxyCrypt = function()
	local crypt_ = syn and syn.crypt
	if missing("table", crypt_, nil) then
		return crypt_
	end
	return missing("table", crypt, nil)
end

canHubEncrypt = function()
	local flag = missing("table", getProxyCrypt(), nil) ~= nil
	local flag2

	if flag then
		flag2 = missing("function", bit32 and bit32.bxor, nil) ~= nil
	else
		flag2 = flag
	end

	return flag2
end

cryptBase64Encode = function(arg, arg2)
	local v_ = missing("function", arg and arg.base64encode, nil)

	if not v_ then
		v_ = missing("function", arg and arg.base64_encode, nil)
	end

	local v_2

	if v_ then
		v_2 = v_
	else
		v_2 = missing("function", arg and arg.encode, nil)
	end

	if v_2 then
		return v_2(arg2)
	end
	return nil
end

chachaU32 = function(arg)
	return arg % 4294967296
end

chachaRot = function(arg, arg2)
	local n = arg % 4294967296
	return chachaU32(bit32.lshift(n, arg2) + bit32.rshift(n, 32 - arg2))
end

chachaQr = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
	arg[arg2] = chachaU32(arg[arg2] + arg[arg3])
	arg[arg5] = chachaRot(bit32.bxor(arg[arg5], arg[arg2]), 16)
	arg[arg4] = chachaU32(arg[arg4] + arg[arg5])
	arg[arg3] = chachaRot(bit32.bxor(arg[arg3], arg[arg4]), 12)
	arg[arg2] = chachaU32(arg[arg2] + arg[arg3])
	arg[arg5] = chachaRot(bit32.bxor(arg[arg5], arg[arg2]), 8)
	arg[arg4] = chachaU32(arg[arg4] + arg[arg5])
	arg[arg3] = chachaRot(bit32.bxor(arg[arg3], arg[arg4]), 7)
end

chachaBytesToU32 = function(arg, arg2)
	local n = arg2 or 1
	local v_, v_2, v_3, v_4 = string.byte(arg, n, n + 3)
	return v_ + v_2 * 256 + v_3 * 65536 + v_4 * 16777216
end

chachaU32ToBytes = function(arg)
	return string.char(arg % 256, math.floor(arg / 256) % 256, math.floor(arg / 65536) % 256, math.floor(arg / 16777216) % 256)
end

chachaBlock = function(arg)
	local v_ = table.create(16)

	for i = 1, 16 do
		v_[i] = arg[i]
	end

	for i = 1, 20 do
		if i % 2 == 1 then
			chachaQr(v_, 1, 5, 9, 13)
			chachaQr(v_, 2, 6, 10, 14)
			chachaQr(v_, 3, 7, 11, 15)
			chachaQr(v_, 4, 8, 12, 16)
		else
			chachaQr(v_, 1, 6, 11, 16)
			chachaQr(v_, 2, 7, 12, 13)
			chachaQr(v_, 3, 8, 9, 14)
			chachaQr(v_, 4, 5, 10, 15)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 16 do
		arg[i] = chachaU32(arg[i] + v_[i])
	end
end

chacha20Crypt = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
	if #arg == 0 then
		return ""
	end
	local str = #arg2 == 32 and "expand 32-byte k" or "expand 16-byte k"
	local v_ = table.create(#arg)
	local n = 1
	arg4 = arg4 or 1

	while n <= #arg do
		local v_2 = table.create(16, 0)

		for i = 0, 3 do
			v_2[i + 1] = chachaBytesToU32(str, i * 4 + 1)
		end

		for i = 0, 3 do
			v_2[5 + i] = chachaBytesToU32(arg2, i * 4 + 1)
		end

		if #arg2 == 32 then
			for i = 0, 3 do
				v_2[9 + i] = chachaBytesToU32(arg2, 16 + i * 4 + 1)
			end
		else
			for i = 0, 3 do
				v_2[9 + i] = chachaBytesToU32(arg2, i * 4 + 1)
			end
		end

		v_2[13] = arg4

		for i = 0, 2 do
			v_2[14 + i] = chachaBytesToU32(arg3, i * 4 + 1)
		end

		chachaBlock(v_2)
		local tbl = {}

		for i = 1, 16 do
			tbl[i] = chachaU32ToBytes(v_2[i])
		end

		local str2 = table.concat(tbl)
		local n2 = math.min(64, #arg - n + 1)

		for i = 0, n2 - 1 do
			local n3 = n + i
			local byte = string.byte
			v_[n3] = string.char(bit32.bxor(string.byte(arg, n + i), byte(str2, i + 1)))
		end

		n += n2
		arg4 += 1
	end

	return table.concat(v_)
end

CHACHA_KEY = "cte~;2*pXH!uj<r;hC3*DkCF-N9&f~#P"

encryptAuthPayload = function(arg, arg2)
	if not canHubEncrypt() then
		return nil
	end
	local v_ = getProxyCrypt()
	local v_2 = chacha20Crypt(arg, CHACHA_KEY, arg2, 1)
	return cryptBase64Encode(v_, v_2)
end

buildProxyHeaders = function(arg)
	local str = arg:sub(#GITHUB_PROXY_BASE + 1)
	if str == "" or not canHubEncrypt() then
		return nil
	end
	local str2 = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false):gsub("-", ""):sub(1, 12)
	local v_ = encryptAuthPayload(game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({ m = "GET", path = str, rid = str2 }), str2)
	if not v_ then
		return nil
	end
	return { ["X-SNP-Enc"] = "1", ["X-SNP-Nonce"] = str2, ["X-SNP-Auth"] = v_ }
end

isVpsNetworkError = function(arg)
	local str = tostring(arg or "")
	return str:find("Timedout", 1, true) or str:find("ConnectFail", 1, true) or str:find("DnsResolve", 1, true) or str:find("Connection refused", 1, true)
end

markVpsBlocked = function(arg)
	if not getgenv()._SNP_VPS_BLOCKED and isVpsNetworkError(arg) then
		getgenv()._SNP_VPS_BLOCKED = true
		fn("vps_blocked", tostring(arg), "github-only for rest of session")

		if type(getgenv().SNP_flushLoadLog) == "function" then
			getgenv().SNP_flushLoadLog()
		end
	end
end

hubLoadUsesGithubOnly = function()
	if getgenv()._SNP_VPS_BLOCKED == true then
		return true
	end
	local snpLoadSource = getgenv()._SNP_LOAD_SOURCE
	return type(snpLoadSource) == "string" and snpLoadSource:find("github", 1, true) ~= nil
end

fetchUrl = function(arg, headers, timeout)
	local function fn2()
		local tbl = { Url = arg, Method = "GET" }

		if headers and next(headers) ~= nil then
			tbl.Headers = headers
		end

		if timeout and timeout > 0 then
			tbl.Timeout = timeout
		end

		return tbl
	end

	local result, str

	if type(request) == "function" then
		local ok

		ok, result = pcall(function()
			return request(fn2())
		end)

		str = "request"
		if not ok then
			return false, nil, nil, "request", result
		end
	elseif type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.request) == "function" then
		local ok

		ok, result = pcall(function()
			return syn.request(fn2())
		end)

		str = "syn.request"
		if not ok then
			return false, nil, nil, "syn.request", result
		end
	else
		if not (type(http) == "table" and type(http.request) == "function") then
			if headers then
				return false, nil, nil, "blocked", "auth headers need request/syn/http"
			end

			local ok, result2 = pcall(function()
				return game:HttpGet(arg, true)
			end)

			if ok and type(result2) == "string" and result2 ~= "" then
				return true, result2, 200, "game:HttpGet", nil
			end
			return false, nil, nil, "game:HttpGet", result2 or "HttpGet failed"
		end

		local ok

		ok, result = pcall(function()
			return http.request(fn2())
		end)

		str = "http.request"
		if not ok then
			return false, nil, nil, "http.request", result
		end
	end

	if not result then
		return false, nil, nil, str, "empty response object"
	end
	local statusCode = result.StatusCode
	local body = result.Body
	if statusCode == 404 then
		body = type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" and body or "404: Not Found"
		return true, body, 404, str, nil
	end

	if statusCode == 401 or statusCode == 403 or statusCode == 429 or statusCode == 502 then
		return false, body, statusCode, str, "http " .. tostring(statusCode)
	end

	if statusCode and statusCode >= 200 and statusCode < 300 and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
		return true, body, statusCode, str, nil
	end
	return false, body, statusCode, str, "bad response"
end

validateHubBody = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
		return false, "empty response"
	end

	if arg:find("<!DOCTYPE", 1, true) or arg:find("<html", 1, true) then
		return false, "HTML error page (blocked or 404)"
	end
	return true, arg
end

downloadGithubRaw = function(arg, arg2)
	local str = tostring(arg or ""):gsub("^/+", "")
	arg2 = arg2 or str

	for i, v_ in ipairs(GITHUB_RAW_SOURCES) do
		local str2 = v_ .. str
		local now = tick()
		fn("github_try", arg2, "mirror=" .. i, str2)
		local v_2, v_3, v_4, v_5, v_6 = fetchUrl(str2, nil)
		fn("github_result", arg2, "mirror=" .. i, "ok=" .. tostring(v_2), "code=" .. tostring(v_4), "transport=" .. tostring(v_5), "ms=" .. tostring(math.floor((tick() - now) * 1000)), "bytes=" .. tostring(type(v_3) == "string" and #v_3 or 0), "err=" .. tostring(v_6))

		if v_2 then
			local v_7, v_8 = validateHubBody(v_3)
			if v_7 then
				fn("github_ok", arg2, "mirror=" .. i)
				return true, v_8, "github#" .. i, v_5
			end
		end
	end

	return false, "all GitHub mirrors failed", nil, nil
end

downloadHub = function(arg, arg2)
	local v_ = arg2 or arg
	local str = tostring(arg or ""):gsub("^/+", "")

	if getgenv()._SNP_VPS_BLOCKED ~= true then
		local v_2 = hubUrl(str)
		local exitTo = nil
		local v_3, v_4, v_5, str2

		for i = 1, 2 do
			local now = tick()

			if i == 1 then
				fn("vps_try", v_, v_2, "timeout=" .. tostring(VPS_HTTP_TIMEOUT) .. "s")
			else
				fn("vps_retry_nonce", v_, "try=" .. i, "new one-shot nonce after 401")
			end

			local v_6 = VPS_HTTP_TIMEOUT
			local v_7
			v_7, v_3, v_4, v_5, str2 = fetchUrl(v_2, buildProxyHeaders(v_2), v_6)
			fn("vps_result", v_, "ok=" .. tostring(v_7), "code=" .. tostring(v_4), "transport=" .. tostring(v_5), "ms=" .. tostring(math.floor((tick() - now) * 1000)), "bytes=" .. tostring(type(v_3) == "string" and #v_3 or 0), "err=" .. tostring(str2))

			if v_7 and v_4 ~= 404 then
				exitTo = 1
				break
			elseif not (v_4 == 401 and i < 2) then
				exitTo = 2
				break
			end
		end

		if exitTo == 1 then
			local v_6, v_7 = validateHubBody(v_3)

			if v_6 then
				getgenv()._SNP_LOAD_SOURCE = "vps"
				fn("vps_ok", v_)
				return true, v_7, "vps", v_5
			end

			fn("vps_invalid", v_, v_7, "-> github fallback")
		elseif exitTo == 2 then
			str2 = str2 or "empty response"
			local str3

			if v_4 then
				str3 = str2 .. " (http " .. tostring(v_4) .. ")"
			else
				str3 = str2
			end

			if isVpsNetworkError(str3) then
				markVpsBlocked(str3)
			end

			fn("vps_fail", v_, str3, "-> github fallback")
		end
	else
		fn("vps_skip", v_, "blocked host — github only")
	end

	local v_2, v_3, v_4, v_5 = downloadGithubRaw(str, v_)

	if v_2 then
		getgenv()._SNP_LOAD_SOURCE = v_4 or "github"
		fn("load_source", v_, v_4 or "github")
		return true, v_3, v_4 or "github", v_5
	end

	fn("all_failed", v_, tostring(v_3))
	return false, tostring(v_3), nil, nil
end

hasLuraphMarker = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
		return false
	end
	local str = arg:sub(1, 16384)
	if str:find("Luraph Obfuscator v14%.", 1) then
		return true
	end

	if str:find("protected using Luraph", 1, true) then
		return true
	end

	if str:find("https://lura%.ph/", 1) then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

hubLeakKick = function()
	error("SNPWARE: script init failed (E-4821)")
end

canHubFileExec = function()
	return type(writefile) == "function" and type(loadfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" and type(delfile) == "function"
end

runHubBodyViaLoadfile = function(arg, arg2)
	local str = ("SNPWARE/_hub_%s_%s.lua"):format(tostring(arg2 or ""):gsub("^/+", ""):gsub("[^%w]+", "_"):sub(1, 48), tostring(os.time()):sub(-6))

	if type(makefolder) == "function" then
		pcall(makefolder, "SNPWARE")
	end

	writefile(str, arg)

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return loadfile(str)()
	end)

	pcall(delfile, str)

	if not ok then
		error(result)
	end

	return result
end

installHubLoadstringCompat = function(arg)
	local v_ = loadstring
	if type(v_) ~= "function" then
		return function()
		end
	end
	local flag = type(load) == "function" and load or nil
	local loadstring_ = getgenv().loadstring

	getgenv().loadstring = function(arg2, arg3)
		local v_2 = arg3 or arg
		local v_3, v_4 = v_(arg2, v_2)
		if v_3 then
			return v_3
		end
		local str = tostring(v_4 or "")
		local flag2 = flag

		if flag then
			local pos = str:find("bytecode", 1, true)

			if pos then
				flag2 = pos
			else
				flag2 = type(arg2) == "string" and arg2:byte(1) == 27
			end
		end

		if flag2 then
			local v_5
			v_5, v_4 = flag(arg2, v_2)
			if v_5 then
				return v_5
			end
		end

		return nil, v_4
	end

	return function()
		getgenv().loadstring = loadstring_
	end
end

runHubBody = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	local flag = tbl[tostring(arg2 or ""):gsub("^/+", "")] == true

	if flag and not hasLuraphMarker(arg) then
		hubLeakKick()
	end

	local str = "@hub/" .. tostring(arg2 or ""):gsub("^/+", "")
	local v_ = installHubLoadstringCompat(str)

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local chunk, v_2 = loadstring(arg, str)

		if not chunk then
			error(v_2 or "compile failed")
		end

		return chunk()
	end)

	v_()
	if ok then
		return result, "loadstring"
	end

	if tostring(result or ""):find("bytecode", 1, true) ~= nil and canHubFileExec() then
		if flag and not hasLuraphMarker(arg) then
			hubLeakKick()
		end

		local v_2 = fn
		local str2 = tostring(arg2 or "")
		local v_3 = tostring
		v_2("script_exec_fallback", str2:gsub("^/+", ""), "loadfile", v_3(arg3))
		return runHubBodyViaLoadfile(arg, arg2), "loadfile"
	end

	error(result)
end

runHubScript = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	arg2 = arg2 or arg
	local n = getgenv()._SNP_VPS_BLOCKED == true and 2 or arg3 or 5
	local result = nil

	for i = 1, n do
		local ok

		ok, result = pcall(function()
			local v_, v_2, v_3, v_4 = downloadHub(arg, arg2)

			if not v_ then
				error(v_2 or "download failed")
			end

			local v_5, v_6 = runHubBody(v_2, arg, v_4)
			fn("script_exec mode=" .. tostring(v_6), arg2)
			return v_5
		end)

		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		fn("script_fail", arg2, "attempt=" .. i, tostring(result))

		if i < n then
			task.wait(1 + i * 0.75)
		end
	end

	fn("script_giveup", arg2, tostring(result))

	if type(getgenv().SNP_flushLoadLog) == "function" then
		getgenv().SNP_flushLoadLog()
	end

	return false, result
end

		tbl3[arg] = nil
		tbl5[arg] = (tbl5[arg] or 0) + n2
		windUIDebug.Log("mark", string.format("end %s dt=%.4fs", tostring(arg), n2), arg2)
		return n2
	end

	windUIDebug.SampleFps = function()
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return game:GetService("RunService")
		end)

		if not ok or not result then
			return
		end

		if n > 0 and clock() - n < 0.25 then
			return
		end
		n = clock()
		local n2 = 0

		pcall(function()
			n2 = 1 / result.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end)

		if n2 > 0 and n2 < 1000 then
			tbl6[#tbl6 + 1] = n2

			if #tbl6 > 40 then
				table.remove(tbl6, 1)
			end

			local n3 = 0

			for i = 1, #tbl6 do
				n3 += tbl6[i]
			end

			windUIDebug.Log("fps", string.format("instant=%.1f avg=%.1f samples=%d", n2, n3 / #tbl6, #tbl6), { New = tbl4.New, SmoothYields = tbl4.SmoothYields })
		end
	end

	windUIDebug.DumpCounters = function(arg)
		local tbl7 = {}

		for k, v_2 in pairs(tbl4.NewByClass) do
			tbl7[#tbl7 + 1] = k .. "=" .. tostring(v_2)
		end

		table.sort(tbl7)

		windUIDebug.Log("counters", arg or "dump", {
			New = tbl4.New,
			SmoothYields = tbl4.SmoothYields,
			SmoothTracked = tbl4.SmoothTracked,
			SmoothReveal = tbl4.SmoothReveal,
			BeginSmooth = tbl4.BeginSmooth,
			DropdownRefresh = tbl4.DropdownRefresh,
			DropdownRefreshForced = tbl4.DropdownRefreshForced,
			DropdownItemsRendered = tbl4.DropdownItemsRendered,
			DropdownOpen = tbl4.DropdownOpen,

			TabSelect = tbl4.TabSelect,
			TabPark = tbl4.TabPark,

			CreateWindow = tbl4.CreateWindow,
		})

		if #tbl7 > 0 then
			windUIDebug.Log("counters.class", table.concat(tbl7, " "))
		end

		local tbl8 = {}

		for k, v_2 in pairs(tbl5) do
			tbl8[#tbl8 + 1] = string.format("%s=%.4fs", k, v_2)
		end

		table.sort(tbl8)

		if #tbl8 > 0 then
			windUIDebug.Log("phases", table.concat(tbl8, " "))
		end
	end

executor = function()
	if identifyexecutor then
		local ok, result, result2 = pcall(identifyexecutor)

		if ok and result then
			if result2 then
				return tostring(result) .. " " .. tostring(result2)
			end
			return tostring(result)
		end
	end

	if getexecutorname then
		local ok, result = pcall(getexecutorname)
		if ok and result then
			return tostring(result)
		end
	end

	if syn and syn.environment then
		return "Synapse"
	end

	if fluxus then
		return "Fluxus"
	end

	if KRNL_LOADED then
		return "KRNL"
	end

	if scriptable_lib or is_sirhurt_closure then
		return "SirHurt"
	end
	return "Executor"
end

snpTrimLogLines = function(arg, arg2)
	if type(arg) ~= "table" or #arg == 0 then
		return false
	end
	arg2 = arg2 or SNP_LOG_MAX_BYTES
	local n = 0

	for i = 1, #arg do
		n = n + #tostring(arg[i]) + 1
	end

	if n <= arg2 then
		return false
	end
	local n2 = math.floor(arg2 * (SNP_LOG_KEEP_RATIO or 0.4))
	local n3 = #arg
	local n4 = 0

	while n3 > 1 and n4 < n2 do
		n4 = n4 + #tostring(arg[n3]) + 1
		n3 -= 1
	end

	local tbl2 = {}

	for i = n3, #arg do
		tbl2[#tbl2 + 1] = arg[i]
	end

	for i = #arg, 1, -1 do
		arg[i] = nil
	end

	arg[1] = string.format("[%s] log buffer trimmed kept~%dB from %dB", os.date("%X"), n4, n)

	for i = 1, #tbl2 do
		arg[i + 1] = tbl2[i]
	end

	return true
end

snpRotateLogFile = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
		return false
	end

	if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local n = tonumber(arg3) or SNP_LOG_MAX_BYTES or 7340032
	local flag = false

	pcall(function()
		if type(isfile) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(isfile, arg)
			if not (ok and result) then
				return
			end
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(readfile, arg)
		if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" then
			return
		end

		if #result <= n then
			return
		end
		local str = string.sub(result, -math.floor(n * (SNP_LOG_KEEP_RATIO or 0.4)))
		local v_2 = string.find(str, "\n", 1, true)
		local str2

		if v_2 then
			str2 = string.sub(str, v_2 + 1)
		else
			str2 = str
		end

		writefile(arg, string.format("[%s] rotated %s was=%dB kept=%dB\n", tostring(arg2 or "LOG"), os.date("%X"), #result, #str2) .. str2)
		flag = true
	end)

	return flag
end

sanitizeHubConfigName = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local match = arg:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if not match or match == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local str = match:gsub("[\\/:*?\"<>|]", "")
	if str == "" then
		return nil
	end
	return str
end

hubConfigIsValidStorageName = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end

	if #arg <= #HUB_CONFIG_GEN_SUFFIX then
		return false
	end
	local v_2 = HUB_CONFIG_GEN_SUFFIX
	if arg:sub(-#HUB_CONFIG_GEN_SUFFIX) ~= v_2 then
		return false
	end
	local str = arg:sub(1, #arg - #HUB_CONFIG_GEN_SUFFIX)
	return sanitizeHubConfigName(str) == str
end

hubConfigDisplayName = function(arg)
	if not hubConfigIsValidStorageName(arg) then
		return nil
	end
	return arg:sub(1, #arg - #HUB_CONFIG_GEN_SUFFIX)
end

hubConfigStorageName = function(arg)
	local str = sanitizeHubConfigName(arg)
	if not str then
		return nil
	end
	local v_2 = HUB_CONFIG_GEN_SUFFIX

	if str:sub(-#HUB_CONFIG_GEN_SUFFIX) == v_2 then
		str = str:sub(1, #str - #HUB_CONFIG_GEN_SUFFIX)
	end

	if str == "" then
		return nil
	end
	return str .. HUB_CONFIG_GEN_SUFFIX
end

hubConfigPath = function(arg)
	local v_2 = hubConfigStorageName(arg)
	if not v_2 then
		return HUB_CONFIG_DIR .. ".json"
	end
	return HUB_CONFIG_DIR .. v_2 .. ".json"
end

hubConfigPurgeInvalidFiles = function()
	local tbl2 = {}
	if not listfiles or not isfile or not delfile then
		return tbl2
	end

	if not isfolder then
		return tbl2
	end

	if not isfolder(HUB_CONFIG_DIR) then
		if makefolder then
			pcall(makefolder, SNP_LOG_DIR)
			pcall(makefolder, HUB_CONFIG_DIR)
		end

		return tbl2
	end

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(listfiles(HUB_CONFIG_DIR)) do
		if type(v_2) == "string" then
			local match = v_2:match("([^\\/]+)%.json$")

			if match and isfile(v_2) and not hubConfigIsValidStorageName(match) then
				configDbg("INFO", "purge", "delete old-generation config file", { path = v_2, storageName = match, needSuffix = HUB_CONFIG_GEN_SUFFIX })

				if pcall(delfile, v_2) then
					tbl2[#tbl2 + 1] = match
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return tbl2
end

		return

		return
	end

		ensureSnpLogDir()
		writefile(arg, string.format("[%s] session %s\n", arg2, os.date("%X")))
	end)
end

snpWriteLogFile = function(arg, arg2)
	if not writefile or not arg2 or #arg2 == 0 then
		return
	end

	if type(snpDebugLogsEnabled) == "function" and not snpDebugLogsEnabled() then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		ensureSnpLogDir()
		snpTrimLogLines(arg2, SNP_LOG_MAX_BYTES)
		writefile(arg, table.concat(arg2, "\n") .. "\n")
		snpRotateLogFile(arg, arg:match("([^/\\]+)%.log$") or "LOG")
	end)
end

snpEncodeLogData = function(arg)
	if arg == nil then
		return ""
	end

	if type(arg) ~= "table" then
		return tostring(arg)
	end
	local tbl2 = {}

	for k, v_2 in pairs(arg) do
		local str

		if typeof(v_2) == "Vector3" then
			str = string.format("V3(%.4f,%.4f,%.4f)", v_2.X, v_2.Y, v_2.Z)
		elseif typeof(v_2) == "Color3" then
			local floor = math.floor
			local n = v_2.B * 255
			str = string.format("RGB(%d,%d,%d)", math.floor(v_2.R * 255), math.floor(v_2.G * 255), floor(n))
		elseif type(v_2) == "table" then
			str = snpEncodeLogData(v_2)
		else
			str = tostring(v_2)
		end

		tbl2[#tbl2 + 1] = tostring(k) .. "=" .. str
	end

	table.sort(tbl2)
	return "{" .. table.concat(tbl2, ", ") .. "}"
end

end

	local v_2 = tostring
	local str = string.format("[%s][%s][%s] %s", os.date("%X"), tostring(arg), tostring(arg2), v_2(arg3))

	if arg4 ~= nil then
		str ..= " | " .. snpEncodeLogData(arg4)
	end

	if not writefile then
		return
	end
	table.insert(configLogLines, str)

	if not configLogFlushQueued then
		configLogFlushQueued = true

		task.defer(function()
			configLogFlushQueued = false
			flushConfigLog()
		end)
	end
end

USER_ACTION_LOG_FILE = SNP_LOG_DIR .. "/UserActions_Debug.log"
userActionLogLines = {}

	snpWriteLogFile(USER_ACTION_LOG_FILE, userActionLogLines)

userActionWrite = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	local v_2 = snpEncodeLogData(arg3)
	if userActionLast[arg] == v_2 then
		return
	end
	userActionLast[arg] = v_2
	userActionLogLines[#userActionLogLines + 1] = string.format("[UI] %s %s %s=%s", os.date("%X"), tostring(arg2), tostring(arg), v_2)

	if not userActionLogFlushQueued then
		userActionLogFlushQueued = true

		task.defer(function()
			userActionLogFlushQueued = false
			flushUserActionLog()
		end)
	end
end

userActionRecord = function(arg, arg2, ...)
	local v_2 = table.pack(...)
	if hubConfigLoading then
		return
	end

	if not writefile then
		return
	end

	if type(snpDebugLogsEnabled) == "function" and not snpDebugLogsEnabled() then
		return
	end
	local value = select("#", ...)
	local str

	if value == 0 then
		str = "(pressed)"
	elseif value == 1 then
		str = v_2[1]
	else
		str = { table.unpack(v_2, 1, v_2.n) }
	end

	if USER_ACTION_CONTINUOUS[arg2] then
		userActionPending[arg] = { kind = arg2, value = str }

		if not userActionTimer[arg] then
			userActionTimer[arg] = true

			task.delay(USER_ACTION_DEBOUNCE, function()
				userActionTimer[arg] = nil
				local v_3 = userActionPending[arg]
				userActionPending[arg] = nil

				if v_3 then
					userActionWrite(arg, v_3.kind, v_3.value)
				end
			end)
		end

		return
	end

	userActionWrite(arg, arg2, str)
end

hubInstallUserActionLogging = function(arg)
	if not Window or type(Window.PendingFlags) ~= "table" then
		return 0
	end

	if not userActionLogStarted then
		userActionLogStarted = true
		snpResetLogFile(USER_ACTION_LOG_FILE, "UI")
	end

	local n = 0

	for k, pendingFlag in pairs(Window.PendingFlags) do
		if type(pendingFlag) == "table" and type(pendingFlag.Callback) == "function" and not pendingFlag.__snpUserLogged then
			pendingFlag.__snpUserLogged = true
			local callback = pendingFlag.Callback
			local str = tostring(pendingFlag.__type or "?")

			pendingFlag.Callback = function(...)
				local v_2 = table.pack(...)
				pcall(userActionRecord, k, str, ...)
				return callback(table.unpack(v_2, 1, v_2.n))
			end

			n += 1
		end
	end

	if n > 0 then
		configDbg("INFO", "ui", "user action logging installed", { reason = tostring(arg or "?"), wrapped = n })
	end

	return n
end

AUTOFARM_LOG_FILE = SNP_LOG_DIR .. "/Autofarm_Debug.log"

autofarmAppendLogChunk = function(arg)
	if not writefile or not arg or arg == "" then
		return
	end

	if type(snpDebugLogsEnabled) == "function" and not snpDebugLogsEnabled() then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		ensureSnpLogDir()

		if type(appendfile) == "function" then
			local flag = false

			if type(isfile) == "function" then
				local result
				flag, result = pcall(isfile, AUTOFARM_LOG_FILE)
				flag = flag and result
			end

			if flag then
				if pcall(appendfile, AUTOFARM_LOG_FILE, arg) then
					snpRotateLogFile(AUTOFARM_LOG_FILE, "AUTOFARM", 7340032)
					return
				end
			end
		end

		local str = ""

		if type(readfile) == "function" then
			local ok
			ok, str = pcall(readfile, AUTOFARM_LOG_FILE)
			ok = ok and type(str) == "string"
			local str2 = ""

			if not ok then
				str = str2
			end
		end

		writefile(AUTOFARM_LOG_FILE, str .. arg)
		snpRotateLogFile(AUTOFARM_LOG_FILE, "AUTOFARM", 7340032)
	end)
end

flushAutofarmLog = function()
	if not autofarmLogLines or #autofarmLogLines == 0 then
		return
	end
	local str = table.concat(autofarmLogLines, "\n") .. "\n"
	autofarmLogLines = {}
	autofarmLogPending = 0
	autofarmAppendLogChunk(str)
end

autofarmDbg = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
	if type(snpDebugLogsEnabled) == "function" and not snpDebugLogsEnabled() then
		return
	end

	if (arg == "TRACE" or arg == "DEBUG") and not AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
		return
	end

	if type(arg4) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(arg4)
		arg4 = ok and result or { err = tostring(result) }
	end

	autofarmLogSeq = (autofarmLogSeq or 0) + 1
	local n = os.clock() - (autofarmSessionT0 or os.clock())
	local v_2 = autofarmLogSeq
	local v_3 = tostring
	local str = string.format("[%s +%.3fs #%d][%s][%s] %s", os.date("%X"), n, v_2, tostring(arg), tostring(arg2), v_3(arg3))

	if arg4 ~= nil then
		str ..= " | " .. snpEncodeLogData(arg4)
	end

	if not writefile then
		return
	end
	table.insert(autofarmLogLines, str)
	autofarmLogPending = (autofarmLogPending or 0) + 1

	if arg == "WARN" or arg == "ERROR" or arg == "FATAL" then
		flushAutofarmLog()
	elseif autofarmLogPending >= 8 then
		flushAutofarmLog()
	elseif not autofarmLogFlushQueued then
		autofarmLogFlushQueued = true

		task.defer(function()
			autofarmLogFlushQueued = false

			if autofarmLogPending and autofarmLogPending > 0 then
				flushAutofarmLog()
			end
		end)
	end
end

autofarmEyeArgBrief = function(arg)
	local kind = typeof(arg)
	if kind == "nil" then
		return nil
	end

	if kind == "string" or kind == "number" or kind == "boolean" then
		return arg
	end

	if kind == "Instance" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return arg:GetFullName()
		end)

		return ok and result or tostring(arg)
	end

	if kind == "Vector3" then
		return string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", arg.X, arg.Y, arg.Z)
	end

	if kind == "CFrame" then
		local position = arg.Position
		return string.format("CF(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f)", position.X, position.Y, position.Z)
	end

	if kind == "table" then
		local n = 0

		for k in pairs(arg) do
			n += 1
			if not (n > 24) then
				continue
			end
			break
		end

		return string.format("{table:%d}", n)
	end

	return tostring(kind)
end

autofarmEyeRoundTimer = function()
	local roundTimerPart = workspace:FindFirstChild("RoundTimerPart")
	if not roundTimerPart then
		return nil
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return roundTimerPart:GetAttribute("Time")
	end)

	if ok then
		return result
	end
	return nil
end

	return nil
end

autofarmEyeMurderBrief = function(arg)
	local v_2 = arg or autofarmCachedRoundData
	local name = nil

	if type(findMurder) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(findMurder)
		ok = ok and result
		name = nil

		if ok then
			name = result.Name
		end
	end

	local flag = nil
	local v_3 = nil

	if type(v_2) == "table" then
		v_3 = nil
		flag = nil

		for k, v_4 in pairs(v_2) do
			if type(v_4) == "table" and v_4.Role == "Murderer" then
				flag = v_4.Dead == true

				if flag then
					v_3 = k
				else
					flag = v_4.Killed == true
					v_3 = k
				end

				break
			else
				v_3 = nil
				flag = nil
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		knifeMurder = name,
		pdMurder = v_3,
		pdMurderDead = flag,
		murderEliminated = autofarmIsMurdererEliminated and autofarmIsMurdererEliminated(v_2) or nil,
	}
end

		return nil
	end

			local str = tostring(v_2.Role or "?")
			local flag2 = v_2.Dead == true or v_2.Killed == true

			end
		end
	end

	return { alive = n2, dead = n, missingLocal = flag, roles = table.concat(tbl2, ",") }
end

autofarmLocalRuntimeSnap = function()
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local v_2 = autofarmCachedRoundData and autofarmCachedRoundData[localPlayer.Name]
	local result = nil

	if humanoid then
		local ok

		ok, result = pcall(function()
			return tostring(humanoid:GetState())
		end)

		result = ok and result or "err"
	end

	local count = nil

	pcall(function()
		if type(gcinfo) == "function" then
			count = gcinfo()
		elseif type(collectgarbage) == "function" then
			count = collectgarbage("count")
		end
	end)

	local ping = nil

	pcall(function()
		local Stats2 = game:GetService("Stats")
		Stats2 = Stats2 and Stats2.Network
		Stats2 = Stats2 and Stats2.ServerStatsItem
		Stats2 = Stats2 and Stats2["Data Ping"]

		if Stats2 and Stats2.GetValue then
			ping = Stats2:GetValue()
		end
	end)

	local v_3 = nil

	pcall(function()
		if identifyexecutor then
			v_3 = identifyexecutor()
		end
	end)

	local n = 0
	local n2 = 0

	if character then
		pcall(function()
			for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
					if descendant.CanCollide then
						n += 1
					else
						n2 += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local str = nil
	local y = nil

	if humanoidRootPart then
		y = humanoidRootPart.Position.Y

		pcall(function()
			local assemblyLinearVelocity = humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			str = string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", assemblyLinearVelocity.X, assemblyLinearVelocity.Y, assemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
		end)
	end

	local v_4 = autofarmEyeMapName or autofarmEyeFindMap()
	autofarmEyeMapName = v_4
	local v_5 = autofarmEyeMurderBrief()

	local tbl2 = {
		canCollect = autofarmLocalCanCollectCoins and autofarmLocalCanCollectCoins() or nil,
		hasChar = character ~= nil,
		hasHum = humanoid ~= nil,
		hasHrp = humanoidRootPart ~= nil,
		health = humanoid and humanoid.Health or nil,
		maxHealth = humanoid and humanoid.MaxHealth or nil,
		humState = result,
		platformStand = humanoid and humanoid.PlatformStand or nil,
		sit = humanoid and humanoid.Sit or nil,
		hrpPos = humanoidRootPart and string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", humanoidRootPart.Position.X, humanoidRootPart.Position.Y, humanoidRootPart.Position.Z) or nil,
		hrpY = y,
		hrpVel = str,
		voidRisk = y ~= nil and y < -100 or false,
		hasFlyBV = humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("FLY_NIGGER") ~= nil or false,
		activeTween = autofarmActiveTween ~= nil,
		landBusy = autofarmLandBusy == true,
		collideOn = n,
		collideOff = n2,
		mapName = v_4,
		roundTimer = autofarmEyeRoundTimer(),
		knifeMurder = v_5.knifeMurder,
		pdMurder = v_5.pdMurder,
		pdMurderDead = v_5.pdMurderDead,
		lastCoinPos = autofarmLastCoinPos and string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", autofarmLastCoinPos.X, autofarmLastCoinPos.Y, autofarmLastCoinPos.Z) or nil,
	}

	local function fn2()
		local v_6 = autofarmCachedRoundData
		if type(v_6) ~= "table" then
			return nil
		end
		return v_6[localPlayer.Name] ~= nil
	end

	tbl2.pdInRound = fn2()
	tbl2.pdDead = v_2 and v_2.Dead or nil
	tbl2.pdKilled = v_2 and v_2.Killed or nil
	tbl2.pdRole = v_2 and v_2.Role or nil
	tbl2.memKb = count
	tbl2.ping = ping
	tbl2.executor = v_3
	tbl2.status1 = status1
	tbl2.loopTick = autofarmLoopTick
	tbl2.coinsTouchedSession = autofarmCoinCollectCount
	return tbl2
end

autofarmSnap = function(arg)
	local tbl2

	if AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
		tbl2 = hubAutofarmRejoinState()
		tbl2.roundend = roundend
		tbl2.startround = startround
		tbl2.fullbag = fullbag
		tbl2.bag = values.bag
		local v_2 = autofarmLocalRuntimeSnap()

		for k, v_3 in pairs(v_2) do
			tbl2[k] = v_3
		end
	else
		tbl2 = {
			roundend = roundend,
			startround = startround,
			fullbag = fullbag,
			bag = values.bag,
			farmType = dropdownval and dropdownval.farmType or nil,
			coinPickMode = dropdownval and dropdownval.coinPickMode or nil,
			selectAfterFarm = dropdownval and dropdownval.selectAfterFarm or nil,
			runnings = values.runnings == true,
			resetmurderer = values.resetmurderer == true,
			status1 = status1,
			loopTick = autofarmLoopTick,
			coinsTouchedSession = autofarmCoinCollectCount,
		}
	end

	if type(arg) == "table" then
		for k, v_2 in pairs(arg) do
			tbl2[k] = v_2
		end
	end

	return tbl2
end

autofarmHookCharacterEye = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = arg:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or arg:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8)
	local humanoidRootPart = arg:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or arg:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 8)

	if humanoid then
		pcall(function()
			humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
				autofarmDbg("WARN", "char", "Humanoid.Died", autofarmSnap())
				flushAutofarmLog()
			end)
		end)

		pcall(function()
			humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(old, new)
				local str = tostring(new)
				local flag = new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying
				if not AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
					return
				end

				if not values.runnings and not flag then
					return
				end
				autofarmDbg(flag and "WARN" or "TRACE", "char", "Humanoid.StateChanged → " .. str, autofarmSnap({ newState = str }))

				if flag then
					flushAutofarmLog()
				end
			end)
		end)

		pcall(function()
			local n = -1

			humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
				if not AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX or not values.runnings then
					return
				end

				if math.abs(health - n) < 1 and health > 0 then
					return
				end
				n = health
				autofarmDbg("TRACE", "char", "HealthChanged", autofarmSnap({ healthNow = health }))
			end)
		end)
	end

	if humanoidRootPart then
		pcall(function()
			humanoidRootPart.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
				if parent == nil then
					autofarmDbg("WARN", "char", "HRP.AncestryChanged → nil", autofarmSnap())
					flushAutofarmLog()
				end
			end)
		end)
	end
end

autofarmInstallTraceHooks = function()
	if autofarmTraceHooksInstalled then
		return
	end
	autofarmTraceHooksInstalled = true

	autofarmDbg("INFO", "trace", "installing third-eye hooks", {
		traceMax = AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX,
		heartbeatSec = 2,
		voidY = -100,
		hasAppendfile = type(appendfile) == "function",
	})

	pcall(function()
		localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			autofarmDbg("INFO", "char", "CharacterAdded", autofarmSnap({ charName = character and character.Name }))
			flushAutofarmLog()
			autofarmHookCharacterEye(character)
		end)
	end)

	if localPlayer.Character then
		pcall(autofarmHookCharacterEye, localPlayer.Character)
	end

	pcall(function()
		localPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
			autofarmDbg("WARN", "char", "CharacterRemoving", autofarmSnap({ charName = character and character.Name }))
			flushAutofarmLog()
		end)
	end)

	pcall(function()
		local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

		GuiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ErrorMessage"):Connect(function()
			local errorMessage = GuiService.ErrorMessage

			if errorMessage and tostring(errorMessage) ~= "" then
				autofarmDbg("FATAL", "kick", "GuiService.ErrorMessage", autofarmSnap({ errorMessage = tostring(errorMessage) }))
				flushAutofarmLog()
			end
		end)
	end)

	pcall(function()
		game:BindToClose(function()
			autofarmDbg("FATAL", "session", "BindToClose", autofarmSnap())
			flushAutofarmLog()
		end)
	end)

	pcall(function()
		local function fn2(arg, arg2)
			if not arg2 then
				return
			end

			arg2.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if not AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
					return
				end

				if child.Name ~= "Coin_Server" then
					return
				end

				if not values.runnings and not startround then
					return
				end
				autofarmDbg("EVENT", "map", "CoinContainer.ChildAdded", autofarmSnap({ map = arg and arg.Name, coin = autofarmCoinBrief and autofarmCoinBrief(child) or child.Name }))
			end)

			arg2.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
				if not AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
					return
				end

				if child.Name ~= "Coin_Server" then
					return
				end

				if not values.runnings and not startround then
					return
				end
				autofarmDbg("EVENT", "map", "CoinContainer.ChildRemoved", autofarmSnap({ map = arg and arg.Name, coinName = child.Name, activeTween = autofarmActiveTween ~= nil }))
			end)
		end

		local function fn3(arg)
			if not arg or not arg:IsA("Model") then
				return
			end
			local coinContainer = arg:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
			if not coinContainer then
				return
			end
			autofarmEyeMapName = arg.Name
			autofarmDbg("EVENT", "map", "map with CoinContainer present", autofarmSnap({ map = arg.Name }))
			fn2(arg, coinContainer)

			arg.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
				if parent == nil then
					autofarmDbg("WARN", "map", "map destroyed / unloaded", autofarmSnap({ map = arg.Name }))
					flushAutofarmLog()

					if autofarmEyeMapName == arg.Name then
						autofarmEyeMapName = nil
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
			pcall(fn3, child)
		end

		workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			task.defer(function()
				pcall(fn3, child)
			end)
		end)

		workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
			if child:IsA("Model") and autofarmEyeMapName == child.Name then
				autofarmDbg("WARN", "map", "workspace ChildRemoved map", autofarmSnap({ map = child.Name, activeTween = autofarmActiveTween ~= nil }))
				flushAutofarmLog()
				autofarmEyeMapName = nil
			end
		end)
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(2)

			if AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
				if values.runnings then
					local v_2 = autofarmSnap({
						heartbeatDt = os.clock() - (autofarmLastHeartbeatLog or 0),
						scan = autofarmScanCoinContainers and autofarmScanCoinContainers() or nil,
					})

					local voidRisk = v_2.voidRisk or v_2.humState == "Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall"
					local str = "TRACE"

					if voidRisk then
						str = "WARN"
					end

					autofarmDbg(str, "heartbeat", "alive tick", v_2)
					autofarmLastHeartbeatLog = os.clock()
					flushAutofarmLog()
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

autofarmInstallGameplayEye = function()
	if autofarmGameplayEyeInstalled then
		return
	end
	autofarmGameplayEyeInstalled = true

	local tbl2 = {
		KillEvent = true,
		GunKill = true,
		KnifeKill = true,
		EliminatePlayer = true,
		GiveWeapon = true,
		TeleportToPart = true,
		SpecialRound = true,
		ShowRoleSelect = true,
		ShowRoleSelectNew = true,
		RoleSelect = true,
		FakeGun = true,
		Stealth = true,
		SpecialXPEvent = true,
		ShowTeammates = true,
		ChangeTarget = true,
		ActivatePerk = true,
	}

	local tbl3 = {
		PlayerDataChanged = true,
		CoinCollected = true,
		CoinsStarted = true,
		RoundEndFade = true,
		RoundStart = true,
		LoadingMap = true,
		Fade = true,
		VictoryScreen = true,
		GameOver = true,
	}

	pcall(function()
		local gameplay = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Gameplay", 30)
		if not gameplay then
			autofarmDbg("WARN", "eye", "Gameplay folder missing", {})
			return
		end
		local n = 0

		for _, child in ipairs(gameplay:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				if not tbl3[child.Name] then
					n += 1

					child.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
						if not AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
							return
						end
						local name = child.Name
						if not values.runnings and not tbl2[name] then
							return
						end
						local tbl4 = { ... }
						local tbl5 = { remote = name, nArgs = #tbl4 }

						for i = 1, math.min(#tbl4, 6) do
							tbl5["a" .. i] = autofarmEyeArgBrief(tbl4[i])
						end

						if name == "TeleportToPart" then
							autofarmDbg("WARN", "gameplay", name, autofarmSnap(tbl5))
							flushAutofarmLog()
							return
						end

						local flag = name == "KillEvent" or name == "GunKill" or name == "KnifeKill" or name == "EliminatePlayer"
						local str = "EVENT"

						if flag then
							str = "WARN"
						end

						autofarmDbg(str, "gameplay", name, autofarmSnap(tbl5))

						if str == "WARN" then
							flushAutofarmLog()
						end
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		autofarmDbg("INFO", "eye", "Gameplay remotes hooked", { hooked = n })
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if ClientTweenEvents and ClientTweenEvents.OnClientEvent then
			ClientTweenEvents.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
				if not AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
					return
				end

				if not values.runnings and not startround then
					return
				end
				autofarmDbg("EVENT", "tween", "ClearTweens", autofarmSnap({ nArgs = select("#", ...) }))
			end)
		end
	end)
end

hubAutofarmRejoinState = function()
	local tbl2 = {}

	for _, toggle in ipairs(HUB_AUTOFARM_REJOIN.toggles) do
		if values[toggle] ~= nil then
			tbl2[toggle] = values[toggle]
		end
	end

	for _, dropdown in ipairs(HUB_AUTOFARM_REJOIN.dropdowns) do
		tbl2[dropdown] = dropdownval[dropdown]
	end

	for _, slider in ipairs(HUB_AUTOFARM_REJOIN.sliders) do
		if valueslider[slider] ~= nil then
			tbl2[slider] = valueslider[slider]
		end
	end

	for _, string_ in ipairs(HUB_AUTOFARM_REJOIN.strings) do
		tbl2[string_] = valuestrings[string_]
	end

	if type(discordWebhookGetActiveUrl) == "function" then
		tbl2.discordWebhookActiveUrl = discordWebhookGetActiveUrl()
	end

	return tbl2
end

hubResolveHubValid = function()
	local valid = getgenv().valid
	if valid == "vps" or valid == "github" then
		return valid
	end

	if getgenv().readySNPWARE then
		return "vps"
	end
	return nil
end

hubHubLoaderUrl = function()
	local v_2 = hubResolveHubValid()
	if v_2 == "vps" then
		return "https://api.snpware.xyz/auth"
	end

	if v_2 == "github" then
		return "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thunderXhub/ThunderXHUB/refs/heads/main/loader"
	end
	return nil
end

hubReadLoaderLanguagePrefs = function()
	local str, flag, str2

	if readfile and isfile and isfile("configlanguage.json") then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile("configlanguage.json"))
		end)

		ok = ok and type(result) == "table"
		str = "en"
		flag = false
		str2 = "slider"

		if ok then
			if type(result.language) == "string" then
				str = hubLanguageCode(result.language)
			end

			if result.valueControl == "inputbox" or result.valueControl == "slider" then
				str2 = result.valueControl
			end

			flag = result.choice == true
		end
	else
		str = "en"
		flag = false
		str2 = "slider"

		if dropdownval then
			local v_2 = hubLanguageCode(dropdownval.language)
			local valueControl = dropdownval.valueControl

			if valueControl then
				valueControl = tostring(dropdownval.valueControl):lower():find("input")
			end

			local flag2 = false
			local str3 = "slider"

			if valueControl then
				str = v_2
				str2 = "inputbox"
			else
				str = v_2
				flag = flag2
				str2 = str3
			end
		end
	end

	return str, str2, flag
end

hubBuildRejoinQueueCode = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7)
	local random = math.random

	return string.format([[spawn(function()
    repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()
    -- Dedup: hub queues once before Teleport and again on OnTeleport; Xeno may run both.
    local bootId = %q
    if getgenv()._SNP_REJOIN_BOOT == bootId then
        return
    end
    getgenv()._SNP_REJOIN_BOOT = bootId
    getgenv().valid = %q
    getgenv().SNP_autostartConfigName = %q
    getgenv().SNP_skipLoaderGui = %s
    getgenv().readySNPWARE = nil
    getgenv().r3thexecuted = nil
    getgenv().choice = %q
    getgenv().valuecontrol1 = %q
    do
        local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(%q)
        end)
        if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then
            getgenv().SNP_rejoinPendingRestore = decoded
        end
    end
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local code
        if game.HttpGetAsync then
            code = game:HttpGetAsync(%q)
        else
            code = game:HttpGet(%q)
        end
        if type(code) ~= "string" or code == "" then
            error("empty loader response")
        end
        local func, compileErr = loadstring(code)
        if not func then
            error("compile: " .. tostring(compileErr))
        end
        func()
    end)
    if not success then
        if getgenv()._SNP_REJOIN_BOOT == bootId then
            getgenv()._SNP_REJOIN_BOOT = nil
        end
        warn("[SNP] rejoin loader failed:", err)
    end
end)
]], string.format("%s-%d", tostring(os.clock()), random(100000, 999999)), tostring(arg4 or ""), tostring(arg3 or ""), arg5 and "true" or "false", tostring(arg6 or "en"), tostring(arg7 or "slider"), arg2, arg, arg)
end

hubQueueKickRejoinScript = function(arg)
	if not hubQueueTeleport then
		hubRejoinDbg("ERROR", "queue", "queue_on_teleport unavailable")
		return false, "queue_on_teleport unavailable"
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(hubQueueTeleport, arg)
	if not ok then
		hubRejoinDbg("ERROR", "queue", "queue_on_teleport pcall failed", { err = tostring(result) })
		return false, tostring(result)
	end
	hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "queue", "queue_on_teleport ok")
	return true
end

hubCallKickRejoinTeleport = function()
	hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "teleport", "Teleport(game.PlaceId) calling", { placeId = game.PlaceId })

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(game.PlaceId)
	end)

	if not ok then
		hubRejoinDbg("ERROR", "teleport", "Teleport pcall failed", { err = tostring(result) })
		hubRejoinTeleporting = false
		return false, tostring(result)
	end

	hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "teleport", "Teleport called")
	return true
end

hubRetryKickRejoin = function(arg, result)
	if not values.rejoinOnKick or not hubRejoinPendingQueueCode then
		hubRejoinDbg("DEBUG", "retry_skip", "retry skipped", { reason = arg, hasQueueCode = hubRejoinPendingQueueCode ~= nil })
		return
	end

	if hubRejoinRetryCount >= HUB_REJOIN_MAX_RETRIES then
		local v_2 = hubRejoinDbg
		local tbl2 = { reason = arg }
		result = result and tostring(result) or nil
		tbl2.result = result
		v_2("ERROR", "retry_exhausted", "max retries reached", tbl2)
		return
	end

	hubRejoinRetryCount = hubRejoinRetryCount + 1
	local n = result == Enum.TeleportResult.Flooded and 10 or 5
	hubRejoinDbg("WARN", "retry_scheduled", "retry scheduled", { reason = arg, waitSec = n, attempt = hubRejoinRetryCount, result = result and tostring(result) or nil })

	task.delay(n, function()
		if not values.rejoinOnKick then
			hubRejoinDbg("DEBUG", "retry_cancel", "toggle off before retry")
			return
		end

		if hubRejoinTeleporting then
			hubRejoinDbg("DEBUG", "retry_cancel", "already teleporting")
			return
		end
		hubRejoinTeleporting = true
		local v_2, v_3 = hubQueueKickRejoinScript(hubRejoinPendingQueueCode)

		if not v_2 then
			hubRejoinTeleporting = false
			hubRejoinDbg("ERROR", "retry_queue_fail", tostring(v_3))
			return
		end

		hubCallKickRejoinTeleport()
	end)
end

hubPerformKickRejoin = function(arg)
	hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "begin", "kick rejoin requested", { kickMessage = tostring(arg or "") })
	if hubRejoinTeleporting then
		hubRejoinDbg("WARN", "skip", "already teleporting")
		return
	end
	local v_2 = hubHubLoaderUrl()
	local v_3 = hubResolveHubValid()
	if not v_2 then
		hubRejoinDbg("ERROR", "abort", "unknown hub loader", { getgenvValid = getgenv().valid, resolvedValid = v_3, readySNPWARE = getgenv().readySNPWARE })
		return
	end
	hubRejoinTeleporting = true
	hubRejoinRetryCount = 0
	local json = HttpService:JSONEncode(hubAutofarmRejoinState())
	local str = hubResolveAutostartConfigName() or ""
	local v_4, v_5, v_6 = hubReadLoaderLanguagePrefs()
	local flag = not v_6
	local v_7 = hubBuildRejoinQueueCode(v_2, json, str, v_3 or "", flag, v_4, v_5)
	hubRejoinPendingQueueCode = v_7

	hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "prepare", "queue payload built", {
		loaderUrl = v_2,
		resolvedValid = v_3,
		autostartName = str,
		loaderLang = v_4,
		loaderValueControl = v_5,
		rememberChoice = v_6,
		skipLoaderGui = flag,
		rejoinState = hubAutofarmRejoinState(),
		queueCodeLen = #v_7,
	})

	if not hubQueueKickRejoinScript(v_7) then
		hubRejoinTeleporting = false
		hubRejoinPendingQueueCode = nil
		return
	end

	local flag2 = false
	local connection = nil

	connection = localPlayer.OnTeleport:Connect(function(arg2)
		hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "OnTeleport", "OnTeleport fired", { state = tostring(arg2) })
		if flag2 then
			return
		end
		flag2 = true

		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end

		hubQueueKickRejoinScript(v_7)
	end)

	task.spawn(hubCallKickRejoinTeleport)
end

HUB_HOP_MIN_PLAYERS = 2
HUB_HOP_ALONE_SECONDS = 25
HUB_HOP_COOLDOWN = 90
hubHopLastAttempt = -math.huge

hubFetchHopCandidates = function()
	local request_ = syn and syn.request or http and http.request or http_request or request
	if type(request_) ~= "function" then
		return nil, "no http request function"
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(request_, {
		Url = string.format("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=Desc&limit=100&excludeFullGames=true", game.PlaceId),
		Method = "GET",
	})

	if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "request failed: " .. tostring(result)
	end

	if tonumber(result.StatusCode) ~= 200 then
		return nil, "http " .. tostring(result.StatusCode)
	end

	local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(result.Body)
	end)

	if not ok2 or type(result2) ~= "table" or type(result2.data) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "decode failed"
	end
	local tbl2 = {}

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(result2.data) do
		local num = tonumber(v_2.playing)
		local num2 = tonumber(v_2.maxPlayers)

		if type(v_2.id) == "string" and v_2.id ~= game.JobId and num and num2 and num < num2 and num >= HUB_HOP_MIN_PLAYERS then
			table.insert(tbl2, { id = v_2.id, playing = num, ping = tonumber(v_2.ping) or math.huge })
		end
	end

	table.sort(tbl2, function(arg, arg2)
		if arg.ping ~= arg2.ping then
			return arg.ping < arg2.ping
		end
		return arg.playing > arg2.playing
	end)

	return tbl2
end

hubServerHopTo = function(arg, arg2)
	if hubRejoinTeleporting then
		return false, "already teleporting"
	end
	local v_2 = hubHubLoaderUrl()
	if not v_2 then
		hubRejoinDbg("ERROR", "hop", "unknown hub loader, hop aborted", { reason = arg2 })
		return false, "unknown loader"
	end

	if not hubQueueTeleport then
		hubRejoinDbg("ERROR", "hop", "queue_on_teleport unavailable, hop aborted", { reason = arg2 })
		return false, "queue_on_teleport unavailable"
	end
	hubRejoinTeleporting = true
	local json = HttpService:JSONEncode(hubAutofarmRejoinState())
	local str = hubResolveAutostartConfigName() or ""
	local v_3, v_4, v_5 = hubReadLoaderLanguagePrefs()
	local v_6 = hubBuildRejoinQueueCode(v_2, json, str, hubResolveHubValid() or "", not v_5, v_3, v_4)
	local v_7, v_8 = hubQueueKickRejoinScript(v_6)
	if not v_7 then
		hubRejoinTeleporting = false
		return false, tostring(v_8)
	end
	local flag = false
	local connection = nil

	connection = localPlayer.OnTeleport:Connect(function(arg3)
		hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "hop", "OnTeleport fired", { state = tostring(arg3) })
		if flag then
			return
		end
		flag = true

		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end

		hubQueueKickRejoinScript(v_6)
	end)

	hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "hop", "teleporting to instance", { reason = arg2, jobId = tostring(arg), queueCodeLen = #v_6 })

	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

			if arg then
				TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, arg, localPlayer)
			else
				TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId)
			end
		end)

		if not ok then
			hubRejoinTeleporting = false

			if connection then
				pcall(function()
					connection:Disconnect()
				end)
			end

			hubRejoinDbg("ERROR", "hop", "teleport pcall failed", { err = tostring(result) })
		end
	end)

	return true
end

hubHopFromEmptyServer = function()
	local count, v_2 = hubFetchHopCandidates()

	if not count or #count == 0 then
		local v_3 = hubRejoinDbg
		local tbl2 = { err = v_2 }
		count = count and #count or 0
		tbl2.count = count
		v_3("WARN", "hop", "no candidate servers, falling back to matchmaking", tbl2)
		return hubServerHopTo(nil, "empty server (fallback)")
	end

	local v_3 = count[1]

	hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "hop", "candidate chosen", {
		jobId = v_3.id,
		ping = v_3.ping ~= math.huge and v_3.ping or nil,
		playing = v_3.playing,
		candidates = #count,
	})

	return hubServerHopTo(v_3.id, "empty server")
end

hubHandleKickErrorMessage = function(arg, arg2)
	local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
	local errorMessage

	if not arg or tostring(arg) == "" then
		errorMessage = GuiService.ErrorMessage
	else
		errorMessage = arg
	end

	if not errorMessage or tostring(errorMessage) == "" then
		hubRejoinDbg("DEBUG", "kick_signal", "empty message ignored", { source = arg2, signalMessage = arg, errorMessageProp = GuiService.ErrorMessage })
		return
	end
	hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "kick_signal", "kick/error detected", { source = arg2, message = tostring(errorMessage), runnings = values.runnings })

	if values.runnings then
		discordNotify("discordNotifyKick", {
			title = "Kicked / Error",
			description = tostring(errorMessage),
			color = 16711680,
			mentionEveryone = true,
		})

		hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "discord", "kick webhook sent")
	end

	if values.rejoinOnKick then
		hubPerformKickRejoin(errorMessage)
	else
		hubRejoinDbg("DEBUG", "kick_signal", "rejoin skipped — toggle off")
	end
end

hubSeasonalBackgroundDefault = function()
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DateTime.now()
	end)

	ok = ok and result
	local match = nil

	if ok then
		local ll = nil

		pcall(function()
			ll = result:FormatUniversalTime("LL", "en-us")
		end)

		match = nil

		if type(ll) == "string" then
			local tbl2 = {
				January = 1,
				February = 2,
				March = 3,
				April = 4,
				May = 5,
				June = 6,
				July = 7,
				August = 8,
				September = 9,
				October = 10,
				November = 11,
				December = 12,
			}

			match = ll:match("^(%a+)")
			match = match and tbl2[match]
		end

		if not match then
			local v_2 = result:ToUniversalTime()
			match = type(v_2) == "table" and tonumber(v_2.Month) or nil
		end
	end

	if not match then
		match = os.date("!*t")
		match = match and tonumber(match.month) or 9
	end

	if match == 12 or match == 1 or match == 2 then
		return "Snowfall"
	end

	if match >= 3 and match <= 5 then
		return "Spring Bloom"
	end

	if match >= 6 and match <= 8 then
		return "Summer Glow"
	end
	return "Autumn Fall"
end

HUB_DROPDOWN_DEFAULTS = {}

for k, v_2 in pairs(dropdownval) do
	if typeof(v_2) == "table" then
		local tbl2 = {}

		for i, v_3 in ipairs(v_2) do
			tbl2[i] = v_3
		end

		HUB_DROPDOWN_DEFAULTS[k] = tbl2
	else
		HUB_DROPDOWN_DEFAULTS[k] = v_2
	end
end

HUB_DROPDOWN_VALUE_ALIASES = {}

LangList = {
	en = "English",
	ru = "Русский",
	es = "Español",
	pt = "Português",
	de = "Deutsch",
	ar = "العربية",
	fil = "Filipino",
}

HUB_LANG_CODES = { "en", "ru", "es", "pt", "de", "ar", "fil" }

hubLanguageDropdownValues = function()
	local tbl2 = {}

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(HUB_LANG_CODES) do
		tbl2[#tbl2 + 1] = LangList[v_2]
	end

	return tbl2
end

hubLanguageCode = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return "en"
	end

	if LangList[arg] then
		return arg
	end

	for k, v_2 in pairs(LangList) do
		if v_2 == arg then
			return k
		end
	end

	return "en"
end

hubNormalizeDropdownValue = function(arg)
	if arg == nil then
		return nil
	end

	if typeof(arg) == "table" then
		return arg.Title or arg[1] or arg.Name
	end
	return arg
end

hubNormalizeDropdownSelection = function(arg, arg2)
	if not arg2 then
		return hubNormalizeDropdownValue(arg)
	end

	if arg == nil then
		return {}
	end

	if typeof(arg) ~= "table" then
		return { arg }
	end
	local tbl2 = {}

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(arg) do
		local title = typeof(v_2) == "table" and (v_2.Title or v_2[1] or v_2.Name) or v_2

		if title then
			tbl2[#tbl2 + 1] = title
		end
	end

	if #tbl2 == 0 then
		for _, v_2 in pairs(arg) do
			if typeof(v_2) ~= "number" then
				local title = typeof(v_2) == "table" and (v_2.Title or v_2[1] or v_2.Name) or v_2

				if title then
					tbl2[#tbl2 + 1] = title
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return tbl2
end

hubDropdownModes = function(arg)
	local v_2 = dropdownval[arg]
	if v_2 == nil then
		return {}
	end

	if typeof(v_2) ~= "table" then
		dropdownval[arg] = { v_2 }
		return dropdownval[arg]
	end

	if #v_2 == 0 and next(v_2) ~= nil then
		dropdownval[arg] = hubNormalizeDropdownSelection(v_2, true)
		return dropdownval[arg]
	end
	return v_2
end

hubDropdownHas = function(arg, arg2)
	return table.find(hubDropdownModes(arg), arg2) ~= nil
end

hubDropdownRawValue = function(arg, arg2)
	local value = arg and arg.Value
	local v_2 = dropdownval[arg2]

	if arg and arg.Multi then
		if typeof(value) == "table" then
			return hubNormalizeDropdownSelection(value, true)
		end

		if typeof(v_2) == "table" then
			return hubNormalizeDropdownSelection(v_2, true)
		end
		return {}
	end

	if value ~= nil then
		if typeof(value) == "table" then
			value = hubNormalizeDropdownValue(value)
		end

		if value ~= nil and value ~= "" then
			return value
		end
	end

	return v_2 ~= nil and v_2 or value
end

hubDropdownValueLabel = function(arg)
	if typeof(arg) == "table" then
		return arg.Title or arg[1] or arg.Name
	end
	return arg
end

hubDropdownDefaultFor = function(arg, arg2)
	local v_2 = HUB_DROPDOWN_DEFAULTS[arg]

	if arg2 then
		local tbl2 = {}

		if typeof(v_2) == "table" then
			for i, v_3 in ipairs(v_2) do
				tbl2[i] = v_3
			end
		end

		return tbl2
	end

	if typeof(v_2) == "table" then
		return v_2[1]
	end
	return v_2
end

hubDropdownValueCheckSkipped = function(arg, arg2)
	if arg == "language" then
		return true
	end

	if CDN_ASSET_SOURCE_BY_PICKER[arg] or CDN_ASSET_MAIN_BY_PICKER[arg] then
		return true
	end

	if HUB_DROPDOWN_DEFAULTS[arg] == nil then
		return true
	end
	return hubIsPlayerTargetDropdown(arg2)
end

hubSanitizeDropdownValue = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
	if arg3 == nil then
		return arg3
	end
	local v_2 = HUB_DROPDOWN_VALUE_ALIASES[arg]

	if v_2 then
		if arg4 and typeof(arg3) == "table" then
			local tbl2 = {}

			for i, v_3 in ipairs(arg3) do
				tbl2[i] = v_2[hubDropdownValueLabel(v_3)] or v_3
			end

			arg3 = tbl2
		else
			arg3 = v_2[hubDropdownValueLabel(arg3)] or arg3
		end
	end

	if hubDropdownValueCheckSkipped(arg, arg2) then
		return arg3
	end
	local values_ = arg2 and arg2.Values
	if typeof(values_) ~= "table" or #values_ == 0 then
		return arg3
	end
	local tbl2 = {}

	for _, v_3 in ipairs(values_) do
		local v_4 = hubDropdownValueLabel(v_3)

		if v_4 ~= nil then
			tbl2[v_4] = true
		end
	end

	if arg4 then
		if typeof(arg3) ~= "table" then
			return arg3
		end
		local tbl3 = {}
		local v_3, v_4, v_5 = ipairs(arg3)
		local n = 0

		for _, v_6 in v_3, v_4, v_5 do
			if tbl2[hubDropdownValueLabel(v_6)] then
				tbl3[#tbl3 + 1] = v_6
			else
				n += 1
			end
		end

		if n == 0 then
			return arg3
		end
		configDbg("WARN", "apply", "dropdown values gone — trimmed", { flag = arg, dropped = n, kept = #tbl3 })
		if #tbl3 > 0 or arg2.AllowNone == true then
			return tbl3
		end
		return hubDropdownDefaultFor(arg, true)
	end

	if tbl2[hubDropdownValueLabel(arg3)] then
		return arg3
	end
	local v_3 = hubDropdownDefaultFor(arg, false)

	if v_3 == nil or not tbl2[hubDropdownValueLabel(v_3)] then
		v_3 = hubDropdownValueLabel(values_[1])
	end

	configDbg("WARN", "apply", "dropdown value gone — default used", { flag = arg, saved = arg3, fallback = v_3 })
	return v_3
end

hubApplyDropdownUi = function(arg, value, arg2, arg3)
	if not arg or value == nil then
		return
	end

	if (arg3 or arg.Flag) == "language" then
		local v_2 = hubLanguageCode(value)
		dropdownval.language = v_2
		arg.Value = arg2 and v_2 or LangList[v_2] or value

		if arg.Display then
			pcall(arg.Display, arg)
		end

		return
	end

	arg.Value = value

	if arg.Display then
		pcall(arg.Display, arg)
	end
end

hubFinalizeConfigApply = function()
	if dropdownval.language and v_ and v_.SetLanguage then
		pcall(function()
			local v_2 = hubLanguageCode(dropdownval.language)
			dropdownval.language = v_2
			v_:SetLanguage(v_2)
			lc = notify[v_2] or notify.en
		end)
	end

	task.wait()

	if type(onNameEspSettingsChanged) == "function" then
		pcall(onNameEspSettingsChanged)
	end

	if type(onEspSettingsChanged) == "function" then
		pcall(onEspSettingsChanged)
	end

	if values.gunDropEsp and type(highlightGunDrop) == "function" then
		for _, v_2 in pairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("GunDrop")) do
			pcall(highlightGunDrop, v_2)
		end
	end

	task.wait()

	if dropdownval.theme and v_ and v_.SetTheme then
		pcall(function()
			v_:SetTheme(dropdownval.theme)
			applyHubTheme(dropdownval.theme)
		end)
	end

	task.wait()
	hubApplyForcedSafetyToggles("finalize")

	if type(discordWebhookLoadFromDisk) == "function" then
		pcall(discordWebhookLoadFromDisk)
	end

	if type(discordWebhookRefreshDropdown) == "function" then
		pcall(discordWebhookRefreshDropdown, dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved)
	end

	pcall(function()
		if Circle then
			Circle.Radius = valueslider.KnifeFOVSize
			Circle.Visible = values.KnifeShowFOV and values.KnifeAimEnabled and localPlayerHasKnife()
		end

		if PredictionIndicator then
			PredictionIndicator.Visible = values.KnifeShowPrediction and values.KnifeAimEnabled and localPlayerHasKnife()
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()

hubAntiflingClearChar = function(arg)
	local v_2 = antiflingCharHooks[arg]
	if not v_2 then
		return
	end

	for _, v_3 in pairs(v_2) do
		if typeof(v_3) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
			pcall(function()
				v_3:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
	end

	antiflingCharHooks[arg] = nil
end

hubAntiflingSetupCharacter = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return
	end
	hubAntiflingClearChar(arg)

	local function fn2(child)
		if values.antifling and not values.alr and child:IsA("BasePart") then
			child.CanCollide = false
		end
	end

	for _, child in ipairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
		fn2(child)
	end

	local v_2 = antiflingCharHooks
	local tbl2 = {}
	local connection = arg.ChildAdded:Connect(fn2)

	local connection2 = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
		if not values.antifling or values.alr then
			return
		end

		if not arg:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			return
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.CanCollide then
				child.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end)

	local destroying = arg.Destroying
	local connect = destroying.Connect

	local function fn3()
		hubAntiflingClearChar(arg)
	end

	tbl2[1] = connection
	tbl2[2] = connection2

	do
		local values = table.pack(connect(destroying, fn3))
		table.move(values, 1, values.n, 3, tbl2)
	end

	v_2[arg] = tbl2
end

hubAntiflingUntrackPlayer = function(arg)
	local v_2 = antiflingPlayerHooks[arg]

	if v_2 then
		pcall(function()
			v_2:Disconnect()
		end)

		antiflingPlayerHooks[arg] = nil
	end

	if arg and arg.Character then
		hubAntiflingClearChar(arg.Character)
	end
end

hubAntiflingTrackPlayer = function(arg)
	if not arg or arg == localPlayer then
		return
	end
	hubAntiflingUntrackPlayer(arg)
	antiflingPlayerHooks[arg] = arg.CharacterAdded:Connect(hubAntiflingSetupCharacter)

	if arg.Character then
		hubAntiflingSetupCharacter(arg.Character)
	end
end

hubAntiflingStop = function()
	if conns.antiflingPlayerAdded then
		conns.antiflingPlayerAdded:Disconnect()
		conns.antiflingPlayerAdded = nil
	end

	if conns.antiflingPlayerRemoving then
		conns.antiflingPlayerRemoving:Disconnect()
		conns.antiflingPlayerRemoving = nil
	end

	for k in pairs(antiflingPlayerHooks) do
		hubAntiflingUntrackPlayer(k)
	end

	for k in pairs(antiflingCharHooks) do
		hubAntiflingClearChar(k)
	end
end

hubAntiflingStart = function()
	hubAntiflingStop()

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		hubAntiflingTrackPlayer(player)
	end

	conns.antiflingPlayerAdded = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hubAntiflingTrackPlayer)
	conns.antiflingPlayerRemoving = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(hubAntiflingUntrackPlayer)
end

hubApplyAutofarmPendingState = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local pendingFlags = Window and Window.PendingFlags

	for _, dropdown in ipairs(HUB_AUTOFARM_REJOIN.dropdowns) do
		if dropdown == "discordWebhookSaved" then
			if arg.discordWebhookSaved ~= nil then
				dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved = arg.discordWebhookSaved

				if type(discordWebhookRefreshDropdown) == "function" then
					discordWebhookRefreshDropdown(arg.discordWebhookSaved)
				end
			end
		elseif arg[dropdown] ~= nil and dropdownval[dropdown] ~= nil then
			dropdownval[dropdown] = arg[dropdown]

			if pendingFlags and pendingFlags[dropdown] then
				hubApplyDropdownUi(pendingFlags[dropdown], arg[dropdown], false, dropdown)
			end
		end
	end

	for _, slider in ipairs(HUB_AUTOFARM_REJOIN.sliders) do
		if arg[slider] ~= nil and valueslider[slider] ~= nil then
			valueslider[slider] = tonumber(arg[slider]) or valueslider[slider]

			if pendingFlags and pendingFlags[slider] then
				hubSyncSliderUi(pendingFlags[slider], valueslider[slider])
			end
		end
	end

	for _, string_ in ipairs(HUB_AUTOFARM_REJOIN.strings) do
		if arg[string_] ~= nil then
			valuestrings[string_] = tostring(arg[string_])

			if pendingFlags and pendingFlags[string_] and pendingFlags[string_].Value ~= nil then
				pendingFlags[string_].Value = valuestrings[string_]
			end

			if string_ == "discordWebhook" and type(discordWebhookSyncUrlInput) == "function" then
				discordWebhookSyncUrlInput(valuestrings[string_])
			elseif string_ == "discordWebhookName" and type(discordWebhookSyncNameInput) == "function" then
				discordWebhookSyncNameInput(valuestrings[string_])
			end
		end
	end

	if arg.discordWebhookActiveUrl and arg.discordWebhookActiveUrl ~= "" then
		if not isValidDiscordWebhook(discordWebhookGetActiveUrl()) then
			valuestrings.discordWebhook = arg.discordWebhookActiveUrl

			if type(discordWebhookSyncUrlInput) == "function" then
				discordWebhookSyncUrlInput(arg.discordWebhookActiveUrl)
			end
		end
	end

	for _, toggle in ipairs(HUB_AUTOFARM_REJOIN.toggles) do
		if toggle ~= "runnings" then
			hubApplyAutofarmPendingToggle(toggle, arg, pendingFlags)
		end
	end

	if arg.antifling ~= nil then
		hubLastConfigToggleValues.antifling = arg.antifling and true or false
	end

	if arg.antiAfk ~= nil then
		hubLastConfigToggleValues.antiAfk = arg.antiAfk and true or false
	end

	hubApplyForcedSafetyToggles("rejoin")

	if arg.runnings then
		hubApplyAutofarmPendingToggle("runnings", arg, pendingFlags)
	end
end

	})

	hubApplyAutofarmPendingState(snpRejoinPendingRestore)
	hubRejoinDbg("INFO", "restore", "rejoin snapshot applied", hubAutofarmRejoinState())
end

NOTIFY_SCALE_REF_WIDTH = 2560
NOTIFY_SCALE_REF_HEIGHT = 1440
NOTIFY_SCALE_REF_VALUE = 1
NOTIFY_SCALE_MIN = 0.5
NOTIFY_SCALE_MAX = 2
notifyScaleBootstrapped = false

roundNotifyScale = function(arg)
	return math.floor(math.clamp(tonumber(arg) or NOTIFY_SCALE_REF_VALUE, NOTIFY_SCALE_MIN, NOTIFY_SCALE_MAX) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
end

getViewportSizeForNotify = function()
	local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if currentCamera and currentCamera.ViewportSize.X > 0 and currentCamera.ViewportSize.Y > 0 then
		return math.floor(currentCamera.ViewportSize.X + 0.5), math.floor(currentCamera.ViewportSize.Y + 0.5)
	end

	if PlayerGui and PlayerGui.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
		local floor = math.floor
		local n = PlayerGui.AbsoluteSize.Y + 0.5
		return math.floor(PlayerGui.AbsoluteSize.X + 0.5), floor(n)
	end

	return nil, nil
end

calcAutoNotifyScale = function(arg, arg2)
	local v_2 = math.sqrt(NOTIFY_SCALE_REF_WIDTH * NOTIFY_SCALE_REF_WIDTH + NOTIFY_SCALE_REF_HEIGHT * NOTIFY_SCALE_REF_HEIGHT)
	return roundNotifyScale(NOTIFY_SCALE_REF_VALUE * (arg / NOTIFY_SCALE_REF_WIDTH * 0.5 + arg2 / NOTIFY_SCALE_REF_HEIGHT * 0.2 + math.sqrt(arg * arg + arg2 * arg2) / v_2 * 0.3))
end

	applyAutoNotifyScaleFromScreen = function(arg)
		if values.autoNotifyScale == false then
			notifyScaleBootstrapped = true
			return valueslider.notifyScale
		end
		local v_2, v_3

		if arg then
			local now = os.clock()
			v_2 = nil
			v_3 = nil

			while os.clock() - now < 15 do
				v_2, v_3 = getViewportSizeForNotify()
				if not (v_2 and v_3 and v_2 > 0) then
					task.wait(0.1)
					continue
				end
				break
			end
		else
			v_2, v_3 = getViewportSizeForNotify()
		end

		if not v_2 or not v_3 then
			return valueslider.notifyScale
		end
		local v_4 = calcAutoNotifyScale(v_2, v_3)
		applyNotifyScale(v_4, true)
		notifyScaleBootstrapped = true
		return v_4
	end
