			local n12 = math.max(0.25, (tonumber(n8) or 5) - os.clock() - now)
			v_10(n12)

			task.delay(n12, function()
				if flag2 or flag5 then
					return
				end

				if frame2.Parent then
					flag2 = true
					closeNotification(text, frame)
				end
			end)
		end

		table.insert(activeNotifications, { key = text, Shell = frame, Frame = frame3, Width = n10, Height = n11, UIScale = uiScale, onClose = fn10 })
		updateStack()

		task.spawn(function()
			local v_12 = fn9(str)
			flag3 = true
			fn8("talk")

			pcall(function()
				sound.Volume = fn4()
				sound:Play()
			end)

			local n12 = os.clock() + 2.4 + math.random() * 1.6
			local n13 = 0

			while n13 < #v_12 and not flag2 and not flag4 and frame2.Parent do
				n13 += 1
				textLabel2.Text = table.concat(v_12, "", 1, n13)
				local v_13 = v_12[n13]

				if os.clock() >= n12 then
					fn8("blink")
					task.wait(0.08)

					if flag3 and not flag4 then
						fn8("talk")
					end

					n12 = os.clock() + 2.2 + math.random() * 2
				elseif n13 % 6 == 0 then
					fn8("idle")
					task.wait(0.015)

					if flag3 and not flag4 then
						fn8("talk")
					end
				end

				local n14

				if v_13 == "." or v_13 == "!" or v_13 == "?" then
					n14 = 0.06
				elseif v_13 == "," or v_13 == ";" or v_13 == ":" then
					n14 = 0.035
				else
					n14 = 0.016

					if v_13 == " " then
						n14 = 0.01
					end
				end

				task.wait(n14)
			end

			fn10()
			if flag4 or flag2 or not frame2.Parent then
				return
			end
			textLabel2.RichText = true
			textLabel2.Text = text
			fn8("idle")
			textLabel3.TextTransparency = 0
			TweenService:Create(textLabel3, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { TextTransparency = 0.55 }):Play()
			fn12()
		end)

		task.spawn(function()
			while frame2.Parent and not flag2 do
				local v_12 = flag3
				local v_13

				if flag3 then
					v_13 = v_12
				else
					v_13 = flag4
				end

				if v_13 then
					task.wait(0.12)
				else
					task.wait(1.7 + math.random() * 2.6)

					if frame2.Parent and not flag2 and not flag3 and not flag4 then
						fn8("blink")
						task.wait(0.09 + math.random() * 0.04)

						if frame2.Parent and not flag2 and not flag3 and not flag4 then
							fn8("idle")
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	sendnotification = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		if (dropdownval.notifydesign or "New") == "Legacy" then
			fn6(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		else
			fn7(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		end
	end
end

hubButtonsEnsureScreenGui = function()
	if hubButtonsScreenGui and hubButtonsScreenGui.Parent then
		return hubButtonsScreenGui
	end
	local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screenGui.Name = "SNP_HubButtons"
	screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	screenGui.DisplayOrder = 10050
	local hui = gethui and gethui() or CoreGui
	screenGui.Parent = hui
	hubButtonsScreenGui = screenGui
	hubBtnLog("screen_gui", "created", "DisplayOrder=10050", "parent=" .. hui.Name)
	return screenGui
end

hubButtonsCleanupLegacyGuis = function()
	local tbl2 = { CoreGui }

	if gethui then
		table.insert(tbl2, gethui())
	end

	local n = 0

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(tbl2) do
		for _, child in ipairs(v_2:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				local name = child.Name

				if name == "SNP_HubButtons" or name:sub(1, 7) == "HubBtn_" then
					child:Destroy()
					n += 1
				end
			end
		end
	end

	hubButtonsScreenGui = nil
	hubButtonZIndex = 50
	hubBtnLog("cleanup_legacy", "removed=" .. tostring(n))
end

hubButtonBringToFront = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return
	end
	hubButtonZIndex = hubButtonZIndex + 1
	arg.ZIndex = hubButtonZIndex
end

hubInputPosVec2 = function(arg)
	if typeof(arg) == "Vector2" then
		return arg
	end

	if typeof(arg) == "Vector3" then
		return Vector2.new(arg.X, arg.Y)
	end
	return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
end

createButton = function(logName, text, arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
	local tbl2 = arg5 or {}
	local tbl3 = { sizeX = arg, sizeY = arg2, connections = {} }
	local v_2 = hubButtonsEnsureScreenGui()
	local textButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	textButton.Name = logName .. "Btn"
	textButton.Text = text
	textButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(tbl3.sizeX, tbl3.sizeY)
	textButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 6, 1)
	textButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
	textButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
	textButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(221, 214, 197)
	textButton.TextSize = 11
	textButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	textButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	textButton.Active = true
	textButton.AutoButtonColor = false
	textButton.Parent = v_2
	hubButtonBringToFront(textButton)
	local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, arg3 or 14)
	uiCorner.Name = "FeatureActionCorner"
	uiCorner.Parent = textButton
	local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	uiStroke.Thickness = 0.89999997615814209
	uiStroke.Color = currentThemePalette and currentThemePalette.accentDark or Color3.fromRGB(176, 113, 23)
	uiStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	uiStroke.Name = "UIStroke"
	uiStroke.Parent = textButton
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6324790483"
	sound.Volume = 2.2
	sound.Parent = textButton
	local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	uiScale.Scale = 1
	uiScale.Parent = textButton
	tbl3.btn = textButton
	tbl3.border = uiStroke
	tbl3.sg = v_2
	tbl3.clickSound = sound
	tbl3.pressScale = uiScale
	tbl3.pressTween = nil
	tbl3.logName = logName
	table.insert(hubButtonPaintList, { btn = textButton, border = uiStroke })
	local locked = false
	local flag = false

	local dragSession = {
		dragging = false,
		dragMoved = false,
		locked = false,
		inputHeld = false,
		multiTouchSeen = false,
		threshold = 6,
		dragStart = nil,
		startOffset = nil,
		activeInput = nil,
		inputType = nil,
		btnName = logName,
	}

	local function fn2()
		return textButton.Position.X.Offset - tbl3.sizeX * 0.5, textButton.Position.Y.Offset - tbl3.sizeY * 0.5
	end

	local function fn3(arg6, arg7)
		local absoluteSize = v_2.AbsoluteSize
		local sizeY = tbl3.sizeY
		return math.clamp(arg6, 0, math.max(0, absoluteSize.X - tbl3.sizeX)), math.clamp(arg7, 0, math.max(0, absoluteSize.Y - sizeY))
	end

	local function setPos(arg6, arg7)
		local v_3, v_4 = fn3(arg6, arg7)
		textButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v_3 + tbl3.sizeX * 0.5, v_4 + tbl3.sizeY * 0.5)
		dragSession.lastX = v_3
		dragSession.lastY = v_4
	end

	local function savePosition()
		if tbl2.onPosChanged then
			local v_3, v_4 = fn2()
			tbl2.onPosChanged(v_3, v_4)
		end
	end

	dragSession.setPos = setPos
	dragSession.savePosition = savePosition

	dragSession.onDragBegan = function()
		hubButtonBringToFront(textButton)
	end

	dragSession.suppressClick = function()
		flag = true

		task.defer(function()
			flag = false
		end)
	end

	dragSession.onDragFinished = function()
		tbl3:playPress(false)
	end

	setPos(tbl2.posX or 20, tbl2.posY or 20)

	tbl3.playPress = function(arg6, arg7)
		if not arg6.btn or not arg6.btn.Parent then
			return
		end

		if arg6.pressTween then
			arg6.pressTween:Cancel()
			arg6.pressTween = nil
		end

		local n = arg7 and 0.92 or 1

		if arg6.pressScale and arg6.pressScale.Parent then
			arg6.pressTween = TweenService:Create(arg6.pressScale, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = n })
			arg6.pressTween:Play()
		end

		if arg6.border then
			arg6.border.Thickness = arg7 and 1.15 or 0.9
		end

		if arg7 and arg6.clickSound then
			arg6.clickSound:Play()
		end

		hubBtnLog(arg6.logName or logName, "press", arg7 and "down" or "up")
	end

	local function fn4()
		if hubButtonDragSession == dragSession then
			hubButtonFinishDragSession(true)
		else
			dragSession.dragging = false
			dragSession.activeInput = nil
			dragSession.dragMoved = false
			tbl3:playPress(false)
		end
	end

	local function fn5(activeInput)
		if locked or not activeInput then
			hubBtnLog(logName, "pointer_skip", "locked=" .. tostring(locked))
			return
		end
		dragSession.dragging = true
		dragSession.dragMoved = false
		dragSession.inputHeld = true
		dragSession.multiTouchSeen = false
		dragSession.activeInput = activeInput
		dragSession.inputType = activeInput.UserInputType
		dragSession.dragStart = hubInputPosVec2(activeInput.Position)
		local v_3, v_4 = fn2()
		dragSession.startOffset = Vector2.new(v_3, v_4)
		dragSession.locked = locked
		hubButtonBringToFront(textButton)
		local str = "pos=" .. textButton.Position.X.Offset .. "," .. textButton.Position.Y.Offset
		hubBtnLog(logName, "pointer_start", "type=" .. tostring(activeInput.UserInputType), "start=" .. tostring(dragSession.dragStart), str)
		hubButtonBeginDragSession(dragSession)
	end

	local function fn6(arg6)
		if hubButtonDragSession ~= dragSession and not dragSession.activeInput then
			return
		end

		if arg6 and arg6 ~= dragSession.activeInput then
			if hubButtonDragSession ~= dragSession then
				return
			end

			if dragSession.inputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or arg6.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				return
			end
		end

		if dragSession.dragging or hubButtonDragSession == dragSession then
			hubBtnLog(logName, "pointer_end", "dragMoved=" .. tostring(dragSession.dragMoved))
			fn4()
		else
			tbl3:playPress(false)
			dragSession.activeInput = nil
			dragSession.dragMoved = false
		end
	end

	tbl3.cancelDrag = function()
		if hubButtonDragSession == dragSession then
			hubButtonFinishDragSession(true)
		end
	end

	tbl3.setDragLocked = function(arg6, arg7)
		locked = arg7 == true

		if locked then
			tbl3:cancelDrag()
		end
	end

	table.insert(tbl3.connections, textButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end
		tbl3:playPress(true)
		fn5(input)
	end))

	table.insert(tbl3.connections, textButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end
		fn6(input)
	end))

	table.insert(tbl3.connections, textButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if not dragSession.dragging and hubButtonDragSession ~= dragSession then
			tbl3:playPress(false)
		end
	end))

	table.insert(tbl3.connections, textButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if flag or dragSession.dragMoved then
			hubBtnLog(logName, "click_skip", "dragMoved=" .. tostring(dragSession.dragMoved), "suppress=" .. tostring(flag))
			return
		end
		hubBtnLog(logName, "click")

		if arg4 then
			arg4()
		end
	end))

	tbl3.setSize = function(arg6, sizeX, sizeY)
		tbl3.sizeX = sizeX
		tbl3.sizeY = sizeY
		textButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sizeX, sizeY)
		local v_3, v_4 = fn2()
		setPos(v_3, v_4)

		if tbl3.pressTween then
			tbl3.pressTween:Cancel()
			tbl3.pressTween = nil
		end

		if tbl3.pressScale then
			tbl3.pressScale.Scale = 1
		end
	end

	tbl3.setCorner = function(arg6, arg7)
		uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, arg7)
	end

	tbl3.setPosition = function(arg6, arg7, arg8)
		setPos(arg7, arg8)
	end

	tbl3.destroy = function()
		if hubButtonDragSession == dragSession then
			hubButtonFinishDragSession(false)
		end

		for _, connection in ipairs(tbl3.connections) do
			if connection and connection.Disconnect then
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
		end

		textButton:Destroy()
	end

	tbl3.dragSession = dragSession
	hubBtnLog(logName, "create_ok", "connections=" .. tostring(#tbl3.connections))
	return tbl3
end

hubAddCdnAssetsHint = function(arg)
	if not CUSTOM_ASSETS_CDN_ENABLED then
		return
	end

	if type(arg) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	if arg.Paragraph then
		arg:Paragraph({ Title = "loc:cdn_assets_hint_title", Desc = "loc:cdn_assets_hint" })
	end

	if arg.Code then
		arg:Code({ Title = "loc:cdn_assets_link", Code = tostring(CUSTOM_ASSETS_BASE) .. "/" })
	end
end

customAssetsReportUse = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
		return
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		pcall(function()
			local tbl2 = {
				Url = CUSTOM_ASSETS_BASE .. "/api/asset/" .. arg .. "/use",
				Method = "POST",
				Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
				Body = "{}",
			}

			if type(request) == "function" then
				request(tbl2)
			elseif type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.request) == "function" then
				syn.request(tbl2)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

customAssetsEnsureDirs = function()
	if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	pcall(makefolder, "SNPWARE")
	pcall(makefolder, CUSTOM_ASSETS_DIR)

	for _, v_2 in ipairs({ "backgrounds", "cursors", "skyboxes", "gun_sounds" }) do
		pcall(makefolder, CUSTOM_ASSETS_DIR .. "/" .. v_2)
	end
end

customAssetsReadJson = function(arg, arg2)
	if not readfile or not isfile or not isfile(arg) then
		return arg2
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(readfile, arg)
	if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" or result == "" then
		return arg2
	end

	local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(result)
	end)

	if ok2 then
		return result2
	end
	return arg2
end

customAssetsWriteJson = function(arg, arg2)
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	customAssetsEnsureDirs()

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONEncode(arg2)
	end)

	if not ok then
		return false
	end
	return pcall(writefile, arg, result)
end

	local v_2 = tostring

	if arg then
		arg = arg.title or arg.id
	end

	return v_2(arg or "asset")
end

customAssetsSaveList = function(arg, arg2)
	customAssetsWriteJson(CUSTOM_ASSETS_DIR .. "/" .. arg .. "_" .. arg2 .. ".json", (arg == "my" and customAssetMy or customAssetOwn)[arg2] or {})
end

customAssetsLoadList = function(arg)
	local flag = arg == "my" and customAssetMy or customAssetOwn
	local tbl2 = {}

	for _, v_2 in ipairs({ "backgrounds", "cursors", "skyboxes", "gun_sounds" }) do
		local tbl3 = customAssetsReadJson(CUSTOM_ASSETS_DIR .. "/" .. arg .. "_" .. v_2 .. ".json", {})

		if type(tbl3) ~= "table" then
			tbl3 = {}
		end

		for _, v_3 in ipairs(tbl3) do
			if type(v_3) == "table" then
				v_3.label = customAssetsLabel(v_3)

				if arg == "own" then
					v_3.is_own = true
				end
			end
		end

		flag[v_2] = tbl3
	end

	for _, v_2 in pairs(flag) do
		for _, v_3 in ipairs(v_2) do
			if type(v_3) == "table" and v_3.label then
				tbl2[v_3.label] = v_3
			end
		end
	end

	if arg == "my" then
		customAssetMyByLabel = tbl2
	else
		customAssetOwnByLabel = tbl2
	end
end

customAssetsListLabels = function(arg, arg2)

		if v_3.label then
			tbl2[#tbl2 + 1] = v_3.label
		end
	end

	table.sort(tbl2)
	return tbl2
end

customAssetsIngestCatalog = function(arg)
	customAssetCatalog.byType = { backgrounds = {}, cursors = {}, skyboxes = {}, gun_sounds = {} }
	customAssetCatalog.byId = {}
	local v_2 = ipairs
	local tbl2 = arg or {}

	for _, v_3 in v_2(tbl2) do
		if type(v_3) == "table" and v_3.id and v_3.type then
			customAssetCatalog.byId[v_3.id] = v_3
			local v_4 = customAssetCatalog.byType[v_3.type]

			if v_4 then
				v_4[#v_4 + 1] = v_3
			end
		end
	end

	customAssetCatalog.byLabel = {}

	for _, v_3 in pairs(customAssetCatalog.byId) do
		local v_4 = customAssetsLabel(v_3)
		v_3.label = v_4
		customAssetCatalog.byLabel[v_4] = v_3
	end

	for k, v_3 in pairs(customAssetMy) do
		local v_4 = ipairs
		v_3 = v_3 or {}
		local flag = false

		for _, v_5 in v_4(v_3) do
			local id = v_5.id and customAssetCatalog.byId[v_5.id]

			if id and customAssetsMergeHubFields(v_5, id) then
				v_5.label = customAssetsLabel(v_5)
				customAssetMyByLabel[v_5.label] = v_5
				flag = true
			end
		end

		if flag then
			customAssetsSaveList("my", k)
		end
	end

	customAssetCatalog.fetchedAt = os.time()
	customAssetsWriteJson(CUSTOM_ASSETS_DIR .. "/catalog.json", { fetchedAt = customAssetCatalog.fetchedAt, items = arg })
end

customAssetsFetchCatalog = function(arg)
	if not CUSTOM_ASSETS_CDN_ENABLED then
		return false
	end
	customAssetsEnsureDirs()
	local flag = not arg

	if flag and customAssetCatalog.fetchedAt > 0 then
		local fetchedAt = customAssetCatalog.fetchedAt
		if os.time() - fetchedAt < CUSTOM_ASSETS_CATALOG_TTL then
			return true
		end
	end

	if flag then
		local v_2 = customAssetsReadJson(CUSTOM_ASSETS_DIR .. "/catalog.json", nil)

		if type(v_2) == "table" and type(v_2.items) == "table" and type(v_2.fetchedAt) == "number" then
			local fetchedAt = v_2.fetchedAt

			if os.time() - fetchedAt < CUSTOM_ASSETS_CATALOG_TTL then
				customAssetsIngestCatalog(v_2.items)
				customAssetCatalog.fetchedAt = v_2.fetchedAt
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	local v_2, v_3 = fetchUrl(CUSTOM_ASSETS_BASE .. "/api/catalog", nil, 15)
	if not v_2 or type(v_3) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(v_3)
	end)

	if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or not result.ok then
		return false
	end
	customAssetsIngestCatalog(result.items or {})
	return true
end

	customAssetsApplyFavoritesFromServer(result.items or {})
	return true, #(result.items or {})
end

customAssetsApplyFavoritesFromServer = function(arg)
	customAssetMy = { backgrounds = {}, cursors = {}, skyboxes = {}, gun_sounds = {} }
	customAssetMyByLabel = {}
	local v_2 = ipairs
	local tbl2 = arg or {}
	local n = 0

	for _, v_3 in v_2(tbl2) do
		if type(v_3) == "table" and v_3.id and v_3.type and customAssetMy[v_3.type] ~= nil then
			if not v_3.is_own then
				local tbl3 = {
					id = v_3.id,
					type = v_3.type,
					title = v_3.title,
					mime = v_3.mime,
					kind = v_3.kind,
					url = v_3.url,
					hub_url = v_3.hub_url,
					preview_url = v_3.preview_url,
					files = v_3.files,
					sheet = v_3.sheet,
					duration = v_3.duration,
					label = customAssetsLabel(v_3),

				v_4[#v_4 + 1] = tbl3
				customAssetMyByLabel[tbl3.label] = tbl3
				n += 1
			end
		end
	end

	for k in pairs(customAssetMy) do
		customAssetsSaveList("my", k)
	end

	return n
end

customAssetsRefreshAllDropdowns = function()
	if skyboxPresetDropdown and cachedSkyboxNames then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(skyboxPresetDropdown, cachedSkyboxNames)
	end

	if skyboxMyDropdown then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(skyboxMyDropdown, customAssetsListLabels(customAssetMy, "skyboxes"))
	end

	if skyboxOwnDropdown then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(skyboxOwnDropdown, customAssetsListLabels(customAssetOwn, "skyboxes"))
	end

	if cursorPresetDropdown and cachedCursorNames then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(cursorPresetDropdown, cachedCursorNames)
	end

	if cursorMyDropdown then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(cursorMyDropdown, customAssetsListLabels(customAssetMy, "cursors"))
	end

	if cursorOwnDropdown then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(cursorOwnDropdown, customAssetsListLabels(customAssetOwn, "cursors"))
	end

	if gunSoundMyDropdown then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(gunSoundMyDropdown, customAssetsListLabels(customAssetMy, "gun_sounds"))
	end

	if gunSoundOwnDropdown then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(gunSoundOwnDropdown, customAssetsListLabels(customAssetOwn, "gun_sounds"))
	end

	if backgroundImageDropdown and cachedBackgroundNames then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(backgroundImageDropdown, cachedBackgroundNames)
	end

	if backgroundMyDropdown then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(backgroundMyDropdown, customAssetsListLabels(customAssetMy, "backgrounds"))
	end

	if backgroundOwnDropdown then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(backgroundOwnDropdown, customAssetsListLabels(customAssetOwn, "backgrounds"))
	end

	if gunSoundPresetDropdown and cachedSoundNames then
		customAssetsRefreshDropdown(gunSoundPresetDropdown, cachedSoundNames)
	end
end

customAssetLocalInflight = {}

customAssetsEnsureLocal = function(arg, arg2)
	if not CUSTOM_ASSETS_CDN_ENABLED then
		return nil
	end

	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local v_2 = string.lower(arg)
	if v_2:find("%.webp", 1, true) or v_2:find("%.gif", 1, true) then
		return nil
	end

	if customAssetLocalCache[arg2] then
		return customAssetLocalCache[arg2]
	end

	if customAssetLocalInflight[arg2] then
		return nil
	end
	customAssetLocalInflight[arg2] = true

	local function fn2(arg3)
		customAssetLocalInflight[arg2] = nil
		return arg3
	end

	customAssetsEnsureDirs()
	local str = CUSTOM_ASSETS_DIR .. "/" .. arg2

	local function fn3(arg3)
		if type(arg3) ~= "string" or #arg3 < 8 then
			return true
		end
		local str2 = arg3:sub(1, 32):lower()
		if str2:find("<!doctype", 1, true) or str2:find("<html", 1, true) then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	if isfile and isfile(str) then
		local ok, result = pcall(readfile, str)

		if not ok or fn3(result) then
			pcall(function()
				if delfile then
					delfile(str)
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	if not (isfile and isfile(str)) then
		if hubConfigLoading or hubConfigMuteAutofarm or getgenv()._SNP_SKIP_CDN_FETCH then
			return (fn2(nil))
		end

		if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
			return (fn2(nil))
		end
		local v_3, v_4, v_5 = fetchUrl(arg, nil, 60)
		if not v_3 or type(v_4) ~= "string" or v_4 == "" or v_5 and v_5 ~= 200 or fn3(v_4) then
			return (fn2(nil))
		end

		if not pcall(writefile, str, v_4) then
			return (fn2(nil))
		end
	end

	if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
		return (fn2(nil))
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(getcustomasset, str)
	if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" or result == "" then
		customAssetsLog("LOCAL", "getcustomasset_fail", { path = arg2, ok = ok, err = not ok and tostring(result) or nil })
		return (fn2(nil))
	end
	customAssetLocalCache[arg2] = result
	return (fn2(result))
end

customAssetsExtFromUrl = function(arg)
	local match = tostring(arg or ""):match("%.([%w]+)$")

	if not match then
		local v_2
		match = tostring(v_2 or ""):match("%.([%w]+)%?")
	end

	if match then
		return "." .. string.lower(match)
	end
	return ".bin"
end

customAssetsMergeHubFields = function(arg, arg2)
	if not arg or not arg2 then
		return false
	end
	local flag = false

	for _, v_2 in ipairs({ "hub_url", "preview_url", "url", "mime", "kind", "files", "title", "sheet" }) do
		local v_3 = arg2[v_2]

		if v_3 ~= nil and v_3 ~= "" and arg[v_2] ~= v_3 then
			arg[v_2] = v_3
			flag = true
		end
	end

	return flag
end

customAssetsResolveItem = function(arg)
	if not CUSTOM_ASSETS_CDN_ENABLED then
		return nil
	end

	if type(arg) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local v_2 = customAssetOwnByLabel[arg] or customAssetMyByLabel[arg] or customAssetCatalog.byLabel[arg]

	if v_2 and v_2.id and customAssetCatalog.byId[v_2.id] then
		customAssetsMergeHubFields(v_2, customAssetCatalog.byId[v_2.id])
	end

	return v_2
end

	if not v_2 or type(arg2) ~= "string" then

end

customAssetsInferPickerSource = function(arg, arg2)
	local tbl2 = {}

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(CDN_ASSET_PICKER_GROUPS) do
		if v_2.main == arg and v_2.presets then
			tbl2 = v_2.presets() or {}
			break
		end
	end

	if hubCdnLabelIsLocalPreset(arg2, tbl2) then
		return "preset"
	end

	if customAssetsResolveItem(arg2) then
		return "my"
	end
	return "preset"
end

customAssetsSelectionDepth = 0

customAssetsClearDropdownUi = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		arg.Value = arg.Multi and {} or nil

		if arg.Display then
			arg:Display()
		end
	end)
end

customAssetsSetActiveSelection = function(arg, value, arg2)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then
		return
	end

	if customAssetsSelectionDepth > 0 then
		return
	end
	customAssetsSelectionDepth = customAssetsSelectionDepth + 1

	pcall(function()
		if dropdownval[arg] ~= nil then
			dropdownval[arg] = value
		end

		local v_2 = arg2
		local flag = v_2 ~= "preset" and v_2 ~= "my" and v_2 ~= "own"
		local v_3 = arg2

		if flag then
			v_3 = customAssetsInferPickerSource(arg, value)
		end

		if CDN_ASSET_PICKER_UI[arg] then
			customAssetsSyncPickerUi(arg, v_3)
			local v_4 = customAssetsGetPickerDropdown(arg, v_3)

			if v_4 then
				v_4.Value = value

				if v_4.Display then
					v_4:Display()
				end
			end
		end

		local pendingFlags = Window and Window.PendingFlags and Window.PendingFlags[arg]

		if v_3 == "preset" then
			if pendingFlags then
				pendingFlags.Value = value

				if pendingFlags.Display then
					pcall(pendingFlags.Display, pendingFlags)
				end
			end
		elseif pendingFlags and pendingFlags.__type == "Dropdown" then
			customAssetsClearDropdownUi(pendingFlags)
		end
	end)

	customAssetsSelectionDepth = customAssetsSelectionDepth - 1
end

customAssetsSyncPickerUi = function(arg, arg2)
	local v_2 = CDN_ASSET_PICKER_UI[arg]
	if not v_2 then
		return
	end

	for k, v_3 in pairs(v_2) do
		if k ~= arg2 then
			customAssetsClearDropdownUi(v_3())
		end
	end
end

hubCdnLabelIsLocalPreset = function(arg, arg2)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
		return false
	end
	local v_2 = ipairs
	arg2 = arg2 or {}

	for _, v_3 in v_2(arg2) do
		if v_3 == arg then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

hubPreferCdnPickerSelections = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(CDN_ASSET_PICKER_GROUPS) do
		local v_3 = arg[v_2.main]
		local v_4 = arg[v_2.own]
		local v_5 = arg[v_2.my]
		local v_6 = hubNormalizeDropdownValue(v_3 and v_3.value)
		local v_7 = hubNormalizeDropdownValue(v_4 and v_4.value)
		local v_8 = hubNormalizeDropdownValue(v_5 and v_5.value)
		local presets = v_2.presets and v_2.presets() or {}
		local v_9

		if type(v_7) == "string" and v_7 ~= "" and v_7 ~= v_6 then
			if hubCdnLabelIsLocalPreset(v_6, presets) and not hubCdnLabelIsLocalPreset(v_7, presets) then
				v_9 = v_7
			elseif customAssetsResolveItem(v_7) and hubCdnLabelIsLocalPreset(v_6, presets) then
				v_9 = v_7
			else
				v_9 = v_6
			end
		else
			v_9 = v_6
		end

		if v_9 == v_6 and type(v_8) == "string" and v_8 ~= "" and v_8 ~= v_6 then
			if hubCdnLabelIsLocalPreset(v_6, presets) and not hubCdnLabelIsLocalPreset(v_8, presets) then
				v_9 = v_8
			elseif customAssetsResolveItem(v_8) and hubCdnLabelIsLocalPreset(v_6, presets) then
				v_9 = v_8
			end
		end

		if type(v_9) == "string" and v_9 ~= "" then
			local str

			if type(v_7) == "string" and v_7 ~= "" and v_9 == v_7 then
				str = "own"
			elseif type(v_8) == "string" and v_8 ~= "" and v_9 == v_8 then
				str = "my"
			elseif hubCdnLabelIsLocalPreset(v_9, presets) then
				str = "preset"
			else
				str = "preset"

				if customAssetsResolveItem(v_9) then
					str = "my"
				end
			end

			customAssetsSetActiveSelection(v_2.main, v_9, str)
		end
	end
end

customAssetsFileUrl = function(arg, arg2)
	if not arg or type(arg2) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local files = arg.files and arg.files[arg2]
	if type(files) ~= "string" or files == "" then
		return nil
	end

	if files:find("^https?://") then
		return files
	end

	if files:find("^/") then
		return CUSTOM_ASSETS_BASE .. files
	end

	if arg.id and arg.type then
		return CUSTOM_ASSETS_BASE .. "/files/approved/" .. tostring(arg.type) .. "/" .. tostring(arg.id) .. "/" .. files:gsub("^/+", "")
	end
	return nil
end

customAssetsIsSheetItem = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return false
	end
	local n = 0

	if type(arg.sheet) == "table" then
		n = tonumber(arg.sheet.totalFrames or 0) or n
	end

	if n > 1 then
		return true
	end

	if n == 1 then
		return false
	end

	if arg.type == "cursors" then
		return arg.kind == "cursors_sheet" and customAssetsFileUrl(arg, "sheet") ~= nil
	end

	if arg.kind == "backgrounds_sheet" then
		return true
	end

	if customAssetsFileUrl(arg, "sheet") then
		return true
	end
	return tostring(arg.hub_url or ""):find("sheet.png", 1, true) ~= nil
end

customAssetsHubMediaUrl = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return nil
	end
	local v_2 = customAssetsFileUrl(arg, "sheet")
	if v_2 and customAssetsIsSheetItem(arg) then
		return v_2
	end

	if type(arg.hub_url) == "string" and arg.hub_url ~= "" then
		local hubUrl_ = arg.hub_url

		if hubUrl_:find("^https?://") then
			if not (hubUrl_:find("%.webp", 1, true) or hubUrl_:find("%.gif", 1, true)) then
				return hubUrl_
			end
		elseif hubUrl_:find("^/") then
			return CUSTOM_ASSETS_BASE .. hubUrl_
		end
	end

	local v_3 = customAssetsFileUrl(arg, "roblox")
	if v_3 then
		return v_3
	end
	local v_4 = customAssetsFileUrl(arg, "main")

	if v_4 then
		local v_5 = string.lower(v_4)
		if not (v_5:find("%.webp", 1, true) or v_5:find("%.gif", 1, true) or v_5:find("%.mp4", 1, true) or v_5:find("%.webm", 1, true)) then
			return v_4
		end
	end

	local url = arg.url or arg.preview_url
	if type(url) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local v_5 = string.lower(url)
	if v_5:find("%.webp", 1, true) or v_5:find("%.gif", 1, true) or v_5:find("%.mp4", 1, true) or v_5:find("%.webm", 1, true) then
		return nil
	end
	return url
end

customAssetsLog = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	local str = string.format("[%s][%s] %s", os.date("%X"), tostring(arg or "ASSET"), tostring(arg2))

	if arg3 ~= nil then
		str ..= " | " .. snpEncodeLogData(arg3)
	end

	if not writefile then
		return
	end
	table.insert(customAssetLogLines, str)

	if not customAssetLogFlushQueued then
		customAssetLogFlushQueued = true

		task.defer(function()
			customAssetLogFlushQueued = false
			snpWriteLogFile(CUSTOM_ASSETS_LOG, customAssetLogLines)
		end)
	end
end

customAssetsEnsureBgClip = function()
	local v_2 = customAssetsGetBgHost()
	if not v_2 then
		return nil
	end
	local snpBgClip = v_2:FindFirstChild("SNPBgClip")
	if snpBgClip and snpBgClip:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
		return snpBgClip
	end

	if snpBgClip then
		snpBgClip:Destroy()
	end

	local canvasGroup = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	canvasGroup.Name = "SNPBgClip"
	canvasGroup.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	canvasGroup.BorderSizePixel = 0
	canvasGroup.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	canvasGroup.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	canvasGroup.ZIndex = 0
	local n = Window and tonumber(Window.UICorner) or 12
	local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, n)
	uiCorner.Parent = canvasGroup
	canvasGroup.Parent = v_2
	return canvasGroup
end

customAssetsReparentIntoBgClip = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = customAssetsEnsureBgClip()
	if not v_2 then
		return
	end

	if arg.Parent ~= v_2 then
		arg.Parent = v_2
	end
end

end

		for _, child in ipairs(v_3:GetChildren()) do

			end
		end

end

customAssetsApplyBackgroundZoom = function()
	local n = math.clamp(tonumber(valueslider.backgroundZoom) or 100, 50, 250) / 100
	customAssetsEnsureBgClip()

	local function fn2(arg)
		if not arg then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			customAssetsReparentIntoBgClip(arg)
			arg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			arg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
			arg.Size = UDim2.new(n, 0, n, 0)
			arg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
			local uiCorner = arg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")

			if uiCorner then
				uiCorner:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end

	fn2(customAssetsGetWindBgImage())
	customAssetsForEachSheetLabel(fn2)
end

		end)

	end

	customAssetBgSheetToken = (customAssetBgSheetToken or 0) + 1
	if not customAssetsGetBgHost() then
		return
	end

	customAssetsForEachSheetLabel(function(arg)
		arg:Destroy()
	end)

	local v_2 = customAssetsGetWindBgImage()

	if v_2 then
		v_2.Visible = true
		v_2.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		v_2.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end
end

customAssetsEnsureSheetMeta = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return nil
	end
	local flag = type(arg.sheet) == "table"
	local num

	if flag then
		num = tonumber(arg.sheet.totalFrames or 0)
	else
		num = flag
	end

	if num and tonumber(arg.sheet.totalFrames) > 1 then
		return arg.sheet
	end

	if arg.id and customAssetCatalog.byId[arg.id] then
		customAssetsMergeHubFields(arg, customAssetCatalog.byId[arg.id])
		local flag2 = type(arg.sheet) == "table"

		if flag2 then
			flag2 = tonumber(arg.sheet.totalFrames or 0)
		end

		if flag2 and tonumber(arg.sheet.totalFrames) > 1 then
			customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_meta_from_catalog", { id = arg.id })
			return arg.sheet
		end
	end

	local str = tostring(arg.type or "backgrounds")
	local sheetJson = arg.files and arg.files.sheet_json

	if type(sheetJson) ~= "string" or sheetJson == "" then
		if arg.id then
			sheetJson = CUSTOM_ASSETS_BASE .. "/files/approved/" .. str .. "/" .. tostring(arg.id) .. "/sheet.json"
		end
	end

	if type(sheetJson) == "string" and sheetJson ~= "" then
		if not sheetJson:find("^https?://") then
			if sheetJson:find("^/") then
				sheetJson = CUSTOM_ASSETS_BASE .. sheetJson
			elseif arg.id then
				sheetJson = CUSTOM_ASSETS_BASE .. "/files/approved/" .. str .. "/" .. tostring(arg.id) .. "/sheet.json"
			end
		end

		customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_meta_fetch", { url = sheetJson })
		local v_2, v_3 = fetchUrl(sheetJson, nil, 15)

		if v_2 and type(v_3) == "string" then
			local ok, sheet = pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONDecode(v_3)
			end)

			ok = ok and type(sheet) == "table"

			if ok then
				ok = tonumber(sheet.totalFrames or 0)
			end

			if ok then
				arg.sheet = sheet
				customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_meta_ok", { id = arg.id, total = sheet.totalFrames, fps = sheet.frameRate })
				return sheet
			end

			customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_meta_bad_json", { id = arg.id })
		else
			customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_meta_fetch_fail", { id = arg.id, ok = v_2 })
		end
	end

	return nil
end

customAssetsSheetSources = function(arg, arg2)
	local tbl2 = {}
	if type(arg) ~= "table" or type(arg2) ~= "table" then
		return tbl2
	end
	local sheets = arg2.sheets
	if type(sheets) ~= "table" then
		return tbl2
	end

	for i, sheet in ipairs(sheets) do
		local file = type(sheet) == "table" and sheet.file or nil

		if type(file) == "string" and file ~= "" then
			local str = customAssetsFileUrl(arg, i == 1 and "sheet" or "sheet_" .. i)

			if not str and arg.id and arg.type then
				str = CUSTOM_ASSETS_BASE .. "/files/approved/" .. tostring(arg.type) .. "/" .. tostring(arg.id) .. "/" .. file
			end

			if str then
				local str2 = customAssetsExtFromUrl(str)

				if str2 ~= ".png" and str2 ~= ".jpg" and str2 ~= ".jpeg" then
					str2 = ".png"
				end

				local insert = table.insert
				local str3 = CUSTOM_ASSETS_SHEET_TAG .. "_" .. i .. str2

				insert(tbl2, {
					url = str,
					rel = "backgrounds/" .. tostring(arg.id) .. str3,
					frames = tonumber(sheet.frames) or 0,
					columns = tonumber(sheet.columns) or tonumber(arg2.columns) or 1,
				})
			end
		end
	end

	return tbl2
end

customAssetsStartSheetAnim = function(image, arg)
	customAssetsStopSheetAnim()
	if type(arg) ~= "table" or type(image) ~= "string" or image == "" then
		customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_anim_skip", { reason = "bad args", assetIdType = type(image), metaType = type(arg) })
		return false
	end
	local n = tonumber(arg.columns) or 1
	local n2 = tonumber(arg.totalFrames) or 1
	local n3 = tonumber(arg.frameSizeX) or 0
	local n4 = tonumber(arg.frameSizeY) or 0
	local num = tonumber(arg.durationSec)
	local n5 = tonumber(arg.frameRate) or 12

	if (not arg.frameRate or n5 < 1) and num and num > 0 and n2 > 1 then
		n5 = n2 / num
	end

	if n5 > 20 then
		n5 = 20
	end

	if n5 < 8 then
		n5 = 8
	end

	if n2 <= 1 or n3 <= 0 or n4 <= 0 or n <= 0 then
		customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_anim_skip", { reason = "bad meta", cols = n, total = n2, fw = n3, fh = n4, fps = n5 })
		return false
	end
	local n6 = tonumber(arg.sizeX) or n * n3
	local n7 = tonumber(arg.sizeY) or math.ceil(n2 / n) * n4
	local n8 = math.max(n6, n7)

	if n8 > 1024 then
		local n9 = 1024 / n8
		n3 = math.max(1, math.floor(n3 * n9 + 0.5))
		n4 = math.max(1, math.floor(n4 * n9 + 0.5))
		customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_rect_scaled", { maxDim = n8, scale = n9, fw = n3, fh = n4 })
	end

	local v_2 = customAssetsGetBgHost()
	if not v_2 then
		customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_anim_skip", { reason = "no Background host" })
		return false
	end
	local v_3 = customAssetsEnsureBgClip() or v_2
	local v_4 = customAssetsGetWindBgImage()

	if v_4 then
		v_4.Image = ""
		v_4.Visible = false
	end

	local imageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	imageLabel.Name = "SNPSheetBg"
	imageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	imageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	imageLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	imageLabel.ZIndex = 0
	imageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	imageLabel.Image = image
	imageLabel.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(n3, n4)
	imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	imageLabel.ImageTransparency = tonumber(valueslider.backgroundTransparency or 6) * 0.1
	imageLabel.Parent = v_3
	customAssetsApplyBackgroundZoom()

	customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_anim_start", {
		assetId = tostring(image):sub(1, 80),
		cols = n,
		total = n2,
		fw = n3,
		fh = n4,
		fps = n5,
		durationSec = num,
		sizeX = n6,
		sizeY = n7,
		windHidden = v_4 ~= nil,
	})

	local n9 = 0
	local n10 = 0
	local n11 = 1 / math.max(1, n5)
	local tbl2 = { { img = imageLabel, frames = n2, cols = n } }
	local v_5 = n2
	local n12 = 1

	local function fn2(arg2)
		local n13 = 0

		for i = 1, #tbl2 do
			local frames = tbl2[i].frames
			if arg2 < n13 + frames then
				return tbl2[i], i, arg2 - n13
			end
			n13 += frames
		end

		return tbl2[1], 1, 0
	end

	customAssetBgSheetConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		if not imageLabel or not imageLabel.Parent then
			customAssetsStopSheetAnim()
			return
		end
		n10 += deltaTime or 0
		local flag = false

		while n11 <= n10 do
			n10 -= n11
			n9 = (n9 + 1) % v_5
			flag = true
		end

		if not flag then
			return
		end
		local v_6, v_7, v_8 = fn2(n9)

		if v_7 ~= n12 then
			for i = 1, #tbl2 do
				tbl2[i].img.Visible = i == v_7
			end

			n12 = v_7
		end

		v_6.img.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(v_8 % v_6.cols * n3, math.floor(v_8 / v_6.cols) * n4)
	end)

	local sheetSources = type(arg) == "table" and arg.sheetSources or nil

	if type(sheetSources) == "table" and #sheetSources > 1 then
		customAssetBgSheetToken = (customAssetBgSheetToken or 0) + 1
		local v_6 = customAssetBgSheetToken

		task.spawn(function()
			for i = 2, #sheetSources do
				local v_7 = sheetSources[i]
				if v_6 ~= customAssetBgSheetToken then
					return
				end
				local image2 = v_7.frames > 0 and customAssetsEnsureLocal(v_7.url, v_7.rel) or nil
				if not image2 then
					customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_layer_fail", { index = i })
					return
				end
				local flag = v_6 ~= customAssetBgSheetToken

				if not flag then
					flag = not (imageLabel and imageLabel.Parent)
				end

				if flag then
					return
				end
				local clone = imageLabel:Clone()
				clone.Name = "SNPSheetBg" .. i
				clone.Image = image2
				clone.Visible = false
				clone.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
				clone.Parent = imageLabel.Parent
				table.insert(tbl2, { img = clone, frames = v_7.frames, cols = v_7.columns })
				v_5 += v_7.frames
				customAssetsLog("BG", "sheet_layer_added", { index = i, frames = v_7.frames, activeTotal = v_5, loopSec = v_5 / math.max(1, n5) })
			end
		end)
	end

	return true
end

end

hubParticleFallPalette = function()
	local spec = hubParticleFallState
	spec = spec and spec.spec
	if spec and type(spec.palette) == "table" and typeof(spec.palette[1]) == "Color3" then
		return spec.palette[1], spec.palette[2]
	end
	local amber = currentThemePalette or HUB_THEME_PALETTES and HUB_THEME_PALETTES.Amber
	if type(amber) ~= "table" then
		local color2 = Color3.fromRGB
		return Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), color2(163, 104, 26)
	end
	return amber.accent or Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), amber.accentDark or Color3.fromRGB(163, 104, 26)
end

		imageLabel.Image = v_2
		imageLabel.Parent = folder
		tbl2[i] = imageLabel

	pcall(function()
		ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(tbl2)
	end)

	folder:Destroy()
end

	end

	if snpBgClip then
		snpBgClip:Destroy()
	end

	hubParticleFallState = nil
end

	end
end

hubStartParticleFall = function(arg)
	local v_2 = HUB_AMBIENT_FALL[arg or HUB_PARTICLE_FALL_NAME]
	if not v_2 then
		return false
	end

	if not Window then
		return false
	end
	hubStopParticleFall()
	local v_3 = customAssetsEnsureBgClip()
	if not v_3 then
		return false
	end
	local v_4 = customAssetsGetWindBgImage()

	if v_4 then
		v_4.Image = ""
		v_4.Visible = false
	end

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "SNPParticleFall"
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	frame.ZIndex = 2
	frame.ClipsDescendants = true
	frame.Active = false

	pcall(function()
		frame.Interactable = false
	end)

	local n = Window and tonumber(Window.UICorner) or 12
	local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, n)
	uiCorner.Parent = frame
	frame.Parent = v_3
	local v_5 = hubParticleFallResolveGlowFrames()
	local v_6 = v_5 and v_5[4] or HUB_PARTICLE_GLOW_IMAGE
	hubParticleFallState = { spec = v_2 }
	local v_7, v_8 = hubParticleFallPalette()
	local imageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	imageLabel.Name = "SNPParticleBottomGlow"
	imageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	imageLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	imageLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	imageLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 14)
	imageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1.08, 0, 0.34, 0)
	imageLabel.Image = v_6
	imageLabel.ImageColor3 = v_8
	imageLabel.ImageTransparency = 0.634
	imageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	imageLabel.ZIndex = 2
	imageLabel.Parent = frame
	local imageLabel2 = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	imageLabel2.Name = "SNPParticleBottomCore"
	imageLabel2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	imageLabel2.BorderSizePixel = 0
	imageLabel2.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	imageLabel2.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 14)
	imageLabel2.Size = UDim2.new(0.76, 0, 0.24, 0)
	imageLabel2.Image = v_6
	imageLabel2.ImageColor3 = v_7
	imageLabel2.ImageTransparency = 0.435
	imageLabel2.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	imageLabel2.ZIndex = 2
	imageLabel2.Parent = frame
	local frame2 = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame2.Name = "SNPParticleBottomLine"
	frame2.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame2.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	frame2.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -2)
	frame2.Size = UDim2.new(0.36, 0, 0, 1)
	frame2.BackgroundColor3 = v_7
	frame2.BackgroundTransparency = 0.465
	frame2.ZIndex = 2
	frame2.Parent = frame
	local flag = v_2.kind == "emoji"
	local emojis = v_2.emojis
	local num = tonumber(v_2.count) or HUB_PARTICLE_FALL_COUNT
	local flag2 = v_2.rise ~= false
	local n2 = tonumber(v_2.spin) or 0

	local function fn2(arg2)
		if flag then
			local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			textLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
			textLabel.Text = emojis[(arg2 - 1) % #emojis + 1]
			textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
			textLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			textLabel.ZIndex = 3
			textLabel.Parent = frame
			return { label = textLabel }
		end

		local imageLabel3 = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		imageLabel3.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		imageLabel3.BorderSizePixel = 0
		imageLabel3.Image = HUB_PARTICLE_GLOW_IMAGE
		imageLabel3.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
		imageLabel3.ZIndex = 2
		imageLabel3.Parent = frame
		local frame3 = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame3.BorderSizePixel = 0
		frame3.ZIndex = 3
		frame3.Parent = frame
		local uiCorner2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
		uiCorner2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		uiCorner2.Parent = frame3
		return { glow = imageLabel3, dot = frame3 }
	end

	local particles = {}

	for i = 1, num do
		particles[i] = fn2(i)
	end

	local function fn3(arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		if flag then
			arg2.size = 16 + math.random(0, 10)
		else
			local tbl2 = { 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5 }
			arg2.size = tbl2[math.random(1, #tbl2)]
		end

		local size = flag and arg2.size or arg2.size
		arg2.x = size + math.random() * math.max(1, arg3 - size * 2)

		if arg5 then
			if flag2 then
				arg2.y = arg4 + math.random(0, 14)
			else
				arg2.y = -math.random(0, 14) - size
			end
		else
			arg2.y = math.random() * arg4
		end

		local n3 = 18 + math.random() * 24
		arg2.vy = flag2 and -n3 or n3
		arg2.vx = (math.random() - 0.5) * 16
		arg2.phase = math.random() * 3.1415926535897931 * 2
		arg2.wave = 1.2 + math.random() * 1.2
		arg2.rot = math.random() * 360
		arg2.rotSpeed = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * n2
	end

	local x_ = frame.AbsoluteSize.X
	local y = frame.AbsoluteSize.Y

	if x_ < 8 then
		x_ = 560
	end

	if y < 8 then
		y = 330
	end

	for i = 1, #particles do
		fn3(particles[i], x_, y, false)
	end

	hubParticleFallState.layer = frame
	hubParticleFallState.bottom = imageLabel
	hubParticleFallState.core = imageLabel2
	hubParticleFallState.line = frame2
	hubParticleFallState.particles = particles
	hubParticleFallState.t = 0
	hubParticleFallState.frame = 4
	hubParticleFallState.frameAcc = 0
	hubParticleFallState.glowFrames = v_5
	local color2 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

	conns.particleFallConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		local v_9 = hubParticleFallState
		if not v_9 or not v_9.layer or not v_9.layer.Parent then
			hubStopParticleFall()
			return
		end
		local n3 = tonumber(deltaTime) or 0
		v_9.t = v_9.t + n3
		local x_2 = v_9.layer.AbsoluteSize.X
		local y2 = v_9.layer.AbsoluteSize.Y
		if x_2 < 8 or y2 < 8 then
			return
		end
		local v_10 = math.sin(v_9.t * 2.1)

		if v_9.bottom then
			v_9.bottom.ImageTransparency = 0.634 + v_10 * 0.012
		end

		if v_9.core then
			v_9.core.ImageTransparency = 0.435 + v_10 * 0.008
		end

		if v_9.line then
			v_9.line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.465 + v_10 * 0.01
		end

		if v_9.glowFrames then
			v_9.frameAcc = v_9.frameAcc + n3

			while v_9.frameAcc >= 0.1 do
				v_9.frameAcc = v_9.frameAcc - 0.1
				v_9.frame = v_9.frame % 8 + 1
				local v_11 = v_9.glowFrames[v_9.frame]

				if v_9.bottom then
					v_9.bottom.Image = v_11
				end

				if v_9.core then
					v_9.core.Image = v_11
				end
			end
		end

		local v_11 = hubParticleFallPalette()
		local flag3 = v_9.spec.rise ~= false

		for i = 1, #v_9.particles do
			local v_12 = v_9.particles[i]
			v_12.x = v_12.x + v_12.vx * n3 + math.sin(v_9.t * v_12.wave + v_12.phase) * 8 * n3
			v_12.y = v_12.y + v_12.vy * n3
			v_12.rot = v_12.rot + v_12.rotSpeed * n3
			local n4 = flag and v_12.size + 8 or 14
			local flag4

			if flag3 then
				flag4 = v_12.y < -n4 or v_12.x < -24 or v_12.x > x_2 + 24
			else
				flag4 = v_12.y > y2 + n4 or v_12.x < -24 or v_12.x > x_2 + 24
			end

			if flag4 then
				fn3(v_12, x_2, y2, true)
			end

			local n5

			if flag3 then
				if v_12.y < y2 * 0.18 then
					n5 = 1 - math.clamp(v_12.y / math.max(1, y2 * 0.18), 0, 1)
				else
					n5 = 0

					if y2 * 0.92 < v_12.y then
						n5 = math.clamp((v_12.y - y2 * 0.92) / math.max(1, y2 * 0.12), 0, 1)
					end
				end
			elseif v_12.y < y2 * 0.08 then
				n5 = 1 - math.clamp(v_12.y / math.max(1, y2 * 0.08), 0, 1)
			else
				n5 = 0

				if y2 * 0.88 < v_12.y then
					n5 = math.clamp((v_12.y - y2 * 0.88) / math.max(1, y2 * 0.12), 0, 1)
				end
			end

			if v_12.label then
				v_12.label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v_12.x, v_12.y)
				v_12.label.Rotation = v_12.rot
				v_12.label.TextSize = v_12.size
				v_12.label.TextTransparency = 0.32 + n5 * 0.68
			else
				local v_13 = v_11:Lerp(color2, 0.28 + 0.72 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(v_12.phase + v_9.t * v_12.wave)))
				local size = v_12.size
				v_12.dot.BackgroundColor3 = v_13
				v_12.dot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.36 + n5 * 0.64
				v_12.dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
				v_12.dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v_12.x, v_12.y)
				local n6 = size * 5
				v_12.glow.ImageColor3 = v_13
				v_12.glow.ImageTransparency = 0.55 + n5 * 0.45
				v_12.glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(n6, n6)
				v_12.glow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v_12.x - size * 2, v_12.y - size * 2)
			end
		end
	end)

	return true
end

hubSetWindowBackgroundMedia = function(image, arg, arg2, arg3)
	local num = tonumber(arg2)
	local imageTransparency

	if num then
		imageTransparency = num
	else
		imageTransparency = (tonumber(valueslider.backgroundTransparency) or 6) * 0.1
	end

	customAssetsStopSheetAnim()
	hubStopParticleFall()
	if not Window then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		if type(v_) == "table" and v_.TransparencyValue == nil then
			v_.TransparencyValue = 0.2
		end

		if type(Window.ToggleTransparency) == "function" then
			Window:ToggleTransparency(true)
		end
	end)

	local v_2 = customAssetsGetBgHost()

	if v_2 then
		local snpVideoBg = v_2:FindFirstChild("SNPVideoBg")

		if snpVideoBg then
			snpVideoBg:Destroy()
		end
	end

	if type(arg3) == "table" and type(image) == "string" and image ~= "" then
		if customAssetsStartSheetAnim(image, arg3) then
			return
		end
	end

	local v_3 = customAssetsGetWindBgImage()

	if v_3 then
		v_3.Visible = true
		v_3.Image = image or ""
		v_3.ImageTransparency = imageTransparency
		v_3.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		v_3.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end

	pcall(function()
		local v_4 = Window
		local setBackgroundImage = v_4.SetBackgroundImage
		local v_5 = image
		local str

		if image then
			str = v_5
		else
			str = ""
		end

		setBackgroundImage(v_4, str)
		Window:SetBackgroundImageTransparency(imageTransparency)
	end)

	customAssetsApplyBackgroundZoom()
end

getHubBackgroundAsset = function(arg)
	if hubIsParticleFallBackground(arg) then
		return ""
	end

	if arg == "Default" or arg == nil or arg == "" then
		return BACKGROUNDS.Default
	end

	if BACKGROUNDS[arg] then
		return BACKGROUNDS[arg]
	end
	local v_2 = customAssetsResolveItem(arg)
	if not v_2 then
		return nil
	end
	local v_3 = customAssetsHubMediaUrl(v_2)
	if not v_3 then
		return nil
	end
	local str = customAssetsExtFromUrl(v_3)

	if str ~= ".png" and str ~= ".jpg" and str ~= ".jpeg" then
		str = ".png"
	end

	local str2 = customAssetsIsSheetItem(v_2) and CUSTOM_ASSETS_SHEET_TAG .. "_1" or "_hub"

	if str2 ~= "_hub" then
		pcall(function()
			for _, v_4 in ipairs({
				"_sheet.png",
				"_sheet_v2.png",
				"_sheet_v3.png",
				"_sheet_v4.png",
				"_sheet_v5.png",
				"_sheet_v6.png",
				"_sheet_v7.png",
			}) do
				local str3 = CUSTOM_ASSETS_DIR .. "/backgrounds/" .. v_2.id .. v_4

				if isfile and isfile(str3) and delfile then
					delfile(str3)
				end

				customAssetLocalCache["backgrounds/" .. v_2.id .. v_4] = nil
			end
		end)
	end

	return customAssetsEnsureLocal(v_3, "backgrounds/" .. v_2.id .. str2 .. str)
end

customAssetsApplyBackground = function(arg)
	customAssetsLog("BG", "apply_begin", { name = arg, customBackground = values.customBackground })

	if hubIsParticleFallBackground(arg) then
		hubSetWindowBackgroundMedia("", false)
		local flag = hubStartParticleFall(arg) == true
		customAssetsLog("BG", "apply_particle_fall", { ok = flag, name = arg })
		return flag
	end

	if arg == "Default" or arg == nil or arg == "" then
		hubSetWindowBackgroundMedia("", false)
		return true
	end
	local v_2 = BACKGROUNDS[arg]
	if v_2 ~= nil then
		hubSetWindowBackgroundMedia(v_2, false)
		return true
	end
	local v_3 = customAssetsResolveItem(arg)
	if not v_3 then
		customAssetsLog("BG", "apply_fail", { reason = "resolve", name = arg })
		return false
	end
	local v_4 = customAssetsEnsureSheetMeta(v_3)
	local flag = v_4 ~= nil or customAssetsIsSheetItem(v_3)

	if type(v_4) == "table" then
		v_4.sheetSources = customAssetsSheetSources(v_3, v_4)
	end

	customAssetsLog("BG", "apply_item", {
		id = v_3.id,
		title = v_3.title,
		kind = v_3.kind,
		hub_url = v_3.hub_url,
		hasSheetMeta = v_4 ~= nil,
		isSheet = flag,
		sheet = v_4,
		filesSheet = v_3.files and v_3.files.sheet or nil,
	})

	local v_5 = getHubBackgroundAsset(arg)
	if not v_5 then
		customAssetsLog("BG", "apply_fail", { reason = "ensure_local", id = v_3.id })
		return false
	end
	hubSetWindowBackgroundMedia(v_5, false, nil, flag and v_4 or nil)
	v_4 = flag and v_4
	local flag2 = false

	if v_4 then
		local v_6 = customAssetsGetBgHost()
		local snpBgClip = v_6 and v_6:FindFirstChild("SNPBgClip")
		local flag3 = v_6 ~= nil

		if flag3 then
			flag2 = (snpBgClip and snpBgClip:FindFirstChild("SNPSheetBg") or v_6:FindFirstChild("SNPSheetBg")) ~= nil
		else
			flag2 = flag3
		end
	end

	customAssetsLog("BG", "apply_done", { id = v_3.id, assetId = tostring(v_5):sub(1, 80), sheetAnim = flag2 })
	customAssetsReportUse(v_3.id)
	return true
end

customAssetsApplySkybox = function(arg)
	if not arg or not arg.files then
		customAssetsLog("SKY", "apply_fail", { reason = "no_files" })
		return false
	end
	local tbl2 = {}

	for _, v_2 in ipairs({ "Bk", "Dn", "Ft", "Lf", "Rt", "Up" }) do
		local v_3 = arg.files[v_2]
		if type(v_3) ~= "string" then
			customAssetsLog("SKY", "apply_fail", { reason = "missing_face", face = v_2, id = arg.id })
			return false
		end
		local v_4 = string.lower(v_3)

		if v_4:find("%.webp", 1, true) or v_4:find("%.gif", 1, true) then
			customAssetsLog("SKY", "apply_fail", {
				reason = "animated_or_webp_face",
				face = v_2,
				id = arg.id,
				hint = "re-upload skybox as PNG/JPG (GIF/WebP not allowed)",
			})

			return false
		end

		local v_5 = customAssetsExtFromUrl(v_3)
		local v_6 = customAssetsEnsureLocal(v_3, "skyboxes/" .. arg.id .. "_" .. v_2 .. v_5)
		if not v_6 then
			customAssetsLog("SKY", "apply_fail", { reason = "ensure_local", face = v_2, id = arg.id, ext = v_5 })
			return false
		end
		tbl2[v_2] = v_6
	end

	for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Sky") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
	sky.Name = "SNPWARE_Sky"

	for k, v_2 in pairs(tbl2) do
		sky["Skybox" .. k] = v_2
	end

	sky.Parent = Lighting
	customAssetsReportUse(arg.id)
	customAssetsLog("SKY", "apply_ok", { id = arg.id })
	return true
end

customAssetsResolveSoundId = function(arg)
	if GUN_SOUNDS[arg] then
		return GUN_SOUNDS[arg]
	end
	local v_2 = customAssetsResolveItem(arg)
	if not v_2 or not v_2.url then
		return nil
	end
	return customAssetsEnsureLocal(v_2.url, "gun_sounds/" .. v_2.id .. customAssetsExtFromUrl(v_2.url))
end

customAssetsResolveCursorId = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
		customAssetCursorSheet = nil
		return nil
	end
	local v_2 = customAssetCursorCache[arg]

	if v_2 then
		if v_2.pending then
			return v_2.assetId
		end

		if v_2.failed then
			return nil
		end

		if v_2.assetId then
			customAssetCursorSheet = v_2.sheet
			return v_2.assetId
		end
	end

	if cursorAssets[arg] then
		customAssetCursorSheet = nil
		customAssetCursorCache[arg] = { assetId = cursorAssets[arg], sheet = nil }
		customAssetsLog("CURSOR", "preset", { name = arg, assetId = tostring(cursorAssets[arg]):sub(1, 60) })
		return cursorAssets[arg]
	end

	customAssetCursorCache[arg] = { pending = true }
	local v_3 = customAssetsResolveItem(arg)

	if not v_3 then
		customAssetCursorSheet = nil
		customAssetCursorCache[arg] = { failed = true }
		customAssetsLog("CURSOR", "resolve_miss", { name = arg })
		return nil
	end

	local flag = v_3.type == "cursors" and (v_3.kind == "cursors_sheet" or customAssetsFileUrl(v_3, "sheet"))
	local v_4 = nil

	if flag then
		local v_5 = customAssetsEnsureSheetMeta(v_3)
		local flag2 = type(v_5) ~= "table"

		if not flag2 then
			flag2 = (tonumber(v_5.totalFrames) or 0) <= 1
		end

		if flag2 then
			v_4 = nil
		else
			v_4 = v_5
		end
	end

	local url

	if v_4 then
		url = customAssetsFileUrl(v_3, "sheet") or customAssetsHubMediaUrl(v_3)
	else
		url = customAssetsFileUrl(v_3, "roblox") or customAssetsFileUrl(v_3, "main") or customAssetsHubMediaUrl(v_3) or v_3.url
	end

	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		customAssetCursorSheet = nil
		customAssetCursorCache[arg] = { failed = true }
		customAssetsLog("CURSOR", "no_url", { name = arg, id = v_3.id, kind = v_3.kind })
		return nil
	end

	local v_5 = string.lower(url)

	if v_5:find("%.webp", 1, true) or v_5:find("%.gif", 1, true) then
		url = customAssetsFileUrl(v_3, "roblox") or customAssetsFileUrl(v_3, "sheet")

		if not url then
			customAssetCursorSheet = nil
			customAssetCursorCache[arg] = { failed = true }
			customAssetsLog("CURSOR", "gif_webp_blocked", { name = arg, id = v_3.id })
			return nil
		end
	end

	local str = customAssetsExtFromUrl(url)

	if str ~= ".png" and str ~= ".jpg" and str ~= ".jpeg" then
		str = ".png"
	end

	local str2 = v_4 and "_csheet_v2" or "_hub_v2"
	local v_6 = customAssetsEnsureLocal(url, "cursors/" .. v_3.id .. str2 .. str)

	if not v_6 then
		customAssetCursorSheet = nil
		customAssetCursorCache[arg] = { failed = true }

		customAssetsLog("CURSOR", "ensure_local_fail", {
			name = arg,
			id = v_3.id,
			url = tostring(url):sub(1, 120),
			path = "cursors/" .. v_3.id .. str2 .. str,
		})

		return nil
	end

	local tbl2 = nil

	if v_4 then
		local n = tonumber(v_4.columns) or 1
		local n2 = tonumber(v_4.totalFrames) or 1
		local n3 = tonumber(v_4.frameSizeX) or 0
		local n4 = tonumber(v_4.frameSizeY) or 0
		local n5 = tonumber(v_4.frameRate) or 12

		if n5 < 8 then
			n5 = 8
		end

		if n5 > 20 then
			n5 = 20
		end

		tbl2 = {
			assetId = v_6,
			frame = 0,
			acc = 0,
			step = 1 / math.max(1, n5),
			fw = n3,
			fh = n4,
			cols = n,
			total = n2,
		}
	end

	customAssetCursorSheet = tbl2
	customAssetCursorCache[arg] = { assetId = v_6, sheet = tbl2 }

	customAssetsLog("CURSOR", "resolve_ok", {
		name = arg,
		id = v_3.id,
		sheet = v_4 ~= nil,
		assetId = tostring(v_6):sub(1, 80),
		url = tostring(url):sub(1, 100),
	})

	return v_6
end

customAssetsInvalidateCursorCache = function(arg)
	if arg then
		customAssetCursorCache[arg] = nil
	else
		customAssetCursorCache = {}
	end
end

customAssetsTickCursorSheet = function(arg, arg2)
	local v_2 = customAssetCursorSheet

	if not v_2 or not arg then
		if arg then
			arg.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 0)
			arg.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		end

		return
	end

	if v_2.total <= 1 or v_2.fw <= 0 or v_2.fh <= 0 then
		arg.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		arg.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		return
	end

	v_2.acc = (v_2.acc or 0) + (arg2 or 0)
	local flag = false

	while v_2.step <= v_2.acc do
		v_2.acc = v_2.acc - v_2.step
		v_2.frame = ((v_2.frame or 0) + 1) % v_2.total
		flag = true
	end

	if flag or arg.ImageRectSize.X ~= v_2.fw then
		local n = v_2.frame % v_2.cols
		local n2 = math.floor(v_2.frame / v_2.cols)
		arg.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(v_2.fw, v_2.fh)
		arg.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(n * v_2.fw, n2 * v_2.fh)
	end
end

customAssetsRefreshDropdown = function(arg, arg2)
	if not arg or not arg.Refresh then
		return
	end
	local value = arg.Value

	pcall(function()
		arg:Refresh(arg2)
	end)

	if value == nil then
		return
	end
	local flag = false

	if type(arg2) == "table" then
		local flag2 = false

		for _, v_2 in ipairs(arg2) do
			if typeof(v_2) == "table" then
				v_2 = v_2.Title or v_2[1] or v_2.Name
			end

			if v_2 == value then
				flag2 = true
				break
			end
		end

		flag = flag2
	end

	if flag then
		arg.Value = value

		if arg.Display then
			pcall(arg.Display, arg)
		end
	end
end

currentThemePalette = HUB_THEME_PALETTES.Amber
hubButtonPaintList = {}

applyHubTheme = function(arg)
	local amber = HUB_THEME_PALETTES[arg] or HUB_THEME_PALETTES.Amber
	currentThemePalette = amber

	if activeNotifications then
		for _, v_2 in ipairs(activeNotifications) do
			local frame = v_2.Frame

			if frame and frame.Parent then
				local v_3 = amber
				local color2 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				local v_4 = v_3.accent:Lerp(color2, 0.58)
				local v_5 = v_3.accentDark:Lerp(color2, 0.74)
				local text = v_3.text or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

				if text.R < 0.4 then
					v_4 = v_3.accent:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 40), 0.32)
					v_5 = v_3.accentDark:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22), 0.22)
				end

				for _, descendant in ipairs(frame:GetDescendants()) do
					if descendant:IsA("UIStroke") then
						descendant.Color = v_3.accent
					elseif descendant:IsA("UIGradient") and descendant.Name == "ThemeGradient" then
						descendant.Color = ColorSequence.new(v_4, v_5)
					elseif descendant:IsA("TextLabel") and (descendant.Name == "NotifyBody" or descendant.Name == "NotifyContinue") then
						descendant.TextColor3 = text
					elseif descendant:IsA("Frame") and descendant.Name == "ProgressFill" then
						descendant.BackgroundColor3 = v_3.accent
					elseif descendant:IsA("Frame") and (descendant.Name == "NotifyTimerFill" or descendant.Name == "NotifyTimerTrack") then
						descendant.BackgroundColor3 = v_3.accent
					elseif descendant:IsA("Frame") and descendant.Name == "NotifyTimerHole" then
						descendant.BackgroundColor3 = v_4
					elseif descendant:IsA("ImageLabel") and descendant.Name == "GlowShadow" then
						descendant.ImageColor3 = v_3.accent
					end
				end

				frame.BackgroundColor3 = v_4
			end
		end
	end

	for i = #hubButtonPaintList, 1, -1 do
		local v_2 = hubButtonPaintList[i]

		if v_2.btn and v_2.btn.Parent then
			if v_2.border then
				v_2.border.Color = amber.accentDark
			end
		else
			table.remove(hubButtonPaintList, i)
		end
	end

	if Window and Window.EditOpenButton then
		pcall(function()
			Window:EditOpenButton({ Color = ColorSequence.new(amber.accent, amber.accentDark) })
		end)
	end

	hubApplyUiElementTransparency()

	if type(pulseApplyTheme) == "function" then
		pcall(pulseApplyTheme)
	end

	if type(hubPaintParticleGradients) == "function" then
		pcall(hubPaintParticleGradients)
	end

	if type(hubParticleFallApplyTheme) == "function" then
		pcall(hubParticleFallApplyTheme)
	end
end

hubUiElementTransparencySnap = hubUiElementTransparencySnap or {}

hubApplyUiElementTransparency = function()
	local n = math.clamp(tonumber(valueslider.uiElementTransparency) or 0, 0, 10)
	local themes = v_ and v_.GetThemes and v_:GetThemes()
	if type(themes) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	for k, theme in pairs(themes) do
		if type(theme) == "table" then
			local name = theme.Name or tostring(k)

			if hubUiElementTransparencySnap[name] == nil then
				hubUiElementTransparencySnap[name] = theme.ElementBackgroundTransparency
			end

			local elementBackgroundTransparency = hubUiElementTransparencySnap[name]

			if elementBackgroundTransparency == nil then
				elementBackgroundTransparency = 0
			end

			if n <= 0 then
				theme.ElementBackgroundTransparency = elementBackgroundTransparency
			else
				theme.ElementBackgroundTransparency = elementBackgroundTransparency + (0.93 - elementBackgroundTransparency) * n / 10
			end
		end
	end

	pcall(function()
		if v_.Creator and v_.Creator.UpdateTheme then
			v_.Creator.UpdateTheme(nil, false)
		elseif v_.Theme and v_.Creator and v_.Creator.SetTheme then
			v_.Creator.SetTheme(v_.Theme)
		end
	end)
end

end

hubApplyHubAppearance = function(arg)
	local str = arg or "manual"
	local theme = dropdownval.theme
	local backgroundImage = dropdownval.backgroundImage
	local n = tonumber(valueslider.backgroundTransparency) or 6
	configDbg("INFO", "appearance", "apply hub appearance", { source = str, theme = theme, backgroundImage = backgroundImage, backgroundTransparency = n })

	if theme and v_ and v_.SetTheme then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			v_:SetTheme(theme)
			applyHubTheme(theme)
		end)

		configDbg(ok and "INFO" or "WARN", "appearance", "theme apply", { source = str, theme = theme, ok = ok, err = ok and nil or tostring(result) })
	end

	if Window then
		if not values.customBackground then
			pcall(function()
				customAssetsApplyBackground("Default")
			end)

			backgroundImage = "Default"
		end

		local flag = false

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			flag = customAssetsApplyBackground(backgroundImage) == true
		end)

		if not (ok and flag) then
			local v_2 = getHubBackgroundAsset(backgroundImage)

			if v_2 then
				ok, result = pcall(function()
					hubSetWindowBackgroundMedia(v_2, false, n * 0.1)
				end)

				flag = ok
			else
				ok = false
				result = result or "background asset missing"
			end
		end

		configDbg(ok and flag and "INFO" or "WARN", "appearance", "background apply", {
			source = str,
			backgroundImage = backgroundImage,
			transparency = n * 0.1,
			ok = ok and flag,
			err = ok and flag and nil or tostring(result),
		})

		pcall(customAssetsApplyBackgroundZoom)
	end
end

gradient = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
	local str = arg4 and "<b>" or "<stroke color='#FFFFFF' thickness='1' transparency='0.1'><b>"
	local n = #arg

	for i = 1, n do
		local n2 = (i - 1) / math.max(n - 1, 1)
		str ..= "<font color=\"rgb(" .. math.floor((arg2.R + (arg3.R - arg2.R) * n2) * 255) .. ", " .. math.floor((arg2.G + (arg3.G - arg2.G) * n2) * 255) .. ", " .. math.floor((arg2.B + (arg3.B - arg2.B) * n2) * 255) .. ")\">" .. arg:sub(i, i) .. "</font>"
	end

	return str .. (arg4 and "</b>" or "</b></stroke>")
end

GetTarget = function(arg)
	if arg == "" or arg == nil then
		return nil
	end

	for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= localPlayer then
			if player.Name:lower():find(arg) or player.DisplayName:lower():find(arg) then
				return player
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

	targetview = ""
	dropdownval.flingPicked = {}
	dropdownval.killWhitelist = {}

	for _, v_2 in ipairs({ dropdownTeleport, dropdownFling, dropdownBang, dropdownView, dropdownKillWhitelist }) do
		if v_2 then
			if v_2.Multi then
				v_2.Value = {}

				if v_2.Select then
					pcall(v_2.Select, v_2, {})
				end
			else
				v_2.Value = nil

				if v_2.Select then
					pcall(v_2.Select, v_2, nil)
				end
			end

			if v_2.Display then
				pcall(v_2.Display, v_2)
			end
		end
	end
end

end

			tbl2[#tbl2 + 1] = v_2
		end
	end

	return tbl2
end

hubPreservePlayerTargetSelections = function(arg)
	local tbl2 = {}

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(hubPlayerNames(arg)) do
		tbl2[v_2] = true
	end

	if dropdownFling then
		local v_2 = hubKeepValidDropdownNames(dropdownFling.Value or dropdownval.flingPicked, tbl2)
		dropdownFling.Value = v_2
		dropdownval.flingPicked = v_2

		if dropdownFling.Display then
			pcall(dropdownFling.Display, dropdownFling)
		end
	end

	if dropdownKillWhitelist then
		local v_2 = hubKeepValidDropdownNames(dropdownKillWhitelist.Value or dropdownval.killWhitelist, tbl2)
		dropdownKillWhitelist.Value = v_2
		dropdownval.killWhitelist = v_2

		if dropdownKillWhitelist.Display then
			pcall(dropdownKillWhitelist.Display, dropdownKillWhitelist)
		end
	end

	local function fn2(arg2, arg3)
		if not arg2 then
			return
		end
		local v_2 = hubDropdownValueName(arg2.Value)

		if type(v_2) == "string" and v_2 ~= "" and not tbl2[v_2] then
			arg2.Value = nil
			arg3()
		end

		if arg2.Display then
			pcall(arg2.Display, arg2)
		end
	end

	fn2(dropdownTeleport, function()
		targetpl = ""
	end)

	fn2(dropdownBang, function()
		targetName = ""
	end)

	fn2(dropdownView, function()
		targetview = ""
	end)
end

hubRefreshTargetDropdowns = function(arg, arg2)
	local flag = arg == true
	local v_2 = hubPlayerNames(arg2)

	for _, v_3 in ipairs({ dropdownTeleport, dropdownFling, dropdownBang, dropdownView, dropdownKillWhitelist }) do
		if v_3 and v_3.Refresh then
			pcall(function()
				v_3:Refresh(v_2)
			end)
		end
	end

	if flag then
		hubClearPlayerTargetDropdowns()
	else
		hubPreservePlayerTargetSelections(arg2)
	end
end

hubStripPlayerTargetsFromConfigElements = function(arg)
	if not arg or not Window or not Window.PendingFlags then
		return
	end

	for k, pendingFlag in pairs(Window.PendingFlags) do
		if hubIsPlayerTargetDropdown(pendingFlag) then
			local v_2 = arg[k]

			if v_2 then
				hubConfigLogSkip("strip", "player_target_dropdown", k, { type = v_2.__type, value = v_2.value })
			end

			arg[k] = nil
		end
	end
end

findMurder = function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
		if not (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife") or character and character:FindFirstChild("Knife")) then
			continue
		end
		character = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if character and character.Health <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local flag = autofarmCachedRoundData and autofarmCachedRoundData[player.Name]

		if flag then
			flag = flag.Dead == true or flag.Killed == true
		end

		if flag then
			continue
		end
		return player
	end

	return nil
end

findSheriff = function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
		if backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
			return player
		end

		if character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
			return player
		end
	end

	return nil
end

murderSafeTpHidden = false
murderSafeTpAnchor = nil
murderSafeTpSavedCf = nil
murderSafeTpPlatform = nil

murderSafeTpRayParams = function(arg)
	local filterDescendantsInstances = { localPlayer.Character }

	if murderSafeTpPlatform then
		filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = murderSafeTpPlatform
	end

	if arg then
		filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = arg
	end

	local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
	return raycastParams
end

murderSafeTpHasLineOfSight = function(arg, arg2)
	if not arg or not arg2 or not arg2.Parent then
		return false
	end
	local parent = arg2.Parent
	local v_2 = murderSafeTpRayParams(parent)
	local tbl2 = { arg, arg + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), arg + Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 0) }
	local tbl3 = { arg2.Position, arg2.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), arg2.Position + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) }

	for i = 1, #tbl2 do
		local v_3 = tbl2[i]

		for i2 = 1, #tbl3 do
			local n = tbl3[i2] - v_3
			if n.Magnitude < 0.05 then
				return true
			end
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(v_3, n, v_2)
			if not hit or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(parent) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

findNearestMurdererHrpInRange = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	if not arg or not arg2 then
		return nil
	end
	arg3 = arg3 or autofarmCachedRoundData
	local n = arg2 + 1
	local v_2 = nil

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= localPlayer and findPlayerTool(player, "Knife") then
			local character = player.Character
			local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			character = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if humanoidRootPart and character and character.Health > 0 then
				local flag = arg3 and arg3[player.Name]

				if flag then
					flag = flag.Dead == true or flag.Killed == true
				end

				if not flag then
					local magnitude = (arg - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude

					if magnitude <= arg2 and magnitude < n and murderSafeTpHasLineOfSight(arg, humanoidRootPart) then
						n = magnitude
						v_2 = humanoidRootPart
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return v_2
end

murderSafeTpNotifyAt = 0
autofarmTpMurderNotifyAt = 0

hubTpToLobbySpawns = function(arg)
	local humanoidRootPart = arg or localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoidRootPart then
		return false
	end
	local spawns = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawns", true)
	if not spawns then
		return false
	end
	local children = spawns:GetChildren()
	if #children == 0 then
		return false
	end
	humanoidRootPart.CFrame = children[math.random(1, #children)].CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	return true
end

hubTpToMapSpawn = function(arg, arg2)
	local humanoidRootPart = arg or localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoidRootPart then
		return false, "no_hrp"
	end
	local tbl2 = {}

	for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if (descendant.Name == "Spawn" or descendant.Name == "PlayerSpawn") and descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(tbl2, descendant)
		end
	end

	if #tbl2 == 0 then
		return false, "no_spawn"
	end
	local v_2 = tbl2[math.random(1, #tbl2)]
	local cFrame = CFrame.new(v_2.Position) * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 0)

	local function fn2(arg3)
		if not arg3 or not arg3.Parent then
			return false
		end
		arg3.CFrame = cFrame
		arg3.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		arg3.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		return true
	end

	if not fn2(humanoidRootPart) then
		return false, "apply_fail"
	end
	local n = tonumber(arg2) or 0

	if n > 0 then
		local n2 = (autofarmMapSpawnStickyToken or 0) + 1
		autofarmMapSpawnStickyToken = n2

		task.spawn(function()
			for i = 1, n do
				if autofarmMapSpawnStickyToken ~= n2 then
					return
				end
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				if not fn2(localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
					return
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	return true, v_2.Name
end

autofarmTpEvacuateUntilMurderClear = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return
	end
	autofarmDbg("WARN", "coin", "teleport murder threat — evacuate lobby", autofarmSnap({ range = 16, anchor = string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", arg.X, arg.Y, arg.Z) }))

	pcall(function()
		local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		autofarmClearFlyForces(humanoidRootPart)
		hubTpToLobbySpawns(humanoidRootPart)
	end)

	while true do
		if values.runnings and not roundend and startround then
			if not findNearestMurdererHrpInRange(arg, 16) then
				autofarmDbg("INFO", "coin", "teleport murder clear — resume farm", autofarmSnap())
				break
			else
				local now = tick()

				if now - autofarmTpMurderNotifyAt >= 3 then
					autofarmTpMurderNotifyAt = now
					sendnotification(lc and lc.autofarm_murder_pause or "Farm paused: murderer in risk zone.", 3)
				end

				pcall(function()
					local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					if humanoidRootPart and (humanoidRootPart.Position - arg).Magnitude < 90 then
						hubTpToLobbySpawns(humanoidRootPart)
					end
				end)

				if autofarmLocalCanCollectCoins() then
					task.wait(0.2)
					continue
				end
			end
		end

		break
	end
end

murderSafeTpCleanup = function()
	if murderSafeTpPlatform and murderSafeTpPlatform.Parent then
		murderSafeTpPlatform:Destroy()
	end

	murderSafeTpPlatform = nil
	murderSafeTpHidden = false
	murderSafeTpAnchor = nil
	murderSafeTpSavedCf = nil
end

murderSafeTpActivate = function(arg, arg2)
	if murderSafeTpHidden or not arg then
		return
	end
	local position = arg.Position
	local position2 = position - Vector3.new(1000, 3, 1000)
	murderSafeTpAnchor = position
	murderSafeTpSavedCf = arg.CFrame
	murderSafeTpHidden = true
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "SNP_MurderSafePlatform"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(100, 1, 100)
	part.Position = position2
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = true
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Parent = workspace
	murderSafeTpPlatform = part
	arg.CFrame = CFrame.new(position2 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
	arg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	arg.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

	if arg2 then
		arg2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
	end
end

murderSafeTpReturn = function(arg)
	if not murderSafeTpHidden then
		return
	end

	if arg and arg.Parent and murderSafeTpSavedCf then
		arg.CFrame = murderSafeTpSavedCf
		arg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		arg.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end

	murderSafeTpCleanup()
end

local function fn2(arg)
	local v_2 = HUB_LOC_BRANCH_UP
	local v_3 = HUB_LOC_BRANCH_DOWN
	if arg:sub(1, #v_2) == v_2 then
		return arg:sub(#v_2 + 1)
	end

	if arg:sub(1, #v_3) == v_3 then
		return arg:sub(#v_3 + 1)
	end
	return arg
end

hubApplyLocBranches = function()
	local v_2 = HUB_LOC_BRANCH_UP
	local v_3 = HUB_LOC_BRANCH_DOWN

	for _, v_4 in pairs(HUB_TRANSLATIONS) do
		if type(v_4) == "table" then
			for k, v_5 in pairs(v_4) do
				if type(v_5) == "string" then
					local v_6 = fn2(v_5)

					if HUB_LOC_BRANCH_UP_KEYS[k] then
						v_4[k] = v_2 .. v_6
					elseif HUB_LOC_BRANCH_DOWN_KEYS[k] then
						v_4[k] = v_3 .. v_6
					else
						v_4[k] = v_6
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

hubApplyLocBranches()
