mobileSilentAimHookInstalled = false
mobileSilentAimOldNamecall = nil

ensureMobileSilentAimHook = function()
	if mobileSilentAimHookInstalled or type(hookmetamethod) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	mobileSilentAimHookInstalled = true

	local fn3 = newcclosure or function(arg)
		return arg
	end

	local function fn4(arg, arg2)
		if typeof(arg) == "Instance" and arg.Name == arg2 then
			return true
		end
		local str = tostring(arg)
		return str == arg2 or str:find(arg2, 1, true) ~= nil
	end

	mobileSilentAimOldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", fn3(function(arg, ...)
		if not values.silentAimhook and not values.KnifeAimEnabled then
			return mobileSilentAimOldNamecall(arg, ...)
		end

		if getnamecallmethod() ~= "FireServer" then
			return mobileSilentAimOldNamecall(arg, ...)
		end

		if values.silentAimhook and fn4(arg, "Shoot") and finalPos then
			if type(finalPos) == "table" then
				silentAimTelemetryHookShot(finalPos[1], finalPos[2])
				return mobileSilentAimOldNamecall(arg, table.unpack(finalPos))
			end

			if finalPos ~= Vector3.zero then
				local v_2 = table.pack(...)
				v_2[2] = CFrame.new(finalPos)
				silentAimTelemetryHookShot(v_2[1], v_2[2])
				return mobileSilentAimOldNamecall(arg, table.unpack(v_2, 1, v_2.n))
			end
		end

		if values.KnifeAimEnabled and fn4(arg, "KnifeThrown") and CurrentPredictionKnife and CurrentPredictionKnife ~= Vector3.zero then
			local v_2 = table.pack(...)
			v_2[2] = CFrame.new(CurrentPredictionKnife)
			return mobileSilentAimOldNamecall(arg, table.unpack(v_2, 1, v_2.n))
		end

		return mobileSilentAimOldNamecall(arg, ...)
	end))
end

hubSaveConfigLanguage = function()
	if not func.file or type(writefile) ~= "function" then
		return
	end

	local tbl3 = {
		language = hubLanguageCode(dropdownval.language),
		choice = true,
		valueControl = dropdownval.valueControl == ValueControlList.inputbox and "inputbox" or "slider",
	}

	if isfile("configlanguage.json") then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile("configlanguage.json"))
		end)

		if ok and type(result) == "table" and result.choice ~= nil then
			tbl3.choice = result.choice
		end
	end

	pcall(function()
		writefile("configlanguage.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(tbl3))
	end)
end

hubRangePreviewEnsure = function()
	if hubRangePreviewRing then
		return true
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "SNP_RangePreview"
	local v_2 = table.create(hubRangePreviewSegments)

	for i = 1, hubRangePreviewSegments do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = "RingSeg"
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		part.Size = Vector3.new(0.14, 0.06, 1)
		part.Parent = folder
		v_2[i] = part
	end

	hubRangePreviewRing = folder
	hubRangePreviewParts = v_2
	return true
end

hubRangePreviewGroundOrigin = function()
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	character = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	return Vector3.new(character.Position.X, character.Position.Y - character.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.08, character.Position.Z)
end

hubRangePreviewUpdateFrame = function()
	local v_2 = hubRangePreviewRing
	local v_3 = hubRangePreviewParts
	if not v_2 or not v_3 then
		return
	end
	local v_4 = hubRangePreviewGroundOrigin()
	if not v_4 then
		v_2.Parent = nil
		return
	end
	local n = math.max(1, hubRangePreviewRange)
	local n2 = #v_3
	local v_5 = hubRangePreviewColor

	for i = 1, n2 do
		local n3 = (i - 1) / n2 * 3.1415926535897931 * 2
		local n4 = i / n2 * 3.1415926535897931 * 2
		local n5 = v_4 + Vector3.new(math.cos(n3) * n, 0, math.sin(n3) * n)
		local n6 = v_4 + Vector3.new(math.cos(n4) * n, 0, math.sin(n4) * n)
		local v_6 = v_3[i]
		v_6.Size = Vector3.new(0.14, 0.06, (n6 - n5).Magnitude + 0.1)
		v_6.CFrame = CFrame.new((n5 + n6) * 0.5, n6)
		v_6.Color = v_5
		v_6.Transparency = 0
	end

	if v_2.Parent ~= workspace then
		v_2.Parent = workspace
	end
end

hubRangePreviewStopLoop = function()
	if hubRangePreviewConn then
		hubRangePreviewConn:Disconnect()
		hubRangePreviewConn = nil
	end
end

hubRangePreviewHide = function()
	hubRangePreviewStopLoop()

	if hubRangePreviewRing then
		hubRangePreviewRing.Parent = nil
	end
end

hubRangePreviewOnAdjust = function(arg, arg2)
	if hubConfigLoading then
		return
	end

	if not hubRangePreviewEnsure() then
		return
	end
	hubRangePreviewRange = math.max(0, tonumber(arg) or 10)

	if arg2 then
		hubRangePreviewColor = arg2
	end

	hubRangePreviewUpdateFrame()

	if not hubRangePreviewConn then
		hubRangePreviewConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(hubRangePreviewUpdateFrame)
	end

	hubRangePreviewHideToken = hubRangePreviewHideToken + 1
	local v_2 = hubRangePreviewHideToken

	task.delay(1.75, function()
		if v_2 == hubRangePreviewHideToken then
			hubRangePreviewHide()
		end
	end)
end

HUB_NUMERIC_RANGE = {}

hubInputOrSlider = function(arg, arg2)
	if arg2.Flag and type(arg2.Value) == "table" then
		local num = tonumber(arg2.Value.Min)
		local num2 = tonumber(arg2.Value.Max)

		if num and num2 then
			HUB_NUMERIC_RANGE[arg2.Flag] = { min = num, max = num2 }
		end
	end

	local rangePreview = arg2.RangePreview

	local function fn3(arg3)
		if rangePreview then
			hubRangePreviewOnAdjust(arg3, rangePreview)
		end

		arg2.Callback(arg3)
	end

	if IS_HUB_INPUT then
		local min = arg2.Value.Min
		local max = arg2.Value.Max
		local step_ = arg2.Step or 1
		local flag = false

		local tbl3 = {
			Title = arg2.Title,
			Type = "Input",
			Placeholder = tostring(min) .. " - " .. tostring(max),
			Flag = arg2.Flag,
			Value = tostring(arg2.Value.Default),
			Callback = function(arg3)
				if not flag then
					return
				end
				local num = tonumber(arg3)
				if not num then
					return
				end
				local n

				if step_ < 1 then
					n = math.clamp(num, min, max)
				else
					n = math.clamp(math.floor(num + 0.5), min, max)
				end

				fn3(n)
			end,
		}

		if arg2.Desc then
			tbl3.Desc = arg2.Desc
		end

		flag = true
		return (arg:Input(tbl3))
	end

	local tbl3 = { Title = arg2.Title, Value = arg2.Value, Step = arg2.Step, Flag = arg2.Flag, Callback = fn3 }

	if arg2.Desc then
		tbl3.Desc = arg2.Desc
	end

	return arg:Slider(tbl3)
end

getPlayerBackpack = function(arg)
	return arg and arg:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
end

findPlayerTool = function(arg, arg2)
	if not arg or not arg2 then
		return nil
	end
	local character = arg.Character

	if character then
		local v_2 = character:FindFirstChild(arg2)
		if v_2 then
			return v_2
		end
	end

	local v_2 = getPlayerBackpack(arg)
	return v_2 and v_2:FindFirstChild(arg2)
end

task.spawn(function()
	pcall(function()
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")

		fn3(HUB_CAT_BLINK)

		folder:Destroy()
	end)

	local function fn3()
		local openButtonMain = Window and Window.OpenButtonMain
		openButtonMain = openButtonMain and openButtonMain.Button
		if typeof(openButtonMain) ~= "Instance" then
			return nil
		end
		local textButton = openButtonMain:FindFirstChild("TextButton") or openButtonMain

		for _, descendant in ipairs(textButton:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("ImageLabel") then
				local image = descendant.Image or ""
				if image == HUB_CAT_IDLE or image == HUB_CAT_BLINK or string.find(image, "rbxassetid://", 1, true) then
					return descendant
				end
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	for i = 1, 20 do
		local v_2 = fn3()

		if v_2 then
			v_2.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
			v_2.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			v_2.Image = HUB_CAT_IDLE
			break
		else
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end

	while Window and Window.OpenButtonMain and not Window.Destroyed do
		task.wait(2.4 + math.random() * 2.2)
		local v_2 = fn3()

		if v_2 then
			v_2.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
			v_2.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

				v_2.Image = HUB_CAT_IDLE
			end
		end
	end
end)

Window:Tag({ Title = "loc:ver", Color = Color3.fromHex("#30ff6a") })
hubCloseParticleGui = nil
hubCloseParticlePool = nil
hubCloseParticleTweens = {}
hubCloseParticleTarget = nil
hubCloseParticleGen = 0
hubLastWindowPos = nil
hubLastWindowSize = nil

pcall(function()
	local function fn3(arg)
		if not arg then
			return
		end
		local snpCloseParticles = arg:FindFirstChild("SNP_CloseParticles")

		if snpCloseParticles then
			snpCloseParticles:Destroy()
		end
	end

	fn3(CoreGui)

	if robloxGui then
		fn3(robloxGui)
	end

	if type(gethui) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(gethui)

		if ok then
			fn3(result)
		end
	end
end)

do
	local function fn3(arg)
		local v_2 = hubCloseParticleGui

		if v_2 then
			arg -= v_2.AbsolutePosition
		end

		return UDim2.fromOffset(arg.X, arg.Y)
	end

	hubParticleThemeGradient = function()
		local function fn4(arg)
			if type(arg) == "table" and typeof(arg.Color) == "ColorSequence" then
				return arg.Color, tonumber(arg.Rotation) or 45
			end
			return nil
		end

		local theme = v_ and v_.Theme
		local n = nil
		local colorSequence = nil

		if theme then
			local accent = theme.Accent
			local getThemeProperty = v_.Creator and v_.Creator.GetThemeProperty

			if type(getThemeProperty) == "function" then
				local ok, result = pcall(getThemeProperty, "Accent", theme)

				if ok and result ~= nil then
					accent = result
				end
			end

			local v_2
			v_2, n = fn4(accent)

			if not v_2 then
				v_2, n = fn4(theme.Button)
			end

			if not v_2 then
				colorSequence, n = fn4(theme.Toggle)
			else
				colorSequence = v_2
			end
		end

		if not colorSequence then
			local amber = currentThemePalette or HUB_THEME_PALETTES.Amber
			colorSequence = ColorSequence.new(amber.accent, amber.accentDark)
			n = 45
		end

		return colorSequence, n or 45
	end

	hubPaintParticleGradients = function()
		if not hubCloseParticlePool then
			return
		end
		local v_2, v_3 = hubParticleThemeGradient()

		for i = 1, #hubCloseParticlePool do
			local v_4 = hubCloseParticlePool[i]

			if v_4 then
				local uiGradient = v_4:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")

				if uiGradient then
					uiGradient.Color = v_2
					uiGradient.Rotation = v_3
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function fn4()
		if hubCloseParticleGui and hubCloseParticleGui.Parent and hubCloseParticlePool and #hubCloseParticlePool == 12 then
			return
		end

		if hubCloseParticleGui then
			pcall(function()
				hubCloseParticleGui:Destroy()
			end)
		end

		local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		screenGui.Name = "SNP_CloseParticles"
		screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		screenGui.DisplayOrder = 20000
		screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

		pcall(function()
			screenGui.ClipToDeviceSafeArea = false
		end)

		if not pcall(function()
			screenGui.Parent = CoreGui
		end) or screenGui.Parent ~= CoreGui then
			if type(gethui) == "function" then
				local ok, parent = pcall(gethui)

				if ok and parent then
					pcall(function()
						screenGui.Parent = parent
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		screenGui.Enabled = false
		hubCloseParticleGui = screenGui
		hubCloseParticlePool = {}

		for i = 1, 12 do
			local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
			frame.Name = "P" .. i
			frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
			frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
			frame.Visible = false
			frame.Active = false
			frame.ZIndex = 200
			frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)

			pcall(function()
				frame.Interactable = false
			end)

			frame.Parent = screenGui
			local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
			uiCorner.Parent = frame
			Instance.new("UIGradient").Parent = frame
			hubCloseParticlePool[i] = frame
		end

		hubPaintParticleGradients()
	end

	local function fn5(arg)
		local button = nil
		local openButtonMain = Window and Window.OpenButtonMain

		if type(openButtonMain) == "table" then
			if arg ~= false then
				pcall(function()
					openButtonMain:Visible(true)
				end)
			end

			if openButtonMain.Button and openButtonMain.Button:IsA("GuiObject") then
				button = openButtonMain.Button
			end
		elseif typeof(openButtonMain) == "Instance" and openButtonMain:IsA("GuiObject") then
			button = openButtonMain

			if arg ~= false then
				pcall(function()
					button.Visible = true
				end)
			end
		end

		if not button then
			return nil
		end
		local absoluteSize = button.AbsoluteSize
		if absoluteSize.X > 2 and absoluteSize.Y > 2 then
			return button.AbsolutePosition + absoluteSize * 0.5
		end
		local parent = button.Parent

		if parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local absoluteSize2 = parent.AbsoluteSize
			if absoluteSize2.X > 2 and absoluteSize2.Y > 2 then
				return parent.AbsolutePosition + absoluteSize2 * 0.5
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function fn6()
		local main = Window and Window.UIElements and Window.UIElements.Main
		local isGuiObject = main and main:IsA("GuiObject")
		local absoluteSize = nil
		local absolutePosition = nil

		if isGuiObject then
			absolutePosition = main.AbsolutePosition
			absoluteSize = main.AbsoluteSize
		end

		local size = Window and Window.Size
		local offset = size and size.X.Offset or 580
		size = size and size.Y.Offset or 460

		if absoluteSize and absoluteSize.X >= 80 and absoluteSize.Y >= 80 then
			hubLastWindowPos = absolutePosition
			hubLastWindowSize = absoluteSize
			return absolutePosition, absoluteSize
		end

		if hubLastWindowPos and hubLastWindowSize then
			return hubLastWindowPos, hubLastWindowSize
		end

		if not absolutePosition then
			local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			currentCamera = currentCamera and currentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
			absolutePosition = Vector2.new((currentCamera.X - offset) * 0.5, (currentCamera.Y - size) * 0.5)
		end

		return absolutePosition, (Vector2.new(offset, size))
	end

	local function fn7(arg)
		fn4()
		hubPaintParticleGradients()
		hubCloseParticleGen = hubCloseParticleGen + 1
		local v_2 = hubCloseParticleGen

		for i = 1, #hubCloseParticleTweens do
			pcall(function()
				hubCloseParticleTweens[i]:Cancel()
			end)
		end

		hubCloseParticleTweens = {}

		for i = 1, 12 do
			local v_3 = hubCloseParticlePool[i]

			if v_3 then
				v_3.Visible = false
			end
		end

		if hubCloseParticleGui then
			hubCloseParticleGui.Enabled = false
		end

		local v_3, v_4 = fn6()
		local v_5 = fn5(arg ~= "close")

		if v_5 then
			hubCloseParticleTarget = v_5
		end

		local function fn8()
			if v_2 ~= hubCloseParticleGen then
				return
			end
			local flag = false

			for i = 1, 12 do
				local v_6 = hubCloseParticlePool[i]
				if v_6 and v_6.Visible then
					flag = true
					break
				end
			end

			if not flag and hubCloseParticleGui then
				hubCloseParticleGui.Enabled = false
			end
		end

		local function fn9()
			if v_2 ~= hubCloseParticleGen then
				return
			end
			local v_6 = fn5() or v_5 or hubCloseParticleTarget

			if not v_6 then
				if hubCloseParticleGui then
					hubCloseParticleGui.Enabled = false
				end

				return
			end

			hubCloseParticleTarget = v_6
			local v_7 = v_4
			local flag = not v_7 or v_7.X < 80
			local v_8 = v_3
			local v_9 = v_4

			if flag then
				v_8, v_9 = fn6()
			end

			local n = v_8 + v_9 * 0.5
			local n2 = v_6 - n
			local magnitude = n2.Magnitude

			if magnitude < 1 then
				magnitude = 1
				n2 = Vector2.new(0, -1)
			end

			local n3 = n2 / magnitude
			local vector2 = Vector2.new(-n3.Y, n3.X)
			local n4 = math.max(v_9.X, v_9.Y) * 0.55
			local n5 = math.max(v_9.X, v_9.Y) * 0.62
			local flag2 = arg == "open"
			local exponential, n6

			if flag2 then
				exponential = Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential
				n6 = 0.58
			else
				n6 = math.clamp(0.7 + magnitude / 1200, 0.95, 1.2)
				exponential = Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
			end

			local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(n6, exponential, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

			if hubCloseParticleGui then
				hubCloseParticleGui.Enabled = true
			end

			local n7 = 12

			for i = 1, 12 do
				local v_10 = hubCloseParticlePool[i]
				local n8 = n + n3 * (math.random() - 0.22) * n4 + vector2 * (math.random() - 0.5) * n5

				if flag2 then
					n8 = n + n3 * (math.random() - 0.5) * n4 * 0.34 + vector2 * (math.random() - 0.5) * n5 * 0.36
				end

				local n9 = 22 + math.random(0, 6)
				local n10 = 10 + math.random(0, 2)
				local n11 = v_6 + vector2 * (math.random() - 0.5) * 18 + n3 * (math.random() - 0.5) * 10
				v_10.Visible = true
				v_10.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25

				if flag2 then
					v_10.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(n10, n10)
					v_10.Position = fn3(v_6)
				else
					v_10.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(n9, n9)
					v_10.Position = fn3(n8)
				end

				task.delay((i - 1) * 0.012, function()
					if v_2 ~= hubCloseParticleGen or not v_10 or not v_10.Parent then
						return
					end
					local tbl3

					if flag2 then
						tbl3 = { Position = fn3(n8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(n10 + 4, n10 + 4) }
					else
						tbl3 = { Position = fn3(n11), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(n10, n10) }
					end

					local tween = TweenService:Create(v_10, tweenInfo, tbl3)
					hubCloseParticleTweens[#hubCloseParticleTweens + 1] = tween
					tween:Play()

					tween.Completed:Connect(function()
						if v_2 ~= hubCloseParticleGen or not v_10 or not v_10.Parent then
							return
						end
						local tween2 = TweenService:Create(v_10, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
						hubCloseParticleTweens[#hubCloseParticleTweens + 1] = tween2
						tween2:Play()

						tween2.Completed:Connect(function()
							if v_2 == hubCloseParticleGen and v_10 then
								v_10.Visible = false
								v_10.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
							end

							n7 -= 1

							if n7 <= 0 then
								fn8()
							end
						end)
					end)
				end)
			end
		end

		if arg == "close" then
			task.delay(0.32, fn9)
		else
			fn9()
		end
	end

	Window:OnClose(function()
		pcall(fn7, "close")

		if IS_HUB_PC then
			sendnotification(lc.keybind .. valuekeys.hubToggleKey, 9)
		end
	end)

	if type(Window.OnOpen) == "function" then
		Window:OnOpen(function()
			pcall(fn7, "open")
		end)
	end
end

HUB_BUTTON_BY_ID = {}
hubButtonsLockPosition = false
hubButtonDragSession = nil
hubButtonDragConns = nil

hubButtonIsTouchHeld = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return false
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return UserInputService:GetTouchInputs()
	end)

	if not ok or not result then
		return false
	end

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(result) do
		if v_2 == arg then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

hubButtonIsDragInputHeld = function(arg)
	if not arg or not arg.inputType then
		return false
	end

	if arg.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		return UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
	end

	if arg.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if arg.inputHeld then
			return true
		end
		return hubButtonIsTouchHeld(arg.activeInput)
	end

	return false
end

hubButtonResolveTouchInput = function(arg, arg2)
	if not arg or arg.inputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		return arg2
	end

	if not arg2 or arg2.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		return nil
	end

	if arg.activeInput and arg2 == arg.activeInput then
		return arg2
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return UserInputService:GetTouchInputs()
	end)

	if ok and result then
		if #result > 1 then
			arg.multiTouchSeen = true
		end

		if #result == 1 and not arg.multiTouchSeen then
			return result[1]
		end
	end

	return nil
end

hubButtonInputEndedMatches = function(arg, arg2)
	if not arg or not arg2 then
		return false
	end

	if arg.activeInput and arg2 == arg.activeInput then
		return true
	end

	if arg.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and arg2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

hubButtonFinishDragSession = function(arg)
	local v_2 = hubButtonDragSession
	if not v_2 then
		return
	end
	hubBtnLog(v_2.btnName or "?", "drag_finish", "save=" .. tostring(arg), "moved=" .. tostring(v_2.dragMoved))
	hubButtonDragSession = nil
	v_2.dragging = false
	v_2.inputHeld = false
	v_2.multiTouchSeen = false
	v_2.activeInput = nil

	if arg and v_2.dragMoved and v_2.savePosition then
		v_2.savePosition()
		hubBtnLog(v_2.btnName or "?", "pos_saved", v_2.lastX or "?", v_2.lastY or "?")
	end

	if v_2.dragMoved and v_2.suppressClick then
		v_2.suppressClick()
	end

	if v_2.onDragFinished then
		v_2.onDragFinished()
	end

	v_2.dragMoved = false
end

hubButtonEnsureDragConns = function()
	if hubButtonDragConns then
		return
	end
	hubButtonDragConns = {}

	table.insert(hubButtonDragConns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		local v_2 = hubButtonDragSession
		if not v_2 or v_2.locked or not v_2.dragging then
			return
		end
		local flag

		if v_2.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			flag = false

			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
				flag = true
			end
		else
			flag = false

			if v_2.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				local v_3 = hubButtonResolveTouchInput(v_2, input)

				if v_3 then
					flag = true
					input = v_3
				end
			end
		end

		if not flag then
			return
		end

		if not hubButtonIsDragInputHeld(v_2) then
			hubButtonFinishDragSession(true)
			return
		end
		local n = hubInputPosVec2(input.Position) - hubInputPosVec2(v_2.dragStart)
		local flag2 = not v_2.dragMoved

		if flag2 then
			local threshold = v_2.threshold
			flag2 = math.abs(n.X) + math.abs(n.Y) >= threshold
		end

		if flag2 then
			v_2.dragMoved = true
			hubBtnLog(v_2.btnName or "?", "drag_start", "delta=" .. tostring(n))
		end

		if not v_2.dragMoved then
			return
		end
		v_2.setPos(v_2.startOffset.X + n.X, v_2.startOffset.Y + n.Y)

		if v_2.dragMoved then
			v_2.savePosition()
		end
	end))

	table.insert(hubButtonDragConns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		local v_2 = hubButtonDragSession
		if not v_2 or not v_2.dragging then
			return
		end

		if not hubButtonInputEndedMatches(v_2, input) then
			return
		end
		hubButtonFinishDragSession(true)
	end))

	table.insert(hubButtonDragConns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local v_2 = hubButtonDragSession
		if not v_2 or not v_2.dragging then
			return
		end

		if v_2.inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end

		if not hubButtonIsDragInputHeld(v_2) then
			hubButtonFinishDragSession(true)
		end
	end))
end

hubButtonBeginDragSession = function(arg)
	hubButtonEnsureDragConns()

	if hubButtonDragSession and hubButtonDragSession ~= arg then
		hubButtonFinishDragSession(true)
	end

	hubButtonDragSession = arg

	if arg.onDragBegan then
		arg.onDragBegan()
	end
end

hubButtonSnapshotLivePositions = function()
	for k, v_2 in pairs(hubButtonControllers) do
		local v_3 = buttonParams[k]
		local btn = v_2 and v_2.btn

		if v_3 and btn and btn.Parent then
			local n = (v_2.sizeX or btn.Size.X.Offset) * 0.5
			local sizeY = v_2.sizeY or btn.Size.Y.Offset
			v_3.posX = btn.Position.X.Offset - n
			v_3.posY = btn.Position.Y.Offset - sizeY * 0.5
		end
	end
end

hubButtonScreenText = function(arg)
	if arg.screenText then
		return arg.screenText
	end

	if arg.title and arg.title:sub(1, 4) == "loc:" and lc then
		local str = arg.title:sub(5)
		if lc[str] then
			return lc[str]:gsub("<[^>]+>", "")
		end
	end

	return arg.id
end

hubButtonSync = function(arg)
	local v_2 = buttonParams[arg]
	local v_3 = HUB_BUTTON_BY_ID[arg]
	if not v_2 or not v_3 then
		return
	end
	local v_4 = hubButtonControllers[arg]

	if v_2.enabled then
		if not v_4 then
			hubBtnLog(arg, "create", "pos=" .. tostring(v_2.posX) .. "," .. tostring(v_2.posY))

			local ok, result = pcall(createButton, "HubBtn_" .. arg, hubButtonScreenText(v_3), v_2.sizeX, v_2.sizeY, v_2.corner, v_3.action, {
				posX = v_2.posX or 20,
				posY = v_2.posY or 20,
				onPosChanged = function(posX, posY)
					v_2.posX = posX
					v_2.posY = posY
				end,
			})

			if ok and result then
				hubButtonControllers[arg] = result
			else
				hubBtnLog(arg, "create_error", tostring(result))
			end
		else
			v_4:setSize(v_2.sizeX, v_2.sizeY)
			v_4:setCorner(v_2.corner)
		end

		local v_5 = hubButtonControllers[arg]

		if v_5 and v_5.setDragLocked then
			v_5:setDragLocked(hubButtonsLockPosition)
		end
	elseif v_4 then
		hubBtnLog(arg, "destroy")
		v_4:destroy()
		hubButtonControllers[arg] = nil
	end
end

hubButtonsSyncAll = function()
	hubButtonSnapshotLivePositions()

	for k in pairs(buttonParams) do
		hubButtonSync(k)
	end
end

hubButtonsDestroyAll = function()
	if hubButtonDragSession then
		hubButtonFinishDragSession(false)
	end

	for k, v_2 in pairs(hubButtonControllers) do
		if v_2 and v_2.destroy then
			v_2:destroy()
		end

		hubButtonControllers[k] = nil
	end

	if hubButtonsScreenGui then
		hubButtonsScreenGui:Destroy()
		hubButtonsScreenGui = nil
	end

	hubButtonZIndex = 50
end

hubButtonsSaveToConfigData = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	arg.buttonParams = buttonParams
end

hubButtonsLoadFromConfigData = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "table" or type(arg.buttonParams) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	for k, buttonParam in pairs(arg.buttonParams) do
		if buttonParams[k] and type(buttonParam) == "table" then
			for k2, v_2 in pairs(buttonParam) do
				buttonParams[k][k2] = v_2
			end

			for _, v_2 in ipairs({ "sizeX", "sizeY", "corner" }) do
				local v_3 = hubClampToElementRange("btn_" .. k .. "_" .. v_2, buttonParams[k][v_2])

				if v_3 ~= nil then
					buttonParams[k][v_2] = v_3
				end
			end

			valueslider["btn_" .. k .. "_sizeX"] = buttonParams[k].sizeX
			valueslider["btn_" .. k .. "_sizeY"] = buttonParams[k].sizeY
			valueslider["btn_" .. k .. "_corner"] = buttonParams[k].corner
			values["btn_" .. k .. "_enabled"] = buttonParams[k].enabled
		end
	end
end

hubButtonsApplyUiFromParams = function()
	hubButtonsLockPosition = values.hubButtonsLockPos == true
	if not Window or not Window.PendingFlags then
		hubButtonsSyncAll()
		return
	end
	local hubButtonsLockPos = Window.PendingFlags.hubButtonsLockPos

	if hubButtonsLockPos and hubButtonsLockPos.Set then
		pcall(hubButtonsLockPos.Set, hubButtonsLockPos, values.hubButtonsLockPos == true, true, false)
	end

	for k, v_2 in pairs(buttonParams) do
		local v_3 = Window.PendingFlags["btn_" .. k .. "_enabled"]

		if v_3 and v_3.Set then
			pcall(v_3.Set, v_3, v_2.enabled == true, true, false)
		end

		for _, v_4 in ipairs({ "sizeX", "sizeY", "corner" }) do
			local v_5 = Window.PendingFlags["btn_" .. k .. "_" .. v_4]
			local num = tonumber(v_2[v_4])

			if v_5 and num then
				hubSyncSliderUi(v_5, num)
			end
		end
	end

	hubButtonsSyncAll()
end

	local function fn29()
		fn6()

		local flag2 = pulseOverlay.prevFps == true
		local flag3 = pulseOverlay.prevTimer == true
		local fpsRow = pulseOverlay.fpsRow

				fpsRow.LayoutOrder = i
			elseif v_3 == "timer" then
				timerRow.LayoutOrder = i

		end

		local v_3 = fn27(visible, visible2)

		if v_2 and not flag then
			fn19()
			fpsRow.Visible = visible
			fpsRow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36)

						descendant.TextTransparency = 0

						descendant.ImageTransparency = 0

				end

		else

			end

			end

			end

findStat = function(arg)
	local v_2 = pairs
	local Stats2 = game:GetService("Stats")

	for _, descendant in v_2(Stats2:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant.Name == arg then
			return descendant
		end
	end

	return nil
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local now = os.clock()

		for i = 1, 6 do
			RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		end

		local n = os.clock() - now
		local n2 = 0

		if n > 0 then
			n2 = math.floor(6 / n + 0.5)
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
		end)

		local n3

		if ok and result then
			n3 = math.floor(result)
		else
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
				return localPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000
			end)

			ok2 = ok2 and result2
			n3 = 0

			if ok2 then
				n3 = math.floor(result2)
			end
		end

		local v_2 = findStat("Receive kBps")
		local v_3 = nil

		if v_2 then
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
				return v_2:GetValue()
			end)

			v_3 = nil

			if ok2 then
				v_3 = result2
			end
		end

		fps_para:SetDesc(string.format("FPS: %d\nNetwork Ping: %d ms\nReceived Network: %d KB/s", n2, n3, v_3 or 0))
		fn8(n2, n3)
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end)

applyStretch = function(arg)
	values.loopStretch = arg == true

	pcall(function()
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(conns.stretchBindName)
	end)

	if not values.loopStretch then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = valueslider

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(conns.stretchBindName, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
		local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not currentCamera or not v_2 then
			return
		end
		local n = tonumber(v_2.stretch) or 0.65

		if n < 0.2 then
			n = 0.2
		elseif n > 1 then
			n = 1
		end

		currentCamera.CFrame = currentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, n, 0, 0, 0, 1)
	end)
end

randomString = function()
	local tbl3 = {}

	for i = 1, math.random(10, 20) do
		tbl3[i] = string.char(math.random(32, 126))
	end

	return table.concat(tbl3)
end

		end

	end

	local function fn13(animId, arg)
		pcall(function()
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not character or not humanoid then
				return
			end
			local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")

			if tbl3.animTrack and tbl3.animId == animId and tbl3.animTrack.IsPlaying then
				if math.abs(tbl3.animTrack.TimePosition - arg) > 0.04 then
					fn11(tbl3.animTrack, arg)
				end

				return
			end

			if animate then
				animate.Disabled = true
			end

			local animTrack = tbl3.animTrack

			for _, v_2 in pairs(humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
				if v_2 ~= animTrack then
					v_2:Stop(0.2)
				end
			end

			if animTrack and animTrack.IsPlaying then
				animTrack:Stop(0.2)
			end

			local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
			animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. animId
			local v_2 = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
			v_2.Looped = true
			v_2.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
			v_2:Play(0.2, 1, 0)
			fn11(v_2, arg)

			if v_2.Length <= 0 then
				task.defer(function()
					if tbl3.animTrack == v_2 and v_2.IsPlaying then
						fn11(v_2, arg)
					end
				end)
			end

			tbl3.animId = animId
			tbl3.animTrack = v_2

			v_2.Stopped:Connect(function()
				if tbl3.animTrack == v_2 then
					tbl3.animTrack = nil
					tbl3.animId = nil
				end

				if values.flyEnabled and values.flySmoothAnim and animate and animate.Parent then
					animate.Disabled = true
				elseif animate and animate.Parent then
					animate.Disabled = false
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

	local function fn14(arg, arg2)
		local n = math.abs(arg)
		local n2 = math.abs(arg2)
		local lastBucket = tbl3.lastBucket

		if n < 0.14 and n2 < 0.14 then
			if lastBucket == "hover" or n < 0.08 and n2 < 0.08 then
				return "hover"
			end

			if lastBucket and lastBucket ~= "hover" then
				return lastBucket
			end
			return "hover"
		end

		local str

		if n2 <= n then
			str = arg >= 0 and "fwd" or "back"
		else
			str = arg2 >= 0 and "right" or "left"
		end

		if not lastBucket or lastBucket == "hover" then
			if math.max(n, n2) < 0.28 then
				return "hover"
			end
			return str
		end

		if str == lastBucket then
			return lastBucket
		end
		local flag = (lastBucket == "fwd" or lastBucket == "back") and n or n2
		n = (str == "fwd" or str == "back") and n or n2
		if n >= 0.28 and n >= flag + 0.12 then
			return str
		end
		return lastBucket
	end

	local function fn15(arg, arg2, pendingSince)
		local v_2 = fn14(arg, arg2)
		pendingSince = pendingSince or os.clock()
		if v_2 == tbl3.lastBucket then
			tbl3.pendingBucket = nil
			return
		end

		if tbl3.pendingBucket ~= v_2 then
			tbl3.pendingBucket = v_2
			tbl3.pendingSince = pendingSince
			return
		end

		if pendingSince - tbl3.pendingSince < 0.12 then
			return
		end
		tbl3.lastBucket = v_2
		tbl3.pendingBucket = nil

		if v_2 == "fwd" then
			fn13(10714177846, 4.65)
		elseif v_2 == "back" then
			fn13(10147823318, 4.11)
		elseif v_2 == "left" then
			fn13(10147823318, 3.55)
		elseif v_2 == "right" then
			fn13(10147823318, 4.81)
		else
			fn13(10714347256, 4)
		end
	end

	local function fn16(arg)
		local v_2 = tbl3
		local v_3 = tbl3
		local v_4 = tbl3
		tbl3.ctrlF = 0
		v_2.ctrlB = 0
		v_3.ctrlL = 0
		v_4.ctrlR = 0
		local v_5 = tbl3
		local v_6 = tbl3
		local v_7 = tbl3
		tbl3.smoothF = 0
		v_5.smoothB = 0
		v_6.smoothL = 0
		v_7.smoothR = 0
		tbl3.currentVel = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
		tbl3.currentLie = 0
		fn12()

		if arg and values.flyEnabled and values.flySmoothAnim then
			fn13(10714347256, 4)
			tbl3.lastBucket = "hover"
		end
	end

	local function fn17(arg)
		if not arg then
			return
		end

		if values.flySmoothAnim then
			arg.P = 30000
			arg.D = 900
		else
			arg.P = 1000
			arg.D = 50
		end
	end

	getRoot = function(arg)
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			if typeof(arg) ~= "Instance" then
				return nil
			end
			return arg:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or arg:FindFirstChild("Torso") or arg:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or nil
		end)

		return ok and result or nil
	end

	hubKeybindKeyCode = function(arg)
		local pendingFlags = Window and Window.PendingFlags and Window.PendingFlags[arg]
		pendingFlags = pendingFlags and pendingFlags.Value

		if type(pendingFlags) ~= "string" or pendingFlags == "" then
			pendingFlags = valuekeys[arg]
		end

		if type(pendingFlags) ~= "string" or pendingFlags == "" then
			return nil
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return Enum.KeyCode[pendingFlags]
		end)

		if not ok or typeof(result) ~= "EnumItem" then
			return nil
		end
		return result
	end

	local function fn18(arg)
		local v_2 = hubKeybindKeyCode(arg)
		return v_2 ~= nil and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(v_2)
	end

	local function fn19()
		if not IS_HUB_PC then
			return 0
		end

		if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			return 0
		end

		if not values.kbFlyVertical then
			return 0
		end
		local n = 0

		if fn18("kbFlyUpKey") then
			n = 1
		end

		if fn18("kbFlyDownKey") then
			n -= 1
		end

		return n
	end

	flyTog = Tabs.character:Toggle({
		Title = "loc:fly",
		Value = values.flyEnabled,
		Flag = "flyEnabled",
		Callback = function(flyEnabled)
			values.flyEnabled = flyEnabled
			local v_2 = getRoot(localPlayer.Character)

			if flyEnabled then
				local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local vector = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
				local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				bodyVelocity.Name = velocityHandlerName

				bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.zero
				bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
				local bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
				bodyGyro.Name = gyroHandlerName
				bodyGyro.Parent = v_2
				bodyGyro.MaxTorque = vector
				fn17(bodyGyro)

				if values.flySmoothAnim then
					fn16(true)
				end

				if conns.mflyCharConn then
					conns.mflyCharConn:Disconnect()
				end

				conns.mflyCharConn = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
					character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 67)
					local v_3 = getRoot(character)
					if not v_3 then
						return
					end
					v_2 = v_3
					local bodyVelocity2 = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
					bodyVelocity2.Name = velocityHandlerName
					bodyVelocity2.Parent = v_3
					bodyVelocity2.MaxForce = Vector3.zero
					bodyVelocity2.Velocity = Vector3.zero
					local bodyGyro2 = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
					bodyGyro2.Name = gyroHandlerName
					bodyGyro2.Parent = v_3
					bodyGyro2.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
					fn17(bodyGyro2)

					if values.flySmoothAnim then
						fn16(true)
					end
				end)

				if conns.mflyRenderConn then
					conns.mflyRenderConn:Disconnect()
				end

				conns.mflyRenderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
					if values.alr then
						return
					end
					v_2 = getRoot(localPlayer.Character)
					currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
					local n = math.clamp(tonumber(deltaTime) or 0.016, 0, 0.05)

					if localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid") and v_2 then
						local humanoid = localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
						local v_3 = v_2:FindFirstChild(velocityHandlerName)
						local v_4 = v_2:FindFirstChild(gyroHandlerName)

						if v_3 and v_4 then
							v_3.MaxForce = vector
							v_4.MaxTorque = vector
							humanoid.PlatformStand = true
							fn17(v_4)

							if values.flySmoothAnim and currentCamera then
								local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
								local lookVector = currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
								local rightVector = currentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
								local vector2 = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z)
								local vector3 = Vector3.new(rightVector.X, 0, rightVector.Z)
								local n2 = 0
								local n3 = 0

								if vector2.Magnitude >= 0.05 then
									local unit = vector2.Unit
									local unit2 = vector3.Magnitude > 0.05 and vector3.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
									local vector4 = Vector3.new(moveDirection.X, 0, moveDirection.Z)
									local magnitude = vector4.Magnitude
									local n4 = 0
									local n5 = 0

									if not (magnitude > 0.05) then
										n2 = n4
										n3 = n5
									else
										local unit3 = vector4.Unit
										n2 = unit3:Dot(unit) * math.clamp(magnitude, 0, 1)
										n3 = unit3:Dot(unit2) * math.clamp(magnitude, 0, 1)
									end
								end

								tbl3.ctrlF = math.max(n2, 0)
								tbl3.ctrlB = math.min(n2, 0)
								tbl3.ctrlL = math.min(n3, 0)
								tbl3.ctrlR = math.max(n3, 0)
								local v_5 = fn9(12, n)
								tbl3.smoothF = fn10(tbl3.smoothF, tbl3.ctrlF, v_5)
								tbl3.smoothB = fn10(tbl3.smoothB, tbl3.ctrlB, v_5)
								tbl3.smoothL = fn10(tbl3.smoothL, tbl3.ctrlL, v_5)
								tbl3.smoothR = fn10(tbl3.smoothR, tbl3.ctrlR, v_5)
								local n4 = tbl3.smoothF + tbl3.smoothB
								local n5 = tbl3.smoothL + tbl3.smoothR
								fn15(n4, n5, os.clock())
								local n6 = math.clamp(math.sqrt(n4 * n4 + n5 * n5), 0, 1)
								local n7 = lookVector * n4 + rightVector * n5
								local unit = n7.Magnitude > 0.0001 and n7.Unit or Vector3.zero
								local n8 = tonumber(valueslider.newflySpeed) or 50
								local n9 = unit * n8 * n6
								local v_6 = fn19()
								local n10

								if v_6 ~= 0 then
									n10 = n9 + Vector3.new(0, v_6 * n8, 0)
								else
									n10 = n9
								end

								if n10.Magnitude < 0.05 then
									n10 = Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0)
								end

								tbl3.currentVel = tbl3.currentVel:Lerp(n10, fn9(8, n))
								v_3.Velocity = tbl3.currentVel
								local vector4 = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z)

								if vector4.Magnitude < 0.05 then
									vector4 = Vector3.new(currentCamera.CFrame.UpVector.X, 0, currentCamera.CFrame.UpVector.Z)
								end

								local vector5 = vector4.Magnitude < 0.05 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) or vector4.Unit
								local vector6 = Vector3.new(tbl3.currentVel.X, 0, tbl3.currentVel.Z)
								local unit2 = vector6.Magnitude > 2 and vector6.Unit or vector5
								local n11

								if n4 > 0.05 then
									n11 = math.clamp(n4, 0, 1)
								else
									n11 = 0

									if n6 > 0.05 then
										n11 = 0.75 * n6
									end
								end

								tbl3.currentLie = fn10(tbl3.currentLie, n11, fn9(9, n))
								v_4.CFrame = v_4.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(v_2.Position, v_2.Position + unit2) * CFrame.Angles(-1.5707963267948966 * tbl3.currentLie, 0, 0), fn9(10, n))
							else
								v_4.CFrame = currentCamera.CFrame
								local vector2 = Vector3.new()
								local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection

								if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
									local lookVector = currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
									local rightVector = currentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
									local unit = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z).Unit
									local unit2 = Vector3.new(rightVector.X, 0, rightVector.Z).Unit
									local v_5 = Vector3.new(moveDirection.X, 0, moveDirection.Z):Dot(unit)
									local newflySpeed = valueslider.newflySpeed
									vector2 = (lookVector * v_5 + unit2 * Vector3.new(moveDirection.X, 0, moveDirection.Z):Dot(unit2)) * newflySpeed
								end

								local v_5 = fn19()

								if v_5 ~= 0 then
									vector2 += Vector3.new(0, v_5 * (tonumber(valueslider.newflySpeed) or 50), 0)
								end

								v_3.Velocity = vector2
							end
						end
					end
				end)
			else
				fn12()
				fn16(false)

				if v_2 then
					local v_3 = v_2:FindFirstChild(velocityHandlerName)

					if v_3 then
						v_3:Destroy()
					end

					local v_4 = v_2:FindFirstChild(gyroHandlerName)

					if v_4 then
						v_4:Destroy()
					end
				end

				if localPlayer.Character then
					local humanoid = localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")

					if humanoid then
						humanoid.PlatformStand = false
					end
				end

				if conns.mflyCharConn then
					conns.mflyCharConn:Disconnect()
					conns.mflyCharConn = nil
				end

				if conns.mflyRenderConn then
					conns.mflyRenderConn:Disconnect()
					conns.mflyRenderConn = nil
				end
			end
		end,
	})

Tabs.character:Button({
	Title = "loc:reset",
	Desc = "",
	Callback = function()
		local character = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
		character = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not character or not character.Parent then
			return
		end
		local flag = character.Health <= 0

		if not flag then
			local dead = Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
			flag = character:GetState() == dead
		end

		if flag then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if hubResetLastAt and now - hubResetLastAt < 1 then
			return
		end
		hubResetLastAt = now
		character.Health = 0
	end,
})

getGunDropPart = function()
	local gunDrop = workspace:FindFirstChild("GunDrop", true)
	if not gunDrop then
		return nil
	end

	if gunDrop:IsA("BasePart") then
		return gunDrop
	end
	return gunDrop:FindFirstChild("Handle", true) or gunDrop:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end

TeleportToGunOLD = function()
	if findMurder() == localPlayer then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = getGunDropPart()
	if not v_2 then
		sendnotification(lc.waitgundrop, 10)
		return
	end
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		sendnotification(lc.rootpart, 10)
		return
	end
	local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoidRootPart then
		sendnotification(lc.rootpart, 10)
		return
	end
	local position = humanoidRootPart.Position
	humanoidRootPart.CFrame = v_2.CFrame
	task.wait(0.2)
	humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position.X, position.Y + 5, position.Z)
end

TeleportToGun = function()
	if not func.fire then
		TeleportToGunOLD()
		return
	end

	if findMurder() == localPlayer then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = getGunDropPart()
	if not v_2 then
		sendnotification(lc.waitgundrop, 10)
		return
	end
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	character = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not character then
		sendnotification(lc.rootpart, 10)
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(firetouchinterest, character, v_2, 0)
	task.wait(0.1)
	pcall(firetouchinterest, character, v_2, 1)

	if not ok then
		TeleportToGunOLD()
	end
end

GRAB_GUN_SAFE_RANGE = 15
grabGunSafeNotifyAt = 0
grabGunSafeBusy = false

grabGunFetchPlayerDataOnce = function()
	if not GetCurrentPlayerData then
		return nil, "no_remote"
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return GetCurrentPlayerData:InvokeServer()
	end)

	if not ok then
		return nil, "invoke_fail"
	end

	if type(result) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "empty"
	end
	local n = 0

	for k in pairs(result) do
		n += 1
	end

	if n == 0 then
		return result, "empty"
	end
	return result, nil
end

grabGunSafeDefault = function(arg)
	if grabGunSafeBusy then
		return
	end
	grabGunSafeBusy = true

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		if findPlayerTool(localPlayer, "Knife") ~= nil then
			sendnotification(lc and lc.grabgun_you_murderer or "You have a knife — you are the murderer, cannot grab the gun.", 4)
			return
		end
		local v_2, v_3 = grabGunFetchPlayerDataOnce()
		if v_3 == "empty" or v_3 == "no_remote" or v_3 == "invoke_fail" or not v_2 then
			sendnotification(lc and lc.grabgun_no_round or "No round data (lobby / map loading) — grab gun unavailable.", 4)
			return
		end
		local v_4 = v_2[localPlayer.Name]
		if v_4 and (v_4.Dead == true or v_4.Killed == true) then
			sendnotification(lc and lc.grabgun_you_dead or "You are dead (Dead/Killed) — cannot grab the gun.", 4)
			return
		end

		if v_4 and v_4.Role == "Murderer" then
			sendnotification(lc and lc.grabgun_you_murderer or "You have a knife — you are the murderer, cannot grab the gun.", 4)
			return
		end
		local v_5 = getGunDropPart()
		if not v_5 then
			sendnotification(lc.waitgundrop, 10)
			return
		end
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		if not (character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
			sendnotification(lc.rootpart, 10)
			return
		end

		if arg then
			while v_5 and v_5.Parent do
				if not values.autoGrabGun then
					return
				end

				if findPlayerTool(localPlayer, "Knife") ~= nil then
					sendnotification(lc and lc.grabgun_you_murderer or "You have a knife — you are the murderer, cannot grab the gun.", 4)
					return
				end

				if not findNearestMurdererHrpInRange(v_5.Position, GRAB_GUN_SAFE_RANGE, v_2) then
					break
				end
				local now = tick()

				if now - grabGunSafeNotifyAt >= 3 then
					grabGunSafeNotifyAt = now
					sendnotification(lc and lc.grabgun_murder_nearby or "Murderer near the gun — not teleporting, waiting.", 3)
				end

				task.wait(0.15)
				v_5 = getGunDropPart()
			end

			if not values.autoGrabGun then
				return
			end
		elseif findNearestMurdererHrpInRange(v_5.Position, GRAB_GUN_SAFE_RANGE, v_2) then
			sendnotification(lc and lc.grabgun_murder_blocked or "Murderer near the gun — teleport cancelled.", 4)
			return
		end

		if not v_5 or not v_5.Parent then
			return
		end

		if findPlayerTool(localPlayer, "Knife") ~= nil then
			sendnotification(lc and lc.grabgun_you_murderer or "You have a knife — you are the murderer, cannot grab the gun.", 4)
			return
		end

		if findNearestMurdererHrpInRange(v_5.Position, GRAB_GUN_SAFE_RANGE, v_2) then
			if not arg then
				sendnotification(lc and lc.grabgun_murder_blocked or "Murderer near the gun — teleport cancelled.", 4)
			end

			return
		end

		TeleportToGunOLD()
	end)

	if not ok then
		warn("[grabGunSafeDefault]", result)
	end

	grabGunSafeBusy = false
end

grabGunByMode = function(arg)
	local teleportGunMode = dropdownval.teleportGunMode

	if teleportGunMode == "Remote" then
		TeleportToGun()
	elseif teleportGunMode == "Safe default" then
		grabGunSafeDefault(arg == true)
	else
		TeleportToGunOLD()
	end
end

Tabs.teleport:Toggle({
	Title = "loc:autograbgun",
	Compact = true,
	Value = values.autoGrabGun,
	Flag = "autoGrabGun",
	Callback = function(autoGrabGun)
		values.autoGrabGun = autoGrabGun

		if conns.gunDropChildConn then
			conns.gunDropChildConn:Disconnect()
			conns.gunDropChildConn = nil
		end

		if conns.gunDropDescendantConn then
			conns.gunDropDescendantConn:Disconnect()
			conns.gunDropDescendantConn = nil
		end

		if autoGrabGun then
			tt = function(arg)
				task.wait(0.1)
				if not values.autoGrabGun then
					return
				end
				local character = localPlayer.Character

				if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and (arg:IsA("BasePart") or arg.Name == "GunDrop") then
					grabGunByMode(true)
				end
			end

			conns.gunDropChildConn = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child.Name == "GunDrop" then
					tt(child)
				end
			end)

			conns.gunDropDescendantConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
				if descendant.Name == "GunDrop" then
					tt(descendant)
				end
			end)

			for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant.Name == "GunDrop" then
					tt(descendant)
				end
			end
		end
	end,
})

	for _, player in v_2(Players2:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= localPlayer then
			table.insert(tbl3, player.Name)
		end
	end

	return tbl3
end

killallBusy = false

hubIsKillWhitelisted = function(arg)
	local killWhitelist = dropdownval.killWhitelist
	if type(killWhitelist) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(killWhitelist) do
		if hubNormalizeDropdownValue(v_2) == arg then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

hubStabPlayerHrp = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	if not arg or not arg2 or not arg3 then
		return false
	end
	local events = arg2:FindFirstChild("Events")
	if not events then
		return false
	end
	local knifeStabbed = events:FindFirstChild("KnifeStabbed")

	if knifeStabbed then
		knifeStabbed:FireServer()
	end

	local handle = arg2:FindFirstChild("Handle")

	if handle and firetouchinterest then
		firetouchinterest(arg3, handle, 1)
		firetouchinterest(arg3, handle, 0)
	end

	local handleTouched = events:FindFirstChild("HandleTouched")
	if handleTouched then
		handleTouched:FireServer(arg3)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

hubKillPlayersExceptWhitelist = function()
	if values.runnings then
		return
	end
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local knife = getPlayerBackpack(localPlayer)
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	knife = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Knife")

	if humanoid and knife then
		humanoid:EquipTool(knife)
	end

	task.wait()
	local knife2 = character:FindFirstChild("Knife")
	if not knife2 then
		return
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= localPlayer and not hubIsKillWhitelisted(player.Name) then
			local character2 = player.Character
			character2 = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if character2 then
				hubStabPlayerHrp(character, knife2, character2)
			end
		end
	end
end

runKillAllBurst = function()
	if values.runnings then
		sendnotification(lc.trollcombatlock or "Trolling and combat tabs locked", 6)
		return
	end

	if killallBusy then
		sendnotification(lc.killall_busy, 8)
		return
	end
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local v_2 = getPlayerBackpack(localPlayer)
	if not (v_2 and v_2:FindFirstChild("Knife") or character and character:FindFirstChild("Knife")) then
		sendnotification(lc.kill, 8)
		return
	end
	killallBusy = true

	task.spawn(function()
		for i = 1, 24 do
			if not values.runnings then
				pcall(function()
					local character2 = localPlayer.Character
					local knife = getPlayerBackpack(localPlayer)
					local humanoid = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
					knife = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Knife")

					if humanoid and knife then
						humanoid:EquipTool(knife)
					end

					task.wait()
					local knife2 = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("Knife")
					if not knife2 then
						return
					end

					for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
						if player ~= localPlayer and not hubIsKillWhitelisted(player.Name) then
							local character3 = player.Character
							character3 = character3 and character3:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

							if character3 and character2 then
								hubStabPlayerHrp(character2, knife2, character3)
							end
						end
					end
				end)

				task.wait()
				continue
			end

			break
		end

		killallBusy = false
	end)
end

hubStabSheriffOnce = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	local humanoid = arg and arg:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	arg2 = arg2 and arg2:FindFirstChild("Knife")

	if humanoid and arg2 then
		humanoid:EquipTool(arg2)
	end

	if arg3 then
		wait()
	else
		task.wait()
	end

	local knife = arg and arg:FindFirstChild("Knife")
	if not knife then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = findSheriff()

	if v_2 and arg then
		local character = v_2.Character
		character = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if character then
			hubStabPlayerHrp(arg, knife, character)
		end
	end
end

		Step = 1,
		Flag = "btn_" .. v_2.id .. "_corner",
		Callback = function(arg)
			local corner = tonumber(arg) or buttonParams[v_2.id].corner
			buttonParams[v_2.id].corner = corner
			valueslider["btn_" .. v_2.id .. "_corner"] = corner
			hubButtonSync(v_2.id)
		end,
	})
end

sectionLoaded("buttons")
Tabs.combat:Section({ Title = "loc:section_combat_universal" })

do
	local CollectionService_ = game:GetService("CollectionService")
	local n = 96
	local tbl4 = { Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(0, 0.65, 0), Vector3.new(0, -0.45, 0) }
	local n2 = 0
	local v_2 = nil
	local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local raycastParams2 = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams2.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local n3 = 1024

	unitDir3 = function(arg)
		if not arg then
			return nil
		end
		local magnitude = arg.Magnitude
		if magnitude ~= magnitude or magnitude < 0.0001 then
			return nil
		end
		return arg / magnitude
	end

	flatUnitXZ = function(arg)
		local vector = Vector3.new(arg.X, 0, arg.Z)
		if vector.Magnitude < 0.01 then
			return nil
		end
		return vector.Unit
	end

	readVec3Attr = function(arg, arg2)
		if not arg then
			return nil
		end
		local attribute = arg:GetAttribute(arg2)
		if typeof(attribute) == "Vector3" then
			return attribute
		end
		return nil
	end

	getKnifeVisual = function(arg)
		if not arg then
			return nil
		end
		local knifeVisual = arg:FindFirstChild("KnifeVisual", true)
		if knifeVisual and knifeVisual:IsA("BasePart") then
			return knifeVisual
		end

		if arg:IsA("BasePart") then
			return arg
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(arg:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Name == "KnifeVisual" then
				return descendant
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	getPlayerHalf = function(arg)
		if arg then
			return arg.Position, arg.Size * 0.5
		end
		return nil, Vector3.new(2, 3, 2)
	end

	local n4 = 6.5
	local n5 = 9

	hitRadius = function(arg)
		if not arg then
			return 7
		end
		local size = arg.Size
		return 5 + math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 0.4 + 1
	end

	buildExclude = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		local filterDescendantsInstances = { arg, arg2, arg3 }

		for _, v_3 in arg2:GetDescendants() do
			if v_3:IsA("BasePart") then
				filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = v_3
			end
		end

		raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
	end

	probeObstacle = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
		local v_3 = unitDir3(arg2)
		if not v_3 then
			return nil
		end
		local n6 = math.min(arg3, 1024)
		local n7 = v_3 * n6
		local n8 = n6 + 1
		local v_4 = nil

		for i = 1, #tbl4 do
			local n9 = arg + tbl4[i]
			local hit = workspace:Spherecast(n9, arg4, n7, raycastParams) or workspace:Raycast(n9, n7, raycastParams)

			if hit then
				local magnitude = (hit.Position - arg).Magnitude

				if magnitude < n8 then
					n8 = magnitude
					v_4 = hit
				end
			end
		end

		return v_4, v_4 and n8 or nil
	end

	getKnifePathEnd = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		local v_3 = unitDir3(arg2)
		if not v_3 then
			return false
		end
		local n6 = arg3 - arg
		local magnitude = n6.Magnitude
		if magnitude ~= magnitude or magnitude > n3 then
			return false
		end
		local v_4 = n6:Dot(v_3)
		if v_4 <= 0 then
			return false
		end
		local v_5, v_6 = probeObstacle(arg, v_3, 4, 0.45)
		if v_5 and v_6 <= 3 then
			return false, math.max(v_6, 0.5)
		end
		local v_7, v_8 = probeObstacle(arg, v_3, 512, 0.45)
		local n7 = v_7 and math.max(v_8, 0.5) or 512
		if v_7 and v_8 < v_4 - 2 then
			return false, n7
		end

		if magnitude > 0.5 then
			local n8 = n6.Unit * magnitude
			local hit = workspace:Spherecast(arg, 0.45, n8, raycastParams) or workspace:Raycast(arg, n8, raycastParams)

			if hit then
				local magnitude2 = (hit.Position - arg).Magnitude
				if magnitude2 < magnitude - 2 then
					return false, math.min(n7, magnitude2)
				end
			end
		end

		return true, n7
	end

	distToPath = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
		return (arg - arg2 + arg3 * math.clamp((arg - arg2):Dot(arg3), 0, arg4)).Magnitude
	end

	predictKnifePath = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		local v_3 = unitDir3(arg2)
		if not v_3 then
			return
		end
		local v_4, v_5 = getKnifePathEnd(arg, v_3, arg3)
		if not v_4 then
			return
		end
		return arg, v_3, math.min(v_5, math.max((arg3 - arg):Dot(v_3), 0) + 2)
	end

	dodgeDirFromPath = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		local vector = Vector3.new(arg3.X, 0, arg3.Z)
		local vector2 = vector.Magnitude < 0.01 and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or vector.Unit
		local vector3 = Vector3.new(-vector2.Z, 0, vector2.X)
		local n6 = distToPath(arg + vector3 * 12, arg2, arg3, arg4) >= distToPath(arg - vector3 * 12, arg2, arg3, arg4) and vector3 or -vector3
		local raycastParams3 = RaycastParams.new()
		raycastParams3.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		raycastParams3.FilterDescendantsInstances = { arg5 }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(arg, n6 * 12, raycastParams3)

		if hit and hit.Distance < 10 then
			local n7 = -n6
			local hit2 = workspace:Raycast(arg, n7 * 12, raycastParams3)

			if not hit2 or hit2.Distance >= 10 then
				n6 = n7
			end
		end

		return n6
	end

	playerInThreatZone = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		local n6 = arg3 - arg
		if n6.Magnitude > 45 then
			return false
		end
		local v_3 = n6:Dot(arg2)
		if v_3 <= 0 then
			return false
		end
		local v_4 = distToPath(arg3, arg, arg2, arg5)
		if n4 < v_4 then
			return false
		end

		if arg2:Dot(n6.Unit) >= 0.55 and v_3 <= n5 then
			return true
		end
		return v_4 <= math.min(hitRadius(arg4), 6.5)
	end

	capsuleHitSoon = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		local magnitude = arg2.Magnitude
		if magnitude < 12 then
			return false, math.huge, false, 0, false
		end
		local n6 = arg2 / magnitude
		local n7 = math.max(arg4.X, arg4.Z) + 8.5
		local n8 = arg3 - arg
		local v_3 = n8:Dot(n6)
		if v_3 < 0 then
			return false, n8.Magnitude, false, 0, false
		end
		local magnitude2 = (arg3 - arg + n6 * v_3).Magnitude
		local n9 = v_3 / magnitude

		for i = 0, 24 do
			local magnitude3 = (arg3 - arg + arg2 * arg5 * i / 24).Magnitude

			if magnitude3 < magnitude2 then
				magnitude2 = magnitude3
			end
		end

		local vector = Vector3.new(n8.X, 0, n8.Z)
		local vector2 = Vector3.new(n6.X, 0, n6.Z)
		local flag = vector.Magnitude > 0.5 and vector2.Magnitude > 0.01
		local flag2 = false

		if flag then
			flag2 = vector.Unit:Dot(vector2.Unit) >= 0.52
		end

		local flag3 = flag2 and magnitude2 <= 18 and n9 <= arg5 * 1.2
		return magnitude2 <= n7 and (n9 <= arg5 * 1.12 or flag3), magnitude2, flag3, n9, flag2
	end

	computeDodgePower = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		local n6 = 42 * math.clamp((arg and arg.Magnitude or 96) / n, 0.75, 1.65) * math.clamp(1 + (14 - (arg2 or 14)) / 12, 0.95, 2.45) * math.clamp(0.5 / math.max(arg3 or 0.5, 0.02), 1, 2.8)

		if arg4 then
			n6 *= 1.25
		end

		if arg5 then
			n6 *= 1.12
		end

		return math.clamp(n6, 32, 88)
	end

	keysForDir = function(arg)
		local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not currentCamera then
			return
		end
		local lookVector = currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
		local vector = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z)
		if vector.Magnitude < 0.001 then
			return
		end
		local unit = vector.Unit
		local vector2 = Vector3.new(unit.Z, 0, -unit.X)
		local tbl5 = {}

		if arg:Dot(unit) > 0.3 then
			tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = Enum.KeyCode.W
		elseif arg:Dot(unit) < -0.3 then
			tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = Enum.KeyCode.S
		end

		if arg:Dot(vector2) > 0.3 then
			tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = Enum.KeyCode.D
		elseif arg:Dot(vector2) < -0.3 then
			tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = Enum.KeyCode.A
		end

		return tbl5
	end

	vimReleaseKeys = function(arg)
		if not arg then
			return
		end

		for i = 1, #arg do
			pcall(VirtualInputManager.SendKeyEvent, VirtualInputManager, false, arg[i], false, game)
		end
	end

	vimPressKeys = function(arg)
		if not arg then
			return
		end

		for i = 1, #arg do
			pcall(VirtualInputManager.SendKeyEvent, VirtualInputManager, true, arg[i], false, game)
		end
	end

	performPlatformDodge = function(arg, arg2)
		local position = arg.Position - Vector3.new(1000, 3, 1000)

		if v_2 and v_2.Parent then
			v_2:Destroy()
		end

		v_2 = nil
		n2 += 1
		local v_3 = n2
		local cFrame = arg.CFrame
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = "SNP_AutoDodgePlatform"
		part.Size = Vector3.new(100, 1, 100)
		part.Position = position
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = true
		part.Transparency = 1
		part.Parent = workspace
		v_2 = part
		arg.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
		arg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		arg.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

		if arg2 then
			arg2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			task.wait(1.7)
			if v_3 ~= n2 then
				return
			end

			if arg.Parent then
				arg.CFrame = cFrame
				arg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				arg.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end

			if part.Parent then
				part:Destroy()
			end

			if v_2 == part then
				v_2 = nil
			end
		end)

		return true
	end

	performDodge = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		if not character then
			return false
		end
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoid or not humanoidRootPart then
			return false
		end
		local v_3 = getPlayerBackpack(localPlayer)
		if v_3 and v_3:FindFirstChild("Knife") or character:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
			return false
		end

		if dropdownval.autododgeMode == "Platform" then
			return performPlatformDodge(humanoidRootPart, humanoid)
		end
		local v_4 = flatUnitXZ(arg)
		if not v_4 then
			return false
		end
		arg2 = arg2 or 42

		if arg3 and arg4 and not arg5 then
			local vector = Vector3.new(humanoidRootPart.Position.X - arg3.X, 0, humanoidRootPart.Position.Z - arg3.Z)
			local v_5 = flatUnitXZ(arg4)

			if vector.Magnitude > 0.5 and v_5 then
				local flag = vector.Unit:Dot(v_5) > 0.52
			end
		end

		local flag = UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled and not UserInputService.TouchEnabled
		local v_5 = flag and keysForDir(v_4) or nil
		local n6 = flag and 1.25 or 3
		local n7 = flag and 0.16 or 0.2
		n2 += 1
		local v_6 = n2
		local walkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed * 2.05
		humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
		local vector = Vector3.new(v_4.X * arg2, math.max(humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, valueslider.autododgeJumpPower or 19), v_4.Z * arg2)
		humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vector
		humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vector
		humanoid:Move(v_4 * n6, false)

		if flag then
			vimPressKeys(v_5)
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			local now = os.clock()

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				while os.clock() - now < n7 do
					if not (v_6 ~= n2 or not humanoidRootPart.Parent) then
						humanoid:Move(v_4 * n6, false)
						RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
						continue
					end

					break
				end
			end)

			if flag then
				vimReleaseKeys(v_5)
			end

			if humanoid.Parent then
				humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed

				if flag then
					humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
				end
			end

			if not ok then
				warn("[autododge]", result)
			end
		end)

		return true
	end

	isKnifeFullyBlocked = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		raycastParams2.FilterDescendantsInstances = { arg3, arg4, arg5 }
		local n6 = arg - arg2
		local magnitude = n6.Magnitude
		if magnitude ~= magnitude or magnitude < 1.5 or magnitude > n3 then
			return false
		end
		local n7 = n6.Unit * magnitude
		local y = arg.Y
		local n8 = 0
		local n9 = 0

		for i = 0, 4 do
			local n10 = -0.6 + i / 4 * 2.6
			if arg2.Y + n10 < y - 0.5 then
				continue
			end
			n8 += 1
			local n11 = arg2 + Vector3.new(0, n10, 0)
			local hit = workspace:Spherecast(n11, 0.18, n7, raycastParams2) or workspace:Raycast(n11, n7, raycastParams2)
			local v_3 = workspace:Spherecast(n11, 0.55, n7, raycastParams2)

			if hit or v_3 then
				local instance = (hit or v_3).Instance
				local n12 = instance.Position.Y + instance.Size.Y * 0.5

				if not (n12 - arg2.Y < 1.1 and y > n12 + 0.3) then
					n9 += 1
				end

				continue
			end

			return false
		end

		if n8 == 0 then
			return false
		end
		return n9 == n8
	end

	tryDodgeThreat = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7)
		local v_3 = unitDir3(arg2)
		if not v_3 then
			return false
		end
		local position = arg7.Position
		if n3 < (position - arg).Magnitude then
			return false
		end
		local n6 = arg - position
		if n6.Magnitude > 5 and n6:Dot(v_3) > 0.35 then
			return false
		end
		local v_4, v_5, v_6 = predictKnifePath(arg, v_3, position, arg7)
		if not v_4 then
			return false
		end

		if not playerInThreatZone(arg, v_3, position, arg7, v_6) then
			return false
		end

		if isKnifeFullyBlocked(arg, position, arg6, arg4, arg5) then
			return false
		end
		local flag = arg3 and arg3.Magnitude >= 12
		local flag2 = false
		local n7 = 42

		if flag then
			local v_7, v_8 = getPlayerHalf(arg7)
			local v_9, v_10, v_11, v_12
			v_9, v_10, flag2, v_11, v_12 = capsuleHitSoon(arg, arg3, position, v_8, 0.95)
			n7 = computeDodgePower(arg3, v_10, v_11, flag2, v_12)
			flag2 = v_12 or flag2
		end

		return performDodge(dodgeDirFromPath(position, arg, v_5, v_6, arg6), n7, arg, arg3, flag2)
	end

	untrackKnife = function(arg)
		local v_3 = conns.knifeDodgeConns[arg]
		if not v_3 then
			return
		end

		if v_3.renderConn then
			v_3.renderConn:Disconnect()
		end

		if v_3.posConn then
			v_3.posConn:Disconnect()
		end

		if v_3.velConn then
			v_3.velConn:Disconnect()
		end

		conns.knifeDodgeConns[arg] = nil
	end

	trackKnife = function(arg, arg2)
		if conns.knifeDodgeConns[arg] then
			return
		end
		local position = arg2.Position
		local flag = false
		local tbl5 = {}
		local v_3 = nil

		step = function()
			if not arg.Parent or flag then
				return
			end
			local position2 = arg2.Position
			local n6 = position2 - position
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not humanoidRootPart then
				position = position2
				return
			end

			if n6.Magnitude > 0.002 and n6.Magnitude < 40 then
				local unit = n6.Unit
				tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = unit

				if #tbl5 > 3 then
					table.remove(tbl5, 1)
				end

				local vector = Vector3.zero

				for i = 1, #tbl5 do
					vector += tbl5[i]
				end

				v_3 = unitDir3(vector) or unit
			end

			if v_3 then
				v_3 = unitDir3(v_3)
			end

			if v_3 then
				buildExclude(character, arg, arg2)
				local v_4 = readVec3Attr(arg, "Direction") or readVec3Attr(arg2, "Direction")
				local n7

				if v_4 and v_4.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					n7 = v_4.Unit * n
				else
					n7 = nil

					if n6.Magnitude > 0.002 then
						n7 = v_3 * math.clamp(n6.Magnitude * 60, 12, 140)
					end
				end

				local ok, result = pcall(tryDodgeThreat, position2, v_3, n7, arg, arg2, character, humanoidRootPart)

				if ok and result then
					flag = true
				elseif not ok then
					warn("[autododge]", result)
				end
			end

			position = position2
		end

		conns.knifeDodgeConns[arg] = {
			renderConn = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
				if not arg.Parent then
					untrackKnife(arg)
					return
				end
				step()
			end),
			posConn = arg2:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function()
				if not flag and arg.Parent then
					step()
				end
			end),
			velConn = arg2:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AssemblyLinearVelocity"):Connect(function()
				if not flag and arg.Parent then
					step()
				end
			end),
		}
	end

	bindKnife = function(arg)
		if not arg or not arg.Parent then
			return
		end
		local v_3 = getKnifeVisual(arg)

		if v_3 then
			trackKnife(arg, v_3)
		end
	end

	autododgeStop = function()
		if v_2 and v_2.Parent then
			v_2:Destroy()
		end

		v_2 = nil

		if conns.knifeDodgeDescendantConn then
			conns.knifeDodgeDescendantConn:Disconnect()
			conns.knifeDodgeDescendantConn = nil
		end

		if conns.knifeDodgeTagConn then
			conns.knifeDodgeTagConn:Disconnect()
			conns.knifeDodgeTagConn = nil
		end

		for k in pairs(conns.knifeDodgeConns) do
			untrackKnife(k)
		end
	end

	autododgeStart = function()
		autododgeStop()

		for _, v_3 in ipairs(CollectionService_:GetTagged(KNIFE_TAG)) do
			bindKnife(v_3)
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant.Name == KNIFE_TAG and not conns.knifeDodgeConns[descendant] then
				bindKnife(descendant)
			end
		end

		conns.knifeDodgeTagConn = CollectionService_:GetInstanceAddedSignal(KNIFE_TAG):Connect(bindKnife)

		conns.knifeDodgeDescendantConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
			if descendant.Name ~= KNIFE_TAG and not CollectionService_:HasTag(descendant, KNIFE_TAG) then
				return
			end
			task.defer(bindKnife, descendant)
		end)
	end
end

autododgeTog = Tabs.combat:Toggle({
	Title = "loc:autododge",
	Value = values.autododge,
	Flag = "autododge",
	Callback = function(autododge)
		values.autododge = autododge

		if autododge then
			autododgeStart()
		else
			autododgeStop()
		end
	end,
})

	Title = "loc:autododgemode",
	Values = { "Dodge", "Platform" },
	Value = dropdownval.autododgeMode,
	RefreshBatchSize = DROPDOWN_REFRESH_BATCH,
	Flag = "autododgeMode",
	Callback = function(autododgeMode)
		if autododgeMode then
			dropdownval.autododgeMode = autododgeMode
		end
	end,
})

hubInputOrSlider(Tabs.combat, {
	Title = "loc:autododgejumppower",
	Value = { Min = 2, Max = 60, Default = valueslider.autododgeJumpPower },
	Step = 1,
	Flag = "autododgeJumpPower",
	Callback = function(arg)
		local num = tonumber(arg)

		if num then
			valueslider.autododgeJumpPower = math.clamp(num, 0, 60)
		end
	end,
})

Tabs.combat:Divider()

tpSafeMurderTog = Tabs.combat:Toggle({
	Title = "loc:tpsafepartifmurdernearest",
	Value = values.tpSafePartIfMurderNearest,
	Flag = "tpSafePartIfMurderNearest",
	Callback = function(tpSafePartIfMurderNearest)
		values.tpSafePartIfMurderNearest = tpSafePartIfMurderNearest

		if not tpSafePartIfMurderNearest then
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			murderSafeTpReturn(character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
			return
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			murderSafeTpNotifyAt = 0

			while values.tpSafePartIfMurderNearest do
				pcall(function()
					if findPlayerTool(localPlayer, "Knife") then
						return
					end
					local character = localPlayer.Character
					local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					character = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if not humanoidRootPart or not character or character.Health <= 0 then
						return
					end
					local murderSafeTpRange = valueslider.murderSafeTpRange or 10

					if murderSafeTpHidden then
						if not findNearestMurdererHrpInRange(murderSafeTpAnchor, murderSafeTpRange) then
							murderSafeTpReturn(humanoidRootPart)
						else
							local now = tick()

							if now - murderSafeTpNotifyAt >= 3 then
								murderSafeTpNotifyAt = now
								sendnotification(lc and lc.safetp_murder_nearby or "Murderer nearby — on safe platform.", 3)
							end
						end
					elseif findNearestMurdererHrpInRange(humanoidRootPart.Position, murderSafeTpRange) then
						murderSafeTpActivate(humanoidRootPart, character)
						murderSafeTpNotifyAt = 0
					end
				end)

				task.wait(0.1)
			end

			local character = localPlayer.Character
			murderSafeTpReturn(character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
		end)
	end,
})

	tbl7.setTransparency = function(transparency)

		end

		if next(tbl7.parts) == nil then
			local descendants = model:GetDescendants()

			for i = 1, #descendants do
				tbl7.applyPart(descendants[i], transparency)
			end

			return
		end

		transparency = transparency and 0.5 or 0

		for k in pairs(tbl7.parts) do
			if k.Parent then
				k.Transparency = transparency
			else
				tbl7.parts[k] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	tbl7.stabilize = function(arg, arg2)
		if not arg or not arg2 then
			return
		end
		local savedState = tbl7.savedState
		local assemblyLinearVelocity = savedState == humanoidStateType.Jumping or savedState == humanoidStateType.Freefall
		local state = arg:GetState()
		local flag = not assemblyLinearVelocity

		if flag then
			flag = state == humanoidStateType.Freefall or state == humanoidStateType.FallingDown or state == humanoidStateType.GettingUp
		end

		if flag then
			pcall(arg.ChangeState, arg, humanoidStateType.Running)
		end

		local savedVel = tbl7.savedVel

		if savedVel then
			assemblyLinearVelocity = assemblyLinearVelocity and savedVel

			if not assemblyLinearVelocity then
				local z = savedVel.Z
				assemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(savedVel.X, math.min(savedVel.Y, 0), z)
			end

			arg2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = assemblyLinearVelocity
		end

		if tbl7.savedAng then
			arg2.AssemblyAngularVelocity = tbl7.savedAng
		end
	end

	tbl7.restorePosition = function()
		local v_7, v_8, v_9 = tbl6.live()

		if not v_8 or not v_8:IsA("BasePart") then
			tbl5.layers[2] = vector
			tbl5.flush(v_9)
			return
		end

		if tbl7.savedCFrame then
			local savedVel = tbl7.savedVel
			local savedAng = tbl7.savedAng
			fn15(v_8, tbl8.orient(tbl7.savedCFrame), savedVel, savedAng)
			tbl7.stabilize(v_9, v_8)
		end

		tbl5.layers[2] = vector
		tbl5.flush(v_9)
	end

	tbl7.enforceMobileMinZoom = function()
		if not tbl7.zoomGuarding or not fn11() then
			return
		end

		if v_5.CameraMinZoomDistance < cameraMinZoomDistance then
			pcall(function()
				v_5.CameraMinZoomDistance = cameraMinZoomDistance
			end)
		end
	end

	tbl7.setMobileZoomGuard = function(arg)
		if arg then
			if not fn11() then
				return
			end

			if tbl7.savedMinZoom == nil then
				local cameraMinZoomDistance2 = v_5.CameraMinZoomDistance

				if cameraMinZoomDistance2 >= cameraMinZoomDistance - 0.01 then
					tbl7.savedMinZoom = 0.5
				else
					tbl7.savedMinZoom = cameraMinZoomDistance2
				end
			end

			tbl7.zoomGuarding = true
			tbl7.enforceMobileMinZoom()
			return
		end

		tbl7.zoomGuarding = false
		local savedMinZoom = tbl7.savedMinZoom
		tbl7.savedMinZoom = nil

		if savedMinZoom ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				v_5.CameraMinZoomDistance = savedMinZoom
			end)
		end
	end

	tbl7.syncLoops = function()
		if not values_.invisActive then
			fn10(tbl7.conns, { "heartbeat", "render" })
			local v_7 = conns_
			conns_.invisHeartbeat = nil
			v_7.invisRender = nil
			return

		if not fn9(tbl7.conns.heartbeat) then

				if not values_.invisActive or not tbl7.ready then
					return
				end

			conns_.invisHeartbeat = connection
		end

		end
	end

	InvisApply = function(arg)
		local flag = arg and true or false

		if not flag and values_.invisActive then
			tbl7.ready = false
			tbl7.restorePosition()
		end

		if flag then

			end

			tbl7.ready = false
			tbl7.restorePosition()
			tbl7.setMobileZoomGuard(false)

			local savedVel = tbl7.savedVel

					tbl5.flush(v_9)
				end)
			end
		end

		tbl7.syncLoops()
		tbl9.updateArmed()
		tbl8.syncMode()
	end

		end
	end

	tbl9.conns.cameraMinZoom = v_5:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraMinZoomDistance"):Connect(function()
		tbl7.enforceMobileMinZoom()
	end)

	tbl9.conns.mouseBehavior = v_2:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MouseBehavior"):Connect(function()

		end

	stalclansShiftLockToggle = tbl8.toggle

		if not arg or not arg:IsA("BasePart") then
			return nil
		end
		local position = arg.Position
		local huge = math.huge
		local v_2 = nil

		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character

			if character and character:FindFirstChild("Fireflies") then
				local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if humanoidRootPart then
					local magnitude = (humanoidRootPart.Position - position).Magnitude

					if magnitude < huge then
						huge = magnitude
						v_2 = player
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if v_2 and huge <= n then
			return v_2
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function fn10(arg)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("Fireflies") then
			return false

		return fn9(arg) == localPlayer
