	useBomb = function()
		local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
		local character = localPlayer.Character or localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
		if not (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb") or character:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb") or backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Toys") and backpack.Toys:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb")) then
			sendnotification(lc.bomb)
			return
		end

		if not canUse then
			return
		end
		canUse = false
		local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoid then
			canUse = true
			return
		end
		local fakeBomb = backpack:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb") or character:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb")

		if not fakeBomb then
			ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Extras.ReplicateToy:InvokeServer("FakeBomb")
			fakeBomb = backpack:WaitForChild("FakeBomb") or character:WaitForChild("FakeBomb")
		end

		fakeBomb.Parent = character
		local remote = fakeBomb:FindFirstChild("Remote")
		if not fakeBomb:IsDescendantOf(character) or not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			canUse = true
			return
		end
		clutchBombFromUse = true

		pcall(function()
			remote:FireServer(CFrame.new(humanoidRootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3.15, 0)), 50)
			task.wait(0.06)
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			humanoid.Jump = true
			task.wait(0.24)

			if fakeBomb.Parent == character then
				fakeBomb.Parent = backpack
			end
		end)

		clutchBombFromUse = false
		fn4("💣: " .. tostring(cooldown) .. "s")
		local now = time()
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character

		while true do
			local v_2 = cooldown

			if time() - now < v_2 then
				if localPlayer.Character ~= character2 then
					fn5()
					canUse = true
					return
				end

				fn4("💣: " .. tostring(cooldown - math.floor(time() - now)) .. "s")
				task.wait(1)
			else
				break
			end
		end

		fn5()
		canUse = true
	end

	hubWaitForLiveBackpack = function(arg, arg2)

	end

startFlingLogic = function(arg)
	local n = 0.1

	while toolknife and toolknife == arg do
		RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

		if isfling and localPlayer.Character then
			local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if humanoidRootPart then
				local velocity = humanoidRootPart.Velocity
				humanoidRootPart.Velocity = velocity * 1000000 + Vector3.new(0, 1000000, 0)
				RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
				humanoidRootPart.Velocity = velocity
				RunService.Stepped:Wait()
				humanoidRootPart.Velocity = velocity + Vector3.new(0, n, 0)
				n = -n
			end
		end
	end
end

createFakeKnife = function()
	if toolknife then
		toolknife:Destroy()
	end

	local character = localPlayer.Character or localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	if not humanoidRootPart then
		return
	end
	toolknife = Instance.new("Tool")
	toolknife.Name = "Fake Knife"
	toolknife.CanBeDropped = false
	toolknife.RequiresHandle = true
	toolknife.TextureId = "rbxassetid://138663675657207"
	toolknife.Grip = CFrame.new(0, -1, -0.1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Handle"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 3, 0.7)
	part.Color = Color3.new(0.639216, 0.635294, 0.647059)
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Parent = toolknife
	local specialMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	specialMesh.Name = "Mesh"
	specialMesh.MeshId = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=121944778"
	specialMesh.TextureId = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=121944805"
	specialMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
	specialMesh.Parent = part
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://142247768"
	sound.Volume = 0.8
	sound.Parent = humanoidRootPart

	table.insert(conns.fakeknife, toolknife.Equipped:Connect(function()
		isfling = true
	end))

	table.insert(conns.fakeknife, toolknife.Unequipped:Connect(function()
		isfling = false
		isAttacking = false
	end))

	table.insert(conns.fakeknife, toolknife.Activated:Connect(function()
		if canAttack then
			canAttack = false
			isAttacking = true
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if humanoid then
				humanoid:LoadAnimation(anims[math.random(1, #anims)]):Play()
			end

			task.wait(0.5)
			isAttacking = false
			task.wait(0.25)
			canAttack = true
		end
	end))

	onHandTouched = function(arg)
		if toolknife and toolknife.Parent == character and isAttacking then
			local parent = arg.Parent

			if parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and parent ~= character then
				if not sound.IsPlaying then
					sound:Play()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	connectRightHand = function(arg)
		local rightHand = arg:FindFirstChild("RightHand", true) or arg:FindFirstChild("Right Arm", true)

		if rightHand then
			table.insert(conns.fakeknife, rightHand.Touched:Connect(onHandTouched))
		end
	end

	connectRightHand(character)
	local v_2 = getPlayerBackpack(localPlayer)

	if v_2 then
		toolknife.Parent = v_2
	end

	task.spawn(startFlingLogic, toolknife)
end

		if glitchEnabled then
			if conns.charcon1 then
				conns.charcon1:Disconnect()
				conns.charcon1 = nil
			end

			if conns.hcf then
				conns.hcf:Disconnect()
				conns.hcf = nil
			end

			valueslider.acceleration = 0.3
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

			conns.charcon1 = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character2)
				character = character2
				humanoid = character2:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
			end)

			conns.hcf = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if not humanoid or not character then
					return
				end
				local state = humanoid:GetState()

				if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
					local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection

					if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
						valueslider.acceleration = math.min(valueslider.acceleration + 0.05, 1)
						character:TranslateBy(moveDirection.Unit * valueslider.glitchPower * valueslider.acceleration / 150)
					end
				end
			end)
		else
			if conns.charcon1 then
				conns.charcon1:Disconnect()
				conns.charcon1 = nil
			end

			if conns.hcf then
				conns.hcf:Disconnect()
				conns.hcf = nil
			end

			valueslider.acceleration = 0.3
		end
	end,
})

smoothedVelocity = Vector3.new()

normalizeSilentAimType = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" then
		return "Dynamic"
	end

	if SILENT_AIM_LEGACY_MODES[arg] then
		return SILENT_AIM_LEGACY_MODES[arg]
	end

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(SILENT_AIM_MODES) do
		if arg == v_2 then
			return arg
		end
	end

	return "Dynamic"
end

silentAimTune = {
	pingScale = 1,
	base = 0.113,
	minLead = 0.02,
	maxLead = 0.6,
	airExtra = 0,
	turnBoost = 0,
	turnGate = 0.15,
	intentBlend = 0.85,
	intentBlendAir = 0.5,
	straightScale = 1,
	turnScale = 1,
	airAimHeight = 5,
	fallMargin = 2,
	gravityScale = 1,
	yBias = 0,
	floorClamp = 1.2,
}

silentAimOvershoot = 4
silentAimPiercingBack = 4
finalAimCore = Vector3.zero
silentAimState = nil
silentAimStateTick = 0
silentAimLastLead = 0
SILENT_AIM_TURN_WINDOW = 0.12
SILENT_AIM_TURN_MIN_SPEED = 1.5
SILENT_AIM_HIST_SPAN = 1
silentAimHist = {}

saFlat = function(arg)
	return Vector3.new(arg.X, 0, arg.Z)
end

saTurnBetween = function(arg, arg2)
	if arg.Magnitude < SILENT_AIM_TURN_MIN_SPEED or arg2.Magnitude < SILENT_AIM_TURN_MIN_SPEED then
		return 0
	end
	return 1 - math.clamp(arg.Unit:Dot(arg2.Unit), -1, 1)
end

saVelAgo = function(arg)
	local v_2 = silentAimHist
	if #v_2 == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if SILENT_AIM_TURN_WINDOW < now - v_2[#v_2][1] then
		return nil
	end
	local n = now - arg

	for i = #v_2, 1, -1 do
		if v_2[i][1] <= n then
			return Vector3.new(v_2[i][2], v_2[i][3], v_2[i][4])
		end
	end

	return Vector3.new(v_2[1][2], v_2[1][3], v_2[1][4])
end

saPushVelSample = function(arg)
	local now = os.clock()
	table.insert(silentAimHist, { now, arg.X, arg.Y, arg.Z })

	while #silentAimHist > 0 and now - silentAimHist[1][1] > SILENT_AIM_HIST_SPAN do
		table.remove(silentAimHist, 1)
	end
end

silentAimBuildState = function(arg, arg2)
	arg = arg and arg.Character
	local humanoidRootPart = arg and arg:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = arg and arg:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (humanoidRootPart and humanoid) then
		return nil
	end
	local assemblyLinearVelocity = humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local v_2 = lastJumpTick
	local n = tick() - v_2
	local flag = n < 0.18

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return humanoid:GetState()
	end)

	local v_3 = nil

	if not ok then
		result = v_3
	end

	local flag2 = result == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or result == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
	local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local filterDescendantsInstances = {}
	arg2 = arg2 or localPlayer.Character
	filterDescendantsInstances[1] = arg
	filterDescendantsInstances[2] = arg2
	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
	raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(humanoidRootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -80, 0), raycastParams)
	local v_4 = saVelAgo(SILENT_AIM_TURN_WINDOW) or assemblyLinearVelocity

	return {
		pos = humanoidRootPart.Position,
		vel = assemblyLinearVelocity,
		svel = smoothedVelocity,
		accel = smoothedAccel,
		moveDir = humanoid.MoveDirection,
		walkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed,
		jumpPower = humanoid.UseJumpPower and humanoid.JumpPower or (humanoid.JumpHeight * 2 * workspace.Gravity) ^ 0.5,
		speed = saFlat(assemblyLinearVelocity).Magnitude,
		speed3 = assemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude,
		turn = saTurnBetween(saFlat(assemblyLinearVelocity), saFlat(v_4)),
		accelMag = smoothedAccel.Magnitude,
		jumpAge = n,
		air = flag2 or humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air or flag,
		sitting = humanoid.Sit or humanoid.PlatformStand,
		strafing = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1,
		floorY = hit and hit.Position.Y or nil,
		standHeight = math.clamp(humanoid.HipHeight + humanoidRootPart.Size.Y * 0.5, 0.5, 8),
		ping = localPlayer:GetNetworkPing(),
	}
end

silentAimPredictors = {}

silentAimPredictors.Default = function(arg)
	if arg.vel.Magnitude == 0 then
		return arg.pos, 0
	end
	local n = arg.vel.Unit * arg.vel.Magnitude / 16.5
	local y = n.Y

	if y > 2.65 then
		y = 2.65
	elseif y < -2 then
		y = -2
	end

	return arg.pos + Vector3.new(n.X, y, n.Z / 1.25), 0
end

silentAimPredictors.Dynamic = function(arg, arg2)
	local v_2 = arg2 or silentAimTune
	if arg.sitting then
		return arg.pos, 0
	end
	local n = arg.ping * v_2.pingScale + v_2.base

	if arg.air then
		n += v_2.airExtra
	end

	if v_2.turnGate < arg.turn then
		n += arg.turn * v_2.turnBoost
	end

	local n2 = math.clamp(n, v_2.minLead, v_2.maxLead)
	local n3 = arg.moveDir * (arg.walkSpeed > 0 and arg.walkSpeed or 16)
	local intentBlendAir = arg.air and v_2.intentBlendAir or v_2.intentBlend
	local n4 = saFlat(arg.vel):Lerp(saFlat(n3), intentBlendAir) * n2 * (v_2.straightScale + (v_2.turnScale - v_2.straightScale) * math.clamp((arg.turn - v_2.turnGate) / math.max(0.001, 1 - v_2.turnGate), 0, 1))
	local gravity = workspace.Gravity
	local floorY = arg.floorY

	if floorY then
		floorY = arg.floorY + (arg.standHeight or 3)
	end

	floorY = floorY or arg.pos.Y - v_2.floorClamp
	local jumpPower = (arg.jumpPower or 0) > 0 and arg.jumpPower or 50
	local n5 = jumpPower * jumpPower / 2 * gravity
	local y

	if not arg.air then
		y = arg.pos.Y
	elseif n5 + v_2.fallMargin < arg.pos.Y - floorY then
		y = math.max(arg.pos.Y + arg.vel.Y * n2 - 0.5 * gravity * v_2.gravityScale * n2 * n2, floorY)
	else
		y = floorY + v_2.airAimHeight
	end

	return Vector3.new(arg.pos.X + n4.X, y + v_2.yBias, arg.pos.Z + n4.Z), n2
end

silentAimPredictors.Piercing = function(arg, arg2)
	return silentAimPredictors.Dynamic(arg, arg2)
end

silentAimPiercingOrigin = function(arg)
	local v_2 = saFlat(arg.vel)

	if v_2.Magnitude < 1 then
		v_2 = saFlat(arg.moveDir)
	end

	local v_3 = silentAimPiercingBack
	return CFrame.new(arg.pos - safeUnit(v_2) * v_3)
end

silentAimExtend = function(arg, arg2)
	local n = arg2 - arg
	if n.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
		return arg2
	end
	return arg + n + n.Unit * silentAimOvershoot
end

silentAimWallBlocked = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
	local n = arg4 - arg2
	if n.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		return false, nil
	end
	local filterDescendantsInstances = { arg }

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("WeaponPassthrough")) do
		table.insert(filterDescendantsInstances, v_2)
	end

	local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(arg2, n, raycastParams)
		if not hit then
			return false, nil
		end

		if hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(arg3) then
			return false, nil
		end

		if hit.Instance.Transparency ~= 1 then
			return true, hit.Instance:GetFullName()
		end
		table.insert(filterDescendantsInstances, hit.Instance)
		raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
	end

	return false, nil
end

silentAimResolveShot = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
	local cFrame = arg2.CFrame
	local gunRaycastAttachment = arg2:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")

	if gunRaycastAttachment then
		cFrame = gunRaycastAttachment.WorldCFrame
	end

	if arg4 == "Piercing" then
		if type(finalPos) == "table" and typeof(finalPos[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(finalPos[2]) == "CFrame" then
			return finalPos[1], finalPos[2].Position, finalAimCore
		end
	elseif typeof(finalPos) == "Vector3" and finalPos ~= Vector3.zero then
		return cFrame, finalPos, finalAimCore
	end

	local v_2 = silentAimBuildState(arg3, arg)
	if not v_2 then
		return cFrame, nil, nil
	end
	local v_3, v_4 = (silentAimPredictors[arg4] or silentAimPredictors.Dynamic)(v_2, silentAimTune)
	silentAimState = v_2
	silentAimStateTick = tick()
	silentAimLastLead = v_4 or 0
	if arg4 == "Piercing" then
		local v_5 = silentAimPiercingOrigin(v_2)
		return v_5, silentAimExtend(v_5.Position, v_3), v_3
	end
	return cFrame, silentAimExtend(cFrame.Position, v_3), v_3
end

SILENT_AIM_TLM_FILE = SNP_LOG_DIR .. "/SilentAim_Telemetry.log"
SILENT_AIM_TLM_WINDOW = 1.6
SILENT_AIM_TLM_STEP = 0.05
SILENT_AIM_TLM_BODY = 3
SILENT_AIM_TLM_SERVER_GAP = 3
SILENT_AIM_TLM_LEAD_TOL = 0.06
SILENT_AIM_TLM_FLUSH_EVERY = 6
SILENT_AIM_TLM_ROTATE_EVERY = 262144
silentAimTlmLines = {}
silentAimTlmPending = 0
silentAimTlmFlushQueued = false
silentAimTlmSeq = 0
silentAimTlmT0 = os.clock()
silentAimTlmLastShotTick = nil
silentAimTlmHeaderDone = false
silentAimTlmSinceRotate = SILENT_AIM_TLM_ROTATE_EVERY

silentAimTelemetryEnabled = function()
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end

	if type(snpDebugLogsEnabled) == "function" and not snpDebugLogsEnabled() then
		return false
	end
	return values.silentAimhook == true or values.silentAim == true or values.shoot == true or values.btn_shootmurder_enabled == true
end

silentAimTlmRound = function(arg, arg2)
	if type(arg) ~= "number" then
		return arg
	end
	local n = 10 ^ (arg2 or 3)
	if arg >= 0 then
		return math.floor(arg * n + 0.5) / n
	end
	return -math.floor(-arg * n + 0.5) / n
end

silentAimTelemetryAppend = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		ensureSnpLogDir()
		local flag = false

		if type(isfile) == "function" then
			local result
			flag, result = pcall(isfile, SILENT_AIM_TLM_FILE)
			flag = flag and result == true
		end

		local flag2 = flag and type(appendfile) == "function"
		local flag3 = false

		if flag2 then
			flag3 = pcall(appendfile, SILENT_AIM_TLM_FILE, arg)
		end

		if not flag3 then
			local flag4 = flag and type(readfile) == "function"
			local str = ""

			if flag4 then
				local ok
				ok, str = pcall(readfile, SILENT_AIM_TLM_FILE)
				ok = ok and type(str) == "string"
				local str2 = ""

				if not ok then
					str = str2
				end
			end

			writefile(SILENT_AIM_TLM_FILE, str .. arg)
		end

		silentAimTlmSinceRotate = silentAimTlmSinceRotate + #arg

		if silentAimTlmSinceRotate >= SILENT_AIM_TLM_ROTATE_EVERY then
			silentAimTlmSinceRotate = 0
			snpRotateLogFile(SILENT_AIM_TLM_FILE, "SAIMTLM", SNP_LOG_MAX_BYTES)
		end
	end)
end

flushSilentAimTelemetry = function()
	if #silentAimTlmLines == 0 then
		return
	end
	local str = table.concat(silentAimTlmLines, "\n") .. "\n"
	silentAimTlmLines = {}
	silentAimTlmPending = 0
	silentAimTelemetryAppend(str)
end

silentAimTelemetryWrite = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
	if not silentAimTlmHeaderDone then
		silentAimTlmHeaderDone = true
		silentAimTlmLines[#silentAimTlmLines + 1] = string.format("[%s] session place=%s job=%s user=%s", os.date("%X"), tostring(game.PlaceId), tostring(game.JobId), tostring(localPlayer and localPlayer.Name))
	end

	local format = string.format
	local v_2 = os.date("%X")
	local v_3 = silentAimTlmT0
	local n = os.clock() - v_3
	local n2 = tonumber(arg3) or 0
	local v_4 = tostring
	local v_5 = format("[%s +%.3fs #%d][%s][%s] %s", v_2, n, n2, tostring(arg), tostring(arg2), v_4(arg4))

	if arg5 ~= nil then
		v_5 ..= " | " .. snpEncodeLogData(arg5)
	end

	silentAimTlmLines[#silentAimTlmLines + 1] = v_5
	silentAimTlmPending = silentAimTlmPending + 1

	if silentAimTlmPending >= SILENT_AIM_TLM_FLUSH_EVERY then
		flushSilentAimTelemetry()
	elseif not silentAimTlmFlushQueued then
		silentAimTlmFlushQueued = true

		task.defer(function()
			silentAimTlmFlushQueued = false
			flushSilentAimTelemetry()
		end)
	end
end

silentAimTelemetrySplitError = function(arg, arg2)
	local tbl4 = {}
	if typeof(arg) ~= "Vector3" then
		return tbl4
	end
	tbl4.vert = arg.Y
	local vector = Vector3.zero

	if arg2 then
		vector = Vector3.zero

		if typeof(arg2.vel) == "Vector3" then
			vector = safeUnit(saFlat(arg2.vel))
		end

		if vector.Magnitude < 0.5 and typeof(arg2.moveDir) == "Vector3" then
			vector = safeUnit(saFlat(arg2.moveDir))
		end
	end

	if vector.Magnitude >= 0.5 then
		local v_2 = saFlat(arg)
		tbl4.along = v_2:Dot(vector)
		tbl4.side = v_2:Dot(Vector3.new(-vector.Z, 0, vector.X))
	end

	return tbl4
end

silentAimTelemetryWhy = function(arg)
	if arg.died then
		return "hit"
	end

	if arg.gap and arg.gap < SILENT_AIM_TLM_SERVER_GAP then
		return "server_rate_gap"
	end

	if arg.errAtLead == nil then
		return "target_gone"
	end

	if arg.errAtLead <= SILENT_AIM_TLM_BODY then
		return "should_have_hit"
	end

	if arg.errMin and arg.errMin <= SILENT_AIM_TLM_BODY then
		local leadWanted = arg.leadWanted
		if leadWanted == nil then
			return "should_have_hit"
		end
		local n = leadWanted - (arg.lead or 0)
		local v_2 = SILENT_AIM_TLM_LEAD_TOL
		if math.abs(n) <= v_2 then
			return "should_have_hit"
		end
		return n > 0 and "over_lead" or "under_lead"
	end

	local n = math.abs(arg.along or 0)
	local n2 = math.abs(arg.side or 0)
	local n3 = math.abs(arg.vert or 0)
	if n3 > n and n3 > n2 then
		return arg.air and "vertical_air" or "vertical"
	end

	if n < n2 then
		return "lateral_turn"
	end
	return (arg.along or 0) > 0 and "under_lead" or "over_lead"
end

silentAimTelemetryFollowBody = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7, arg8)
	local character = arg3.Character
	local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	character = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local tbl4 = {}
	local n = arg4 + SILENT_AIM_TLM_WINDOW
	local v_2 = nil
	local v_3 = nil
	local v_4 = nil
	local v_5 = nil
	local flag, n2

	while true do
		flag = false
		n2 = nil

		if not (tick() < n) then
			break
		else
			task.wait(SILENT_AIM_TLM_STEP)
			local parent = humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart.Parent and character and character.Parent
			n2 = nil

			if parent then
				n2 = tick() - arg4
				local position = humanoidRootPart.Position
				local magnitude = (position - arg6).Magnitude

				if #tbl4 < 40 then
					tbl4[#tbl4 + 1] = string.format("%.2f=%.1f", n2, magnitude)
				end

				if v_2 == nil or magnitude < v_2 then
					v_2 = magnitude
					v_3 = n2
				end

				if v_4 == nil and n2 >= arg5 then
					v_4 = position
					v_5 = magnitude
				end

				if not (character.Health <= 0) then
					continue
				else
					flag = true
					break
				end
			end

			break
		end
	end

	local tbl5 = {
		died = flag,
		gap = arg8,
		lead = arg5,
		leadWanted = v_3,
		errAtLead = v_5,
		errMin = v_2,
		air = arg7 and arg7.air or false,
	}

	if v_4 then
		local v_6 = silentAimTelemetrySplitError(v_4 - arg6, arg7)
		local along = v_6.along
		local side = v_6.side
		local vert = v_6.vert
		tbl5.along = along
		tbl5.side = side
		tbl5.vert = vert
	end

	silentAimTelemetryWrite("RESULT", arg2, arg, (flag and "HIT " or "MISS ") .. silentAimTelemetryWhy(tbl5), {
		lead = silentAimTlmRound(arg5),
		errAtLead = silentAimTlmRound(v_5, 2),
		errMin = silentAimTlmRound(v_2, 2),
		leadWanted = silentAimTlmRound(v_3),
		along = silentAimTlmRound(tbl5.along, 2),
		side = silentAimTlmRound(tbl5.side, 2),
		vert = silentAimTlmRound(tbl5.vert, 2),
		diedAt = silentAimTlmRound(n2),
		samples = #tbl4,
		trail = table.concat(tbl4, "|"),
	})
end

silentAimTelemetryFollow = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7, arg8)
	task.spawn(function()
		pcall(silentAimTelemetryFollowBody, arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7, arg8)
	end)
end

silentAimTelemetryRecordShotBody = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	if not silentAimTelemetryEnabled() then
		return
	end
	local character = arg2 and arg2.Character
	character = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local state = type(arg3.state) == "table" and arg3.state or nil
	local flag = state == nil

	if flag then
		flag = tick() - (silentAimStateTick or 0) < 0.12
	end

	if flag then
		state = silentAimState
	end

	if state == nil then
		state = silentAimBuildState(arg2, localPlayer.Character)
	end

	local tbl4 = state or {}
	local aim = typeof(arg3.aim) == "Vector3" and arg3.aim or nil
	local core

	if typeof(arg3.core) == "Vector3" and arg3.core ~= Vector3.zero then
		core = arg3.core
	else
		core = aim
	end

	if core == nil then
		return
	end
	local origin = typeof(arg3.origin) == "Vector3" and arg3.origin or nil
	local pos = typeof(tbl4.pos) == "Vector3" and tbl4.pos or character.Position
	local n = tonumber(arg3.lead) or tonumber(silentAimLastLead) or 0
	silentAimTlmSeq = silentAimTlmSeq + 1
	local v_2 = silentAimTlmSeq
	local now = tick()
	local n2 = silentAimTlmLastShotTick and now - silentAimTlmLastShotTick or nil
	silentAimTlmLastShotTick = now

	silentAimTelemetryWrite("SHOT", arg, v_2, tostring(arg3.mode or "?"), {
		lead = silentAimTlmRound(n),
		ping = silentAimTlmRound(tbl4.ping),
		gap = silentAimTlmRound(n2),
		aim = aim,
		core = core,
		origin = origin,
		target = pos,
		aimAhead = silentAimTlmRound((core - pos).Magnitude, 2),
		dist = origin and silentAimTlmRound((pos - origin).Magnitude, 2) or nil,
		vel = tbl4.vel,
		moveDir = tbl4.moveDir,
		speed = silentAimTlmRound(tbl4.speed, 2),
		speed3 = silentAimTlmRound(tbl4.speed3, 2),
		walkSpeed = silentAimTlmRound(tbl4.walkSpeed, 2),
		turn = silentAimTlmRound(tbl4.turn),
		air = tbl4.air,
		jumpAge = silentAimTlmRound(tbl4.jumpAge),
		sitting = tbl4.sitting,
		strafing = tbl4.strafing,
		floorY = silentAimTlmRound(tbl4.floorY, 2),
		standHeight = silentAimTlmRound(tbl4.standHeight, 2),
		wallCheck = arg3.wallCheck,
		murderer = arg2.Name,
	})

	silentAimTelemetryFollow(v_2, arg, arg2, now, n, core, state, n2)
end

silentAimTelemetryRecordShot = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	pcall(silentAimTelemetryRecordShotBody, arg, arg2, arg3)
end

silentAimTelemetryRecordBlockedBody = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6)
	if not silentAimTelemetryEnabled() then
		return
	end
	silentAimTlmSeq = silentAimTlmSeq + 1
	local tbl4 = silentAimState or {}
	local pos = typeof(tbl4.pos) == "Vector3" and tbl4.pos or nil

	silentAimTelemetryWrite("BLOCKED", arg, silentAimTlmSeq, tostring(arg3 or "?"), {
		hitPart = arg6,
		origin = arg4,
		checkTo = arg5,
		target = pos,
		dist = arg4 and pos and silentAimTlmRound((pos - arg4).Magnitude, 2) or nil,
		murderer = arg2 and arg2.Name or nil,
	})
end

silentAimTelemetryRecordBlocked = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6)
	pcall(silentAimTelemetryRecordBlockedBody, arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6)
end

		return

			origin = typeof(arg) == "CFrame" and arg.Position or nil,
			aim = typeof(arg2) == "CFrame" and arg2.Position or nil,
			core = v_3,
		})
	end)
end

onUpdate = function()
	if autofarmBurstShooting then
		return
	end

	if not values.shoot then
		return
	end

	if findSheriff() ~= localPlayer then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = findMurder()
	if not (v_2 and v_2.Character and v_2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
		return
	end

	if values.shootOnlyKnifeOut and dropdownval.shootMode == "Manual" then
		if not v_2.Character:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
			return
		end
	end

	local character = localPlayer.Character
	if not (character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
		return
	end
	local humanoidRootPart = character.HumanoidRootPart
	local humanoidRootPart2 = v_2.Character.HumanoidRootPart
	local v_3 = lastShot
	if tick() - v_3 <= 0.5 then
		return
	end
	local v_4 = normalizeSilentAimType(dropdownval.silentAimType)
	local v_5, position, v_6 = silentAimResolveShot(character, humanoidRootPart, v_2, v_4)
	position = position or humanoidRootPart2.Position

	if v_4 ~= "Piercing" then
		local position2 = humanoidRootPart2.Position

		if typeof(v_6) == "Vector3" and v_6 ~= Vector3.zero then
			position2 = v_6
		end

		local v_7, v_8 = silentAimWallBlocked(character, v_5.Position, v_2.Character, position2)
		if v_7 then
			silentAimTelemetryRecordBlocked("autoshoot", v_2, v_4, v_5.Position, position2, v_8)
			return
		end
	end

	local gun = character:FindFirstChild("Gun") or findPlayerTool(localPlayer, "Gun")

	if gun and gun.Parent ~= character then
		character.Humanoid:EquipTool(gun)
	end

	local gun2 = character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
	if not gun2 then
		return
	end
	local shoot = gun2:FindFirstChild("Shoot")
	if not shoot then
		return
	end
	lastShot = tick()
	shoot:FireServer(v_5, CFrame.new(position))
	silentAimTelemetryRecordShot("autoshoot", v_2, { mode = v_4, origin = v_5.Position, aim = position, core = v_6, wallCheck = v_4 ~= "Piercing" })
end

getmap = function()
	for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if child:FindFirstChild("Spawn", true) or child:FindFirstChild("PlayerSpawn", true) then
			return child
		end
	end

	return nil
end

				local n = 0

				while values.shoot do
					local character = localPlayer.Character

					if not character then
						task.wait(0.5)
					else
						local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if not humanoidRootPart then
							task.wait(0.1)
						elseif findSheriff() == localPlayer then
							if dropdownval.shootMode == "Spin" then
								local v_2 = findMurder()

								if v_2 and v_2.Character then
									values.notm = false
									local humanoidRootPart2 = v_2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

									if humanoidRootPart2 then
										local shootRadius = valueslider.shootRadius
										local n2 = math.cos(math.rad(n)) * shootRadius
										local shootRadius2 = valueslider.shootRadius
										character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(humanoidRootPart2.CFrame * CFrame.new(n2, 0, math.sin(math.rad(n)) * shootRadius2))
										n = (n + 5) % 360
									end
								else
									values.notm = true
								end

								task.wait(0.03)
							elseif dropdownval.shootMode == "Behind" then
								local v_2 = findMurder()

								if v_2 and v_2.Character then
									values.notm = false
									local humanoidRootPart2 = v_2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

									if humanoidRootPart2 then
										humanoidRootPart.CFrame = humanoidRootPart2.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, valueslider.shootRadius / 2)
										workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, humanoidRootPart2.Position)
									end
								else
									values.notm = true
								end

								task.wait(0.02)
							else
								task.wait(1.6)
							end
						else
							task.wait(1.3)
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		elseif conns.cn then
			conns.cn:Disconnect()
			conns.cn = nil
		end
	end,
})

ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Gameplay"):WaitForChild("PlayerDataChanged", 5).OnClientEvent:Connect(function(arg)
	if not arg or type(arg) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local flag = false
	local n = 0

	for _, v_2 in pairs(arg) do
		if type(v_2) == "table" then
			if v_2.Role == "Murderer" then
				if v_2.Dead == true or v_2.Killed == true then
					flag = true
				end
			elseif v_2.Dead ~= true and v_2.Killed ~= true then
				n += 1
			end
		end
	end

	if flag or n == 0 then
		for _, v_2 in pairs(adorns) do
			if v_2 then
				v_2:Destroy()
			end
		end

		table.clear(adorns)
	end

	if not values.shoot or values.notm then
		return
	end

	if dropdownval.shootMode ~= "Spin" and dropdownval.shootMode ~= "Behind" then
		return
	end

	for _, v_2 in pairs(arg) do
		if v_2.Role == "Murderer" then
			if v_2.Dead == true or v_2.Killed == true then
				local localPlayer2 = game.Players.LocalPlayer
				local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer2.Character and localPlayer2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if humanoidRootPart then
					task.wait(0.1)
					local flag2 = findSheriff() == localPlayer

					if getmap() and flag2 then
						local v_3 = getmap()

						if v_3 then
							local spawn_ = v_3:FindFirstChild("Spawn", true) or v_3:FindFirstChild("PlayerSpawn", true)

							if spawn_ and spawn_:IsA("BasePart") then
								humanoidRootPart.CFrame = spawn_.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
							end
						end
					elseif not getmap() and flag2 then
						local spawns = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawns", true)

						if spawns then
							local children = spawns:GetChildren()

							if #children > 0 then
								humanoidRootPart.CFrame = children[math.random(1, #children)].CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

shootMurderLastWarn = 0

shootCallback = function(arg)
	if values.runnings then
		return false
	end

	if not values.silentAim and arg ~= true then
		return false
	end

	if findSheriff() ~= localPlayer then
		local now = tick()

		if now - shootMurderLastWarn >= 1.5 then
			shootMurderLastWarn = now
			sendnotification(lc.notsheriff, 5)
		end

		return false
	end

	local v_2 = findMurder()
	local character = v_2 and v_2.Character
	local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not v_2 or not character or not humanoidRootPart then
		print("No murderer to shoot")
		return false
	end
	local character2 = localPlayer.Character
	local humanoidRootPart2 = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

	if character2 and humanoidRootPart2 and humanoid then
		local v_3 = normalizeSilentAimType(dropdownval.silentAimType)
		local v_4, position, v_5 = silentAimResolveShot(character2, humanoidRootPart2, v_2, v_3)
		position = position or humanoidRootPart.Position

		if v_3 ~= "Piercing" and raycastsheriff1 then
			local position2 = humanoidRootPart.Position
			local v_6

			if typeof(v_5) == "Vector3" and v_5 ~= Vector3.zero then
				v_6 = v_5
			else
				v_6 = position2
			end

			local v_7, v_8 = silentAimWallBlocked(character2, v_4.Position, character, v_6)

			if v_7 then
				TestStats.shotsBlockedByWall = TestStats.shotsBlockedByWall + 1
				silentAimTelemetryRecordBlocked(arg == true and "button" or "keybind", v_2, v_3, v_4.Position, v_6, v_8)
				print("Wall detected, shot cancelled: " .. tostring(v_8))
				return false
			end
		end

		local gun = character2:FindFirstChild("Gun")

		if not gun then
			local v_6 = findPlayerTool(localPlayer, "Gun")

			if not v_6 then
				local now = tick()

				if now - shootMurderLastWarn >= 1.5 then
					shootMurderLastWarn = now
					sendnotification(lc.notsheriff, 5)
				end

				return false
			end

			if not adaptiveAutoEquip then
				print("Enable Auto equip gun in Buttons → Shoot Murderer options, or equip Gun first")
				return false
			end
			humanoid:EquipTool(v_6)
			local now = os.clock()

			while not character2:FindFirstChild("Gun") and os.clock() - now < 0.35 do
				task.wait()
			end

			gun = character2:FindFirstChild("Gun")
			if not gun then
				return false
			end
		end

		local shoot = gun:FindFirstChild("Shoot")
		if not shoot then
			print("Gun Shoot remote missing")
			return false
		end
		shoot:FireServer(v_4, CFrame.new(position))
		TestStats.shotsFired = TestStats.shotsFired + 1

		silentAimTelemetryRecordShot(arg == true and "button" or "keybind", v_2, {
			mode = v_3,
			origin = v_4.Position,
			aim = position,
			core = v_5,
			wallCheck = v_3 ~= "Piercing" and raycastsheriff1 == true,
		})

		if humanoid then
			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
			humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		end

		return true
	end

	print("miss humanoid??")
	return false
end

TestStats = {
	fps = 0,
	frameCount = 0,
	fpsTimer = 0,
	ping = 0,
	targetSpeed = 0,
	airborne = false,
	moving = false,
	accelMag = 0,
	velLerp = 0,
	bulletTime = 0,
	distance = 0,
	shotsFired = 0,
	shotsBlockedByWall = 0,
	lastPredictionPos = Vector3.zero,
	lastActualPos = Vector3.zero,
	lastError = 0,
	avgError = 0,
	errorSamples = 0,
	history = {},
}

safeUnit = function(arg)
	if arg.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		return Vector3.new()
	end
	return arg.Unit
end

recordPredictionSample = function(arg, arg2)
	table.insert(TestStats.history, { predicted = arg, targetTime = tick() + arg2, userId = lastTargetUserId })

	if #TestStats.history > 30 then
		table.remove(TestStats.history, 1)
	end
end

evaluateOldSamples = function()
	local now = tick()
	local n = 1

	while n <= #TestStats.history do
		local v_2 = TestStats.history[n]

		if v_2.targetTime <= now then
			local v_3 = findMurder()

			if v_3 and v_3.UserId == v_2.userId and v_3.Character and v_3.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				local position = v_3.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
				local magnitude = (v_2.predicted - position).Magnitude
				TestStats.lastPredictionPos = v_2.predicted
				TestStats.lastActualPos = position
				TestStats.lastError = magnitude
				TestStats.errorSamples = TestStats.errorSamples + 1
				TestStats.avgError = TestStats.avgError + (magnitude - TestStats.avgError) / TestStats.errorSamples
			end

			table.remove(TestStats.history, n)
		else
			n += 1
		end
	end
end

local function fn9(deltaTime)
	TestStats.frameCount = TestStats.frameCount + 1
	TestStats.fpsTimer = TestStats.fpsTimer + deltaTime

	if TestStats.fpsTimer >= 0.5 then
		TestStats.fps = TestStats.frameCount / TestStats.fpsTimer
		TestStats.frameCount = 0
		TestStats.fpsTimer = 0
	end

	evaluateOldSamples()

	if not values.silentAim and not values.shoot and not values.silentAimhook then
		if findSheriff() ~= localPlayer then
			return
		end
	end

	local v_2 = findMurder()
	if not (v_2 and v_2.Character and v_2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
		return
	end
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local humanoidRootPart = v_2.Character.HumanoidRootPart
	local humanoid = v_2.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	local assemblyLinearVelocity = humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local position = humanoidRootPart.Position

	if lastTargetUserId ~= v_2.UserId then
		lastTargetUserId = v_2.UserId
		smoothedVelocity = assemblyLinearVelocity
		smoothedAccel = Vector3.new()
		lastVelocity = assemblyLinearVelocity
		lastTick = tick()
		TestStats.history = {}
		table.clear(silentAimHist)
	end

	local now = tick()
	local n = (assemblyLinearVelocity - lastVelocity) / math.max(now - lastTick, 0.0041666666666666666)
	local v_3 = saTurnBetween(saFlat(assemblyLinearVelocity), saFlat(saVelAgo(SILENT_AIM_TURN_WINDOW) or lastVelocity))
	local magnitude = n.Magnitude
	local flag = lastVelocity.Y <= 1 and assemblyLinearVelocity.Y > 20

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return humanoid:GetState()
	end)

	local flag2 = false

	if ok then
		flag2 = result == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or result == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
	end

	if flag then
		lastJumpTick = now
	end

	local flag3 = now - lastJumpTick < 0.18
	local velLerp = math.clamp(0.18 + v_3 * 0.35 + math.min(magnitude / 800, 0.35), 0.18, 0.85)
	local v_4 = (smoothedVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)):Lerp(Vector3.new(assemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, assemblyLinearVelocity.Z), velLerp)
	local n2 = flag3 and 1 or 0.55
	smoothedVelocity = Vector3.new(v_4.X, smoothedVelocity.Y * (1 - n2) + assemblyLinearVelocity.Y * n2, v_4.Z)
	smoothedAccel = smoothedAccel:Lerp(n, 0.25)
	lastVelocity = assemblyLinearVelocity
	lastTick = now
	saPushVelSample(assemblyLinearVelocity)
	TestStats.targetSpeed = assemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
	TestStats.airborne = humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air or flag2 or flag3
	TestStats.moving = assemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 1
	TestStats.accelMag = magnitude
	TestStats.velLerp = velLerp
	TestStats.ping = localPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
	finalPos = Vector3.zero
	finalAimCore = Vector3.zero
	local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
	if not (character and (character:FindFirstChild("Gun") or backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun"))) then
		return
	end
	local v_5 = silentAimBuildState(v_2, character)
	if not v_5 then
		return
	end
	silentAimState = v_5
	silentAimStateTick = now
	local humanoidRootPart2 = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local position2 = humanoidRootPart2 and humanoidRootPart2.Position or position
	humanoidRootPart2 = humanoidRootPart2 and humanoidRootPart2:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")

	if humanoidRootPart2 then
		position2 = humanoidRootPart2.WorldCFrame.Position
	end

	local v_6 = normalizeSilentAimType(dropdownval.silentAimType)
	local v_7, v_8 = (silentAimPredictors[v_6] or silentAimPredictors.Dynamic)(v_5, silentAimTune)
	local bulletTime = v_8 or 0
	silentAimLastLead = bulletTime
	TestStats.bulletTime = bulletTime
	TestStats.distance = (position - position2).Magnitude
	finalAimCore = v_7

	if v_6 == "Piercing" then
		local v_9 = silentAimPiercingOrigin(v_5)
		finalPos = { v_9, CFrame.new(silentAimExtend(v_9.Position, v_7)) }
	else
		finalPos = silentAimExtend(position2, v_7)
	end

	if bulletTime > 0 then
		recordPredictionSample(v_7, bulletTime)
	end
end

needsCombatAimLoop = function()
	if values.silentAim or values.silentAimhook or values.shoot then
		return true
	end
	return findSheriff() == localPlayer
end

syncCombatAimLoop = function()
	if needsCombatAimLoop() then
		if not conns.combatAimRender then
			conns.combatAimRender = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(fn9)
		end
	elseif conns.combatAimRender then
		conns.combatAimRender:Disconnect()
		conns.combatAimRender = nil
	end
end

makeFrame = function(parent, name, size, position, backgroundColor3)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = name
	frame.Size = size
	frame.Position = position
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor3 or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 32)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = parent
	return frame
end

makeLabel = function(parent, text, size, position, textSize, textXAlignment)
	local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	textLabel.Size = size
	textLabel.Position = position
	textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
	textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	textLabel.TextSize = textSize or 13
	textLabel.TextXAlignment = textXAlignment or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	textLabel.Text = text
	textLabel.Parent = parent
	return textLabel
end

makeButton = function(parent, text, size, position, backgroundColor3)
	local textButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	textButton.Size = size
	textButton.Position = position
	textButton.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor3 or Color3.fromRGB(50, 90, 160)
	textButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
	textButton.AutoButtonColor = true

	return textButton
end

	if not arg.statsLabel then
		return
	end
	local tbl4 = {}
	local str = string.format("FPS:        %.1f", TestStats.fps)
	local str2 = string.format("Ping:       %.0f ms", TestStats.ping * 1000)
	local str3 = string.format("Mode:       %s", dropdownval.silentAimType)
	local str4 = string.format("Aim:        %s    Wall: %s", values.silentAim and "ON" or "off", raycastsheriff1 and "ON" or "off")
	local str5 = string.format("AimHook:        %s    Wall: %s", values.silentAimhook and "ON" or "off", raycastsheriff1 and "ON" or "off")
	local str6 = string.format("Target spd: %.2f stud/s", TestStats.targetSpeed)
	local str7 = string.format("Accel:      %.2f stud/s^2", TestStats.accelMag)
	local str8 = string.format("Airborne:   %s", TestStats.airborne and "YES (jump/fall)" or "no")
	local str9 = string.format("Lerp:       %.2f", TestStats.velLerp)
	local str10 = string.format("Bullet t:   %.0f ms", TestStats.bulletTime * 1000)
	local str11 = string.format("Distance:   %.1f studs", TestStats.distance)
	local str12 = string.format("Shots:      %d  (blocked %d)", TestStats.shotsFired, TestStats.shotsBlockedByWall)
	local v_2 = table.pack(string.format("Pred err:   last %.2f / avg %.2f (%d)", TestStats.lastError, TestStats.avgError, TestStats.errorSamples))
	tbl4[1] = str
	tbl4[2] = str2
	tbl4[3] = str3
	tbl4[4] = str4
	tbl4[5] = str5
	tbl4[6] = ""
	tbl4[7] = str6
	tbl4[8] = str7
	tbl4[9] = str8
	tbl4[10] = str9
	tbl4[11] = ""
	tbl4[12] = str10
	tbl4[13] = str11
	tbl4[14] = ""
	tbl4[15] = str12

	do
		local values = table.pack(table.unpack(v_2, 1, v_2.n))
		table.move(values, 1, values.n, 16, tbl4)
	end

	arg.statsLabel.Text = table.concat(tbl4, "\n")
end

hubOnPC(function()
	Tabs.combat:Divider()
	values.aimbotEnabled = false
	values.aimbotPrediction = false
	valueslider.aimbotFOVRadius = 240

	Tabs.combat:Toggle({
		Title = "loc:aimbot",
		Value = values.aimbotEnabled,
		Flag = "aimbotEnabled",
		Callback = function(aimbotEnabled)
			values.aimbotEnabled = aimbotEnabled
		end,
	})

	Tabs.combat:Toggle({
		Title = "loc:prediction",
		Value = values.aimbotPrediction,
		Flag = "aimbotPrediction",
		Callback = function(aimbotPrediction)
			values.aimbotPrediction = aimbotPrediction
		end,
	})

	hubInputOrSlider(Tabs.combat, {
		Title = "loc:fovradius",
		Value = { Min = 80, Max = 340, Default = valueslider.aimbotFOVRadius },
		Step = 1,
		Flag = "aimbotFOVRadius",
		Callback = function(arg)
			valueslider.aimbotFOVRadius = tonumber(arg)
		end,
	})

	Tabs.combat:Divider()
	local mouse = localPlayer:GetMouse()
	local vector = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
	local n = 0.2
	local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	GetClosestPlayerToMouse = function()
		local aimbotFOVRadius = valueslider.aimbotFOVRadius
		local character = nil

		for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player.Character and (player.Character:FindFirstChild("Knife") or findPlayerTool(player, "Knife")) and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player ~= localPlayer and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health > 0 then
				local v_2, v_3 = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)

				if v_3 then
					local v_4 = tonumber
					local y = mouse.Y
					local magnitude = (Vector2.new(tonumber(mouse.X), v_4(y)) - Vector2.new(v_2.X, v_2.Y)).Magnitude

					if magnitude < aimbotFOVRadius then
						character = player.Character
						aimbotFOVRadius = magnitude
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return character, aimbotFOVRadius < valueslider.aimbotFOVRadius
	end

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and values.aimbotEnabled then
			local v_2, v_3 = GetClosestPlayerToMouse()
			local flag = false

			if v_3 then
				UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
				flag = true
			end

			while UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) and values.aimbotEnabled do
				if v_2 then
					currentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(currentCamera.CFrame.Position, (values.aimbotPrediction and v_2.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + v_2.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity * n + vector or v_2.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame).Position)
				end

				task.wait()
			end

			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default

			if flag and type(stalclansMouseUnlock) == "function" then
				pcall(stalclansMouseUnlock)
			end
		end
	end)
end)

Tabs.combat:Toggle({
	Title = "loc:knifeaura",
	Value = values.knifeAura,
	Flag = "knifeAura",
	Callback = function(knifeAura)
		values.knifeAura = knifeAura
		if not knifeAura then
			return
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			while values.knifeAura do
				if values.runnings then
					values.knifeAura = false
					break
				else
					pcall(function()
						local character = localPlayer.Character
						if not character then
							return
						end
						local knife = character:FindFirstChild("Knife")

						if not knife and values.autoequipknife then
							local knife2 = getPlayerBackpack(localPlayer)
							local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
							knife2 = knife2 and knife2:FindFirstChild("Knife")

							if humanoid and knife2 then
								humanoid:EquipTool(knife2)
								task.wait()
								knife = character:FindFirstChild("Knife")
							end
						end

						knife = knife or findPlayerTool(localPlayer, "Knife")
						if not knife or not knife:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
							return
						end

						for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
							if not (player == localPlayer or not player.Character) then
								local humanoidRootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
								local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

								if not (not humanoidRootPart or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0) then
									if not (valueslider.knifeAuraRange <= localPlayer:DistanceFromCharacter(humanoidRootPart.Position)) then
										if values.knifeAuraWallCheck then
											local humanoidRootPart2 = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
											if not humanoidRootPart2 then
												continue
											end
											local n = humanoidRootPart.Position - humanoidRootPart2.Position

											if n.Magnitude >= 0.05 then
												local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
												raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
												raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
												local hit = workspace:Raycast(humanoidRootPart2.Position, n, raycastParams)
												if hit and not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
													continue
												end
											end
										end

										hubStabPlayerHrp(character, knife, humanoidRootPart)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end)

					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end
		end)
	end,
})

local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

attachThrowAura = function(arg)
	if conns.throwAuraConns[arg] or not arg:IsA("Model") or arg.Name ~= "ThrowingKnife" then
		return
	end
	local bladePosition = arg:FindFirstChild("BladePosition") or arg:FindFirstChild("KnifeVisual", true)

	if bladePosition and bladePosition:IsA("Attachment") then
		bladePosition = bladePosition.Parent
	end

	if not bladePosition or not bladePosition:IsA("BasePart") then
		for _, v_2 in arg:GetDescendants() do
			if v_2:IsA("BasePart") and v_2.Name == "KnifeVisual" then
				bladePosition = v_2
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if not bladePosition then
		return
	end
	local n = 0

	step = function()
		if not values.throwingKnifeActive or not arg.Parent then
			local v_2 = conns.throwAuraConns[arg]

			if v_2 then
				v_2.hb:Disconnect()
				v_2.pos:Disconnect()
				v_2.anc:Disconnect()
				conns.throwAuraConns[arg] = nil
			end

			return
		end

		if tick() - n < 0.033333333333333333 then
			return
		end
		n = tick()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local knife = character and character:FindFirstChild("Knife")
		local handle = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		local handleTouched = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Events") and knife.Events:FindFirstChild("HandleTouched")
		if not handle or not handleTouched then
			return
		end
		local position = bladePosition.Position
		local throwingKnifeReach = valueslider.throwingKnifeReach

		for _, v_2 in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if not (v_2 == localPlayer or not v_2.Character) then
				local humanoidRootPart = v_2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local humanoid = v_2.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

				if not (not humanoidRootPart or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0) then
					local n2 = humanoidRootPart.Position - position
					local magnitude = n2.Magnitude

					if not (magnitude < 1 or magnitude > throwingKnifeReach) then
						if values.throwingKnifeWallCheck then
							local filterDescendantsInstances = { character, arg }

							for _, v_3 in arg:GetDescendants() do
								if v_3:IsA("BasePart") then
									filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = v_3
								end
							end

							raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
							local n3 = n2.Unit * magnitude
							local hit = workspace:Spherecast(position, 0.35, n3, raycastParams) or workspace:Raycast(position, n3, raycastParams)
							hit = hit and hit.Instance
							if hit and v_2.Character and not hit:IsDescendantOf(v_2.Character) then
								continue
							end
						end

						if func.fire and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
							pcall(firetouchinterest, humanoidRootPart, handle, 0)
							pcall(firetouchinterest, humanoidRootPart, handle, 1)
						end

						handleTouched:FireServer(humanoidRootPart)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	conns.throwAuraConns[arg] = {
		hb = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step),
		pos = bladePosition:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(step),
		anc = arg.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
			if not parent then
				step()
			end
		end),
	}

	step()
end

setThrowAuraState = function(throwingKnifeActive)
	values.throwingKnifeActive = throwingKnifeActive

	if conns.throwAuraDescendantConn then
		conns.throwAuraDescendantConn:Disconnect()
		conns.throwAuraDescendantConn = nil
	end

	for k, throwAuraConn in pairs(conns.throwAuraConns) do
		throwAuraConn.hb:Disconnect()
		throwAuraConn.pos:Disconnect()
		throwAuraConn.anc:Disconnect()
		conns.throwAuraConns[k] = nil
	end

	if not throwingKnifeActive then
		return
	end

	for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant.Name == "ThrowingKnife" then
			attachThrowAura(descendant)
		end
	end

	conns.throwAuraDescendantConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
		if descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant.Name == "ThrowingKnife" then
			task.defer(attachThrowAura, descendant)
		end
	end)
end

	Title = "loc:throwknife",

	Flag = "throwingKnifeActive",
	Callback = setThrowAuraState,

HasGun = function(arg)
	local backpack = arg:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
	local character = arg.Character
	return backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") or character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
end

IsInsideFOV = function(arg)
	if not values.KnifeUseFOV then
		return true
	end
	local v_2, v_3 = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(arg)
	if v_3 then
		local knifeFOVSize = valueslider.KnifeFOVSize
		return (Vector2.new(v_2.X, v_2.Y) - Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)).Magnitude <= knifeFOVSize
	end
	return false
end

GetKnifeTarget = function()
	if not values.KnifeAimEnabled then
		return
	end
	local primaryPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart
	if not primaryPart then
		return
	end
	local huge = math.huge
	local v_2 = nil

	for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player == localPlayer then
			continue
		end
		local primaryPart2 = player.Character and player.Character.PrimaryPart

		if primaryPart2 then
			local magnitude = (primaryPart.Position - primaryPart2.Position).Magnitude

			if IsInsideFOV(primaryPart2.Position) and magnitude < huge then
				if dropdownval.knifeTargetingMode == "Only Sheriff" and HasGun(player) then
					return player
				end

				if dropdownval.knifeTargetingMode == "Everyone" then
					huge = magnitude
					v_2 = player
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return v_2
end

GetKnifePrediction = function()
	if not values.KnifeAimEnabled or not localPlayerHasKnife() then
		if PredictionIndicator then
			PredictionIndicator.Visible = false
		end

		return nil
	end

	local v_2 = GetKnifeTarget()

	if v_2 then
		local primaryPart = v_2.Character and v_2.Character.PrimaryPart

		if primaryPart then
			local assemblyLinearVelocity = primaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local n = predictionIntervalHorizontal / 100
			local n2 = primaryPart.Position + Vector3.new(assemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, assemblyLinearVelocity.Z) * n

			if values.KnifeShowPrediction and values.KnifeAimEnabled and localPlayerHasKnife() and PredictionIndicator then
				local v_3, v_4 = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(n2)

				if v_4 then
					PredictionIndicator.Position = Vector2.new(v_3.X, v_3.Y)
					PredictionIndicator.Visible = true
				else
					PredictionIndicator.Visible = false
				end
			elseif PredictionIndicator then
				PredictionIndicator.Visible = false
			end

			return n2
		end
	end

	if PredictionIndicator then
		PredictionIndicator.Visible = false
	end

	return nil
end

local function fn11()
	if not values.KnifeAimEnabled then
		if Circle then
			Circle.Visible = false
		end

		if PredictionIndicator then
			PredictionIndicator.Visible = false
		end

		return
	end

	if Circle then
		Circle.Radius = valueslider.KnifeFOVSize
		Circle.Visible = values.KnifeShowFOV and values.KnifeAimEnabled and localPlayerHasKnife()
	end

	CurrentPredictionKnife = GetKnifePrediction() or CurrentPredictionKnife
end

syncKnifeAimLoop = function()
	if values.KnifeAimEnabled then
		if not conns.knifeAimRender then
			conns.knifeAimRender = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(fn11)
		end
	else
		if conns.knifeAimRender then
			conns.knifeAimRender:Disconnect()
			conns.knifeAimRender = nil
		end

		fn11()
	end
end

	Tabs.combat:Toggle({
		Title = "loc:togsilentaimKNIFE",
		Value = values.KnifeAimEnabled,
		Flag = "KnifeAimEnabled",
		Callback = function(knifeAimEnabled)
			values.KnifeAimEnabled = knifeAimEnabled
			syncKnifeAimLoop()
		end,
	})

	Tabs.combat:Keybind({
		Title = "loc:silentaimKNIFE",
		Value = valuekeys.knifeAimKeybind,
		Flag = "knifeAimKeybind",
		Callback = function()
			if values.KnifeAimEnabled then
				local tbl4 = {}
				if findMurder() ~= localPlayer then
					print(lc.kill)
					return
				end

				if not localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
					local humanoid = localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
					local knife = getPlayerBackpack(localPlayer)
					knife = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Knife")
					if not knife then
						print("You don't have the knife..?")
						return
					end
					humanoid:EquipTool(knife)
				end

				local v_2 = findPlayerTool(localPlayer, "Knife")
				local v_3 = CurrentPredictionKnife
				if not v_3 or v_3 == Vector3.zero then
					return
				end
				tbl4[1] = v_2.Handle.CFrame
				tbl4[2] = CFrame.new(v_3)

				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					localPlayer.Character.Knife.Events.KnifeThrown:FireServer(unpack(tbl4))
				end)

				if ok then
					local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

					if humanoid then
						humanoid.PlatformStand = false
						humanoid.AutoRotate = true
					end
				end

				if not ok then
					warn("Error:", result)
				end
			end
		end,
	})
end)

Tabs.troll:Section({ Title = "loc:section_fling" })
activeToggle = nil

dropdownFling = Tabs.troll:Dropdown({
	Title = "loc:inputfling",
	Values = hubPlayerNames(),

	Multi = true,
	AllowNone = true,

flingPartSpeed = function(arg)
	if not arg or not arg.Parent then
		return 0
	end
	local assemblyLinearVelocity = arg.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if assemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 0 then
		return assemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
	end
	return arg.Velocity.Magnitude
end

minifling = function(arg)
	if arg == localPlayer or not arg.Character then
		values.alr = false
		return
	end

	if values.alr then
		return
	end
	values.alr = true

	if type(autofarmStopFloatDrive) == "function" then
		pcall(autofarmStopFloatDrive, "minifling")
	end

	if values.flyEnabled then
		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if humanoid then
			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		end
	end

	local Players2 = game:GetService("Players")
	if not Players2.LocalPlayer then
		values.alr = false
		return
	end

	if not getgenv().FPDH then
		local fallenPartsDestroyHeight = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
		getgenv().FPDH = fallenPartsDestroyHeight
	end

	local bodyVelocity = nil
	local connection = nil
	local v_2 = nil

	flingApplyCam = function(cameraSubject)
		local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		if currentCamera and cameraSubject and cameraSubject.Parent then
			currentCamera.CameraSubject = cameraSubject
		end
	end

	flingStopCamLock = function()
		if connection then
			pcall(function()
				connection:Disconnect()
			end)

			connection = nil
		end

		v_2 = nil
	end

	Cleanup = function(arg2)
		flingStopCamLock()

		pcall(function()
			if bodyVelocity and bodyVelocity.Parent then
				bodyVelocity:Destroy()
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = getgenv().FPDH
			getgenv().FPDH = nil
		end)

		pcall(function()
			flingApplyCam(localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or arg2)
		end)

		pcall(function()
			if arg2 then
				arg2:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
			end
		end)

		values.alr = false
	end

	g = function(arg2)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local rootPart = humanoid and humanoid.RootPart
		if not arg2 or not character or not humanoid or not rootPart then
			Cleanup(humanoid)
			return
		end
		local character2 = arg2.Character
		if not character2 then
			Cleanup(humanoid)
			return
		end
		local humanoid2 = character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid2 then
			Cleanup(humanoid)
			return
		end
		local humanoidRootPart = character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			Cleanup(humanoid)
			return
		end
		local head = character2:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not head then
			Cleanup(humanoid)
			return
		end
		local accessory = character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
		accessory = accessory and accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		if not character2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then
			Cleanup(humanoid)
			return
		end

		if flingPartSpeed(rootPart) < 50 then
			local cFrame = rootPart.CFrame
			getgenv().OldPos = cFrame
		end

		if head and head.Parent and flingPartSpeed(head) > 500 then
			Cleanup(humanoid)
			return
		end
		flingStopCamLock()
		v_2 = head or accessory or humanoid2
		flingApplyCam(v_2)

		connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not values.alr then
				return
			end
			local head2 = v_2

			if not head2 or not head2.Parent then
				local character3 = arg2 and arg2.Character

				if character3 then
					head2 = character3:FindFirstChild("Head") or character3:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				end

				v_2 = head2
			end

			if head2 then
				flingApplyCam(head2)
			end
		end)

		FPos = function(arg3, arg4, arg5)
			if not rootPart or not arg3 or not arg3.Parent then
				return
			end
			local cFrame = CFrame.new(arg3.Position) * arg4 * arg5
			rootPart.CFrame = cFrame

			if character and character.PrimaryPart then
				character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(cFrame)
			end

			rootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(90000000, 900000000, 90000000)
			rootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(900000000, 900000000, 900000000)
		end

		v = function(arg3)
			local now = tick()
			local n = 0

			while true do
				if not (not arg2 or arg2.Parent ~= Players2) then
					if not (not arg2.Character or arg2.Character ~= character2) then
						if not (not arg3 or not arg3.Parent) then
							if not (not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0) then
								if not (not rootPart or not rootPart.Parent) then
									if not (humanoid2 and humanoid2.Sit) then
										flingApplyCam(v_2 or head or humanoid2)
										local v_3 = flingPartSpeed(arg3)

										if v_3 < 50 then
											n += 100
											local n2 = humanoid2.MoveDirection * v_3 / 1.25
											local cframe = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + n2, cframe(math.rad(n), 0, 0))
											task.wait()
											local n3 = humanoid2.MoveDirection * v_3 / 1.25
											local cframe2 = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + n3, cframe2(math.rad(n), 0, 0))
											task.wait()
											local n4 = humanoid2.MoveDirection * v_3 / 1.25
											local cframe3 = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(2.25, 1.5, -2.25) + n4, cframe3(math.rad(n), 0, 0))
											task.wait()
											local n5 = humanoid2.MoveDirection * v_3 / 1.25
											local cframe4 = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(-2.25, -1.5, 2.25) + n5, cframe4(math.rad(n), 0, 0))
											task.wait()
											local moveDirection = humanoid2.MoveDirection
											local cframe5 = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + moveDirection, cframe5(math.rad(n), 0, 0))
											task.wait()
											local moveDirection2 = humanoid2.MoveDirection
											local cframe6 = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + moveDirection2, cframe6(math.rad(n), 0, 0))
											task.wait()
										else
											local cframe = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, humanoid2.WalkSpeed), cframe(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0))
											task.wait()
											local cframe2 = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -humanoid2.WalkSpeed), cframe2(0, 0, 0))
											task.wait()
											local cframe3 = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, humanoid2.WalkSpeed), cframe3(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0))
											task.wait()

											if humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart.Parent then
												local v_4 = flingPartSpeed(humanoidRootPart)
												local cframe4 = CFrame.Angles
												FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, v_4 / 1.25), cframe4(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0))
												task.wait()
												local cframe5 = CFrame.Angles
												FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -v_4 / 1.25), cframe5(0, 0, 0))
												task.wait()
												local cframe6 = CFrame.Angles
												FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, v_4 / 1.25), cframe6(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0))
												task.wait()
											end

											local cframe4 = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), cframe4(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0))
											task.wait()
											local cframe5 = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), cframe5(0, 0, 0))
											task.wait()
											local cframe6 = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), cframe6(-1.5707963267948966, 0, 0))
											task.wait()
											local cframe7 = CFrame.Angles
											FPos(arg3, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), cframe7(0, 0, 0))
											task.wait()
										end

										if not (flingPartSpeed(arg3) > 500 or tick() > now + 2) then
											continue
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				break
			end

			flingStopCamLock()
			flingApplyCam(humanoid)
		end

		workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = (0/0)
		bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bodyVelocity.Name = "EpixVel"
		bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart
		bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(900000000, 900000000, 900000000)
		bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)

		if humanoidRootPart and head then
			if (humanoidRootPart.Position - head.Position).Magnitude > 5 then
				v(head)
			else
				v(humanoidRootPart)
			end
		elseif humanoidRootPart then
			v(humanoidRootPart)
		elseif head then
			v(head)
		elseif accessory then
			v(accessory)
		end

		if bodyVelocity and bodyVelocity.Parent then
			bodyVelocity:Destroy()
			bodyVelocity = nil
		end

		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
		flingStopCamLock()
		flingApplyCam(humanoid)

		if getgenv().OldPos and rootPart and character and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local now = os.clock()

			while true do
				if not (not rootPart or not rootPart.Parent) then
					if not (os.clock() - now > 5) then
						local cFrame = getgenv().OldPos * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
						rootPart.CFrame = cFrame

						if character.PrimaryPart then
							character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(cFrame)
						end

						humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)

						for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
							if child:IsA("BasePart") then
								child.Velocity = Vector3.new()
								child.RotVelocity = Vector3.new()
							end
						end

						task.wait()
						if not ((rootPart.Position - getgenv().OldPos.Position).Magnitude < 10) then
							continue
						end
					end
				end

				break
			end
		end

		Cleanup(humanoid)
	end

	g(arg)
end

	Callback = function(arg)

					while enb do
						local v_2 = hubNormalizeDropdownSelection(dropdownval.flingPicked, true)

						if #v_2 == 0 and type(dropdownFling.Value) == "table" then
							v_2 = hubNormalizeDropdownSelection(dropdownFling.Value, true)
						end

						for _, v_3 in ipairs(v_2) do
							if enb then
								local v_4 = Players:FindFirstChild(v_3)

								if v_4 and v_4 ~= localPlayer and v_4.Character and v_4.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
									minifling(v_4)

									while true do

										end
										break
									end

							end

							break
						end

					end
				end)

				activeToggle = nil
				values.alr = false

				if not ok then
					warn("Fling player error: " .. tostring(result))
				end
			end)
		end
	end,
})

	if arg then
		local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
		animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. arg2
		local v_2 = arg:LoadAnimation(animation)
		v_2:Play()
		return v_2
	end
end

cleanupBang = function()
	values.bangFollowing = false

	if bangAnimTrack then
		bangAnimTrack:Stop()
		bangAnimTrack = nil
	end

	bangCoroutine = nil

	if conns.bangCharConnection then
		conns.bangCharConnection:Disconnect()
		conns.bangCharConnection = nil
	end
end

cleanupGS = function()
	values.gsRunning = false

	if gsAnimTrack then
		gsAnimTrack:Stop()
		gsAnimTrack = nil
	end

	gsCoroutine = nil

	if conns.gsCharConnection then
		conns.gsCharConnection:Disconnect()
		conns.gsCharConnection = nil
	end

	if gsOriginalGravity then
		workspace.Gravity = gsOriginalGravity
		gsOriginalGravity = nil
	end
end

cleanupGB = function()
	values.gbRunning = false

	if gbAnimTrack then
		gbAnimTrack:Stop()
		gbAnimTrack = nil
	end

	gbCoroutine = nil

	if conns.gbCharConnection then
		conns.gbCharConnection:Disconnect()
		conns.gbCharConnection = nil
	end

	if conns.gbTargetConnection then
		conns.gbTargetConnection:Disconnect()
		conns.gbTargetConnection = nil
	end
end

bangTog = Tabs.troll:Toggle({
	Title = "loc:bang",
	Value = false,
	Callback = function(arg)
		if not arg then
			cleanupBang()
			return
		end
		targetPlayer = GetTarget(targetName)

		if not targetPlayer then
			sendnotification(lc.targetbang)
			cleanupBang()
			return
		end

		values.bangFollowing = true

		followLoop = function()
			while values.bangFollowing do
				local character = localPlayer.Character
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				character = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local character2 = targetPlayer.Character
				character2 = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if humanoid and character and character2 then
					if not bangAnimTrack or not bangAnimTrack.IsPlaying then
						bangAnimTrack = playAnimation(humanoid, "10714068222")
						bangAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(2)
					end

					local n = character2.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1)
					local n2 = character2.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 2.5)
					TweenService:Create(character, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { CFrame = n }):Play()
					wait(0.2)
					TweenService:Create(character, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { CFrame = n2 }):Play()
					wait(0.2)
				else
					wait(0.5)
				end
			end

			if bangAnimTrack then
				bangAnimTrack:Stop()
				bangAnimTrack = nil
			end
		end

		bangCoroutine = coroutine.wrap(followLoop)
		bangCoroutine()

		conns.bangCharConnection = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			if values.bangFollowing then
				local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

				if bangAnimTrack then
					bangAnimTrack:Stop()
				end

				bangAnimTrack = playAnimation(humanoid, "10714068222")
				bangAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(2)
			end
		end)
	end,
})

			end

				character2 = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					character2.Velocity = Vector3.zero

				workspace.Gravity = gsOriginalGravity
				gsOriginalGravity = nil

		end

		gsCoroutine()

startAnim = function()
	if jerkanim then
		jerkanim:Stop()
	end

	local humanoid = (localPlayer.Character or localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()):FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if humanoid and values.jerkenabled then
		local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
		animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://698251653"
		jerkanim = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
		jerkanim:Play()
		jerkanim.TimePosition = 0.58
		jerkanim:AdjustSpeed(valueslider.jerkUI / 10)

		task.spawn(function()
			while jerkanim and values.jerkenabled do
				if jerkanim.TimePosition >= 0.63 then
					jerkanim.TimePosition = 0.58
				end

				task.wait()
			end
		end)
	end
end

Tabs.troll:Toggle({
	Title = "loc:jerk",
	Value = values.jerkenabled,
	Flag = "jerkenabled",
	Callback = function(jerkenabled)
		values.jerkenabled = jerkenabled

		if jerkenabled then
			startAnim()

			if not conns.jerkConn then
				conns.jerkConn = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
					task.wait(0.5)

					if values.jerkenabled then
						startAnim()
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			if jerkanim then
				jerkanim:Stop()
			end

			if conns.jerkConn then
				conns.jerkConn:Disconnect()
				conns.jerkConn = nil
			end
		end
	end,
})

Tabs.troll:Section({ Title = "loc:section_funny_functions" })
SPIN_RENDER_BIND = "SNPWARE_Spinner"
spinSavedAutoRotate = nil

hubStopSpinner = function()
	pcall(function()
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(SPIN_RENDER_BIND)
	end)

	local character = localPlayer.Character

	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if humanoid and spinSavedAutoRotate ~= nil then
			humanoid.AutoRotate = spinSavedAutoRotate
		end

		local v_2 = getRoot(character)

		if v_2 then
			local spinning = v_2:FindFirstChild("Spinning")

			if spinning then
				spinning:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	spinSavedAutoRotate = nil
end

hubStartSpinner = function()
	hubStopSpinner()
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = getRoot(character)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not v_2 or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	local spinning = v_2:FindFirstChild("Spinning")

	if spinning then
		spinning:Destroy()
	end

	spinSavedAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	local v_3 = values
	local v_4 = valueslider
	local v_5 = hubStopSpinner
	local v_6 = localPlayer
	local v_7 = getRoot

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(SPIN_RENDER_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function(arg)
		if not v_3 or not v_3.spinningEnabled then
			v_5()
			return
		end
		local character2 = v_6.Character
		if not character2 then
			return
		end
		local v_8 = v_7(character2)
		local humanoid2 = character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not v_8 or not humanoid2 or humanoid2.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		humanoid2.AutoRotate = false
		v_8.CFrame = v_8.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, (tonumber(v_4 and v_4.spinspeed) or 20) * arg, 0)
	end)
end

hubFlipFeatureToggle = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	if not arg or type(arg.Set) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	local flag

	if type(arg2) == "function" then
		flag = arg2() and true or false
	else
		flag = false

		if arg.Value ~= nil then
			flag = arg.Value and true or false
		end
	end

	local flag2 = not flag
	if flag2 and arg3 and values.alr then
		return
	end
	pcall(arg.Set, arg, flag2)
end

Tabs.troll:Section({ Title = "loc:section_fake_lag" })

stopEgor = function()
	if conns.egorRunConn then
		conns.egorRunConn:Disconnect()
		conns.egorRunConn = nil
	end

	if conns.egorSpeedConn then
		conns.egorSpeedConn:Disconnect()
		conns.egorSpeedConn = nil
	end

	local character = localPlayer.Character
	character = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if character then
		character.WalkSpeed = 16

		for _, v_2 in pairs(character:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
			if v_2.Animation.AnimationId == "rbxassetid://913376220" then
				v_2:Stop()
			end
		end
	end
end

startEgor = function()
	stopEgor()
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 3

	conns.egorSpeedConn = humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
		if values.egorenb then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = 3
		end
	end)

	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://913376220"
	local v_2 = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
	v_2.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
	v_2:AdjustSpeed(6)

	conns.egorRunConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then
			if conns.egorRunConn then
				conns.egorRunConn:Disconnect()
			end

			return
		end

		if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude == 0 then
			if v_2.IsPlaying then
				v_2:Stop()
			end
		elseif not v_2.IsPlaying then
			v_2:Play()
			v_2:AdjustSpeed(6)
		end
	end)
end

	Title = "loc:robloxegor",
	Value = values.egorenb,
	Callback = function(egorenb)
		values.egorenb = egorenb

		if egorenb then
			startEgor()
		else
			stopEgor()
		end
	end,
})

	if values.egorenb then

	end

fakelagSeconds = function(arg, arg2)
	local num = tonumber(arg) or arg2
	if num > 1 then
		return num / 100
	end
	return num
end

doTeleport = function()
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	character = character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

	if humanoidRootPart and character and character.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
		humanoidRootPart.CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame + character.MoveDirection.Unit * math.random(valueslider.teleportDistance * 100) / 100
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if values.enabledfakelag then
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if humanoidRootPart then
				humanoidRootPart.Anchored = true
				task.wait(fakelagSeconds(valueslider.anchoredDuration, 0.4))
				humanoidRootPart.Anchored = false

				if values.teleportEnabled then
					doTeleport()
				end
			end
		end

		task.wait(fakelagSeconds(valueslider.interval, 0.07))
	end
end)

clearTrapEspLabels = function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Character then
			for _, descendant in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("BillboardGui") and descendant.Name == "TrapLabel" then
					descendant:Destroy()
				end
			end
