trapEspArmed = false
trapEspCharDesc = {}
trapEspCharAdded = {}

trapEspDisconnect = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return
	end

	if typeof(arg) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
		pcall(function()
			arg:Disconnect()
		end)
	end

	local trapEspConns = conns.trapEspConns

	for i = #trapEspConns, 1, -1 do
		if trapEspConns[i] == arg then
			table.remove(trapEspConns, i)
			break
		end
	end
end

disableTrapEsp = function()
	trapEspArmed = false

	for _, trapEspConn in ipairs(conns.trapEspConns) do
		if trapEspConn and typeof(trapEspConn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
			pcall(function()
				trapEspConn:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
	end

	table.clear(conns.trapEspConns)
	table.clear(trapEspCharDesc)
	table.clear(trapEspCharAdded)
	clearTrapEspLabels()
end

handleTrap = function(parent)
	if not (parent:IsA("Model") and parent.Name == "Trap") then
		return
	end

	if parent:FindFirstChild("TrapLabel") then
		return
	end
	local primaryPart = parent.PrimaryPart or parent:FindFirstChild("TrapVisual") or parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local billboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboardGui.Name = "TrapLabel"
	billboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 70)
	billboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboardGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	billboardGui.Adornee = primaryPart
	billboardGui.Parent = parent
	local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	textLabel.Text = "TRAP"
	textLabel.TextColor3 = valuecolors.espTrapColor
	textLabel.TextScaled = true
	textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.RobotoCondensed
	textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	textLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	textLabel.Parent = billboardGui
end

initESP = function()
	if trapEspArmed then
		return
	end
	trapEspArmed = true

	local function fn12(arg, arg2)
		trapEspDisconnect(trapEspCharDesc[arg])
		trapEspCharDesc[arg] = nil
		if not arg2 then
			return
		end
		local connection = arg2.DescendantAdded:Connect(handleTrap)
		trapEspCharDesc[arg] = connection
		table.insert(conns.trapEspConns, connection)

		for _, descendant in ipairs(arg2:GetDescendants()) do
			handleTrap(descendant)
		end
	end

	local function fn13(player)
		if player == localPlayer then
			return
		end

		if trapEspCharAdded[player] then
			return
		end

		local connection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			fn12(player, character)
		end)

		trapEspCharAdded[player] = connection
		table.insert(conns.trapEspConns, connection)

		if player.Character then
			fn12(player, player.Character)
		end
	end

	table.insert(conns.trapEspConns, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(fn13))

	table.insert(conns.trapEspConns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		trapEspDisconnect(trapEspCharDesc[player])
		trapEspDisconnect(trapEspCharAdded[player])
		trapEspCharDesc[player] = nil
		trapEspCharAdded[player] = nil
	end))

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		fn13(player)
	end
end

thrownKnifeEspPool = {}

getThrownKnifeTrackPos = function(arg)
	local bladePosition = arg:FindFirstChild("BladePosition")
	if bladePosition and bladePosition:IsA("BasePart") then
		return bladePosition.Position
	end
	local knifeVisual = arg:FindFirstChild("KnifeVisual")
	if knifeVisual and knifeVisual:IsA("BasePart") then
		return knifeVisual.Position
	end

	if arg.PrimaryPart then
		return arg.PrimaryPart.Position
	end
	return nil
end

clearThrownKnifeEsp = function(arg)
	local v_2 = thrownKnifeEspPool[arg]
	if not v_2 then
		return
	end

	if v_2.ancestryConn then
		v_2.ancestryConn:Disconnect()
	end

	if v_2.highlight then
		pcall(function()
			v_2.highlight:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	if v_2.box then
		pcall(function()
			v_2.box:Remove()
		end)
	end

	thrownKnifeEspPool[arg] = nil
end

clearAllThrownKnifeEsp = function()
	for k in pairs(thrownKnifeEspPool) do
		clearThrownKnifeEsp(k)
	end
end

attachThrownKnifeEsp = function(adornee)
	if not values.thrownKnifeEsp or not adornee or not adornee.Parent then
		return
	end

	if not adornee:IsA("Model") or adornee.Name ~= "ThrowingKnife" then
		return
	end

	if thrownKnifeEspPool[adornee] then
		return
	end
	local tbl4 = {}
	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.Name = "ThrownKnifeEspHighlight"
	highlight.Adornee = adornee
	highlight.Parent = adornee
	highlight.Enabled = true
	highlight.FillColor = valuecolors.espThrownKnifeColor
	highlight.OutlineColor = valuecolors.espThrownKnifeColor
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.35
	highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	tbl4.highlight = highlight

	if Drawing and Drawing.new then
		local ok, box = pcall(function()
			local square = Drawing.new("Square")
			square.Thickness = 2
			square.Filled = false
			square.Color = valuecolors.espThrownKnifeColor
			square.Visible = false
			return square
		end)

		if ok and box then
			tbl4.box = box
		end
	end

	tbl4.ancestryConn = adornee.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
		if not parent then
			clearThrownKnifeEsp(adornee)
		end
	end)

	thrownKnifeEspPool[adornee] = tbl4
end

scanThrownKnivesForEsp = function()
	for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant.Name == "ThrowingKnife" then
			attachThrownKnifeEsp(descendant)
		end
	end
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
	if values.thrownKnifeEsp and descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant.Name == "ThrowingKnife" then
		attachThrownKnifeEsp(descendant)
	end
end)

local function fn12()
	local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not currentCamera then
		return
	end

	for k, v_2 in pairs(thrownKnifeEspPool) do
		if not k.Parent then
			clearThrownKnifeEsp(k)
		elseif v_2.box then
			local v_3 = getThrownKnifeTrackPos(k)

			if v_3 then
				local v_4, v_5 = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(v_3)

				if v_5 and v_4.Z > 0 then
					local n = math.clamp(900 / v_4.Z, 14, 140)
					v_2.box.Size = Vector2.new(n, n)
					v_2.box.Position = Vector2.new(v_4.X - n / 2, v_4.Y - n / 2)
					v_2.box.Visible = true
				else
					v_2.box.Visible = false
				end
			else
				v_2.box.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end
end

syncThrownKnifeEspLoop = function()
	if values.thrownKnifeEsp then
		if not conns.thrownKnifeEspRender then
			conns.thrownKnifeEspRender = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(fn12)
		end
	elseif conns.thrownKnifeEspRender then
		conns.thrownKnifeEspRender:Disconnect()
		conns.thrownKnifeEspRender = nil
	end
end

Tabs.esp:Divider()

Tabs.esp:Toggle({
	Title = "loc:seethrownknife",
	Value = values.thrownKnifeEsp,
	Flag = "thrownKnifeEsp",
	Callback = function(thrownKnifeEsp)
		values.thrownKnifeEsp = thrownKnifeEsp
		syncThrownKnifeEspLoop()

		if thrownKnifeEsp then
			scanThrownKnivesForEsp()
		else
			clearAllThrownKnifeEsp()

			for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant.Name == "ThrowingKnife" then
					local thrownKnifeEspHighlight = descendant:FindFirstChild("ThrownKnifeEspHighlight") or descendant:FindFirstChild("Highlight")

					if thrownKnifeEspHighlight then
						thrownKnifeEspHighlight:Destroy()
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end,
})

Tabs.esp:Colorpicker({
	Title = "loc:espthrownknifecolor",
	Default = valuecolors.espThrownKnifeColor,
	Flag = "espThrownKnifeColor",
	Callback = function(espThrownKnifeColor)
		if typeof(espThrownKnifeColor) == "Color3" then
			valuecolors.espThrownKnifeColor = espThrownKnifeColor

			for _, v_2 in pairs(thrownKnifeEspPool) do
				if v_2.highlight then
					v_2.highlight.FillColor = espThrownKnifeColor
					v_2.highlight.OutlineColor = espThrownKnifeColor
				end

				if v_2.box then
					v_2.box.Color = espThrownKnifeColor
				end
			end
		end
	end,
})

UpdateSessionData = function(arg)
	if arg and type(arg) == "table" then
		local v_2 = arg[1] or arg

		for k, v_3 in pairs(v_2) do
			sessionData[k] = v_3
		end

		for k, v_3 in pairs(v_2) do
			if type(v_3) == "table" then
				espLog("session", k, v_3.Role or "?", (v_3.Dead or v_3.Killed) and "dead" or "alive")
			end
		end
	end

	if syncCombatAimLoop then
		syncCombatAimLoop()
	end

	if syncKnifeAimLoop then
		syncKnifeAimLoop()
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		syncPlayerInstanceEsp(player)

		if syncPlayerNameEsp then
			syncPlayerNameEsp(player)
		end
	end
end

nameEspClearRecord = function(arg, arg2)
	if arg2.nameBillboard then
		pcall(function()
			arg2.nameBillboard:Destroy()
		end)

		arg2.nameBillboard = nil
		arg2.nameTagFrame = nil
		arg2.nameTagStroke = nil
		arg2.nameListLayout = nil
		arg2.nameLabel = nil
		arg2.distanceLabel = nil
		arg2.avatarImage = nil
		arg2.avatarStroke = nil
	end

	if arg2.quickBillboard then
		pcall(function()
			arg2.quickBillboard:Destroy()
		end)

		arg2.quickBillboard = nil
		arg2.plusStroke = nil
		arg2.menuStroke = nil
	end

	local v_2 = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Esp_player_QuickAction_" .. tostring(arg.UserId))

	if v_2 then
		v_2:Destroy()
	end
end

				arg2.nameBillboard:Destroy()
			end)

			arg2.nameTagFrame = nil
			arg2.nameTagStroke = nil
			arg2.nameListLayout = nil
			arg2.nameLabel = nil
			arg2.distanceLabel = nil
			arg2.avatarImage = nil
			arg2.avatarStroke = nil
		else
			arg2.nameBillboard.Adornee = adornee
		end

		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35

getPlayerNameEspVisualState = function(arg)
	local v_2 = sessionData[arg.Name]

	if sessionData[arg.Name] == nil or not v_2 then
		if values.NameEspDead then
			return true, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
		end
		return false, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
	end

	if v_2.Killed or v_2.Dead then
		if values.NameEspDead then
			return true, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
		end
		return false, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
	end

	if v_2.Role == "Murderer" then
		if values.NameEspMurderer then
			return true, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		end
		return false, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
	end

	if v_2.Role == "Sheriff" then
		if values.NameEspSheriff then
			return true, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
		end
		return false, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
	end

	if v_2.Role == "Hero" then
		if values.NameEspHero then
			return true, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
		end

		if values.NameEspSheriff then
			return true, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
		end
		return false, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
	end

	if v_2.Role == "Innocent" then
		if values.NameEspInnocent then
			return true, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
		end
		return false, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
	end

	return false, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
end

syncPlayerNameEsp = function(arg)
	if arg == localPlayer then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = nameEspRecords[arg]
	if not v_2 or not v_2.alive then
		return
	end

	if not (values.NameEspInnocent or values.NameEspSheriff or values.NameEspMurderer or values.NameEspHero or values.NameEspDead) then
		if v_2.nameBillboard then
			v_2.nameBillboard.Enabled = false
		end

		if v_2.quickBillboard then
			v_2.quickBillboard.Enabled = false
		end

		return
	end

	local espPlayerNameMode = hubDropdownModes("espPlayerNameMode")
	local flag = table.find(espPlayerNameMode, "QuickAction") ~= nil
	local flag2 = table.find(espPlayerNameMode, "Avatar") ~= nil
	local flag3 = table.find(espPlayerNameMode, "Distance") ~= nil
	local v_3, v_4 = getPlayerNameEspVisualState(arg)

	if not v_3 then
		if v_2.nameBillboard then
			v_2.nameBillboard.Enabled = false
		end

		if v_2.quickBillboard then
			v_2.quickBillboard.Enabled = false
		end

		return
	end

	local character = arg.Character
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")

	if not head then
		if v_2.nameBillboard then
			v_2.nameBillboard.Enabled = false
		end

		if v_2.quickBillboard then
			v_2.quickBillboard.Enabled = false
		end

		return
	end

	nameEspEnsureBillboard(arg, v_2, head, v_4, flag2, flag3)
	local upperTorso = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not flag or not upperTorso then
		if v_2.quickBillboard then
			pcall(function()
				v_2.quickBillboard:Destroy()
			end)

			local v_5 = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Esp_player_QuickAction_" .. tostring(arg.UserId))

			if v_5 then
				v_5:Destroy()
			end

			v_2.quickBillboard = nil
			v_2.plusStroke = nil
			v_2.menuStroke = nil
		end
	elseif not v_2.quickBillboard or not v_2.quickBillboard.Parent then
		local v_5, v_6, v_7 = nameEspBuildQuickAction(arg, upperTorso, v_4)
		v_2.quickBillboard = v_5
		v_2.plusStroke = v_6
		v_2.menuStroke = v_7
	else
		v_2.quickBillboard.Adornee = upperTorso
		v_2.quickBillboard.Enabled = true

		if v_2.plusStroke then
			v_2.plusStroke.Color = v_4
		end

		if v_2.menuStroke then
			v_2.menuStroke.Color = v_4
		end
	end
end

updateNameEspDistances = function()
	if not hubDropdownHas("espPlayerNameMode", "Distance") then
		return
	end
	local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoidRootPart then
		return
	end

	for k, v_2 in pairs(nameEspRecords) do
		if not (not v_2.alive or not v_2.nameBillboard or not v_2.nameBillboard.Enabled) then
			if v_2.distanceLabel then
				local humanoidRootPart2 = k.Character and k.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if humanoidRootPart2 then
					v_2.distanceLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor((humanoidRootPart.Position - humanoidRootPart2.Position).Magnitude)) .. "m"
					v_2.distanceLabel.Visible = true
				else
					v_2.distanceLabel.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

bindNameEspPlayer = function(arg)
	if arg == localPlayer then
		return
	end

	if not nameEspRecords[arg] then
		nameEspRecords[arg] = { alive = true }
	else
		nameEspRecords[arg].alive = true
	end

	local v_2 = nameEspCharConns[arg]

	if v_2 then
		v_2:Disconnect()
	end

	nameEspCharConns[arg] = arg.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(0.35)
		local v_3 = nameEspRecords[arg]

		if v_3 and v_3.alive then
			nameEspClearRecord(arg, v_3)
			syncPlayerNameEsp(arg)
		end
	end)

	syncPlayerNameEsp(arg)
end

nameEspUnregister = function(arg)
	local v_2 = nameEspRecords[arg]
	if not v_2 then
		return
	end
	v_2.alive = false
	local v_3 = nameEspCharConns[arg]

	if v_3 then
		v_3:Disconnect()
		nameEspCharConns[arg] = nil
	end

	nameEspClearRecord(arg, v_2)
	nameEspRecords[arg] = nil
end

onNameEspSettingsChanged = function()
	local nameEspInnocent = values.NameEspInnocent or values.NameEspSheriff or values.NameEspMurderer or values.NameEspHero or values.NameEspDead
	local espPlayerNameMode = hubDropdownHas("espPlayerNameMode", "Distance")

	if nameEspInnocent then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player ~= localPlayer then
				local v_2 = nameEspRecords[player]

				if v_2 then
					nameEspClearRecord(player, v_2)
				end

				bindNameEspPlayer(player)
			end
		end
	else
		for k, v_2 in pairs(nameEspCharConns) do
			v_2:Disconnect()
			nameEspCharConns[k] = nil
		end

		for k, v_2 in pairs(nameEspRecords) do
			nameEspClearRecord(k, v_2)
			nameEspRecords[k] = nil
		end
	end

	if nameEspInnocent and espPlayerNameMode then
		if not conns.nameEspHeartbeat then
			conns.nameEspHeartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				local nameEspInnocent2 = values.NameEspInnocent or values.NameEspSheriff or values.NameEspMurderer or values.NameEspHero or values.NameEspDead
				local espPlayerNameMode2 = hubDropdownHas("espPlayerNameMode", "Distance")
				if not nameEspInnocent2 or not espPlayerNameMode2 then
					onNameEspSettingsChanged()
					return
				end
				local now = os.clock()
				if now - nameEspDistanceLastTick < 0.033333333333333333 then
					return
				end
				nameEspDistanceLastTick = now
				updateNameEspDistances()
			end)
		end
	elseif conns.nameEspHeartbeat then
		conns.nameEspHeartbeat:Disconnect()
		conns.nameEspHeartbeat = nil
	end
end

espObjects = {}
tracerDrawings = {}
espCharConns = {}
espDebugSnap = {}
wasDrawingEspActive = false
lastDrawingUpdate = 0
timeupd = 1 / (valueslider.espRefreshRate or 60)

getPlayerEspVisualState = function(arg)
	local v_2 = sessionData[arg.Name]

	if not v_2 then
		if values.HighlightDead then
			return true, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
		end
		return false, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
	end

	if v_2.Killed == true or v_2.Dead == true then
		if values.HighlightDead then
			return true, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
		end
		return false, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
	end

	if v_2.Role == "Murderer" and values.HighlightMurderer then
		return true, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	end

	if v_2.Role == "Sheriff" and values.HighlightSheriff then
		return true, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
	end

	if v_2.Role == "Hero" and values.HighlightHero then
		return true, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
	end

	if v_2.Role == "Hero" and not values.HighlightHero then
		return true, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
	end

	if v_2.Role == "Innocent" and values.HighlightInnocent then
		return true, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
	end
	return false, Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
end

RemoveAllVisuals = function(arg)
	espLog("clear", arg.Name)
	espDebugSnap[arg.UserId] = nil

	if espObjects[arg] then
		pcall(function()
			espObjects[arg].box:Remove()
		end)

		espObjects[arg] = nil
	end

	if tracerDrawings[arg] then
		pcall(function()
			tracerDrawings[arg]:Remove()
		end)

		tracerDrawings[arg] = nil
	end

	local character = arg.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local highlight = character:FindFirstChild("Highlight")

	if highlight then
		highlight:Destroy()
	end

	for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("Highlight") and descendant.Name == "EspHighlight" then
			descendant:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for _, child in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		local espAdornment = child:FindFirstChild("espAdornment")

		if espAdornment then
			espAdornment:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

syncPlayerInstanceEsp = function(arg)
	if arg == localPlayer then
		return
	end
	local highlightInnocent = values.HighlightInnocent or values.HighlightMurderer or values.HighlightSheriff or values.HighlightHero or values.HighlightDead
	local espModes = hubDropdownHas("espModes", "Highlight")
	local espModes2 = hubDropdownHas("espModes", "Chams")
	local character = arg.Character

	local function fn13()
		if not character then
			return
		end
		local highlight = character:FindFirstChild("Highlight")

		if highlight then
			highlight:Destroy()
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("Highlight") and descendant.Name == "EspHighlight" then
				descendant:Destroy()
			end
		end

		for _, child in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			local espAdornment = child:FindFirstChild("espAdornment")

			if espAdornment then
				espAdornment:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	local flag = not highlightInnocent
	local flag2

	if flag then
		flag2 = flag
	else
		flag2 = not (espModes or espModes2)
	end

	if flag2 or not character then
		fn13()
		local str = not highlightInnocent and "toggles_off"

		if not str then
			str = not (espModes or espModes2) and "no_instance_mode"
		end

		str = str or "no_character"
		local str2 = str .. "|off"

		if espDebugSnap[arg.UserId] ~= str2 then
			espDebugSnap[arg.UserId] = str2
			espLog("instance", arg.Name, str, "show=false")
		end

		return
	end

	local highlight = character:FindFirstChild("Highlight")

	if highlight then
		highlight:Destroy()
	end

	local v_2, v_3 = getPlayerEspVisualState(arg)

	if espModes then
		if v_2 then
			for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("Highlight") and descendant.Name == "EspHighlight" and descendant.Parent ~= character then
					descendant:Destroy()
				end
			end

			local espHighlight = character:FindFirstChild("EspHighlight")

			if not espHighlight or not espHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
				if espHighlight then
					espHighlight:Destroy()
				end

				espHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
				espHighlight.Name = "EspHighlight"
				espHighlight.Parent = character
			end

			espHighlight.Adornee = character
			espHighlight.Enabled = true
			espHighlight.FillColor = v_3
			espHighlight.OutlineColor = valuecolors.espHighlightOutline
			espHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
			espHighlight.FillTransparency = valueslider.TRANS * 0.1
			espHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		else
			local espHighlight = character:FindFirstChild("EspHighlight")

			if espHighlight and espHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
				espHighlight:Destroy()
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("Highlight") and descendant.Name == "EspHighlight" then
					descendant:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	else
		local espHighlight = character:FindFirstChild("EspHighlight")

		if espHighlight and espHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
			espHighlight:Destroy()
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("Highlight") and descendant.Name == "EspHighlight" then
				descendant:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	if espModes2 then
		if v_2 then
			for _, child in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
					local espAdornment = child:FindFirstChild("espAdornment")

					if not espAdornment then
						espAdornment = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment", child)
						espAdornment.Name = "espAdornment"
						espAdornment.AlwaysOnTop = true
						espAdornment.ZIndex = 5
					end

					espAdornment.Adornee = child
					espAdornment.Size = child.Size
					espAdornment.Color3 = v_3
					espAdornment.Transparency = valueslider.ChamTransparency * 0.1
				end
			end
		else
			for _, child in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				local espAdornment = child:FindFirstChild("espAdornment")

				if espAdornment then
					espAdornment:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	else
		for _, child in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			local espAdornment = child:FindFirstChild("espAdornment")

			if espAdornment then
				espAdornment:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	local str = sessionData[arg.Name]
	local role = str and (str.Role or "?") or "no_session"

	if str then
		str = (str.Dead or str.Killed) and "dead" or "alive"
	end

	str = str or "lobby"
	local str2 = string.format("%s|%s|%s|hl=%s|ch=%s|show=%s", role, str, tostring(v_3), espModes and "1" or "0", espModes2 and "1" or "0", v_2 and "1" or "0")

	if espDebugSnap[arg.UserId] ~= str2 then
		espDebugSnap[arg.UserId] = str2
		espLog("instance", arg.Name, role, str, v_2 and "show" or "hide", espModes and "highlight" or "", espModes2 and "chams" or "")
	end
end

UpdateDrawingESP = function()
	local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not currentCamera then
		return
	end
	local espModes = hubDropdownHas("espModes", "Boxes")
	local espModes2 = hubDropdownHas("espModes", "Tracers")
	if not espModes and not espModes2 then
		return
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= localPlayer then
			local character = player.Character

			if not character then
				if espObjects[player] then
					pcall(function()
						espObjects[player].box:Remove()
					end)

					espObjects[player] = nil
				end

				if tracerDrawings[player] then
					pcall(function()
						tracerDrawings[player]:Remove()
					end)

					tracerDrawings[player] = nil
				end
			else
				local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if humanoidRootPart then
					local v_2, v_3 = getPlayerEspVisualState(player)

					if espModes and v_2 then
						local v_4, v_5 = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(humanoidRootPart.Position)

						if v_5 then
							if not espObjects[player] then
								local square = Drawing.new("Square")
								square.Thickness = 2
								square.Filled = false
								espObjects[player] = { box = square }
							end

							local box = espObjects[player].box
							local n = 1000 * valueslider.BoxScale * 0.1 / v_4.Z
							local n2 = 1500 * valueslider.BoxScale * 0.1 / v_4.Z
							box.Size = Vector2.new(n, n2)
							box.Position = Vector2.new(v_4.X - n / 2, v_4.Y - n2 / 2)
							box.Color = v_3
							box.Visible = true
						elseif espObjects[player] then
							espObjects[player].box.Visible = false
						end
					elseif espObjects[player] then
						espObjects[player].box.Visible = false
					end

					if espModes2 and v_2 then
						local n = currentCamera.ViewportSize.X / 2
						local y = currentCamera.ViewportSize.Y
						local v_4, v_5 = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(humanoidRootPart.Position)

						if v_5 then
							local line = tracerDrawings[player]

							if not line then
								line = Drawing.new("Line")
								tracerDrawings[player] = line
								line.Thickness = 1
							end

							line.From = Vector2.new(n, y)
							line.To = Vector2.new(v_4.X, v_4.Y)
							line.Color = v_3
							line.Visible = true
						elseif tracerDrawings[player] then
							tracerDrawings[player].Visible = false
						end
					elseif tracerDrawings[player] then
						tracerDrawings[player].Visible = false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

onEspSettingsChanged = function()
	local highlightInnocent = values.HighlightInnocent or values.HighlightMurderer or values.HighlightSheriff or values.HighlightHero or values.HighlightDead
	local espModes = hubDropdownHas("espModes", "Highlight")
	local espModes2 = hubDropdownHas("espModes", "Chams")
	local espModes3 = hubDropdownHas("espModes", "Boxes")
	local espModes4 = hubDropdownHas("espModes", "Tracers")
	local v_2 = espModes or espModes2
	local v_3 = espModes3 or espModes4
	local str = table.concat(hubDropdownModes("espModes"), ",")
	espLog("settings", "roleEsp=" .. tostring(highlightInnocent) .. " modes=" .. str .. " instance=" .. tostring(v_2) .. " drawing=" .. tostring(v_3))

	if highlightInnocent and (espModes or espModes2) then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player ~= localPlayer then
				local v_4 = espCharConns[player]

				if v_4 then
					v_4:Disconnect()
				end

				espCharConns[player] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
					task.defer(function()
						espLog("character", player.Name, "respawn")
						syncPlayerInstanceEsp(player)
					end)
				end)

				syncPlayerInstanceEsp(player)
			end
		end
	else
		for k, v_4 in pairs(espCharConns) do
			v_4:Disconnect()
			espCharConns[k] = nil
		end

		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			syncPlayerInstanceEsp(player)
		end
	end

	if highlightInnocent and (espModes3 or espModes4) then
		if not conns.espDrawingHeartbeat then
			wasDrawingEspActive = true

			conns.espDrawingHeartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				local espModes5 = hubDropdownHas("espModes", "Boxes")
				local espModes6 = hubDropdownHas("espModes", "Tracers")
				local flag = not (values.HighlightInnocent or values.HighlightMurderer or values.HighlightSheriff or values.HighlightHero or values.HighlightDead)

				if not flag then
					flag = not (espModes5 or espModes6)
				end

				if flag then
					onEspSettingsChanged()
					return
				end
				local now = os.clock()

				if timeupd <= now - lastDrawingUpdate then
					lastDrawingUpdate = now
					UpdateDrawingESP()
				end
			end)

			espLog("drawing loop", "started", "rate=" .. tostring(valueslider.espRefreshRate or 60))
		end
	else
		if conns.espDrawingHeartbeat then
			conns.espDrawingHeartbeat:Disconnect()
			conns.espDrawingHeartbeat = nil
		end

		if wasDrawingEspActive then
			wasDrawingEspActive = false
			espLog("drawing loop", "stopped")

			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if espObjects[player] then
					pcall(function()
						espObjects[player].box:Remove()
					end)

					espObjects[player] = nil
				end

				if tracerDrawings[player] then
					pcall(function()
						tracerDrawings[player]:Remove()
					end)

					tracerDrawings[player] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	onEspSettingsChanged()
	onNameEspSettingsChanged()

sectionLoaded("esp")
HUB_CACHE_DIR = "SNPWARE/hub_cache"
HUB_CACHE_MANIFEST = HUB_CACHE_DIR .. "/manifest.json"

ensureHubCacheDir = function()
	if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	pcall(makefolder, "SNPWARE")
	pcall(makefolder, HUB_CACHE_DIR)
end

readHubCacheManifest = function()
	if type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(HUB_CACHE_MANIFEST) then
		return {}
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(HUB_CACHE_MANIFEST))
	end)

	if ok and type(result) == "table" then
		return result
	end
	return {}
end

saveHubCacheManifest = function(arg)
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	ensureHubCacheDir()

	pcall(function()
		writefile(HUB_CACHE_MANIFEST, HttpService:JSONEncode(arg))
	end)
end

hubCacheRemoteSizes = nil

fetchHubCacheRemoteSizes = function()
	if hubLoadUsesGithubOnly() then
		fn("cache_sizes_skip", "github path — manifest API is VPS-only")
		return nil
	end

	if hubCacheRemoteSizes then
		return hubCacheRemoteSizes
	end
	local cacheSizes, v_2 = downloadHub("api/cache_sizes", "cache_sizes")
	if not cacheSizes or type(v_2) ~= "string" or v_2 == "" then
		return nil
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(v_2)
	end)

	if ok and type(result) == "table" then
		hubCacheRemoteSizes = result
		return hubCacheRemoteSizes
	end
	return nil
end

readHubCacheFile = function(arg, arg2)
	if type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(arg) then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(readfile, arg)
	if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" or result == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local flag

	if arg2 then
		flag = (type(result) == "string" and #result or 0) ~= arg2
	else
		flag = arg2
	end

	if flag then
		return nil
	end
	return result
end

runHubCacheScript = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	local v_2 = arg3 or arg2
	local flag = type(readfile) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function"

	local function fn13(defaultCacheJson)
		if type(defaultCacheJson) ~= "string" or defaultCacheJson == "" then
			return false, "empty cache body"
		end
		local n = #defaultCacheJson
		local windUIDebug = getgenv().WindUIDebug

		if windUIDebug and windUIDebug.Log then
			windUIDebug.Log("cache", "compile begin", { key = arg2, bytes = n })

			if windUIDebug.Flush then
				windUIDebug.Flush()
			end
		end

		if type(task) == "table" and type(task.wait) == "function" then
			task.wait()
		end

		local match = defaultCacheJson:match("^%s*(.)")

		if match == "{" or match == "[" then
			if arg2 == "skin_cache" then
				DEFAULT_CACHE_JSON = defaultCacheJson
				_G.DEFAULT_CACHE_JSON = defaultCacheJson
				fn("hub_cache_json", arg2, n)
				return true
			end

			if arg2 == "handle_cache" then
				DEFAULT_HANDLE_CACHE_JSON = defaultCacheJson
				_G.DEFAULT_HANDLE_CACHE_JSON = defaultCacheJson
				fn("hub_cache_json", arg2, n)
				return true
			end
		end

		local chunk, v_3 = loadstring(defaultCacheJson)
		if not chunk then
			return false, v_3
		end

		if type(task) == "table" and type(task.wait) == "function" then
			task.wait()
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(chunk)

		if type(task) == "table" and type(task.wait) == "function" then
			task.wait()
		end

		local windUIDebug2 = getgenv().WindUIDebug

		if windUIDebug2 and windUIDebug2.Log then
			windUIDebug2.Log("cache", "compile done", { key = arg2, bytes = n, ok = ok })

			if windUIDebug2.Flush then
				windUIDebug2.Flush()
			end
		end

		if not ok then
			return false, result
		end
		return true, result
	end

	if hubLoadUsesGithubOnly() then
		fn("hub_cache_github", arg2, "always fetch")
		local v_3, v_4 = downloadHub(arg, v_2)

		if not v_3 then
			if flag then
				ensureHubCacheDir()
				local v_5 = readHubCacheFile(HUB_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. arg2 .. ".lua", nil)
				if v_5 then
					fn("hub_cache_offline", arg2, #v_5)
					return fn13(v_5)
				end
			end

			if not flag then
				return runHubScript(arg, v_2)
			end
			return false, v_4
		end

		if flag then
			ensureHubCacheDir()
			local v_5 = readHubCacheManifest()
			writefile(HUB_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. arg2 .. ".lua", v_4)
			v_5[arg2] = type(v_4) == "string" and #v_4 or 0
			saveHubCacheManifest(v_5)
			fn("hub_cache_saved", arg2, v_5[arg2])
		end

		return fn13(v_4)
	end

	if not flag then
		return runHubScript(arg, v_2)
	end
	ensureHubCacheDir()
	local v_3 = readHubCacheManifest()
	local str2 = HUB_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. arg2 .. ".lua"
	local v_4 = v_3[arg2]
	local num = fetchHubCacheRemoteSizes()
	num = num and tonumber(num[arg2])
	local flag2 = num and v_4 == num
	local v_5 = nil

	if flag2 then
		v_5 = readHubCacheFile(str2, num)
	end

	if not v_5 then
		local v_6, v_7 = downloadHub(arg, v_2)

		if v_6 then
			local n = type(v_7) == "string" and #v_7 or 0

			if v_4 == n then
				local v_8 = readHubCacheFile(str2, n) or v_7

				if not isfile(str2) then
					writefile(str2, v_8)
					v_5 = v_8
				else
					v_5 = v_8
				end
			else
				writefile(str2, v_7)
				v_3[arg2] = n
				saveHubCacheManifest(v_3)
				itemspawnerLog(string.format("[hub_cache] updated %s (%d bytes)", arg2, n))
				v_5 = v_7
			end
		else
			local v_8 = readHubCacheFile(str2, v_4)
			if not v_8 then
				return runHubScript(arg, v_2)
			end
			itemspawnerLog(string.format("[hub_cache] offline fallback %s", arg2))
			v_5 = v_8
		end
	end

	if type(v_5) ~= "string" or v_5 == "" then
		return false, "empty cache body"
	end
	return fn13(v_5)
end

		end
	end

							n2 += 1
							table.insert(tbl15, child)
							tbl16[child] = (n2 - 1) % #TREE_CHROMA_LIGHT_COLORS + 1
						end
					end
				end

				for _, child in ipairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
					if child.Name == "Lights" and child:IsA("BasePart") then
						n2 += 1
						table.insert(tbl15, child)
						tbl16[child] = (n2 - 1) % #TREE_CHROMA_LIGHT_COLORS + 1
					end
				end

				for _, v_2 in ipairs(tbl15) do
					if v_2.Parent then
						v_2.Color = TREE_CHROMA_LIGHT_COLORS[tbl16[v_2] or 1]
					end
				end

				task.spawn(function()
					while arg.Parent and chromaTweenTokens[arg2] == n do
						for _, v_2 in ipairs(TREE_CHROMA_HOST_COLORS) do
							if not arg.Parent or chromaTweenTokens[arg2] ~= n then
								return
							end
							local tween = TweenService:Create(arg, CHROMA_TWEEN_INFO, { Color = v_2 })
							tween:Play()
							local n3 = os.clock() + 1.05

							while os.clock() < n3 do
								if not arg.Parent or chromaTweenTokens[arg2] ~= n then
									tween:Cancel()
									return
								end
								task.wait()
							end

							for _, v_3 in ipairs(tbl15) do
								if v_3.Parent then
									local n4 = (tbl16[v_3] or 1) + 1

									if #TREE_CHROMA_LIGHT_COLORS < n4 then
										n4 = 1
									end

									tbl16[v_3] = n4
									v_3.Color = TREE_CHROMA_LIGHT_COLORS[n4]
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end)

				return n2
			end

			encodeLogData = function(arg)
				if arg == nil then
					return ""
				end

				if type(arg) ~= "table" then
					return tostring(arg)
				end
				local tbl15 = {}

				for k, v_2 in pairs(arg) do
					local str2

					if typeof(v_2) == "Vector3" then
						str2 = string.format("V3(%.4f,%.4f,%.4f)", v_2.X, v_2.Y, v_2.Z)
					elseif typeof(v_2) == "Color3" then
						local floor = math.floor
						local n = v_2.B * 255
						str2 = string.format("RGB(%d,%d,%d)", math.floor(v_2.R * 255), math.floor(v_2.G * 255), floor(n))
					elseif type(v_2) == "table" then
						str2 = encodeLogData(v_2)
					else
						str2 = tostring(v_2)
					end

					table.insert(tbl15, tostring(k) .. "=" .. str2)
				end

				table.sort(tbl15)
				return "{" .. table.concat(tbl15, ", ") .. "}"
			end

			flushDebugLog = function()
				flushSkinLog()
			end

			dbg = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
				local v_2 = tostring
				local str2 = string.format("[%s][%s][%s] %s", os.date("%X"), tostring(arg), tostring(arg2), v_2(arg3))

				if arg4 ~= nil then
					str2 ..= " | " .. encodeLogData(arg4)
				end

				if not writefile then
					return
				end
				table.insert(skinLogLines, str2)

				if not flag then
					flag = true

					task.defer(function()
						flag = false
						flushDebugLog()
					end)
				end
			end

			CapturedSkins = {}

			arrToVec3 = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
				if typeof(arg) == "Vector3" then
					return arg
				end

				if type(arg) ~= "table" then
					local vector = Vector3.new
					arg2 = arg2 or 1
					arg3 = arg3 or 1
					return vector(arg2, arg3, arg4 or 1)
				end

				return Vector3.new(arg[1] or arg2 or 1, arg[2] or arg3 or 1, arg[3] or arg4 or 1)
			end

			arrToCFrame = function(arg)
				if typeof(arg) == "CFrame" then
					return arg
				end

				if type(arg) ~= "table" or #arg < 12 then
					return nil
				end
				return CFrame.new(arg[1], arg[2], arg[3], arg[4], arg[5], arg[6], arg[7], arg[8], arg[9], arg[10], arg[11], arg[12])
			end

			reviveEntry = function(arg)
				if arg.Scale then
					arg.Scale = arrToVec3(arg.Scale, 1, 1, 1)
				end

				if arg.Offset then
					arg.Offset = arrToVec3(arg.Offset, 0, 0, 0)
				end

				if arg.VertexColor then
					arg.VertexColor = arrToVec3(arg.VertexColor, 1, 1, 1)
				end

				if arg.HandScale then
					arg.HandScale = arrToVec3(arg.HandScale, 1, 1, 1)
				end

				if arg.HandSize then
					arg.HandSize = arrToVec3(arg.HandSize, 1, 3, 1)
				end

				if arg.HandOffset then
					arg.HandOffset = arrToVec3(arg.HandOffset, 0, 0, 0)
				end

				if arg.HandVertexColor then
					arg.HandVertexColor = arrToVec3(arg.HandVertexColor, 1, 1, 1)
				end

				if arg.GripCF then
					arg.GripCF = arrToCFrame(arg.GripCF)
				end

				if arg.DisplayScale then
					arg.DisplayScale = arrToVec3(arg.DisplayScale, 1, 1, 1)
				end

				if arg.DisplayMeshPartSize then
					arg.DisplayMeshPartSize = arrToVec3(arg.DisplayMeshPartSize, 1, 1, 1)
				end

				if arg.PartSize then
					arg.PartSize = arrToVec3(arg.PartSize, 1, 1, 1)
				end

				if type(arg.MeshId) == "string" then
					arg.MeshId = arg.MeshId:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
				end

				if type(arg.TextureId) == "string" then
					arg.TextureId = arg.TextureId:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
				end

				if arg.Chroma ~= true then
					if tostring(arg.DataID or arg.Name or ""):find("Chroma", 1, true) then
						arg.Chroma = true
					end
				end

				if arg.DataID and database[arg.DataID] then
					local v_2 = database[arg.DataID]

					if v_2.ItemName then
						arg.Name = v_2.ItemName
					end

					if v_2.Rarity and (not arg.Rarity or arg.Rarity == "") then
						arg.Rarity = v_2.Rarity
					end

					if not arg.ItemID and v_2.ItemID then
						arg.ItemID = v_2.ItemID
					end
				end

				if arg.Type == "Knife" then
					arg.IsCustomMesh = arg.MeshId and arg.MeshId ~= "" and not arg.MeshId:find("121944778")
				else
					arg.IsCustomMesh = arg.MeshId and arg.MeshId ~= "" and not arg.MeshId:find("79401392")
				end

				return arg
			end

			SNAPSHOT_VERSION = 5

			canReplayDisplay = function(arg)
				if type(arg) ~= "table" then
					return false, "invalid"
				end
				local meshId = arg.MeshId or arg.HandMesh
				if not meshId or meshId == "" then
					return false, "no_mesh"
				end

				if (arg.DisplayKind or arg.Kind) == "MeshPart" then
					if arg.DisplayMeshPartSize then
						return true, (arg.SnapshotVersion or 0) >= SNAPSHOT_VERSION and "v2_mp" or "legacy_mp"
					end
					return false, "missing_mp_size"
				end

				if (arg.SnapshotVersion or 0) >= SNAPSHOT_VERSION then
					if arg.DisplayScale then
						return true, "v2_sm"
					end
					return false, "missing_display_scale"
				end

				if arg.DisplayScale then
					return true, "legacy_sm"
				end

				if arg.Scale and arg.Kind ~= "MeshPart" then
					return true, "legacy_scale"
				end
				return false, "legacy_incomplete"
			end

			DISABLED_SKIN_KEYS = { SlouseClown = true, SlouseClownGun = true }

			if type(WeaponsSpawnerDB) == "table" then
				for k, v_2 in pairs(WeaponsSpawnerDB) do
					if fn13(k, v_2) then
						DISABLED_SKIN_KEYS[k] = true
					end
				end
			end

			migrateCacheEntry = function(arg)
				if type(arg) ~= "table" then
					return
				end

				if not arg.DisplayKind and arg.Kind then
					arg.DisplayKind = arg.Kind
				end

				local displayKind = arg.DisplayKind or arg.Kind

				if displayKind == "MeshPart" and arg.Scale and not arg.DisplayMeshPartSize then
					arg.DisplayMeshPartSize = arg.Scale
				end

				if displayKind ~= "MeshPart" and arg.Scale and not arg.DisplayScale then
					arg.DisplayScale = arg.Scale
				end

				if displayKind == "MeshPart" and arg.DisplayMeshPartSize and arg.MeshNaturalSize and not arg.DisplayScale then
					local meshNaturalSize = arg.MeshNaturalSize
					local displayMeshPartSize = arg.DisplayMeshPartSize

					if type(meshNaturalSize) == "table" and type(displayMeshPartSize) == "table" then
						local y = meshNaturalSize[2] or meshNaturalSize.Y or 0
						local y2 = displayMeshPartSize[2] or displayMeshPartSize.Y or 0

						if y > 0.001 then
							local n = y2 / y

							if n > 0.0005 and n < 6 then
								arg.DisplayScale = { n, n, n }
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			migrateCache = function()
				local n = 0

				for _, v_2 in pairs(CapturedSkins) do
					migrateCacheEntry(v_2)

					if not canReplayDisplay(v_2) then
						n += 1
					end
				end

				if n > 20 then
					dbg("WARN", "cache", "нужен re-harvest v6 (skin_harvester.lua) для FX/Chroma фиксов", { incomplete = n })
				end
			end

			isUsableEntry = function(arg)
				if type(arg) ~= "table" then
					return false
				end

				if canReplayDisplay(arg) then
					return true
				end
				local flag2 = type(arg.MeshId) == "string" and arg.MeshId ~= "" or type(arg.HandMesh) == "string" and arg.HandMesh ~= ""
				local flag3 = type(arg.TextureId) == "string" and arg.TextureId ~= "" or type(arg.HandTexture) == "string" and arg.HandTexture ~= ""
				return flag2 or flag3
			end

			isPlayerSkinKey = function(arg, arg2)
				if type(arg) == "string" and (arg:sub(1, 6) == "knife_" or arg:sub(1, 4) == "gun_") then
					return true
				end

				if type(arg2) ~= "table" then
					return false
				end
				local str2 = tostring(arg2.Source or "")

				if str2 ~= "" and not str2:find("harvester:", 1, true) and str2 ~= "default" and str2 ~= "file" and str2 ~= "embedded" then
					if not arg2.DataID and not arg2.ItemID then
						return true
					end
				end

				return false
			end

			purgePlayerSkins = function()
				local capturedSkins = _G.CapturedSkins or CapturedSkins
				if type(capturedSkins) ~= "table" then
					return
				end
				local n = 0

				for k, capturedSkin in pairs(capturedSkins) do
					if isPlayerSkinKey(k, capturedSkin) then
						CapturedSkins[k] = nil
						n += 1
					end
				end

				if n > 0 then
					dbg("INFO", "cache", "removed player scans", { removed = n })
				end

				return n
			end

			ingestTable = function(arg, arg2)
				if type(arg) ~= "table" then
					return 0
				end
				local n = 0

				for k, v_2 in pairs(arg) do
					if not isPlayerSkinKey(k, v_2) then
						if isUsableEntry(v_2) then
							if not CapturedSkins[k] then
								n += 1
							end

							local v_3 = CapturedSkins[k]

							if not v_3 then
								CapturedSkins[k] = reviveEntry(v_2)
							elseif arg2 == "file" then
								local v_4 = reviveEntry(v_2)

								if v_3.Chroma == true then
									v_4.Chroma = true
								end

								if (not v_4.ItemID or v_4.ItemID == "") and v_3.ItemID then
									v_4.ItemID = v_3.ItemID
								end

								if (not v_4.Rarity or v_4.Rarity == "") and v_3.Rarity then
									v_4.Rarity = v_3.Rarity
								end

								if not v_4.DisplayScale and v_3.DisplayScale then
									v_4.DisplayScale = v_3.DisplayScale
								end

								if not v_4.DisplayMeshPartSize and v_3.DisplayMeshPartSize then
									v_4.DisplayMeshPartSize = v_3.DisplayMeshPartSize
								end

								if not v_4.SnapshotVersion and v_3.SnapshotVersion then
									v_4.SnapshotVersion = v_3.SnapshotVersion
								end

								if not v_4.DisplayKind and v_3.DisplayKind then
									v_4.DisplayKind = v_3.DisplayKind
								end

								if not v_4.DisplayRootClass and v_3.DisplayRootClass then
									v_4.DisplayRootClass = v_3.DisplayRootClass
								end

								if not v_4.PartSize and v_3.PartSize then
									v_4.PartSize = v_3.PartSize
								end

								if not v_4.ChromaMask and v_3.ChromaMask then
									v_4.ChromaMask = v_3.ChromaMask
								end

								CapturedSkins[k] = v_4
							end
						end
					end
				end

				return n
			end

			loadCache = function()
				CapturedSkins = {}
				local defaultCacheJson = nil
				local flag2 = not defaultCacheJson or defaultCacheJson == ""
				local str2 = "none"

				if flag2 then
					defaultCacheJson = _G.DEFAULT_CACHE_JSON

					if (not defaultCacheJson or defaultCacheJson == "") and type(DEFAULT_CACHE_JSON) == "string" then
						defaultCacheJson = DEFAULT_CACHE_JSON
					end

					if defaultCacheJson and defaultCacheJson ~= "" then
						str2 = "embedded"
					end
				end

				if not defaultCacheJson or defaultCacheJson == "" then
					warn("[skincore] skin cache missing (OtherSCRIPTS/cache / DEFAULT_CACHE_JSON)")
					return
				end

				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return HttpService:JSONDecode(defaultCacheJson)
				end)

				if ok and type(result) == "table" then
					local v_2 = ingestTable(result, str2)
					local n = 0

					for k in pairs(CapturedSkins) do
						n += 1
					end

					_G.CapturedSkins = CapturedSkins
					dbg("INFO", "cache", "loaded skin cache", { source = str2, added = v_2, total = n })
				else
					warn("[skincore] skin cache JSON decode failed:", result)
				end
			end

			normalizeGingerscopeHoldAnimsInCache = function()
				for k, v_2 in pairs(CapturedSkins) do
					if type(v_2) == "table" and type(k) == "string" and (k == "Gingerscope" or k:sub(1, 12) == "Gingerscope_") then
						v_2.CustomHoldAnim = customHoldAnim
					end
				end
			end

			mergeHandleEntry = function(arg, arg2)
				local v_2 = CapturedSkins[arg]
				if type(v_2) ~= "table" or type(arg2) ~= "table" then
					return false
				end

				if arg2.GripCF then
					v_2.GripCF = arg2.GripCF
				end

				if arg2.HandleTree then
					v_2.HandleTree = arg2.HandleTree
				end

				if arg2.CustomHoldAnim then
					local flag2 = arg == "Gingerscope"
					local flag3

					if flag2 then
						flag3 = flag2
					else
						flag3 = type(arg) == "string" and arg:sub(1, 12) == "Gingerscope_"
					end

					if flag3 then
						v_2.CustomHoldAnim = customHoldAnim
					else
						v_2.CustomHoldAnim = arg2.CustomHoldAnim
					end
				end

				if arg2.Type and (not v_2.Type or v_2.Type == "") then
					v_2.Type = arg2.Type
				end

				if arg2.DataID and not v_2.DataID then
					v_2.DataID = arg2.DataID
				end

				if arg2.ToolName then
					v_2.ToolName = arg2.ToolName
				end

				v_2.HasHandData = true
				return true
			end

			loadHandleCache = function()
				local defaultHandleCacheJson = nil
				local flag2 = not defaultHandleCacheJson or defaultHandleCacheJson == ""
				local str2 = "none"

				if flag2 then
					defaultHandleCacheJson = _G.DEFAULT_HANDLE_CACHE_JSON

					if (not defaultHandleCacheJson or defaultHandleCacheJson == "") and type(DEFAULT_HANDLE_CACHE_JSON) == "string" then
						defaultHandleCacheJson = DEFAULT_HANDLE_CACHE_JSON
					end

					if defaultHandleCacheJson and defaultHandleCacheJson ~= "" then
						str2 = "embedded"
					end
				end

				if not defaultHandleCacheJson or defaultHandleCacheJson == "" then
					warn("[skincore] handle cache missing (OtherSCRIPTS/cache_handle / DEFAULT_HANDLE_CACHE_JSON)")
					return
				end

				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return HttpService:JSONDecode(defaultHandleCacheJson)
				end)

				if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
					warn("[skincore] handle cache JSON decode failed:", result)
					return
				end
				local n = 0
				local n2 = 0
				local n3 = 0

				for k, v_2 in pairs(result) do
					n += 1

					if CapturedSkins[k] then
						if mergeHandleEntry(k, v_2) then
							CapturedSkins[k] = reviveEntry(CapturedSkins[k])
							n2 += 1
						end
					else
						n3 += 1
					end
				end

				_G.CapturedSkins = CapturedSkins
				dbg("INFO", "handle_cache", "merged handle cache", { source = str2, merged = n2, missingSkin = n3, total = n })
			end

			vec3ToArr = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
				if typeof(arg) == "Vector3" then
					return { arg.X, arg.Y, arg.Z }
				end

				if type(arg) == "table" then
					return arg
				end
				local tbl15 = {}
				arg2 = arg2 or 1
				arg3 = arg3 or 1
				local n = arg4 or 1
				tbl15[1] = arg2
				tbl15[2] = arg3
				tbl15[3] = n
				return tbl15
			end

			cframeToArr = function(arg)
				if typeof(arg) == "CFrame" then
					return { arg:GetComponents() }
				end

				if type(arg) == "table" then
					return arg
				end
				return nil
			end

			saveCache = function()

								Type = v_2.Type,

								Chroma = v_2.Chroma == true,
								Source = v_2.Source,
								HasHandData = v_2.HasHandData,
								HandMesh = v_2.HandMesh,
								HandTexture = v_2.HandTexture,
								HandScale = v_2.HandScale and vec3ToArr(v_2.HandScale, 1, 1, 1) or nil,
								HandSize = v_2.HandSize and vec3ToArr(v_2.HandSize, 1, 3, 1) or nil,
								HandOffset = v_2.HandOffset and vec3ToArr(v_2.HandOffset, 0, 0, 0) or nil,
								HandVertexColor = v_2.HandVertexColor and vec3ToArr(v_2.HandVertexColor, 1, 1, 1) or nil,
								HandKind = v_2.HandKind,
								GripCF = cframeToArr(v_2.GripCF),
								AttachmentCFrame = cframeToArr(v_2.AttachmentCFrame),
								DisplayScale = v_2.DisplayScale and vec3ToArr(v_2.DisplayScale, 1, 1, 1) or nil,
								DisplayKind = v_2.DisplayKind,
								DisplayRootClass = v_2.DisplayRootClass,
								DisplayMeshPartSize = v_2.DisplayMeshPartSize and vec3ToArr(v_2.DisplayMeshPartSize, 1, 1, 1) or nil,
								MeshLocalCFrame = cframeToArr(v_2.MeshLocalCFrame),
								BackdropSM = v_2.BackdropSM,
								PartSize = v_2.PartSize and vec3ToArr(v_2.PartSize, 1, 1, 1) or nil,
								SnapshotVersion = v_2.SnapshotVersion,
								MeshNaturalSize = v_2.MeshNaturalSize and vec3ToArr(v_2.MeshNaturalSize, 1, 1, 1) or nil,
								SurfaceAppearance = v_2.SurfaceAppearance,
								DisplayAttachment = v_2.DisplayAttachment,
								DisplayAttachmentName = v_2.DisplayAttachmentName,
								RigidConstraint = v_2.RigidConstraint,
								DisplayTransform = v_2.DisplayTransform,
								SpecialMesh = v_2.SpecialMesh,
								HandSurfaceAppearance = v_2.HandSurfaceAppearance,
								DisplayTree = v_2.DisplayTree,
								DisplayTreeVersion = v_2.DisplayTreeVersion,
								HandleTree = v_2.HandleTree,
								HandleTreeVersion = v_2.HandleTreeVersion,
								VhRelativeCF = cframeToArr(v_2.VhRelativeCF) or v_2.VhRelativeCF,
								VhSize = v_2.VhSize and vec3ToArr(v_2.VhSize, 0.46, 0.61, 0.46) or nil,
								HandleSize = v_2.HandleSize and vec3ToArr(v_2.HandleSize, 0.46, 3.2, 0.66) or nil,
								HasLightParts = v_2.HasLightParts == true,
								HasLights = v_2.HasLights == true,
								HasDetailing = v_2.HasDetailing == true,
								FxFolders = v_2.FxFolders,
								FX = v_2.FX == true,
								ChromaMask = v_2.ChromaMask,
								ChromaStaticLayer = v_2.ChromaStaticLayer,
								ChromaTextures = v_2.ChromaTextures,
								Grip = v_2.Grip and vec3ToArr(v_2.Grip, 0, 0, 0) or nil,
								GripFwd = v_2.GripFwd and vec3ToArr(v_2.GripFwd, 0, 0, 1) or nil,
								GripRight = v_2.GripRight and vec3ToArr(v_2.GripRight, 1, 0, 0) or nil,
								GripUp = v_2.GripUp and vec3ToArr(v_2.GripUp, 0, 1, 0) or nil,
							}
						end
					end

					writefile(CACHE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(tbl15))
				end)
			end

			isChromaSkin = function(arg, arg2)
				if type(arg) ~= "table" then
					return false
				end

				if arg.Chroma == true then
					return true
				end

			stopCustomHoldTrack = function()
				local v_2 = customHoldState
				v_2.syncToken = v_2.syncToken + 1

				customHoldState.skinId = nil

			getHumanoidAnimator = function(parent)

			playCustomHoldTrack = function(arg, arg2, skinId, tool, arg3)
				stopCustomHoldTrack()
				if not isGunEquippedOnCharacter(arg3 or tool and tool.Parent, tool) then
					return false, "not equipped"
				end

				if not arg or arg.Health <= 0 then
					return false, "no humanoid"
				end

				if not arg2 or arg2 == "" then
					return false, "no anim"
				end
				local customHold = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("CustomHold")

				if not customHold or not customHold:IsA("Animation") then
					local v_2 = dbg
					skinId = skinId or "?"
					local tbl15 = { error = "no CustomHold on tool", animId = arg2 }
					tool = tool and tool:GetFullName()
					tbl15.tool = tool or nil
					v_2("WARN", "custom_hold", skinId, tbl15)
					return false, "no CustomHold"
				end

				preloadCustomHoldId(arg2)
				local v_2 = getHumanoidAnimator(arg)

				local ok, track = pcall(function()
					return v_2:LoadAnimation(customHold)
				end)

				if not ok or not track then
					ok, track = pcall(function()
						return arg:LoadAnimation(customHold)
					end)
				end

				if not ok or not track then
					dbg("WARN", "custom_hold", skinId or "?", { error = "LoadAnimation failed", animId = arg2, detail = tostring(track) })
					return false, "load failed"
				end
				customHoldState.track = track
				customHoldState.skinId = skinId
				customHoldState.boundTool = tool
				track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
				track.Looped = true
				track:Play(0)
				dbg("INFO", "custom_hold", skinId or "?", { animId = arg2, length = track.Length, playing = track.IsPlaying, tool = tool:GetFullName() })
				return true
			end

			syncCustomHoldForCharacter = function(arg)
				if not arg then
					stopCustomHoldTrack()
					return
				end
				local v_2 = nil

				for _, child in ipairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Tool") and (child:GetAttribute("IsGun") or child.Name == "Gun") then
						v_2 = child
						break
					else
						v_2 = nil
					end
				end

				if not v_2 then
					stopCustomHoldTrack()
					return
				end
				local v_3 = resolveGunSkinForApply()
				if not v_3 then
					stopCustomHoldTrack()
					return
				end

				if DISABLED_SKIN_KEYS[selectedGunKey] and not isGingerscopeFamilySkin(v_3, selectedGunKey) then
					stopCustomHoldTrack()
					return
				end
				local v_4 = resolveCustomHoldAnimId(v_3, selectedGunKey)
				applyCustomHoldToTool(v_2, v_3, selectedGunKey)
				if not v_4 then
					stopCustomHoldTrack()
					return
				end
				local dataID = v_3.DataID or v_3.Name or "Gun"
				if customHoldState.skinId == dataID and customHoldState.track and customHoldState.boundTool == v_2 and customHoldState.track.IsPlaying then
					return
				end
				playCustomHoldTrack(arg:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), v_4, dataID, v_2, arg)
			end

			bindCustomHoldCharacter = function(arg)
				if not arg or arg:GetAttribute("SC_CustomHoldCharHooked") then
					return
				end
				arg:SetAttribute("SC_CustomHoldCharHooked", true)

				arg.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
					if child:IsA("Tool") and (child:GetAttribute("IsGun") or child.Name == "Gun") then
						stopCustomHoldTrack()
					end
				end)
			end

			hookCustomHoldForGun = function(arg)
				if not arg or not arg:IsA("Tool") then
					return
				end

				if not (arg:GetAttribute("IsGun") or arg.Name == "Gun") then
					return
				end

				if arg:GetAttribute("SC_CustomHoldHooked") then
					return
				end
				arg:SetAttribute("SC_CustomHoldHooked", true)

				arg.Equipped:Connect(function()
					local parent = arg.Parent
					if not parent or not parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						return
					end
					syncCustomHoldForCharacter(parent)
				end)

				arg.Unequipped:Connect(function()
					stopCustomHoldTrack()
				end)

				if arg.Parent and arg.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
					syncCustomHoldForCharacter(arg.Parent)
				end
			end

			hookCustomHoldForContainer = function(arg)
				if not arg then
					return
				end

				for _, child in ipairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Tool") then
						hookCustomHoldForGun(child)
					end
				end

				arg.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
					if child:IsA("Tool") then
						hookCustomHoldForGun(child)
					end
				end)
			end

			local function fn19(arg)
				if typeof(arg) == "Color3" then
					return arg
				end

				if type(arg) == "table" and arg.__t == "Color3" then
					local r = arg.R or 0
					local g_ = arg.G or 0
					local b = arg.B or 0

					if r > 1 or g_ > 1 or b > 1 then
						r /= 255
						g_ /= 255
						b /= 255
					end

					return Color3.new(r, g_, b)
				end

				return Color3.new(0.972549, 0.85098, 0.427451)
			end

			applyLightPartsFromTree = function(parent, arg)

				local children = displayTree.Children or {}
				local n = 0

				for _, child in v_2(children) do
					if child.ClassName == "Model" and child.Name == "LightParts" then
						local model = Instance.new("Model")
						model.Name = "LightParts"
						model.Parent = parent
						local v_3, v_4, v_5 = ipairs(child.Children or {})
						local n2 = 0

						for _, v_6 in v_3, v_4, v_5 do
							if v_6.ClassName == "MeshPart" then
								if spawnLightMeshFromTree(parent, v_6, model) then
									n2 += 1
								end
							end
						end

						if n2 == 0 then
							model:Destroy()
						else
							n += n2
						end
					elseif child.ClassName == "MeshPart" and (child.Name == "Lights" or child.Name == "LightPart") then
						if spawnLightMeshFromTree(parent, child, parent) then
							n += 1
						end
					elseif child.ClassName == "Part" and child.Name == "Detailing" then
						if spawnDetailingFromTree(parent, child, arg) then
							n += 1

							if DETAILING_APPLY_SKINS[dataID] then
								parent.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if dataID and (dataID == "TreeKnife2023" or dataID == "TreeGun2023" or dataID == "TreeKnife2023Chroma" or dataID == "TreeGun2023Chroma") then
					parent.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
				end

				if dataID and (dataID == "TreeKnife2023Chroma" or dataID == "TreeGun2023Chroma") then
					local lightParts = parent:FindFirstChild("LightParts")
					local n2 = 0

					if lightParts then
						for _, child in ipairs(lightParts:GetChildren()) do
							if child:IsA("BasePart") then
								n2 += 1
								child.Color = TREE_CHROMA_LIGHT_COLORS[(n2 - 1) % #TREE_CHROMA_LIGHT_COLORS + 1]
							end
						end
					end

					for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
						if child.Name == "Lights" and child:IsA("BasePart") then
							n2 += 1
							child.Color = TREE_CHROMA_LIGHT_COLORS[(n2 - 1) % #TREE_CHROMA_LIGHT_COLORS + 1]
						end
					end
				end

				if n > 0 and dataID then
					parent:SetAttribute("SC_FxSkinKey", dataID)
				end

				return n
			end

			createMeshPartFromId = function(arg)
				if not arg or arg == "" then
					return nil
				end
				local v_2 = AssetService
				local AssetService2

				if AssetService then
					AssetService2 = v_2
				else
					AssetService2 = game:GetService("AssetService")
				end

				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return AssetService2:CreateMeshPartAsync(arg)
				end)

				if ok and result and result:IsA("MeshPart") then
					return result
				end

				if typeof(result) == "Instance" then
					pcall(function()
						result:Destroy()
					end)
				end

				return nil
			end

			setMeshIdSafe = function(arg, meshId)
				if not arg or not meshId or meshId == "" then
					return false
				end
				prepMeshSwap(arg)

				if arg:IsA("MeshPart") then
					local v_2 = createMeshPartFromId(meshId)
					if not v_2 then
						return false
					end

					local ok = pcall(function()
						arg:ApplyMesh(v_2)
					end)

					v_2:Destroy()
					if not ok then
						return false
					end
				elseif not pcall(function()
							arg.MeshId = meshId
						end) then
					return false
				end

				prepMeshSwap(arg)
				return true
			end

			syncToolHandleAttachedVisuals = function(arg)
				if not arg or not arg:IsA("BasePart") then
					return
				end

				if handleVisualSyncBusy[arg] then
					return
				end
				handleVisualSyncBusy[arg] = true

				pcall(function()
					local v_2 = arg:FindFirstChild(OVERLAY_MESH_NAME)
					local vh = arg:FindFirstChild("VH")
					local localTransparencyModifier = arg.LocalTransparencyModifier
					local flag2 = arg:GetAttribute("SC_ThrowHide") == true

					if vh and not v_2 and arg.Transparency < 0.999 then
						arg.Transparency = 1
					end

					local flag3

					if v_2 then
						flag3 = flag2 or arg.Transparency >= 0.999
					elseif not vh then
						flag3 = flag2 or arg.Transparency >= 0.999
					else
						flag3 = flag2
					end

					local localTransparencyModifier2 = (flag3 or localTransparencyModifier >= 0.999) and 1 or localTransparencyModifier

					if v_2 and v_2:IsA("BasePart") then
						v_2.Transparency = flag3 and 1 or 0
						v_2.LocalTransparencyModifier = localTransparencyModifier2
					end

					if vh and vh:IsA("BasePart") then
						local flag4 = flag2 or localTransparencyModifier >= 0.999
						vh.Transparency = flag4 and 1 or 0
						vh.LocalTransparencyModifier = localTransparencyModifier2

						for _, descendant in ipairs(vh:GetDescendants()) do
							if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
								descendant.LocalTransparencyModifier = localTransparencyModifier2

								if flag4 then
									descendant.Transparency = 1
								end
							end
						end
					end

					for _, child in ipairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
						local name = child.Name

						if name == "LightParts" or name == "Lights" or name == "LightPart" or name == "Detailing" then
							local tbl15 = {}

							if child:IsA("BasePart") then
								table.insert(tbl15, child)
							end

							for _, descendant in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
								if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
									table.insert(tbl15, descendant)
								end
							end

							for _, v_3 in ipairs(tbl15) do
								v_3.LocalTransparencyModifier = localTransparencyModifier2

								if flag3 or localTransparencyModifier2 >= 0.999 then
									if v_3:GetAttribute("SC_FxWasT") == nil then
										v_3:SetAttribute("SC_FxWasT", v_3.Transparency)
									end

									v_3.Transparency = 1
								else
									local attribute = v_3:GetAttribute("SC_FxWasT")

									if attribute ~= nil then
										v_3.Transparency = attribute

										pcall(function()
											v_3:SetAttribute("SC_FxWasT", nil)
										end)
									end
								end
							end

							for _, descendant in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
								if descendant:IsA("Decal") then
									if flag3 or localTransparencyModifier2 >= 0.999 then
										if descendant:GetAttribute("SC_FxWasT") == nil then
											descendant:SetAttribute("SC_FxWasT", descendant.Transparency)
										end

										descendant.Transparency = 1
									else
										local attribute = descendant:GetAttribute("SC_FxWasT")

										if attribute ~= nil then
											descendant.Transparency = attribute

											pcall(function()
												descendant:SetAttribute("SC_FxWasT", nil)
											end)
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end

					if vh and not v_2 then
						flag2 = flag2 or localTransparencyModifier >= 0.999
					else
						flag2 = flag3 or localTransparencyModifier2 >= 0.999
					end

					for _, descendant in ipairs(arg:GetDescendants()) do
						if descendant:IsA("Decal") and descendant.Name == "Chroma" then
							if flag2 then
								if descendant:GetAttribute("SC_ChromaWas") == nil then
									descendant:SetAttribute("SC_ChromaWas", descendant.Transparency)
								end

								descendant.Transparency = 1
							elseif descendant:GetAttribute("ChromaLayer") == nil and descendant:GetAttribute("StaticLayer") == nil then
								pcall(function()
									descendant:SetAttribute("SC_ChromaWas", nil)
								end)
							else
								local attribute = descendant:GetAttribute("SC_ChromaWas")

								if attribute ~= nil then
									descendant.Transparency = attribute

									pcall(function()
										descendant:SetAttribute("SC_ChromaWas", nil)
									end)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end)

				handleVisualSyncBusy[arg] = nil
			end

			bindToolHandleVisualSync = function(arg)
				if not arg or not arg:IsA("BasePart") then
					return
				end
				local v_2 = handleVisualSyncConns[arg]

				if v_2 then
					for _, v_3 in ipairs(v_2) do
						pcall(function()
							v_3:Disconnect()
						end)
					end
				end

				local tbl15 = {}

				table.insert(tbl15, arg:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(function()
					syncToolHandleAttachedVisuals(arg)
				end))

				table.insert(tbl15, arg:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalTransparencyModifier"):Connect(function()
					syncToolHandleAttachedVisuals(arg)
				end))

				table.insert(tbl15, arg.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
					syncToolHandleAttachedVisuals(arg)
				end))

				handleVisualSyncConns[arg] = tbl15
				syncToolHandleAttachedVisuals(arg)
			end

			resolveMeshPartDisplaySize = function(arg, arg2)
				if arg.DisplayScale then
					local v_2 = arrToVec3(arg.DisplayScale, 1, 1, 1)
					local v_3 = arg2 and getMeshNaturalSize(arg2)
					if v_3 then
						return Vector3.new(v_3.X * v_2.X, v_3.Y * v_2.Y, v_3.Z * v_2.Z), "mp_display_scale", false
					end
				end

				local v_2 = arrToVec3(arg.DisplayMeshPartSize or arg.Scale or arg.HandScale, 1, 1, 1)
				local v_3 = arg2 and meshPartToUniformDisplayScale(arg2, v_2)
				if v_3 then
					return v_3, "mp_uniform", false
				end

				if arg2 and not getMeshNaturalSize(arg2) then
					return v_2, "mp_size_wait", true
				end
				return v_2, "mp_studs", false
			end

			applyMeshPartVisual = function(parent, arg, size)
				if not parent or not parent:IsA("BasePart") or type(arg) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end
				local v_2 = resolveSkinMeshId(arg)
				if not v_2 then
					return nil
				end
				local v_3 = resolveSurfaceAppearanceForSkin(arg)
				stripSurfaceAppearances(parent)
				local handTexture = arg.HandTexture or arg.TextureId

				if parent:IsA("MeshPart") then
					removeOverlayMeshPart(parent)

					if setMeshIdSafe(parent, v_2) then
						parent.TextureID = ""

						if size then
							parent.Size = size
						end

						parent.Transparency = 0

						if v_3 then
							applySurfaceAppearanceFromCache(parent, { SurfaceAppearance = v_3 })
							local colorMap = v_3.ColorMap

							if (not parent.TextureID or parent.TextureID == "") and colorMap and colorMap ~= "" then
								parent.TextureID = colorMap
							end
						elseif handTexture and handTexture ~= "" then
							parent.TextureID = handTexture
						end

						return parent
					end

					dbg("WARN", "mesh", "MeshPart ApplyMesh failed; no SM fallback on MeshPart host", { meshId = v_2, skin = arg.DataID })
					return nil
				end

				local v_4 = ensureOverlayMeshPart(parent, v_2)

				if v_4 then
					if size then
						v_4.Size = size
					end

					if v_3 then
						applySurfaceAppearanceFromCache(v_4, { SurfaceAppearance = v_3 })
						local colorMap = v_3.ColorMap

						if (not v_4.TextureID or v_4.TextureID == "") and colorMap and colorMap ~= "" then
							v_4.TextureID = colorMap
						end
					elseif handTexture and handTexture ~= "" then
						v_4.TextureID = handTexture
					end

					return v_4
				end

				removeOverlayMeshPart(parent)
				parent.Transparency = 0
				local specialMesh = parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") or parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("DataModelMesh")

				if not specialMesh then
					local specialMesh2 = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
					specialMesh2.Name = "Mesh"
					specialMesh2.Parent = parent
					specialMesh = specialMesh2
				end

				if not setMeshIdSafe(specialMesh, v_2) then
					dbg("WARN", "mesh", "SM fallback MeshId set failed", { meshId = v_2 })
					return nil
				end

				if specialMesh:IsA("SpecialMesh") or specialMesh:IsA("FileMesh") then
					if handTexture and handTexture ~= "" then
						specialMesh.TextureId = handTexture
					end
				end

				if not size then
					size = arrToVec3(arg.HandScale or arg.DisplayMeshPartSize or arg.Scale, 1, 1, 1)
				end

				local vector = nil

				if arg.DisplayScale then
					vector = arrToVec3(arg.DisplayScale, 1, 1, 1)
					local n = math.max(vector.X, vector.Y, vector.Z)
					local flag2 = n > 5e-05 and n <= 100
					local v_5 = nil

					if not flag2 then
						vector = v_5
					end
				end

				vector = vector or studsToSpecialMeshScale(v_2, size, arg) or Vector3.one
				specialMesh.Scale = vector
				dbg("INFO", "mesh", "MeshPart→SpecialMesh fallback", { meshId = v_2, skin = arg.DataID, scale = tostring(vector) })
				return specialMesh
			end

			startDisplayGuardian = function(arg, arg2, arg3, size, arg4)
				stopDisplayGuardian(arg)
				if not arg or not arg3 or not size then
					return
				end

				local function fn23()
					if not arg.Parent then
						stopDisplayGuardian(arg)
						return
					end

					for _, child in ipairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("MeshPart") and child ~= arg3 then
							local name = child.Name

							if name ~= "Lights" and name ~= "LightPart" and name ~= "Detailing" and name ~= "VH" and name ~= OVERLAY_MESH_NAME then
								child:Destroy()
							end
						end
					end

					local vh = arg:FindFirstChild("VH")

					if vh and vh:IsA("BasePart") then
						arg.Transparency = 1
						vh.Transparency = 0
					else
						local partSize = arg4

						if not arg4 then
							partSize = displayBaselines[arg]
							partSize = partSize and partSize.partSize
						end

						if arg:IsA("BasePart") and partSize then
							if (arg.Size - partSize).Magnitude > 0.02 then
								arg.Size = partSize
							end
						end
					end

					if not arg3.Parent then
						return
					end

					if arg3:IsA("MeshPart") then
						if (arg3.Size - size).Magnitude > 0.02 then
							arg3.Size = size
						end
					elseif arg3:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
						if (arg3.Scale - size).Magnitude > 0.02 then
							arg3.Scale = size
						end
					end
				end

				displayGuardians[arg] = {
					conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(fn23),
					sizeConn = arg3:GetPropertyChangedSignal(arg3:IsA("MeshPart") and "Size" or "Scale"):Connect(fn23),
				}

				fn23()
			end

			meshNaturalSizeCache = {}
			pendingMeshRefresh = {}

			local function fn23(arg)
				if not arg or arg == "" then
					return ""
				end
				return tostring(arg):match("(%d+)") or tostring(arg)
			end

			naturalSizeFromSkinData = function(arg)
				if type(arg) ~= "table" or not arg.MeshNaturalSize then
					return nil
				end
				local v_2 = arrToVec3(arg.MeshNaturalSize, 0, 0, 0)
				if v_2.Magnitude > 0.001 then
					return v_2
				end
				return nil
			end

			naturalSizeFromCapturedSkins = function(arg)
				local v_2 = fn23(arg)
				if v_2 == "" or type(CapturedSkins) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end

				for _, v_3 in pairs(CapturedSkins) do
					if type(v_3) == "table" and v_3.MeshNaturalSize then
						if fn23(v_3.MeshId or v_3.HandMesh) == v_2 then
							local v_4 = arrToVec3(v_3.MeshNaturalSize, 0, 0, 0)
							if v_4.Magnitude > 0.001 then
								return v_4
							end
						end
					end
				end

				return nil
			end

			getMeshNaturalSize = function(arg)
				if not arg or arg == "" then
					return nil
				end
				local v_2 = meshNaturalSizeCache[arg]
				if v_2 ~= nil then
					return v_2 or nil
				end
				local v_3 = naturalSizeFromCapturedSkins(arg)
				if v_3 then
					meshNaturalSizeCache[arg] = v_3
					return v_3
				end

				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(arg)
				end)

				if ok and result then
					local meshSize = result.MeshSize
					result:Destroy()
					if meshSize and meshSize.Magnitude > 0.001 then
						meshNaturalSizeCache[arg] = meshSize
						return meshSize
					end
				end

				meshNaturalSizeCache[arg] = false
				return nil
			end

			studsToSpecialMeshScale = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
				if not arg2 then
					return nil
				end
				local v_2 = naturalSizeFromSkinData(arg3) or getMeshNaturalSize(arg)
				if not v_2 then
					return nil
				end
				return Vector3.new(v_2.X > 0.001 and arg2.X / v_2.X or 1, v_2.Y > 0.001 and arg2.Y / v_2.Y or 1, v_2.Z > 0.001 and arg2.Z / v_2.Z or 1)
			end

			meshPartToUniformDisplayScale = function(arg, arg2)
				if not arg2 then
					return nil
				end
				local v_2 = getMeshNaturalSize(arg)
				if not v_2 then
					return nil
				end
				local n = v_2.Y > 0.001 and arg2.Y / v_2.Y or 0.65
				if n > 5e-05 and n <= 100 then
					return Vector3.new(n, n, n)
				end
				return nil
			end

			studsToLobbySMFallback = function(arg, arg2)
				if not arg2 then
					return Vector3.new(0.65, 0.65, 0.65)
				end
				local v_2 = meshPartToUniformDisplayScale(arg, arg2)
				if v_2 then
					return v_2
				end
				local n = math.clamp(0.55 / math.max(math.max(arg2.X, arg2.Y, arg2.Z) * 0.4, 0.5), DISPLAY_SM_MIN, DISPLAY_SM_MAX)
				return Vector3.new(n, n, n)
			end

			scheduleScaleRefresh = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
				if not arg or arg == "" then
					return
				end
				local str2 = tostring(arg) .. ":" .. tostring(arg3 or "")
				if pendingMeshRefresh[str2] or not arg3 and pendingMeshRefresh[arg] then
					return
				end
				local v_2 = arg3 and str2 or arg
				pendingMeshRefresh[v_2] = true
				dbg("INFO", "scale", "waiting for mesh natural size", { meshId = arg, token = arg3 })

				task.spawn(function()
					for i = 1, 12 do
						if getMeshNaturalSize(arg) then
							dbg("INFO", "scale", "natural size loaded, re-applying", { meshId = arg, attempt = i })
							pcall(arg2)
							break
						else
							task.wait(0.3)
						end
					end

					if not getMeshNaturalSize(arg) then
						dbg("WARN", "scale", "natural size timeout", { meshId = arg })
					end

					pendingMeshRefresh[v_2] = nil
				end)
			end

			toolSkinApplyGen = toolSkinApplyGen or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

			resolveScaleForTarget = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
				if not arg4 then
					return nil, "no_scale"
				end
				local handKind = arg.HandKind or arg.Kind

				if arg2 == "MeshPart" then
					if handKind == "MeshPart" then
						return arg4, "mp_to_mp_direct"
					end
					local v_2 = naturalSizeFromSkinData(arg) or getMeshNaturalSize(arg3)
					if v_2 then
						return Vector3.new(arg4.X * v_2.X, arg4.Y * v_2.Y, arg4.Z * v_2.Z), "sm_to_mp"
					end
					return nil, "sm_to_mp_wait"
				end

				if handKind == "MeshPart" then
					if arg.DisplayScale then
						local v_2 = arrToVec3(arg.DisplayScale, 1, 1, 1)
						local n = math.max(v_2.X, v_2.Y, v_2.Z)
						if n > 5e-05 and n <= 100 then
							return v_2, "mp_to_sm_display_scale"
						end
					end

					local v_2 = studsToSpecialMeshScale(arg3, arg4, arg)
					if v_2 then
						return v_2, "mp_to_sm_converted"
					end
					return nil, "mp_to_sm_wait"
				end

				return arg4, "sm_to_sm_direct"
			end

			hideExtraDisplayParts = function(arg, arg2)
				local function fn24(arg3)
					while arg3 and arg3 ~= arg do
						local name = arg3.Name
						if name == "LightParts" or name == "Lights" or name == "LightPart" or name == "Detailing" then
							return true
						end
						arg3 = arg3.Parent
					end

					return false
				end

				for _, descendant in ipairs(arg:GetDescendants()) do
					if not fn24(descendant) then
						if descendant:IsA("MeshPart") and descendant ~= arg2 then
							descendant.Transparency = 1
							descendant.CanCollide = false
							descendant.CastShadow = false
						elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") and not descendant:IsA("MeshPart") and descendant ~= arg and not descendant:IsA("Attachment") then
							if not (descendant.Name == "Attachment" or descendant:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")) and descendant:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") == nil then
								descendant.Transparency = 1
							end
						elseif (descendant:IsA("SpecialMesh") or descendant:IsA("FileMesh")) and descendant ~= arg2 then
							descendant.Scale = Vector3.new(0.001, 0.001, 0.001)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			getChromaHost = function(arg)

				local v_2 = arg:FindFirstChild(OVERLAY_MESH_NAME)

					if v_4.Parent and v_4.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
						return v_4.Parent
					end
				end
