				return arg:FindFirstChild("Handle") or arg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			end

			clearChromaEffect = function(arg)
				stopChromaTweens(arg)
				local v_2 = chromaRoots[arg]

				if v_2 then
					for _, v_3 in ipairs(v_2) do
						local inst = v_3.inst

						if inst and inst.Parent then
							pcall(function()
								CollectionService:RemoveTag(inst, "ChromaDecal")
							end)

							if inst:IsA("Decal") and inst.Name == "Chroma" then
								pcall(function()
									inst:SetAttribute("SC_ChromaWas", nil)
								end)

								pcall(function()
									inst:SetAttribute("ChromaLayer", nil)
								end)

								pcall(function()
									inst:SetAttribute("StaticLayer", nil)
								end)

								inst:Destroy()
							end
						end
					end

					chromaRoots[arg] = nil
				end

				for _, descendant in ipairs(arg:GetDescendants()) do
					if descendant:IsA("Decal") and descendant.Name == "Chroma" then
						pcall(function()
							CollectionService:RemoveTag(descendant, "ChromaDecal")
						end)

						pcall(function()
							descendant:SetAttribute("SC_ChromaWas", nil)
						end)

						pcall(function()
							descendant:SetAttribute("ChromaLayer", nil)
						end)

						pcall(function()
							descendant:SetAttribute("StaticLayer", nil)
						end)

						descendant:Destroy()
					end
				end

				local v_3 = getChromaHost(arg)

				if v_3 and v_3:IsA("BasePart") then

			ensureChromaDecal = function(parent, face)

			chromaBaseDataId = function(arg)

			treeChromaTexture = function(arg)
				if type(arg) ~= "table" then

					if texture.__t == "Content" then

					elseif texture.__t == "string" or type(texture.U) == "string" then
						texture = texture.U or texture.V
					end
				end

				if type(texture) == "string" and texture ~= "" then
					return texture
				end
				return nil
			end

			local function fn24(arg)

			resolveChromaMaskTexture = function(arg, arg2)

				if arg.ChromaLayer and arg.ChromaLayer ~= "" and not isChromaLayerTex(arg.ChromaLayer) then
					return arg.ChromaLayer

							if attribute and attribute ~= "" and not isChromaLayerTex(attribute) then

							end

							if descendant.Texture ~= "" and not isChromaLayerTex(descendant.Texture) then
								return descendant.Texture
							end
						end
					end
				end

				local handTexture = arg.HandTexture or arg.TextureId
				if (arg.HandKind or arg.Kind) ~= "MeshPart" and handTexture and handTexture ~= "" and not isDefaultTexture(handTexture) and not isChromaLayerTex(handTexture) then

				return nil
			end

			setupChromaDecal = function(arg, texture, arg2)
				if not texture or texture == "" or isChromaLayerTex(texture) then
					local attribute = arg:GetAttribute("ChromaLayer")

					if attribute and attribute ~= "" and not isChromaLayerTex(attribute) then
						texture = attribute
					elseif arg.Texture ~= "" and not isChromaLayerTex(arg.Texture) then
						texture = arg.Texture
					end
				end

				if not texture or texture == "" or isChromaLayerTex(texture) then
					return false
				end
				arg:SetAttribute("ChromaLayer", texture)

				if arg2 and arg2 ~= "" and not isChromaLayerTex(arg2) then
					arg:SetAttribute("StaticLayer", arg2)
				else
					pcall(function()
						arg:SetAttribute("StaticLayer", nil)
					end)
				end

				arg.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
				arg.Texture = texture
				arg.Transparency = 0
				return true
			end

			applyChromaEffect = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
				if not arg then
					return
				end
				clearChromaEffect(arg)
				if not arg2 then
					dbg("INFO", "chroma", "off: " .. tostring(arg3), { root = arg:GetFullName() })
					return
				end
				local left = arg4 and resolveChromaDecalFace(arg4) or Enum.NormalId.Left
				local v_2 = getChromaHost(arg)
				stopChromaTweens(arg)
				chromaTweenTokens[arg] = chromaTweenTokens[arg] or 0
				stripChromaScripts(arg)
				local tbl15 = {}
				chromaRoots[arg] = tbl15

				if skinUsesTreeChromaDecals(arg4) and v_2 and v_2:IsA("BasePart") then
					v_2.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
					v_2.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					local specialMesh = v_2:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") or v_2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("DataModelMesh")

					if specialMesh and specialMesh:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
						specialMesh.TextureId = ""
					elseif v_2:IsA("MeshPart") then
						v_2.TextureID = ""
					end

					for _, child in ipairs(v_2:GetChildren()) do
						local isDecal = child:IsA("Decal")
						local flag2

						if isDecal then
							flag2 = child.Name == "Chroma" or child.Name == "Decal"
						else
							flag2 = isDecal
						end

						if flag2 then
							child:Destroy()
						end
					end

					local v_3 = collectTreeChromaDecalNodes(arg4)

					for _, v_4 in ipairs(v_3) do
						local properties = v_4.Properties or {}
						local v_5 = treeChromaTexture(properties)

						if v_5 and v_5 ~= "" then
							local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
							decal.Name = "Chroma"
							decal.Texture = v_5
							decal.Face = fn24(properties.Face)
							local transparency = properties.Transparency
							decal.Transparency = type(transparency) == "number" and transparency or 0
							decal.Color3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
							decal:SetAttribute("ChromaLayer", v_5)

							pcall(function()
								decal:SetAttribute("StaticLayer", nil)
							end)

							decal.Parent = v_2
							stripChromaScripts(decal)
							table.insert(tbl15, { inst = decal })
						end
					end

					local v_4 = startTreeChromaNativeEffect(v_2, arg)

					dbg("INFO", "chroma", "on: " .. tostring(arg3), {
						root = arg:GetFullName(),
						host = v_2:GetFullName(),

						decals = #tbl15,
						lightTweens = v_4,
						face = "Front",
						engine = "hostColor+LightPartStep",
					})

					return
				end

				if v_2 and v_2.Name == "VH" and v_2:IsA("BasePart") then
					for _, descendant in ipairs(arg:GetDescendants()) do
						if descendant:IsA("Decal") and descendant.Name == "Chroma" and descendant.Parent ~= v_2 then
							descendant.Transparency = 1

							pcall(function()
								CollectionService:RemoveTag(descendant, "ChromaDecal")
							end)
						end
					end

					local tbl16 = {}
					local tbl17 = {}

					local function fn25(arg5)
						if not arg5 or arg5 == "" or isChromaLayerTex(arg5) or tbl17[arg5] then
							return
						end
						tbl17[arg5] = true
						table.insert(tbl16, arg5)
					end

					local tbl18 = {}
					collectChromaTexturesFromTree(arg4 and arg4.DisplayTree, tbl18)
					collectChromaTexturesFromTree(arg4 and arg4.HandleTree, tbl18)

					for _, v_3 in ipairs(tbl18) do
						fn25(v_3)
					end

					if #tbl16 == 0 and arg4 and arg4.ChromaMask then
						fn25(arg4.ChromaMask)
					end

					local tbl19 = {}

					for _, child in ipairs(v_2:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("Decal") and child.Name == "Chroma" then
							table.insert(tbl19, child)
						end
					end

					for i, v_3 in ipairs(tbl16) do
						local decal = tbl19[i]

						if not decal then
							decal = Instance.new("Decal")
							decal.Name = "Chroma"
							decal.Parent = v_2
						end

						if left then
							pcall(function()
								decal.Face = left
							end)
						end

						if setupChromaDecal(decal, v_3, nil) then
							detachFromNativeChroma(decal)
							stripChromaScripts(decal)
							startChromaDecalRainbow(decal, arg)
							table.insert(tbl15, { inst = decal })
						end
					end

					for i = #tbl16 + 1, #tbl19 do
						tbl19[i].Transparency = 1

						pcall(function()
							CollectionService:RemoveTag(tbl19[i], "ChromaDecal")
						end)
					end

					dbg("INFO", "chroma", "on: " .. tostring(arg3), {
						root = arg:GetFullName(),
						host = v_2:GetFullName(),
						mode = "vh_multi",
						decals = #tbl15,
						textures = tbl16,
						face = left and left.Name or nil,
						engine = "ChromaDecal+Tween",
					})

					return
				end

				local v_3 = arg4 and resolveChromaMaskTexture(arg4, arg) or nil
				local chromaStaticLayer = arg4 and arg4.ChromaStaticLayer or nil

				if not chromaStaticLayer and arg4 and arg4._sessionChromaDecals and arg4._sessionChromaDecals[1] then
					chromaStaticLayer = arg4._sessionChromaDecals[1].staticLayer
				end

				local function fn25(arg5)
					if left then
						pcall(function()
							arg5.Face = left
						end)
					end

					if setupChromaDecal(arg5, v_3, chromaStaticLayer) then
						detachFromNativeChroma(arg5)
						stripChromaScripts(arg5)
						startChromaDecalRainbow(arg5, arg)
						table.insert(tbl15, { inst = arg5 })
					end
				end

				for _, descendant in ipairs(arg:GetDescendants()) do
					if descendant:IsA("Decal") and descendant.Name == "Chroma" then
						fn25(descendant)
					end
				end

				if #tbl15 == 0 and v_3 then
					if v_2 then
						fn25(ensureChromaDecal(v_2, left))
					end
				end

				dbg("INFO", "chroma", "on: " .. tostring(arg3), {
					root = arg:GetFullName(),
					host = v_2 and v_2:GetFullName() or nil,
					mode = "legacy_static",
					decals = #tbl15,
					mask = v_3,
					staticLayer = chromaStaticLayer,
					face = left and left.Name or nil,
					engine = "ChromaDecal+Tween",
				})
			end

				local surfaceAppearance = arg2.SurfaceAppearance

					return false

				fn25("NormalMap", surfaceAppearance.NormalMap)

			resolveLobbySpecialMeshScale = function(arg, arg2)

					local n = math.max(v_2.X, v_2.Y, v_2.Z)
					if n > 5e-05 and n <= 100 then
						return v_2, displayKind == "MeshPart" and "gun_mp_display_scale" or "lobby_sm", false
					end
				end

				local v_2 = arrToVec3(arg.DisplayMeshPartSize or arg.Scale or arg.HandScale, 1, 1, 1)
				local v_3 = meshPartToUniformDisplayScale(arg2, v_2)
				if v_3 then
					return v_3, "lobby_mp_uniform", false
				end

				if arg2 and not getMeshNaturalSize(arg2) then
					return studsToLobbySMFallback(arg2, v_2), "lobby_mp_wait", true

				local v_4 = studsToSpecialMeshScale(arg2, v_2, arg)

				if v_4 then
					local n = math.max(v_4.X, v_4.Y, v_4.Z)
					if n > 5e-05 and n <= 100 then
						return Vector3.new(n, n, n), "lobby_mp_conv", false
					end
				end

				return studsToLobbySMFallback(arg2, v_2), "lobby_fallback", false
			end

			replayDisplaySnapshot = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
				local str2 = arg3 and "Knife" or "Gun"
				local v_2 = resolveSkinMeshId(arg2)
				local v_3 = resolveSkinTextureId(arg2)
				local displayKind = arg2.DisplayKind or arg2.Kind
				local v_4 = resolveToolVhLayout(arg2)

				if v_4 and not arg:IsA("MeshPart") and not skinNeedsMeshPartVisual(arg2) then
					removeOverlayMeshPart(arg)
					local v_5, v_6 = ensureToolVhHost(arg, v_4)
					if not v_6 then
						return nil, nil, "vh_host_fail", nil, false
					end
					prepMeshSwap(v_6)
					setMeshIdSafe(v_6, v_2)
					applyTextureToDisplayMesh(v_6, v_6.ClassName, v_3, str2)
					local v_7, v_8, v_9 = resolveLobbySpecialMeshScale(arg2, v_2)
					v_6.Scale = v_7

						v_6.VertexColor = arrToVec3(arg2.VertexColor or arg2.HandVertexColor, 1, 1, 1)

					return v_6, v_6.ClassName, "display_vh:" .. tostring(v_4.source or "?"), v_7, v_9
				end

				clearDisplayVh(arg)

				if (arg:IsA("MeshPart") or not arg:IsA("MeshPart") and skinNeedsMeshPartOverlayOnPart(arg2)) and skinNeedsMeshPartVisual(arg2) then
					local v_5, v_6, v_7 = resolveMeshPartDisplaySize(arg2, v_2)
					local v_8 = applyMeshPartVisual(arg, arg2, v_5)
					if not v_8 then
						return nil, nil, "mp_visual_fail", nil, false
					end
					finalizeDisplayVisuals(arg, v_8, arg2, arg3)
					return v_8, "MeshPart", v_6, v_5, v_7
				end

				if not arg:IsA("MeshPart") and (arg3 or displayKind == "MeshPart") then
					removeOverlayMeshPart(arg)
					local specialMesh = arg:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") or arg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("DataModelMesh")
					if not specialMesh then
						return nil, nil, "no_mesh", nil, false
					end
					prepMeshSwap(specialMesh)
					setMeshIdSafe(specialMesh, v_2)
					applyTextureToDisplayMesh(specialMesh, specialMesh.ClassName, v_3, str2)
					local v_5, v_6, v_7 = resolveLobbySpecialMeshScale(arg2, v_2)
					specialMesh.Scale = v_5

					if specialMesh:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
						specialMesh.Offset = arrToVec3(arg2.Offset or arg2.HandOffset, 0, 0, 0)
						specialMesh.VertexColor = arrToVec3(arg2.VertexColor or arg2.HandVertexColor, 1, 1, 1)
					end

					finalizeDisplayVisuals(arg, specialMesh, arg2, arg3)

			isThrownKnifeWorldPart = function(arg)

			end

								return

					end

			end

			getDefaultWeaponSkin = function(arg)

			applyAllSkins = function()
				local v_2 = resolveKnifeSkinForApply()
				local v_3 = resolveGunSkinForApply()

				dbg("INFO", "apply", "applyAllSkins start", {
					knife = v_2 and (v_2.DataID or v_2.Name),
					gun = v_3 and (v_3.DataID or v_3.Name),
					defaults = applyDefaultsWhenUnselected,
				})

				local character = localPlayer.Character
				local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")

				local function fn29(arg)
					if not arg:IsA("Tool") then
						return
					end
					local attribute = arg:GetAttribute("IsKnife") or arg.Name == "Knife"
					local attribute2 = arg:GetAttribute("IsGun") or arg.Name == "Gun"

					if attribute and v_2 then
						applySkinToTool(arg, v_2)
					elseif attribute2 and v_3 then
						applySkinToTool(arg, v_3)
					elseif applyDefaultsWhenUnselected and attribute then
						applyBackpackToolIcon(arg, { DataID = "DefaultKnife" }, true)
					elseif applyDefaultsWhenUnselected and attribute2 then
						applyBackpackToolIcon(arg, { DataID = "DefaultGun" }, false)
					end
				end

						fn29(child)
					end
				end

				if backpack then
					for _, child in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
						fn29(child)
					end
				end

					applyToDisplay(true, v_2, nil, not SelectedKnife)
				elseif applyDefaultsWhenUnselected and character then
					local displayRefKnife = character:FindFirstChild("DisplayRefKnife")

					if displayRefKnife and displayRefKnife.Value then
						restoreDisplayToVisibleDefault(displayRefKnife.Value, true)
					end

					end

				end

				fn27()
				flushDebugLog()
			end

			hookContainer = function(arg)

							v_3 = resolveGunSkinForApply()

			skinNameIndex = nil

			buildSkinNameIndex = function()
				if skinNameIndex then
					return
				end
				skinNameIndex = {}
				local capturedSkins = _G.CapturedSkins or CapturedSkins
				if type(capturedSkins) ~= "table" then
					return
				end

				for k, capturedSkin in pairs(capturedSkins) do
					if not isPlayerSkinKey(k, capturedSkin) then
						local tbl15 = {}

						if capturedSkin.Name then
							table.insert(tbl15, capturedSkin.Name)
						end

						if capturedSkin.DataID then
							table.insert(tbl15, capturedSkin.DataID)
							local v_2 = database[capturedSkin.DataID]

							if v_2 and v_2.ItemName then
								table.insert(tbl15, v_2.ItemName)
							end
						end

						table.insert(tbl15, k)

						for _, v_2 in ipairs(tbl15) do
							if type(v_2) == "string" and v_2 ~= "" then
								skinNameIndex[v_2] = skinNameIndex[v_2] or {}
								local flag2 = false

								for _, v_3 in ipairs(skinNameIndex[v_2]) do
									if v_3 == k then
										flag2 = true
										break
									end
								end

								if not flag2 then
									table.insert(skinNameIndex[v_2], k)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			isChromaTags = function(arg)
				if type(arg) ~= "table" then
					return false
				end

				for _, v_2 in ipairs(arg) do
					if v_2 == "Chroma" then
						return true
					end
				end

				return false
			end

			pickSkinKey = function(arg, arg2)
				if type(arg) ~= "table" or #arg == 0 then
					return nil
				end

				if arg2 then
					for _, v_2 in ipairs(arg) do
						if v_2:find("Chroma", 1, true) then
							return v_2
						end
					end
				end

				for _, v_2 in ipairs(arg) do
					if not v_2:find("Chroma", 1, true) then
						return v_2
					end
				end

				return arg[1]
			end

			synthesizeTierSkinFromBase = function(dataID)
				local capturedSkins = _G.CapturedSkins or CapturedSkins
				if type(capturedSkins) ~= "table" or type(dataID) ~= "string" or dataID == "" then
					return nil
				end

				if capturedSkins[dataID] and not isPlayerSkinKey(dataID, capturedSkins[dataID]) then
					return dataID
				end
				local str2 = dataID:gsub("_(Purple|Gold|Silver|Bronze|Red|Blue)$", "")
				if str2 == dataID then
					return nil
				end
				local v_2 = capturedSkins[str2]
				if type(v_2) ~= "table" or isPlayerSkinKey(str2, v_2) then
					return nil
				end
				local v_3 = WeaponsSpawnerDB and WeaponsSpawnerDB[dataID]
				local tbl15 = {}

				for k, v_4 in pairs(v_2) do
					if type(v_4) == "table" then
						local tbl16 = {}

						for k2, v_5 in pairs(v_4) do
							tbl16[k2] = v_5
						end

						tbl15[k] = tbl16
					else
						tbl15[k] = v_4
					end
				end

				tbl15.DataID = dataID
				tbl15.Name = dataID

				if type(v_3) == "table" then
					local image = v_3.Image or v_3.image or ""
					local match = image:match("assetId=(%d+)") or image:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)")

					if match then
						local textureId = "rbxassetid://" .. match
						tbl15.TextureId = textureId
						tbl15.HandTexture = textureId
						tbl15._sessionTexture = textureId
					end
				end

				capturedSkins[dataID] = tbl15
				dbg("INFO", "skin", "synthesized tier variant from base", { dataId = dataID, baseId = str2 })
				return dataID
			end

			resolveSkinCacheKey = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
				if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
					return nil
				end
				local capturedSkins = _G.CapturedSkins or CapturedSkins
				if type(capturedSkins) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end

				if capturedSkins[arg] and not isPlayerSkinKey(arg, capturedSkins[arg]) then
					return arg
				end
				local v_2 = synthesizeTierSkinFromBase(arg)
				if v_2 then
					return v_2
				end
				buildSkinNameIndex()
				local flag2 = arg:match("_T$") ~= nil or isChromaTags(arg3)
				local match = arg:match("^(.-)_T$") or arg
				local v_3 = pickSkinKey(skinNameIndex and skinNameIndex[arg], flag2)
				if v_3 then
					return v_3
				end
				local v_4 = pickSkinKey(skinNameIndex and skinNameIndex[match], flag2)
				if v_4 then
					return v_4
				end

				for k, capturedSkin in pairs(capturedSkins) do
					if type(capturedSkin) == "table" and not isPlayerSkinKey(k, capturedSkin) then
						if capturedSkin.Name == match or capturedSkin.Name == arg then
							return k
						end
					end
				end

				if type(database) == "table" then
					for k, v_5 in pairs(database) do
						if k == arg or k == match then
							if capturedSkins[k] and not isPlayerSkinKey(k, capturedSkins[k]) then
								return k
							end
						end

						if type(v_5) == "table" and v_5.ItemName == match then
							if capturedSkins[k] and not isPlayerSkinKey(k, capturedSkins[k]) then
								return k
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if capturedSkins[arg] and not isPlayerSkinKey(arg, capturedSkins[arg]) then
					return arg
				end

				if capturedSkins[match] and not isPlayerSkinKey(match, capturedSkins[match]) then
					return match
				end
				local match2 = arg:match("^(.+)_Godly$")

				if match2 then
					local str2 = match2 .. "_Ancient"
					if capturedSkins[str2] and not isPlayerSkinKey(str2, capturedSkins[str2]) then
						return str2
					end
				end

				return nil
			end

			selectSkinByKey = function(arg)
				if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
					return false, "empty_key"
				end
				local capturedSkins = _G.CapturedSkins or CapturedSkins
				synthesizeTierSkinFromBase(arg)
				capturedSkins = capturedSkins and capturedSkins[arg]
				if not capturedSkins then
					return false, "not_in_cache"
				end

				if DISABLED_SKIN_KEYS[arg] and not isGingerscopeFamilySkin(capturedSkins, arg) then
					return false, "disabled"
				end
				applyDefaultsWhenUnselected = false
				local type_ = capturedSkins.Type

				if not type_ and capturedSkins.DataID and database[capturedSkins.DataID] then
					local v_2 = database[capturedSkins.DataID]
					type_ = v_2.WeaponType or v_2.ItemType
				end

				if type_ == "Knife" then
					SelectedKnife = capturedSkins
					selectedKnifeKey = arg
				else
					if type_ ~= "Gun" then
						return false, "unknown_type"
					end
					SelectedGun = capturedSkins
					selectedGunKey = arg
					preloadCustomHoldForSkin(capturedSkins, arg)
				end

				dbg("INFO", "itemspawner", "select " .. arg, { type = type_ })
				applyAllSkins()
				return true
			end

			end

			}

			end)

			end

			dbg("INFO", "boot", "SkinChanger core ready (no GUI)", { skins = totalCached, itemSpawnerApi = _G.ItemSpawnerSkins ~= nil })
		end)

		if not ok then
			itemspawnerLog("[itemspawner] skin core failed:", result)
		end
	end

		local rightUpperLeg = parent:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")
		if not rightUpperLeg then
			return
		end
		fn17(rightUpperLeg)
		fn17(parent:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg"))
		fn17(parent:FindFirstChild("RightFoot"))
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = "KorbloxLeg"
		part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 2, 1)
		part.Anchored = false
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.Massless = true
		part.Color = color72
		part.Parent = parent
		local specialMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
		specialMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
		specialMesh.MeshId = meshId2
		specialMesh.TextureId = textureId
		specialMesh.Scale = Vector3.one
		specialMesh.Parent = part
		local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
		weld.Part0 = rightUpperLeg
		weld.Part1 = part
		weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, -0.8, 0)
		weld.Parent = part
		fn16(part)
	end

	local function fn25(arg)
		if not arg then
			return
		end
		local korbloxLeg = arg:FindFirstChild("KorbloxLeg")

		if korbloxLeg then
			korbloxLeg:Destroy()
		end

		for _, v_2 in ipairs(tbl4) do
			local v_3 = arg:FindFirstChild("KorbloxR15_" .. v_2)

			if v_3 then
				v_3:Destroy()
			end

			fn15(arg:FindFirstChild(v_2))
		end

		local rightLeg = arg:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")

		if rightLeg then
			for _, child in ipairs(rightLeg:GetChildren()) do
				local isSpecialMesh = child:IsA("SpecialMesh")

				if isSpecialMesh then
					isSpecialMesh = string.find(tostring(child.MeshId or ""), "101851696", 1, true) ~= nil
				end

				if isSpecialMesh then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end

			fn15(rightLeg)
		end
	end

	local function fn26(arg, arg2)
		if not arg or arg2 ~= n then
			return
		end
		local head = arg:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local humanoid = arg:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if not head or not humanoid then
			head, humanoid = fn19(arg, 15)
		end

		if arg2 ~= n then
			return
		end

		if values.FakeHeadless then
			fn21(head)
		end

		if not values.FakeKorblox or not humanoid then
			return
		end

		if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
			fn23(arg)
		elseif humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
			fn24(arg)
		end
	end

	local function fn27()
		n += 1
		local v_2 = n
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		if not character then
			return
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			fn13()
			if v_2 ~= n then
				return
			end

			if not values.FakeHeadless then
				fn22(character)
			end

			if not values.FakeKorblox then
				fn25(character)
			end

			task.defer(function()
				if v_2 ~= n then
					return
				end

				if not values.FakeHeadless then
					fn22(character)
				end

				if not values.FakeKorblox then
					fn25(character)
				end
			end)

			if v_2 ~= n then
				return
			end

			if values.FakeHeadless or values.FakeKorblox then
				fn26(character, v_2)
			end
		end)
	end

	localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		n += 1
		local v_2 = n

		if values.FakeHeadless or values.FakeKorblox then
			task.spawn(function()
				fn13()
				fn26(character, v_2)
			end)
		end
	end)

XrayFunction = function()
	scan = function(arg, localTransparencyModifier)
		for _, child in pairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") and not child.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not child.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
				child.LocalTransparencyModifier = localTransparencyModifier
			end

			scan(child, localTransparencyModifier)
		end
	end

	x = function(arg)
		if arg then
			if values.ChangeXray then
				scan(workspace, valueslider.XrayTransparency)
			else
				scan(workspace, 0)
			end
		else
			scan(workspace, 0)
		end
	end

	x(true)
end

hubSkyboxApplying = false

hubSkyboxSelectedName = function()
	local skybox = dropdownval and dropdownval.skybox
	if type(skybox) == "string" and skybox ~= "" and skybox ~= "Default" then
		return skybox
	end
	return nil
end

hubReapplyCustomSkybox = function(arg)
	if hubSkyboxApplying or hubConfigLoading or not values.customSkybox then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = hubSkyboxSelectedName()
	if not v_2 then
		return
	end
	configDbg("INFO", "skybox", "reapply", { reason = tostring(arg or ""), name = v_2 })
	ApplySkybox(v_2)
end

hubEnsureSkyboxWatch = function()
	if conns.skyboxChildRemoved then
		return
	end

	conns.skyboxChildRemoved = Lighting.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
		if hubSkyboxApplying or not values.customSkybox then
			return
		end

		if not child:IsA("Sky") then
			return
		end

		task.defer(function()
			if hubSkyboxApplying or not values.customSkybox then
				return
			end

			if Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky") then
				return
			end
			hubReapplyCustomSkybox("lighting_sky_removed")
		end)
	end)

	conns.skyboxChildAdded = Lighting.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if hubSkyboxApplying or not values.customSkybox then
			return
		end

		if not child:IsA("Sky") or child.Name == "SNPWARE_Sky" then
			return
		end

		task.defer(function()
			if hubSkyboxApplying or not values.customSkybox then
				return
			end

			if not child.Parent then
				return
			end
			hubReapplyCustomSkybox("lighting_foreign_sky")
		end)
	end)
end

ApplySkybox = function(arg)
	local v_2 = arg and Skyboxes[arg]

	configDbg("INFO", "skybox", "ApplySkybox begin", {
		name = arg,
		isDefault = arg == "Default",
		hasPreset = v_2 ~= nil,
		hadExistingSky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky") ~= nil,
	})

	hubSkyboxApplying = true
	local flag = false

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Sky") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end

		if arg == "Default" then
			configDbg("INFO", "skybox", "ApplySkybox default — custom sky cleared", {})
			return
		end

		if v_2 then
			local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
			sky.Name = "SNPWARE_Sky"

			for k, v_3 in pairs(v_2) do
				sky["Skybox" .. k] = v_3
			end

			sky.Parent = Lighting
			configDbg("INFO", "skybox", "ApplySkybox applied", { name = arg, parent = sky.Parent and sky.Parent.Name })
			flag = true
			return
		end

		local v_3 = customAssetsResolveItem(arg)

		if v_3 and v_3.type == "skyboxes" then
			local v_4 = customAssetsApplySkybox(v_3)
			configDbg(v_4 and "INFO" or "WARN", "skybox", "ApplySkybox CDN", { name = arg, ok = v_4 })
			flag = v_4 == true
			return
		end

		configDbg("WARN", "skybox", "ApplySkybox unknown preset", { name = arg })
	end)

	hubSkyboxApplying = false

	if not ok then
		configDbg("WARN", "skybox", "ApplySkybox error", { err = tostring(result), name = arg })
	end

	if values.customSkybox and flag then
		hubEnsureSkyboxWatch()
	end
end

			return
		end

		if customSkybox then
			ApplySkybox(dropdownval.skybox)
			hubEnsureSkyboxWatch()
		else
			ApplySkybox("Default")
		end
	end,
})

	local gunSound = values.customGunSound and dropdownval.gunSound or "Default Gun"
	local v_2 = customAssetsResolveSoundId(gunSound) or GUN_SOUNDS[gunSound]
	if not v_2 or v_2 == "" then
		return
	end

	if not hubGunSoundPreviewSound or not hubGunSoundPreviewSound.Parent then
		hubGunSoundPreviewSound = Instance.new("Sound")
		hubGunSoundPreviewSound.Name = "SNP_GunSoundPreview"
		hubGunSoundPreviewSound.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
	end

	hubGunSoundPreviewSound.SoundId = v_2
	hubGunSoundPreviewSound.Volume = math.clamp((tonumber(valueslider.gunSoundVolume) or 5) / 10, 0.05, 1)
	hubGunSoundPreviewSound.PlaybackSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(valueslider.gunSoundPlaybackSpeed) or 1, 0.25, 3)
	hubGunSoundPreviewSound:Stop()
	hubGunSoundPreviewSound:Play()
end

Tabs.visual:Section({ Title = "loc:section_improve_fps" })
values.removeRaggy = false
values.destroyCoins = false
opt = {}

opt.getCoinContainer = function()
	return Workspace:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer", true)
end

conn = nil

opt.attachCoinListener = function(arg)
	if conns.coinDestroyTouches[arg] then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = nil

	conns.coinDestroyTouches[arg] = arg.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		if not values.destroyCoins then
			return
		end
		local parent = hit.Parent

		if parent and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(parent) then
			if v_2 and typeof(v_2) == "RBXScriptConnection" and v_2.Connected then
				v_2:Disconnect()
			end

			conns.coinDestroyTouches[arg] = nil
			task.wait(0.1)

			if arg and arg.Parent then
				arg:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end)
end

opt.monitorCoins = function()
	local v_2 = opt.getCoinContainer()

	if v_2 then
		for _, child in ipairs(v_2:GetChildren()) do
			if child.Name == "Coin_Server" and child:IsA("BasePart") then
				opt.attachCoinListener(child)
			end
		end

		if conns.coinDestroyContainerConn then
			conns.coinDestroyContainerConn:Disconnect()
		end

		conns.coinDestroyContainerConn = v_2.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child.Name == "Coin_Server" and child:IsA("BasePart") then
				opt.attachCoinListener(child)
			end
		end)
	end
end

opt.destroyTargetModels = function()
	for _, descendant in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("Model") and table.find({ "Raggy", "GlitchProof" }, descendant.Name) then
			descendant:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
	if values.removeRaggy then
		opt.destroyTargetModels()
	end
end)

ToDisable = { Textures = false, VisualEffects = true, Parts = true, Particles = true, Sky = true }
ToEnable = { FullBright = true }
OriginalValues = {}

save = function(arg, arg2)
	if not OriginalValues[arg] then
		OriginalValues[arg] = arg2
	end
end

hubApplyLowerCpuLoad = function()
	local v_2 = next
	local descendants, v_3 = game:GetDescendants()

	for _, v_4 in v_2, descendants, v_3 do
		if ToDisable.Parts then
			if v_4:IsA("BasePart") then
				save(v_4, { Material = v_4.Material })
				v_4.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			end
		end

		if ToDisable.Particles then
			if v_4:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v_4:IsA("Smoke") or v_4:IsA("Explosion") or v_4:IsA("Sparkles") or v_4:IsA("Fire") then
				save(v_4, { Enabled = v_4.Enabled })
				v_4.Enabled = false
			end
		end

		if ToDisable.VisualEffects then
			if v_4:IsA("BloomEffect") or v_4:IsA("BlurEffect") or v_4:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") or v_4:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
				save(v_4, { Enabled = v_4.Enabled })
				v_4.Enabled = false
			end
		end

		if ToDisable.Textures then
			if v_4:IsA("Decal") or v_4:IsA("Texture") then
				save(v_4, { Texture = v_4.Texture })
				v_4.Texture = ""
			end
		end

		if ToDisable.Sky then
			if v_4:IsA("Sky") then
				save(v_4, { Parent = v_4.Parent })
				v_4.Parent = nil
			end
		end
	end

	if ToEnable.FullBright then
		save(Lighting, { Brightness = Lighting.Brightness, OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient })
		Lighting.Brightness = -1
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	end
end

values.lower = false

Tabs.visual:Toggle({
	Title = "loc:lowercpuload",
	Value = values.lower,
	Flag = "lower",
	Callback = function(arg)
		local lower = arg and true or false
		if hubLowerApplied == lower then
			values.lower = lower
			return
		end
		hubLowerApplied = lower
		values.lower = lower

		if lower then
			hubApplyLowerCpuLoad()
		else
			for k, v_2 in pairs(OriginalValues) do
				if k and k.Parent ~= nil or v_2.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						if v_2.Parent ~= nil and k:IsA("Sky") and Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky") then
							k:Destroy()
							return
						end

						for k2, v_3 in pairs(v_2) do
							k[k2] = v_3
						end
					end)
				end
			end

			OriginalValues = {}
		end
	end,
})

			if conns.hitboxPlayerAddedConn then
				conns.hitboxPlayerAddedConn:Disconnect()
			end

			local hitboxLoopGen = conns.hitboxLoopGen

			conns.hitboxPlayerAddedConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
				if player == localPlayer then
					return
				end
				local humanoidRootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if humanoidRootPart then
					humanoidRootPart.Size = values.HitboxSize
					humanoidRootPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(169, 169, 169)
					humanoidRootPart.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
					humanoidRootPart.CanCollide = false
					humanoidRootPart.Transparency = valueslider.HitboxTransparency * 0.1
				end
			end)

			task.spawn(function()
				while values.Hitboxexpander and conns.hitboxLoopGen == hitboxLoopGen do
					for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
						if player ~= localPlayer then
							local humanoidRootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

							if humanoidRootPart then
								humanoidRootPart.Size = values.HitboxSize
								humanoidRootPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(169, 169, 169)
								humanoidRootPart.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
								humanoidRootPart.CanCollide = false
								humanoidRootPart.Transparency = valueslider.HitboxTransparency * 0.1
							end
						end
					end

					task.wait(0.5)
				end
			end)

			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if player ~= localPlayer then
					local humanoidRootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					if humanoidRootPart then
						humanoidRootPart.Size = values.HitboxSize
						humanoidRootPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(169, 169, 169)
						humanoidRootPart.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
						humanoidRootPart.CanCollide = false
						humanoidRootPart.Transparency = valueslider.HitboxTransparency * 0.1
					end
				end
			end
		else
			conns.hitboxLoopGen = (conns.hitboxLoopGen or 0) + 1

			if conns.hitboxPlayerAddedConn then
				conns.hitboxPlayerAddedConn:Disconnect()
				conns.hitboxPlayerAddedConn = nil
			end

			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if player ~= localPlayer then
					local humanoidRootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					if humanoidRootPart then
						humanoidRootPart.Size = values.HitboxDefaultSize
						humanoidRootPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
						humanoidRootPart.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
						humanoidRootPart.CanCollide = false
						humanoidRootPart.Transparency = 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end,
})

targetPart = workspace:WaitForChild("RoundTimerPart", 5)

formatSecondsToTime = function(arg)
	if not arg or arg <= 0 then
		return "0:00"
	end
	local n = math.floor(arg / 60)
	local n2 = math.floor(arg % 60)
	return string.format("%d:%02d", n, n2)
end

syncTimer = function()
	fn6()

	if not targetPart then
		targetPart = workspace:FindFirstChild("RoundTimerPart")
	end

	local function fn14()
		local timerText = pulseOverlay.timerText
		if not timerText then
			return
		end

		if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then
			targetPart = workspace:FindFirstChild("RoundTimerPart")
		end

		local attribute = nil

		if targetPart then
			attribute = targetPart:GetAttribute("Time")
		end

		if type(attribute) ~= "number" or attribute <= 0 then
			timerText.Text = fn3("roundwaiting", "Waiting for round...")
			timerText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
			return
		end

		timerText.Text = fn3("roundendin", "Round end in: ") .. formatSecondsToTime(attribute)

		if attribute <= 10 then
			timerText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(139, 0, 255)
		else
			timerText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(242, 242, 247)
		end
	end

	if conns.roundTimerObserverConn then
		conns.roundTimerObserverConn:Disconnect()
		conns.roundTimerObserverConn = nil
	end

	if targetPart then
		conns.roundTimerObserverConn = targetPart:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Time"):Connect(fn14)
	end

	if not conns.roundTimerPartAddedConn then
		conns.roundTimerPartAddedConn = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child.Name == "RoundTimerPart" then
				targetPart = child

				if values.showtimer then
					syncTimer()
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	if not pulseOverlay._roundHooked then
		pulseOverlay._roundHooked = true

		task.spawn(function()
			local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
			local gameplay = remotes and (remotes:FindFirstChild("Gameplay") or remotes:WaitForChild("Gameplay", 10))
			if not gameplay then
				return
			end

			local function fn15()
				if values.showtimer then
					task.defer(fn14)
				end
			end

			local roundStart = gameplay:FindFirstChild("RoundStart")

			if roundStart and roundStart:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				roundStart.OnClientEvent:Connect(fn15)
			end

			local gameOver = gameplay:FindFirstChild("GameOver")

			if gameOver and gameOver:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				gameOver.OnClientEvent:Connect(fn15)
			end

			local victoryScreen = gameplay:FindFirstChild("VictoryScreen")

			if victoryScreen and victoryScreen:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				victoryScreen.OnClientEvent:Connect(fn15)
			end
		end)
	end

	fn14()
end

Tabs.other:Toggle({
	Title = "loc:showtimer",
	Value = values.showtimer,
	Flag = "showtimer",
	Callback = function(showtimer)
		values.showtimer = showtimer
		fn7("timer", showtimer == true)

		if values.showtimer then
			syncTimer()
		elseif conns.roundTimerObserverConn then
			conns.roundTimerObserverConn:Disconnect()
			conns.roundTimerObserverConn = nil
		end
	end,
})

				}

					game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character.Trap.Activate:FireServer(unpack(tbl4))

			end

stopView = function(arg)
	currentview = nil
	currentviewThread = nil

	pcall(function()
		local character = localPlayer.Character

		if character then
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

			if humanoid then
				workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = humanoid
			end
		end
	end)

	if arg ~= false then
		sendnotification(lc.stoppedviewing, 3)
	end
end

startView = function(arg)
	if currentviewThread then
		currentview = nil
		currentviewThread = nil
	end

	if arg and arg.Character and arg.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		currentview = arg

		currentviewThread = spawn(function()
			while currentview == arg do
				if arg.Parent and arg.Character and arg.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
					game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = arg.Character.Humanoid
					local v_2 = ln

					if tick() - v_2 > 3 then
						ln = tick()

						sendnotification(lc.viewing .. "\"" .. arg.Name .. "\"", 3.5, "rbxassetid://14856414755", lc.stopview or "Stop view", function()
							stopView()
						end)
					end

					wait(0.3)
				else
					game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = localPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
					currentview = nil
					sendnotification(lc.targetlost, 3.5)
					break
				end
			end
		end)
	else
		sendnotification(lc.target, 3.5)
		game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = localPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		currentview = nil
	end
end

lnn = 0

end

Fade.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(arg)
	if arg and type(arg) == "table" then
		for k, v_2 in pairs(arg) do
			if not (type(v_2) ~= "table" or k == nil) then
				local str2 = tostring(k)
				local playerByUserId = Players:FindFirstChild(str2)

				if not playerByUserId and typeof(k) == "number" then
					playerByUserId = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(k)
				end

				local userId = playerByUserId and playerByUserId.UserId
				local str3 = "rbxassetid://14856414755"

				if userId then
					str3 = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. playerByUserId.UserId .. "&w=420&h=420"
				end

				if v_2.Role == "Murderer" and not v_2.Dead and not v_2.Killed and values.murdnotify then
					if lc.murderis and lc.goodluck then
						local color72 = Color3.fromRGB
						local goodluck = lc.goodluck
						sendnotification(lc.murderis .. gradient(str2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), color72(255, 0, 0)) .. goodluck, 13, str3)
					end
				end

				if v_2.Role == "Sheriff" and not v_2.Dead and not v_2.Killed and values.shernotify then
					if lc.sheriffis and lc.goodluck then
						local color72 = Color3.fromRGB
						local goodluck = lc.goodluck
						sendnotification(lc.sheriffis .. gradient(str2, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255), color72(0, 0, 255)) .. goodluck, 13, str3)
					end
				end

				if k == localPlayer.Name and values.nb == true then
					local response = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Extras"):WaitForChild("GetChance"):InvokeServer()
					local v_3

					if v_2.Role == "Innocent" then
						local color72 = Color3.fromRGB
						v_3 = gradient(v_2.Role, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), color72(0, 255, 0))
					elseif v_2.Role == "Murderer" then
						local color72 = Color3.fromRGB
						v_3 = gradient(v_2.Role, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), color72(255, 0, 0))
					else
						v_3 = nil

						if v_2.Role == "Sheriff" then
							local color72 = Color3.fromRGB
							v_3 = gradient(v_2.Role, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255), color72(0, 0, 255))
						end
					end

					if v_3 and lc.role and lc.chance and response ~= nil then
						sendnotification(lc.role .. v_3 .. lc.chance .. response, 8)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if values.ChangeXray then
			XrayFunction()
		elseif values.lower then
			hubApplyLowerCpuLoad()
		end
	end
end)

			end

		end
	end
end

snpwareChatUi = { icon = nil, iconImage = nil, window = nil, closeChat = nil }

applyHideSnpwareChat = function(arg)
	values.hideSnpwareChat = arg == true
	local icon = snpwareChatUi.icon
	local iconImage = snpwareChatUi.iconImage
	if not icon then
		return
	end

	if values.hideSnpwareChat then
		icon.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
		icon.AutoButtonColor = false
		icon.Active = false
		icon.Interactable = false

		if iconImage then
			iconImage.ImageTransparency = 0.9
		end

		if type(snpwareChatUi.closeChat) == "function" then
			pcall(snpwareChatUi.closeChat)
		elseif snpwareChatUi.window then
			snpwareChatUi.window.Visible = false
		end
	else
		icon.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		icon.AutoButtonColor = true
		icon.Active = true
		icon.Interactable = true

		if iconImage then
			iconImage.ImageTransparency = 0
		end
	end
end

isValidDiscordWebhook = function(arg)
	local match = tostring(arg or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if match == "" then
		return false
	end
	return match:find("https://discord.com/api/webhooks/", 1, true) == 1 or match:find("https://discordapp.com/api/webhooks/", 1, true) == 1
end

discordWebhookCatalog = {}
discordWebhookDropdown = nil
discordWebhookHydrated = false
discordWebhookLoading = false

discordWebhookFilePath = function()
	return HUB_WEBHOOKS_DIR .. "discord_webhooks.json"
end

discordWebhookEnsureDir = function()
	if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	pcall(makefolder, SNP_LOG_DIR)
	pcall(makefolder, HUB_WEBHOOKS_DIR)
end

discordWebhookHasStoredData = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end

	if type(arg.catalog) == "table" and #arg.catalog > 0 then
		return true
	end
	return isValidDiscordWebhook(tostring(arg.lastUrl or ""))
end

discordWebhookMigrateLegacy = function()
	if type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = discordWebhookFilePath()
	if type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(v_2) then
		return
	end
	local str2 = HUB_CONFIG_DIR .. "discord_webhooks.json"
	if type(isfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(str2) then
		return
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(str2))
	end)

	if not ok or not discordWebhookHasStoredData(result) then
		return
	end
	discordWebhookEnsureDir()

	pcall(function()
		writefile(v_2, HttpService:JSONEncode(result))
	end)
end

hubFindUiTextBox = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	for _, v_2 in ipairs({ "Input", "InputBox", "SliderValueBox" }) do
		local v_3 = arg[v_2]
		if typeof(v_3) == "Instance" and v_3:IsA("TextBox") then
			return v_3
		end
	end

	local inputFrame = arg.InputFrame
	if typeof(inputFrame) == "Instance" and inputFrame.FindFirstChildWhichIsA then
		return inputFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextBox", true)
	end
	local sliderContainer = arg.SliderContainer
	if typeof(sliderContainer) == "Instance" and sliderContainer.FindFirstChildWhichIsA then
		return sliderContainer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextBox", true)
	end

	for _, v_2 in pairs(arg) do
		if typeof(v_2) == "Instance" then
			if v_2:IsA("TextBox") then
				return v_2
			end

			if v_2.FindFirstChildWhichIsA then
				local textBox = v_2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextBox", true)
				if textBox then
					return textBox
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

discordWebhookGetDropdownNames = function()
	local tbl5 = {}

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(discordWebhookCatalog) do
		if v_2.name and v_2.name ~= "" then
			table.insert(tbl5, v_2.name)
		end
	end

	table.sort(tbl5)
	return tbl5
end

discordWebhookSyncUrlInput = function(arg)
	local discordWebhook = Window and Window.PendingFlags and Window.PendingFlags.discordWebhook

	if discordWebhook and discordWebhook.Value ~= nil then
		discordWebhook.Value = tostring(arg or "")
	end

	if discordWebhook then
		discordWebhook = hubFindUiTextBox(discordWebhook.UIElements or discordWebhook)
	end

	if discordWebhook then
		discordWebhook.Text = tostring(arg or "")
	end
end

discordWebhookSyncNameInput = function(arg)
	local discordWebhookName = Window and Window.PendingFlags and Window.PendingFlags.discordWebhookName

	if discordWebhookName and discordWebhookName.Value ~= nil then
		discordWebhookName.Value = tostring(arg or "")
	end

	local v_2

	if discordWebhookName then
		v_2 = hubFindUiTextBox(discordWebhookName.UIElements or discordWebhookName)
	else
		v_2 = discordWebhookName
	end

	if v_2 then
		v_2.Text = tostring(arg or "")
	end
end

discordWebhookClearInputs = function()
	valuestrings.discordWebhook = ""
	valuestrings.discordWebhookName = ""
	discordWebhookSyncUrlInput("")
	discordWebhookSyncNameInput("")
end

discordWebhookGetInputUrl = function()
	local discordWebhook = valuestrings.discordWebhook
	local discordWebhook2 = Window and Window.PendingFlags and Window.PendingFlags.discordWebhook
	local text

	if discordWebhook2 then
		if type(discordWebhook2.Value) == "string" and discordWebhook2.Value ~= "" then
			discordWebhook = discordWebhook2.Value
		end

		local v_2 = hubFindUiTextBox(discordWebhook2.UIElements or discordWebhook2)

		if v_2 and v_2.Text and v_2.Text ~= "" then
			text = v_2.Text
		else
			text = discordWebhook
		end
	else
		text = discordWebhook
	end

	return tostring(text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end

discordWebhookGetActiveUrl = function()
	local discordWebhook = valuestrings.discordWebhook
	local discordWebhook2 = Window and Window.PendingFlags and Window.PendingFlags.discordWebhook

	if discordWebhook2 then
		if type(discordWebhook2.Value) == "string" and discordWebhook2.Value ~= "" then
			discordWebhook = discordWebhook2.Value
		end

		local v_2 = hubFindUiTextBox(discordWebhook2.UIElements or discordWebhook2)

		if v_2 and v_2.Text and v_2.Text ~= "" then
			discordWebhook = v_2.Text
		end
	end

	local match = tostring(discordWebhook or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

	if isValidDiscordWebhook(match) then
		if match ~= valuestrings.discordWebhook then
			valuestrings.discordWebhook = match
		end

		return match
	end

	local discordWebhookSaved = dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved

	if discordWebhookSaved and discordWebhookSaved ~= "" then
		for _, v_2 in ipairs(discordWebhookCatalog) do
			if v_2.name == discordWebhookSaved and isValidDiscordWebhook(v_2.url) then
				return v_2.url
			end
		end
	end

	return ""
end

discordWebhookOnUrlChanged = function(arg)
	local match = tostring(arg or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	local v_2 = isValidDiscordWebhook(valuestrings.discordWebhook)
	valuestrings.discordWebhook = match
	local v_3 = isValidDiscordWebhook(match)

	if v_3 and not v_2 and not discordWebhookLoading then
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function()
				sendDiscordWebhook(discordBuildEmbed({
					title = "Webhook connected",
					description = "Test message — notifications are active.",
					color = 5763719,
					skipAccount = true,
				}))
			end)
		end)
	end

	autofarmDbg("INFO", "discord", "webhook url changed", { valid = v_3, len = #match, runnings = values.runnings })

	if discordWebhookHydrated and not discordWebhookLoading then
		discordWebhookSyncActiveToDisk()
	end
end

discordWebhookApplySelection = function(discordWebhookSaved)
	if not discordWebhookSaved or discordWebhookSaved == "" then
		return
	end

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(discordWebhookCatalog) do
		if v_2.name == discordWebhookSaved then
			valuestrings.discordWebhook = v_2.url
			dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved = discordWebhookSaved
			valuestrings.discordWebhookName = discordWebhookSaved
			discordWebhookSyncNameInput(discordWebhookSaved)
			discordWebhookSyncUrlInput(v_2.url)
			return
		end
	end
end

discordWebhookPersist = function(arg)
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = discordWebhookGetActiveUrl()
	if not arg and #discordWebhookCatalog == 0 and not isValidDiscordWebhook(v_2) then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		discordWebhookEnsureDir()
		local jsonEncode = HttpService.JSONEncode

		local tbl5 = {
			selected = dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved,
			catalog = discordWebhookCatalog,
			lastUrl = v_2,
			lastName = valuestrings.discordWebhookName,
		}

		writefile(discordWebhookFilePath(), jsonEncode(HttpService, tbl5))

		autofarmDbg("INFO", "discord", "webhooks saved", {
			path = discordWebhookFilePath(),
			catalog = #discordWebhookCatalog,
			selected = dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved,
			urlLen = #v_2,
		})
	end)
end

discordWebhookSyncActiveToDisk = function()
	if not discordWebhookHydrated or discordWebhookLoading then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = discordWebhookGetActiveUrl()
	local discordWebhookSaved = dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved

	if discordWebhookSaved and discordWebhookSaved ~= "" and isValidDiscordWebhook(v_2) then
		for i, v_3 in ipairs(discordWebhookCatalog) do
			if v_3.name == discordWebhookSaved then
				discordWebhookCatalog[i].url = v_2
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if #discordWebhookCatalog > 0 or isValidDiscordWebhook(v_2) then
		discordWebhookPersist(false)
	end
end

discordWebhookLoadFromDisk = function()
	discordWebhookLoading = true
	discordWebhookCatalog = {}

	if type(readfile) ~= "function" then
		discordWebhookLoading = false
		discordWebhookHydrated = true
		return
	end

	discordWebhookMigrateLegacy()
	local v_2 = discordWebhookFilePath()

	if type(isfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(v_2) then
		discordWebhookLoading = false
		discordWebhookHydrated = true
		return
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(v_2))
	end)

	if not ok or not discordWebhookHasStoredData(result) then
		discordWebhookLoading = false
		discordWebhookHydrated = true
		return
	end

	if type(result.catalog) == "table" then
		discordWebhookCatalog = result.catalog
	end

	if result.selected and result.selected ~= "" then
		dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved = result.selected

		for _, v_3 in ipairs(discordWebhookCatalog) do
			if v_3.name == result.selected and isValidDiscordWebhook(v_3.url) then
				valuestrings.discordWebhook = v_3.url
				valuestrings.discordWebhookName = v_3.name
				dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved = v_3.name
				discordWebhookSyncNameInput(v_3.name)
				discordWebhookSyncUrlInput(v_3.url)
				discordWebhookLoading = false
				discordWebhookHydrated = true
				return
			end
		end
	end

	local match = tostring(result.lastUrl or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

	if isValidDiscordWebhook(match) then
		valuestrings.discordWebhook = match
		valuestrings.discordWebhookName = tostring(result.lastName or "")
		discordWebhookSyncNameInput(valuestrings.discordWebhookName)
		discordWebhookSyncUrlInput(match)
	end

	discordWebhookLoading = false
	discordWebhookHydrated = true
end

discordWebhookRefreshDropdown = function(arg)
	if not discordWebhookDropdown then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = discordWebhookGetDropdownNames()
	discordWebhookDropdown:Refresh(v_2)

	if arg and table.find(v_2, arg) then
		if discordWebhookDropdown.Select then
			discordWebhookDropdown:Select(arg)
		end

		discordWebhookApplySelection(arg)
	elseif #v_2 > 0 then
		if discordWebhookDropdown.Select then
			discordWebhookDropdown:Select(v_2[1])
		end

		discordWebhookApplySelection(v_2[1])
	elseif discordWebhookDropdown.Select then
		discordWebhookDropdown:Select(nil)
	end
end

discordWebhookSaveCurrent = function()
	local v_2 = discordWebhookGetInputUrl()
	if not isValidDiscordWebhook(v_2) then
		sendnotification(lc.invalidwebhook, 5)
		return
	end
	local match = tostring(valuestrings.discordWebhookName or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

	if match == "" then
		match = "Webhook " .. tostring(#discordWebhookCatalog + 1)
	end

	local flag = false

	for i, v_3 in ipairs(discordWebhookCatalog) do
		if v_3.name == match then
			discordWebhookCatalog[i].url = v_2
			flag = true
			break
		end
	end

	if not flag then
		table.insert(discordWebhookCatalog, { name = match, url = v_2 })
	end

	dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved = match
	discordWebhookPersist(true)
	discordWebhookRefreshDropdown(match)
	sendnotification(lc.discord_webhook_saved_ok, 4)
end

discordWebhookDeleteSelected = function()
	local discordWebhookSaved = dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved
	if not discordWebhookSaved or discordWebhookSaved == "" then
		sendnotification(lc.discord_webhook_pick_delete, 4)
		return
	end

	for i, v_2 in ipairs(discordWebhookCatalog) do
		if v_2.name == discordWebhookSaved then
			table.remove(discordWebhookCatalog, i)
			break
		end
	end

	dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved = nil
	discordWebhookPersist(true)
	discordWebhookRefreshDropdown(nil)
	sendnotification(lc.discord_webhook_deleted_ok, 4)
end

discordWebhookInitFromDisk = function()
