			pcall(hubAutostartConfigToggle.Set, hubAutostartConfigToggle, arg == true, false, true)
		end
	end

	hubSetAutostartEnabled = function(arg, arg2)
		local tbl10 = arg2 or {}

		if arg then
			local v_4 = selectedHubConfig

			if type(v_4) ~= "string" or v_4 == "" then
				v_4 = hubReadPersistedAutostartConfigName()
			end

			if type(v_4) ~= "string" or v_4 == "" then
				v_4 = hubReadPersistedSelectedConfigName()
			end

			if type(v_4) ~= "string" or v_4 == "" then
				values.autostartConfig = false
				hubPersistAutostartConfigName(nil)

				if not tbl10.silent then
					hubSyncAutostartToggleUi(false)
					sendnotification(lc.config_pick, 8)
				end

				return false
			end

			values.autostartConfig = true
			selectedHubConfig = v_4
			hubPersistSelectedConfigName(v_4)
			hubPersistAutostartConfigName(v_4)

			if not tbl10.silent then
				configDbg("INFO", "ui", "autostart config enabled", { name = v_4 })
			end

			return true
		end

		values.autostartConfig = false
		hubPersistAutostartConfigName(nil)

		if not tbl10.silent then
			configDbg("INFO", "ui", "autostart config disabled", {})
		end

		return true
	end

	hubBootstrapConfigOnStart = function()
		local snpHubBootId = getgenv()._SNP_HUB_BOOT_ID
		local now = os.clock()
		local exitTo = nil

		while true do
			if not (os.clock() - now < 90) then
				exitTo = 1
				break
			else
				if getgenv()._SNP_HUB_BOOT_ID == snpHubBootId then
					if getgenv()._SNP_HUB_UI_READY then
						exitTo = 1
						break
					else
						task.wait(0.2)
						continue
					end
				end

				break
			end
		end

		if exitTo == 1 then
			if not getgenv()._SNP_HUB_UI_READY then
				hubFinishBootUnlock("ui_ready_timeout")
				return
			end
			task.wait(0.85)
			if getgenv()._SNP_HUB_BOOT_ID ~= snpHubBootId then
				return
			end

			local function fn36(arg)
				if getgenv()._SNP_HUB_BOOT_ID ~= snpHubBootId then
					return
				end
				hubFinishBootUnlock(arg)
			end

			local snpAutostartConfigName = getgenv().SNP_autostartConfigName
			getgenv().SNP_autostartConfigName = nil

			if not snpAutostartConfigName or snpAutostartConfigName == "" then
				snpAutostartConfigName = hubReadPersistedAutostartConfigName()
			end

			local v_4 = snpAutostartConfigName or hubReadPersistedSelectedConfigName()
			local v_5 = hubConfigNames()

			if hubConfigDropdown and hubConfigDropdown.Refresh then
				pcall(hubConfigDropdown.Refresh, hubConfigDropdown, v_5)
			end

			if v_4 then
				selectedHubConfig = v_4

				if hubConfigDropdown then
					hubConfigDropdown.Value = v_4

					if hubConfigDropdown.Display then
						pcall(hubConfigDropdown.Display, hubConfigDropdown)
					end
				end
			end

			if snpAutostartConfigName and snpAutostartConfigName ~= "" then
				local flag3 = false

				for _, v_6 in ipairs(hubConfigNames()) do
					if v_6 == snpAutostartConfigName then
						flag3 = true
						break
					end
				end

				if flag3 then
					selectedHubConfig = snpAutostartConfigName
					values.autostartConfig = true
					dropdownval.autostartConfig = snpAutostartConfigName
					hubSyncAutostartToggleUi(true)
				else
					values.autostartConfig = false
					hubPersistAutostartConfigName(nil)
					hubSyncAutostartToggleUi(false)
					snpAutostartConfigName = nil
				end
			else
				values.autostartConfig = false
				hubSyncAutostartToggleUi(false)
			end

			if not snpAutostartConfigName or snpAutostartConfigName == "" then
				if getgenv().SNP_rejoinPendingRestore then
					task.wait(0.5)
					hubApplyAutofarmRejoinRestoreAfterLoad(nil)
				end

				fn36("no_autostart")
				return
			end

			if not isfile(hubConfigPath(snpAutostartConfigName)) then
				configDbg("WARN", "bootstrap", "autostart config missing", { name = snpAutostartConfigName })
				values.autostartConfig = false
				hubPersistAutostartConfigName(nil)
				hubSyncAutostartToggleUi(false)

				if getgenv().SNP_rejoinPendingRestore then
					task.wait(0.5)
					hubApplyAutofarmRejoinRestoreAfterLoad(nil)
				end

				fn36("autostart_missing")
				return
			end

			configDbg("INFO", "bootstrap", "autostart config loading", { name = snpAutostartConfigName })
			flushConfigLog()

			if Window and type(Window.SetLoadProgress) == "function" then
				pcall(function()
					Window:SetLoadProgress(0.92, "autoload")
				end)
			end

			if type(Window.Lock) == "function" then
				pcall(function()
					Window:Lock({
						Title = "Loading " .. (getgenv().valid == "github" and "Thunder Hub" or "SNPWARE") .. "...",
						Status = "autoload",
						Progress = true,
					})
				end)
			end

			task.wait(0.35)
			hubLoadConfig(snpAutostartConfigName)
			local now2 = os.clock()

			while hubConfigLoading and os.clock() - now2 < 180 do
				if getgenv()._SNP_HUB_BOOT_ID ~= snpHubBootId then
					return
				end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end

			task.wait(0.55)
			fn36("autoload_done")
			return
		end
	end

	hubConfigManager = function()
		return Window and Window.ConfigManager
	end

	hubConfigNames = function()
		if not listfiles or not isfolder then
			return {}
		end

		if not isfolder(HUB_CONFIG_DIR) then
			if makefolder then
				makefolder(HUB_CONFIG_DIR)
			end

			return {}
		end

		local tbl10 = {}
		local tbl11 = {}
		local v_4 = next
		local v_5, v_6 = listfiles(HUB_CONFIG_DIR)

		for _, v_7 in v_4, v_5, v_6 do
			local match = type(v_7) == "string" and v_7:match("([^\\/]+)%.json$")

			if match and hubConfigIsValidStorageName(match) then
				local v_8 = hubConfigDisplayName(match)

				if v_8 and not tbl11[v_8] then
					if isfile(HUB_CONFIG_DIR .. match .. ".json") or isfile(v_7) then
						tbl11[v_8] = true
						table.insert(tbl10, v_8)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		table.sort(tbl10)
		return tbl10
	end

	refreshHubConfigDropdown = function(arg)
		local v_4 = hubConfigNames()

		if hubConfigDropdown then
			hubConfigDropdown:Refresh(v_4)

			if arg == nil then
				arg = selectedHubConfig
			end

			if arg then
				local flag3 = false

				for _, v_5 in ipairs(v_4) do
					if v_5 == arg then
						hubConfigDropdown:Select(arg)
						selectedHubConfig = arg
						hubPersistSelectedConfigName(arg)
						flag3 = true
						break
					end
				end

				if not flag3 then
					selectedHubConfig = nil
					hubPersistSelectedConfigName(nil)

					if hubConfigDropdown.Select then
						hubConfigDropdown:Select(nil)
					end

					if values.autostartConfig then
						hubSetAutostartEnabled(false, { silent = true })
						hubSyncAutostartToggleUi(false)
					end
				end
			else
				selectedHubConfig = nil
				hubPersistSelectedConfigName(nil)

				if hubConfigDropdown.Select then
					hubConfigDropdown:Select(nil)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	CONFIG_APPLY_ORDER = { Dropdown = 1, Input = 2, Keybind = 3, Slider = 4, Colorpicker = 5, Toggle = 6 }
	CONFIG_SLIDER_RUNTIME = { espRefreshTime = "espRefreshRate", firelfyslider = "fireflywait" }
	CONFIG_SLIDER_UI_SCALE = { interval = 100, anchoredDuration = 100 }

	hubSliderRuntimeKey = function(arg)
		return CONFIG_SLIDER_RUNTIME[arg] or arg
	end

	hubSliderUiValue = function(arg, arg2)
		local num = tonumber(arg2)
		if num == nil then
			return nil
		end
		local v_4 = CONFIG_SLIDER_UI_SCALE[arg] or CONFIG_SLIDER_UI_SCALE[hubSliderRuntimeKey(arg)]
		if v_4 then
			return num * v_4
		end
		return num
	end

	hubClampToElementRange = function(arg, arg2)
		local num = tonumber(arg2)
		if num == nil then
			return nil
		end
		local v_4 = HUB_NUMERIC_RANGE[arg]
		local min, max

		if v_4 then
			min = v_4.min
			max = v_4.max
		else
			local pendingFlags = Window and Window.PendingFlags and Window.PendingFlags[arg]
			local value2 = pendingFlags and type(pendingFlags.Value) == "table" and pendingFlags.Value or nil
			min = nil
			max = nil

			if value2 then
				min = tonumber(value2.Min)
				max = tonumber(value2.Max)
			end
		end

		if not (min and max) then
			return num
		end

		if max < min then
			max = min
		end

		local n2 = math.clamp(num, min, max)

		if n2 ~= num then
			configDbg("WARN", "apply", "numeric value out of range — clamped", { flag = arg, saved = num, min = min, max = max, used = n2 })
		end

		return n2
	end

	hubApplySliderValue = function(arg, arg2)
		local num = tonumber(arg2)
		if not num then
			return nil
		end
		local v_4 = hubClampToElementRange(arg, num) or num
		local v_5 = hubSliderRuntimeKey(arg)
		local v_6 = CONFIG_SLIDER_UI_SCALE[arg] or CONFIG_SLIDER_UI_SCALE[v_5]
		local n2

		if v_6 then
			n2 = v_4 / v_6
		else
			n2 = v_4
		end

		if valueslider[v_5] ~= nil then
			valueslider[v_5] = n2
		elseif valueslider[arg] ~= nil then
			valueslider[arg] = n2
		end

		return v_4
	end

	hubConfigSkipReason = function(arg, arg2)
		if arg == "autostartConfig" or arg == "hubAutostartConfig" then
			return "autostart_not_in_config"
		end

		if hubIsPlayerTargetDropdown(arg2) then
			return "player_target_dropdown"
		end
		return nil
	end

	hubConfigLogSkip = function(phase, reason, flag3, arg)
		if not CONFIG_VERBOSE_APPLY then
			return
		end
		local tbl10 = arg or {}
		tbl10.phase = phase
		tbl10.reason = reason
		tbl10.flag = flag3
		configDbg("DEBUG", "skip", "flag skipped", tbl10)
	end

	hubConfigIsExcluded = function(arg, arg2)

	end

	if Window then
		Window.HubConfigIsExcluded = hubConfigIsExcluded
	end

	hubRegisterAllFlags = function(arg)
		if not Window or not Window.PendingFlags then
			configDbg("WARN", "register", "PendingFlags missing")
			return
		end
		local tbl10 = {}
		local n2 = 0
		local n3 = 0

		for k, pendingFlag in pairs(Window.PendingFlags) do
			local v_4 = hubConfigSkipReason(k, pendingFlag)

			if v_4 then
				n2 += 1
				tbl10[v_4] = (tbl10[v_4] or 0) + 1
				hubConfigLogSkip("register", v_4, k, { type = pendingFlag and pendingFlag.__type })
			else
				arg:Register(k, pendingFlag)
				n3 += 1
			end
		end

		configDbg("INFO", "register", "flags registered", { registered = n3, skipped = n2, skipReasons = tbl10 })
	end

	hubSyncNumericUiFromValues = function()
		if not Window or not Window.PendingFlags then
			return
		end
		local tbl10 = {}

		for k, v_4 in pairs(CONFIG_SLIDER_RUNTIME) do
			tbl10[v_4] = k
		end

		for k, v_4 in pairs(valueslider) do
			local v_5 = tbl10[k] or k
			local v_6 = Window.PendingFlags[v_5] or Window.PendingFlags[k]

			if v_6 and v_4 ~= nil then
				hubSyncSliderUi(v_6, hubSliderUiValue(v_5, v_4) or v_4)
			end
		end
	end

	hubApplyLoadedToggleCallbacks = function(arg)
		if type(arg) ~= "table" or not Window or not Window.PendingFlags then
			return
		end
		local tbl10 = { customBackground = true, customSkybox = true, customCursor = true, customGunSound = true }
		configDbg("INFO", "apply", "hubApplyLoadedToggleCallbacks begin", {})
		local tbl11 = {}

		for k, v_4 in pairs(arg) do
			if v_4 and v_4.__type == "Toggle" and v_4.value ~= nil and not tbl10[k] then
				local v_5 = Window.PendingFlags[k]

				if v_5 and v_5.Callback then
					tbl11[#tbl11 + 1] = { flag = k, el = v_5, value = v_4.value }
				end
			end
		end

		table.sort(tbl11, function(arg2, arg3)
			return tostring(arg2.flag) < tostring(arg3.flag)
		end)

		local n2 = 0

		for i, v_4 in ipairs(tbl11) do
			n2 += 1
			pcall(v_4.el.Callback, v_4.value)

			if i % 4 == 0 then
				task.wait()
			end
		end

		configDbg("INFO", "apply", "hubApplyLoadedToggleCallbacks end", { fired = n2, queued = #tbl11 })
	end

	hubSyncSliderUi = function(arg, arg2)
		if type(arg) ~= "table" or arg2 == nil then
			return
		end
		local num = tonumber(arg2)
		if not num then
			return
		end
		local value2 = type(arg.Value) == "table" and arg.Value or nil

		if not value2 then
			if arg.Set then
				pcall(arg.Set, arg, tostring(num), true, false)
			end

			local v_4 = hubFindUiTextBox(arg.UIElements)

			if v_4 then
				v_4.Text = tostring(num)
			end

			return
		end

		local n2 = tonumber(value2.Min) or 0
		local n3 = tonumber(value2.Max) or 100

		if n3 < n2 then
			n3 = n2
		end

		local default = math.clamp(num, n2, n3)
		value2.Default = default
		local uiElements = arg.UIElements

		if uiElements and uiElements.SliderIcon and uiElements.SliderIcon.Frame then
			uiElements.SliderIcon.Frame.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp((default - n2) / math.max(n3 - n2, 0.0001), 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
		end

		local v_4 = hubFindUiTextBox(uiElements)

		if v_4 then
			v_4.Text = tostring(default)
		end

		if arg.ForceValue then
			pcall(function()
				arg:ForceValue(default, true)
			end)
		elseif arg.Set then
			pcall(function()
				arg:Set(default, nil, nil, true)
			end)
		end
	end

	hubApplyLoadedConfig = function(arg, arg2)
		local tbl10 = arg2 or {}
		arg = arg and arg.__elements
		if not arg or not Window or not Window.PendingFlags then
			configDbg("WARN", "apply", "hubApplyLoadedConfig skipped", { hasElements = arg ~= nil, hasWindow = Window ~= nil, onlyType = tbl10.onlyType })
			return
		end
		local tbl11 = {}

		for k, v_4 in pairs(arg) do
			tbl11[#tbl11 + 1] = { flag = k, entry = v_4 }
		end

		table.sort(tbl11, function(arg3, arg4)
			local n2 = CONFIG_APPLY_ORDER[arg3.entry.__type] or 99
			local n3 = CONFIG_APPLY_ORDER[arg4.entry.__type] or 99
			if n2 ~= n3 then
				return n2 < n3
			end
			return tostring(arg3.flag) < tostring(arg4.flag)
		end)

		configDbg("INFO", "apply", "hubApplyLoadedConfig begin", {
			onlyType = tbl10.onlyType,
			excludeType = tbl10.excludeType,
			callbacks = tbl10.callbacks,
			elementCount = #tbl11,
		})

		local flag3 = tbl10.callbacks ~= false
		local onlyType = tbl10.onlyType
		local excludeType = tbl10.excludeType
		local n2 = 0
		local tbl12 = {}
		local n3 = 0
		local n4 = 0
		local n5 = 0

		for _, v_4 in ipairs(tbl11) do
			local flag4 = v_4.flag
			local entry = v_4.entry
			local v_5 = Window.PendingFlags[flag4]

			if not v_5 or not entry or not entry.__type then
				n4 += 1
				local str2 = not v_5 and "missing_pending_flag" or "missing_entry_type"
				tbl12[str2] = (tbl12[str2] or 0) + 1
				hubConfigLogSkip("apply", str2, flag4, { hasEl = v_5 ~= nil, entryType = entry and entry.__type, onlyType = onlyType, excludeType = excludeType })
			else
				local v_6 = hubConfigSkipReason(flag4, v_5)

				if v_6 then
					n4 += 1
					tbl12[v_6] = (tbl12[v_6] or 0) + 1
					hubConfigLogSkip("apply", v_6, flag4, { type = entry.__type, value = entry.value, onlyType = onlyType, excludeType = excludeType })
				else
					local type_ = entry.__type

					if excludeType and type_ == excludeType then
						n4 += 1
						tbl12.exclude_type_filter = (tbl12.exclude_type_filter or 0) + 1
					elseif onlyType and type_ ~= onlyType then
						n4 += 1
						tbl12.only_type_filter = (tbl12.only_type_filter or 0) + 1
					else
						local value2 = entry.value

						if CONFIG_VERBOSE_APPLY then
							configDbg("INFO", "apply", "apply element", { flag = flag4, type = type_, value = value2 })
						end

						local ok, result = pcall(function()
							n2 += 1
							n3 += 1

							if type_ == "Toggle" then
								if value2 ~= nil then
									if values[flag4] ~= nil then
										values[flag4] = value2
									end

									if v_5.Set then
										pcall(v_5.Set, v_5, value2, false, false)
									end

									if flag3 and v_5.Callback then
										if hubConfigLoading and type_ == "Toggle" then
											task.spawn(function()
												pcall(v_5.Callback, value2)
											end)
										elseif hubConfigLoading then
											pcall(v_5.Callback, value2)
										else
											task.defer(function()
												pcall(v_5.Callback, value2)
											end)
										end
									end
								end
							elseif type_ == "Dropdown" then
								if value2 ~= nil then
									local flag5 = entry.multi == true or v_5.Multi == true
									local v_7 = hubNormalizeDropdownSelection(value2, flag5)

									if not flag5 and flag4 == "language" then
										v_7 = hubLanguageCode(v_7)
									end

									local v_8 = hubSanitizeDropdownValue(flag4, v_5, v_7, flag5)

									if dropdownval[flag4] ~= nil then
										if flag5 and typeof(v_8) == "table" then
											local v_9 = dropdownval[flag4]

											if typeof(v_9) == "table" then
												table.clear(v_9)

												for i, v_10 in ipairs(v_8) do
													v_9[i] = v_10
												end

												v_8 = v_9
											else
												dropdownval[flag4] = v_8
											end
										else

										pcall(v_5.Select, v_5, v_8)

										pcall(v_5.Callback, v_8)
									end
								end

	hubDisconnectAllConns = function()
		for k, v_4 in pairs(conns) do

					for _, v_5 in pairs(v_4) do

							pcall(function()
								v_5:Disconnect()
							end)
						elseif type(v_5) == "table" then
							for _, v_6 in pairs(v_5) do
								if typeof(v_6) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
									pcall(function()
										v_6:Disconnect()
									end)
								end
							end
						end
					end

					conns[k] = {}
				elseif v_4 and typeof(v_4) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
					pcall(function()
						v_4:Disconnect()
					end)

					conns[k] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end

	hubLoadConfig = function(arg)
		if hubConfigLoading then
			configDbg("WARN", "load", "load rejected — busy", { name = arg })
			return false, lc.config_busy or "Config load already in progress"
		end
		hubConfigLoading = true
		hubConfigMuteAutofarm = true
		configDbg("INFO", "load", "load begin", { name = arg, path = hubConfigPath(arg) })

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			local v_4 = hubConfigManager()

			if not v_4 or not readfile then
				error(lc.config_fail or "ConfigManager unavailable")
			end

			local v_5 = hubConfigPath(arg)

			if not isfile(v_5) then
				error(lc.config_not_found or "Config file does not exist")
			end

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(v_5))
			end)

			if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
				error(lc.config_parse_fail or "Failed to parse config file")
			end

			local tbl10 = {}
			local n2 = 0

			if type(result.__elements) == "table" then
				for k, element in pairs(result.__elements) do
					n2 += 1

					if CONFIG_VERBOSE_APPLY then
						local n3 = #tbl10 + 1
						local str2 = tostring(k)
						local v_6 = tostring
						element = element and element.__type
						tbl10[n3] = str2 .. ":" .. v_6(element)
					end
				end

				if CONFIG_VERBOSE_APPLY then
					table.sort(tbl10)
				end
			end

			configDbg("INFO", "load", "config parsed", {
				name = arg,
				version = result.__version,
				elementCount = n2,
				hasTheme = result.__elements and result.__elements.theme ~= nil,
				hasBackground = result.__elements and result.__elements.backgroundImage ~= nil,
				hasBackgroundTrans = result.__elements and result.__elements.backgroundTransparency ~= nil,
				hasSkybox = result.__elements and result.__elements.skybox ~= nil,
				themeValue = result.__elements and result.__elements.theme and result.__elements.theme.value,
				backgroundValue = result.__elements and result.__elements.backgroundImage and result.__elements.backgroundImage.value,
				backgroundTransValue = result.__elements and result.__elements.backgroundTransparency and result.__elements.backgroundTransparency.value,
				skyboxValue = result.__elements and result.__elements.skybox and result.__elements.skybox.value,
				elements = CONFIG_VERBOSE_APPLY and table.concat(tbl10, ", ") or nil,
			})

			flushConfigLog()
			local v_6, v_7 = v_4:CreateConfig(hubConfigStorageName(arg))

			if type(v_6) ~= "table" then
				error(tostring(v_7 or "CreateConfig failed"))
			end

			hubResetBeforeConfigLoad()
			hubRegisterAllFlags(v_6)
			hubStripPlayerTargetsFromConfigElements(result.__elements)
			hubCaptureConfigToggleValues(result.__elements)

			if type(result.__elements) == "table" then
				result.__elements.autostartConfig = nil
				result.__elements.hubAutostartConfig = nil

				for k, element in pairs(result.__elements) do
					if not Window.PendingFlags[k] then
						hubConfigLogSkip("load", "orphan_json_flag", k, { type = element and element.__type, value = element and element.value })
					end
				end
			end

			hubButtonsLoadFromConfigData(result)
			hubConfigApplyGen = hubConfigApplyGen + 1
			local v_8 = hubConfigApplyGen

			task.defer(function()
				local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
					local flag3 = v_8 ~= hubConfigApplyGen

					if not flag3 then
						hubApplyLoadedConfig(result, { excludeType = "Toggle", callbacks = false })
						task.wait()
						hubPreferCdnPickerSelections(result.__elements)
						task.wait()
						hubApplyLoadedConfig(result, { onlyType = "Toggle", callbacks = false })
						task.wait(0.25)
						flag3 = v_8 ~= hubConfigApplyGen
					end

					if not flag3 then
						hubApplyLoadedConfig(result, { onlyType = "Slider", callbacks = false })
						task.wait()
						hubApplyLoadedConfig(result, { onlyType = "Input", callbacks = false })
						task.wait()
						hubSyncNumericUiFromValues()
						hubPreferCdnPickerSelections(result.__elements)
						task.wait()
						hubApplyLoadedToggleCallbacks(result.__elements)
						task.wait(0.15)
						hubButtonsApplyUiFromParams()
						hubRefreshTargetDropdowns(true)
						task.wait()
						hubFinalizeConfigApply()
						hubApplyAutofarmRejoinRestoreAfterLoad(result)
					end

					hubRangePreviewHide()
				end)

				if not ok2 then
					configDbg("ERROR", "load", "load defer failed", { name = arg, err = tostring(result2) })
				end

				if v_8 == hubConfigApplyGen then
					hubConfigLoading = false
					hubConfigMuteAutofarm = false
					pcall(hubFlushPendingAutofarmEnable, "load_complete")

					if ok2 then
						configDbg("INFO", "load", "load complete", {
							name = arg,
							theme = dropdownval.theme,
							backgroundImage = dropdownval.backgroundImage,
							backgroundTransparency = valueslider.backgroundTransparency,
							skybox = dropdownval.skybox,
							runnings = values.runnings,
							pendingFarmFlushed = values.runnings,
						})

						pcall(hubLogCombatState, "config_" .. tostring(arg))
						pcall(hubInstallUserActionLogging, "config_load")
					end

					flushConfigLog()

					if ok2 then
						task.spawn(function()
							local function fn36()
								return v_8 ~= hubConfigApplyGen
							end

							task.wait(1.35)

							if not fn36() and type(hubApplyHubAppearance) == "function" then
								pcall(hubApplyHubAppearance, "autoload_deferred")
							end

							task.wait(0.25)

							if not fn36() and values.customSkybox and dropdownval.skybox and type(ApplySkybox) == "function" then
								pcall(ApplySkybox, dropdownval.skybox)
							end

							task.wait(0.2)
							local pendingFlags = Window and Window.PendingFlags

							for _, v_9 in ipairs({ "customCursor", "customGunSound" }) do
								if not fn36() and values[v_9] and pendingFlags and pendingFlags[v_9] and pendingFlags[v_9].Callback then
									pcall(pendingFlags[v_9].Callback, true)
									task.wait(0.15)
								end
							end

							pcall(hubFlushPendingAutofarmEnable, "autoload_deferred")
						end)
					end
				end
			end)

			hubConfigFile = v_6
		end)

		if not ok then
			hubConfigLoading = false
			hubConfigMuteAutofarm = false
			pcall(hubFlushPendingAutofarmEnable, "load_failed")
			configDbg("ERROR", "load", "load failed", { name = arg, err = tostring(result) })
			return false, tostring(result)
		end

		configDbg("INFO", "load", "load scheduled", { name = arg })
		return true
	end

		Callback = function()
			if not hubConfigManager() or not readfile then
				configDbg("ERROR", "load", "ConfigManager unavailable (ui)")

				return
			end

			local v_5 = selectedHubConfig

				return
			end

			local v_6, v_7 = hubLoadConfig(v_5)

			if v_6 then
				sendnotification(lc.config_loaded, 6)
			else
				sendnotification(tostring(v_7 or lc.config_fail), 8)
			end
		end,
	})

	updateScrollThumb = function()
		local y = scrollingFrame.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y
		local y2 = scrollingFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y
		local y3 = frame2.AbsoluteSize.Y

		if y2 <= 0 or y3 <= 0 or y <= y2 then
			frame2.Visible = false
			frame3.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
			frame3.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
			return
		end

		frame2.Visible = true
		local n8 = math.clamp(math.floor(y2 / y * y3), 24, y3)
		local n9 = math.max(0, y - y2)
		local n10 = n9 > 0 and scrollingFrame.CanvasPosition.Y / n9 or 0
		local n11 = math.floor(math.max(0, y3 - n8) * math.clamp(n10, 0, 1))
		frame3.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, n8)
		frame3.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, n11)
	end

	setScrollFromThumb = function(arg)
		local y = scrollingFrame.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y
		local y2 = scrollingFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y
		local n8 = math.max(0, frame2.AbsoluteSize.Y - frame3.AbsoluteSize.Y)
		local n9 = math.max(0, y - y2)
		if n8 <= 0 or n9 <= 0 then
			scrollingFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
			return
		end
		scrollingFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.floor(n9 * math.clamp(arg / n8, 0, 1)))
	end

		local n14 = math.max(0, y - y2)

	fn20 = function(arg, arg2)
		if arg2 ~= nil then
			n9 = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(arg2) or 1))
		end

		if arg == nil then
			arg = true
		end

		search = fn28()

		if arg then
			for _, child in ipairs(scrollingFrame2:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("TextLabel") then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end

			local textLabel5 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			textLabel5.Name = "ServerListLoading"
			textLabel5.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
			textLabel5.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			textLabel5.Text = "Loading servers..."
			textLabel5.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
			textLabel5.TextSize = 13
			textLabel5.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			textLabel5.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
			textLabel5.Parent = scrollingFrame2
			fn23()
		end

		if not (flag and v_4) then
			if arg then
				task.delay(1.5, function()
					if flag8 then
						fn20(true)
					end
				end)
			end

			return
		end

		if not pcall(function()
			local tbl7 = { type = "get_servers", page = n9, pageSize = n8, myJobId = tostring(getgenv().haha or "") }

			if search ~= "" then
				tbl7.search = search
			end

			v_4:Send(HttpService:JSONEncode(tbl7))
		end) then
			fn27("Failed to request server list")
			return
		end

		if arg then
			n += 1
			local v_12 = n

			task.delay(8, function()
				if n ~= v_12 or not flag8 then
					return
				end

				if scrollingFrame2:FindFirstChild("ServerListLoading") then
					fn27("Server list timeout.\nTap to refresh.")
				end
			end)
		end
	end

				fakeDual = conns and fn17(conns.fakeDualKnifePacks) or 0,
				webhookQ = fn18(discordWebhookQueue),
				notifs = fn18(activeNotifications),
				hubCtrls = fn17(hubButtonControllers),
			},
			flags = {
				traceMax = AUTOFARM_TRACE_MAX == true,
				appendfile = type(appendfile) == "function",
				writefile = type(writefile) == "function",
				getfilesize = type(getfilesize) == "function",
				afHooks = autofarmTraceHooksInstalled == true,
				afEye = autofarmGameplayEyeInstalled == true,
				afTick = tonumber(autofarmLoopTick) or 0,
				afCoins = tonumber(autofarmCoinCollectCount) or 0,
				farmType = type(dropdownval) == "table" and dropdownval.farmType or nil,
				coinPick = type(dropdownval) == "table" and dropdownval.coinPickMode or nil,
				status1 = tostring(status1 or ""),
				fullbag = fullbag == true,
				startround = startround == true,
				roundend = roundend == true,
			},
			files = { memdiag = fn20(str2) },
			cache = {
				customAssets = fn17(customAssetLocalCache),
				adminMedia = fn17(tbl5),
				skins = fn17(CapturedSkins) + fn17(_G and _G.CapturedSkins),
			},
		}

		if arg then
			tbl6.inst = fn22()
		end

		local v_11 = nil

		if HttpService then
			local ok, result = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, tbl6)
			local v_12 = nil

			if ok then
				v_11 = result
			else
				v_11 = v_12
			end
		end

		fn21(v_11 or string.format("{\"t\":%d,\"luaMb\":%.1f,\"tick\":%d,\"ex\":%q}", tbl6.t, tbl6.luaMb, tbl6.tick, tostring(tbl6.ex)))

		if n3 == 1 or n5 and math.abs(n5) >= 20 then
			print(string.format("[MEM_DIAG] t=%ds luaMb=%.1f d=%.1f tick=%d on=%d adorns=%d espObj=%d knife=%d conn=%d", tbl6.t, tbl6.luaMb, n5 or 0, tbl6.tick, tbl6.onN or 0, tbl6.buf.adorns, tbl6.buf.espObj, tbl6.buf.knifeDraw, tbl6.connN or 0))
		end

		return tbl6
	end

	getgenv().SNP_memDiagNow = function(arg)
		return fn28(arg ~= false)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(8)
		if not snpDebugLogsEnabled() then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			if type(ensureSnpLogDir) == "function" then
				ensureSnpLogDir()
			end

			if type(writefile) == "function" then
				writefile(str2, "")
			end
		end)

		print("[MEM_DIAG] started → " .. str2 .. " every " .. n .. "s")
		fn28(true)

		while true do
			task.wait(45)

			if not snpDebugLogsEnabled() then
				break
			else
				fn28(n3 % 5 == 4)
			end
		end
	end)
end
